stories.story_chinese:
在一个温暖的下午，东先生决定举办一个特别的聚会。
他想邀请所有姓氏很特别的朋友们来到家里。
首先来的客人们是中先生和也先生。
他们两个在门口相遇，一起走了进来。
接着，元先生和别先生也到了，他们带来了很多水果。
后先生和国先生在花园里聊天，讨论着天气。
坐先生和左先生在沙发上休息，他们是好朋友。
常先生和年先生在厨房里帮东先生准备茶水。
教先生是一个老师，他给每个人介绍自己的故事。
新先生来自很远的地方，他带来了很多有趣的新闻。
楼先生和毛先生在讨论房子的设计，他们都很专业。
水先生和能先生在谈论如何保护环境。
花先生带来了美丽的鲜花，让房间变得很香。
路先生和车先生在讨论最近的交通情况。
过先生和还先生在分享他们去旅行的经历。
那先生和都先生在谈论不同城市的文化。
钱先生和错先生在玩一个关于数字的小游戏。
门先生和高先生最后才到达，因为他们迷路了。
东先生看着房间里这么多不同姓氏的人，感到很开心。
他说：“虽然我们的姓氏各不相同，但我们都是好朋友。”
大家一起坐下来，开心地聊天，吃点心。
这个聚会充满了笑声和温暖。
每个人都觉得这个下午非常特别。
他们约定明年这个时候再见面。
这种特别的友谊让大家感到很幸福。
太阳慢慢落下，窗外变得安静了。
客人们一个个告别，走在回家的路上。
东先生关上门，心中充满了喜悦。

stories.story_pinyin:
Zài yī gè wēn nuǎn de xià wǔ, Dōng xiān sheng jué dìng jǔ bàn yī gè tè bié de jù huì.
Tā xiǎng yāo qǐng suǒ yǒu xìng shì hěn tè bié de péng yǒu men lái dào jiā lǐ.
Shǒu xiān lái de kè rén men shì Zhōng xiān sheng hé Yě xiān sheng.
Tā men liǎng gè zài mén kǒu xiāng yù, yī qǐ zǒu le jìn lái.
Jiē zhe, Yuán xiān sheng hé Bié xiān sheng yě dào le, tā men dài lái le hěn duō shuǐ guǒ.
Hòu xiān sheng hé Guó xiān sheng zài huā yuán lǐ liáo tiān, tǎo lùn zhe tiān qì.
Zuò xiān sheng hé Zuǒ xiān sheng zài shā fā shàng xiū xī, tā men shì hǎo péng yǒu.
Cháng xiān sheng hé Nián xiān sheng zài chú fáng lǐ bāng Dōng xiān sheng zhǔn bèi chá shuǐ.
Jiào xiān sheng shì yī gè lǎo shī, tā gěi měi gè rén jiè shào zì jǐ de gù shì.
Xīn xiān sheng lái zì hěn yuǎn de dì fang, tā dài lái le hěn duō yǒu qù de xīn wén.
Lóu xiān sheng hé Máo xiān sheng zài tǎo lùn fáng zi de shè jì, tā men dōu hěn zhuān yè.
Shuǐ xiān sheng hé Néng xiān sheng zài tán lùn rú hé bǎo hù huán jìng.
Huā xiān sheng dài lái le měi lì de xiān huā, ràng fáng jiān biàn de hěn xiāng.
Lù xiān sheng hé Chē xiān sheng zài tǎo lùn zuì jìn de jiāo tōng qíng kuàng.
Guō xiān sheng hé Huán xiān sheng zài fēn xiǎng tā men qù lǚ xíng de jīng lì.
Nā xiān sheng hé Dū xiān sheng zài tán lùn bù tóng chéng shì de wén huà.
Qián xiān sheng hé Cuò xiān sheng zài wán yī gè guān yú shù zì de xiǎo yóu xì.
Mén xiān sheng hé Gāo xiān sheng zuì hòu cái dào dá, yīn wèi tā men mí lù le.
Dōng xiān sheng kàn zhe fáng jiān lǐ zhè me duō bù tóng xìng shì de rén, gǎn dào hěn kāi xīn.
Tā shuō: “Suī rán wǒ men de xìng shì gè bù xiāng tóng, dàn wǒ men dōu shì hǎo péng yǒu.”
Dà jiā yī qǐ zuò xià lái, kāi xīn de liáo tiān, chī diǎn xin.
Zhè gè jù huì chōng mǎn le xiào shēng hé wēn nuǎn.
Měi gè rén dōu jué de zhè gè xià wǔ fēi cháng tè bié.
Tā men yuē dìng míng nián zhè gè shí hou zài jiàn miàn.
Zhè zhǒng tè bié de yǒu yì ràng dà jiā gǎn dào hěn xìng fú.
Tài yáng màn màn luò xià, chuāng wài biàn de ā n jìng le.
Kè rén men yī gè yī gè gào bié, zǒu zài huí jiā de lù shàng.
Dōng xiān sheng guān shàng mén, xīn zhōng chōng mǎn le xǐ yuè.

stories.story_english:
On a warm afternoon, Mr. Dong decided to hold a special gathering.
He wanted to invite all his friends with very unique surnames to his home.
The first guests to arrive were Mr. Zhong and Mr. Ye.
The two of them met at the door and walked in together.
Then, Mr. Yuan and Mr. Bie arrived, bringing lots of fruit.
Mr. Hou and Mr. Guo chatted in the garden, discussing the weather.
Mr. Zuo (sitting) and Mr. Zuo (left) rested on the sofa; they are good friends.
Mr. Chang and Mr. Nian helped Mr. Dong prepare tea in the kitchen.
Mr. Jiao is a teacher, and he introduced his story to everyone.
Mr. Xin came from a far-off place and brought many interesting news items.
Mr. Lou and Mr. Mao discussed the design of the house; they are both very professional.
Mr. Shui and Mr. Neng discussed how to protect the environment.
Mr. Hua brought beautiful fresh flowers, making the room very fragrant.
Mr. Lu and Mr. Che discussed the recent traffic situation.
Mr. Guo (passed) and Mr. Huan shared their travel experiences.
Mr. Na and Mr. Du discussed the cultures of different cities.
Mr. Qian and Mr. Cuo played a small game involving numbers.
Mr. Men and Mr. Gao arrived last because they got lost.
Mr. Dong felt very happy seeing so many people with different surnames in the room.
He said, "Although our surnames are all different, we are all good friends."
Everyone sat down together, chatting happily and eating snacks.
This gathering was full of laughter and warmth.
Everyone felt that this afternoon was very special.
They agreed to meet again at this time next year.
This special friendship made everyone feel very happy.
The sun slowly set, and it became quiet outside the window.
The guests said goodbye one by one and walked on the road home.
Mr. Dong closed the door, his heart full of joy.

stories.story_chinese:
今天是大卫的生日。
小明想送他一个礼物，但是他口袋里没有钱。
他看了一下钱包，里面是零元。
小明很担心，他觉得没什么可以送的。
他问老师：“老师，我没准备礼物，没关系吗？”
老师笑了，说：“没事儿，心意最重要。”
小明决定给大卫画一张画。
大卫收到画后非常开心，对小明说：“谢谢你！”
小明不好意思地说：“不客气。”
大卫想给小明买饮料，但小明说：“不用，谢谢。”
在这个温暖的下午，小明发现最好的礼物没花钱。

stories.story_pinyin:
Jīntiān shì Dàwèi de shēngrì.
Xiǎomíng xiǎng sòng tā yígè lǐwù, dànshì tā kǒudài lǐ méiyǒu qián.
Tā kàn le yíxià qiánbāo, lǐmiàn shì líng yuán.
Xiǎomíng hěn dānxīn, tā juéde méishénme kěyǐ sòng de.
Tā wèn lǎoshī: “Lǎoshī, wǒ méi zhǔnbèi lǐwù, méiguānxì ma?”
Lǎoshī xiào le, shuō: “Méishìr, xīnyì zuì zhòngyào.”
Xiǎomíng juédìng gěi Dàwèi huà yì zhāng huà.
Dàwèi shōudào huà hòu fēicháng kāixīn, duì Xiǎomíng shuō: “Xièxie nǐ!”
Xiǎomíng bù hǎoyìsi de shuō: “Bú kèqi.”
Dàwèi xiǎng gěi Xiǎomíng mǎi yǐnliào, dàn Xiǎomíng shuō: “Búyòng, xièxie.”
Zài zhège wēnnuǎn de xiàwǔ, Xiǎomíng fāxiàn zuì hǎo de lǐwù méi huā qián.

stories.story_english:
Today is David's birthday.
Xiao Ming wanted to give him a gift, but he had no money in his pocket.
He looked at his wallet; there were zero yuan inside.
Xiao Ming was worried; he felt there was nothing he could give.
He asked the teacher, "Teacher, I haven't prepared a gift, is it okay?"
The teacher smiled and said, "It's nothing, the thought is what matters most."
Xiao Ming decided to draw a picture for David.
After receiving the drawing, David was very happy and said to Xiao Ming, "Thank you!"
Xiao Ming said shyly, "You're welcome."
David wanted to buy a drink for Xiao Ming, but Xiao Ming said, "No need, thank you."
On this warm afternoon, Xiao Ming discovered that the best gifts don't cost money.

stories.story_chinese:
大卫是一名老师，他很喜欢写字。
现在学校放假了，他想回家看他的母亲。
大卫记得他的母亲住在个小城市。
他准备开车去那里。
在路上，天突然下雨了。
大卫看到路边有一只小狗在跑。
小狗看起来生病了，它很累。
大卫决定把小狗接进来，让它在车里休息。
大卫开车到了小城市，然后回到家门口。
他听到屋子里有声音，他听见母亲在唱歌。
母亲唱的歌非常好听。
大卫走进屋子，母亲说：“快进来！”
母亲笑着说：“请进，请坐！”
大卫坐下后，告诉母亲他找到了一只小狗。
他把小狗放进去，让它在温暖的房间里睡一会儿。
大卫想，小狗现在可以好好睡觉了。
第二天，大卫想出去走走。
他看到一只小鸟在天上飞。
大卫突然忘记了带雨伞，他又得跑回去拿。
这时，他的朋友王先生打电话给他。
王先生说他不能来，因为他需要请假。
大卫说：“没关系，你休息吧。”
大卫陪着母亲和小狗在家里聊天。
他告诉母亲，他很开心能回来。
母亲问他什么时候回去工作。
大卫说他还没决定，他想在这里多住几天。
他看着窗外，觉得生活很美好。
他想给朋友写一封信，告诉他们这里的风景。
小狗现在好了，它能跳起来了。
大卫决定以后每天开车带小狗出去玩。
当他准备上车的时候，小狗在后面叫。
大卫笑着下车，抱起小狗。
他们一起在阳光下快乐地走着。

stories.story_english:
David is a teacher, and he likes writing very much.
Now that school is on holiday, he wants to return home to see his mother.
David remembers that his mother lives in a small city.
He prepares to drive a car there.
On the way, it suddenly started to rain.
David saw a little dog running by the roadside.
The little dog looked ill and was very tired.
David decided to bring the little dog in and let it rest in the car.
David drove to the small city and then returned to the doorstep of his home.
He heard a sound inside the house; he heard his mother singing.
The song his mother sang was very pleasant to hear.
David walked into the house, and his mother said, "Come in quickly!"
His mother said with a smile, "Please come in, please have a seat!"
After David sat down, he told his mother that he had found a little dog.
He put the little dog inside to let it sleep for a while in the warm room.
David thought that the little dog could now have a good sleep.
The next day, David wanted to go out for a walk.
He saw a little bird flying in the sky.
David suddenly forgot to bring his umbrella, so he had to run back to get it.
At this time, his friend Mr. Wang made a telephone call to him.
Mr. Wang said he couldn't come because he needed to request leave.
David said, "It's okay, please rest."
David chatted with his mother and the little dog at home.
He told his mother that he was very happy to have come back.
His mother asked him when he would go back to work.
David said he hadn't decided yet; he wanted to stay here for a few more days.
He looked out the window and felt that life was very beautiful.
He wanted to write a letter to his friends to tell them about the scenery here.
The little dog is better now; it can jump up.
David decided to drive the little dog out to play every day from now on.
When he was preparing to get in the car, the little dog barked from behind.
David smiled and got out of the car to pick up the little dog.
They walked happily together in the sunshine.

stories.story_chinese:
王小明是一个可爱的小孩子。
他现在是一名小学生，在市中心的一所小学读书。
每天早上，他从舒服的床上面起来。
他背上蓝色的书包，开心地准备去上学。
在学校的教学楼前，他见到了他的好同学小红。
小红是一个很聪明的女生，而小明是一个活泼的男生。
他们一起走进教室，准备上第一节课。
他们的老师姓李，大家都叫他李先生。
李先生告诉学生们，学习非常重要。
小明想，他以后想成为一名中学生，然后成为一名大学生。
他希望有一天能进入著名的艺术学院学习绘画。
在学校里，每个等级的等候区都有很多不同年龄的学生。
无论小学生还是大孩子，大家都热爱读书。
时间过得很快，终于到了放学的时间。
小明走出校门，看到父亲在等他。
父亲看着这个聪明的小子，脸上露出了笑容。
小明兴奋地分享今天在学校发生的事情。
他觉得学习新知识是一件快乐的事情。
他期待着明天的校园生活。

Wáng Xiǎomíng shì yí gè kě ài de xiǎo hái zi.
Tā xiàn zài shì yì míng xiǎo xué shēng, zài shì zhōng xīn de yì suǒ xiǎo xué dú shū.
Měi tiān zǎo shang, tā cóng shū fu de chuáng shàng miàn qǐ lái.
Tā bēi shàng lán sè de shū bāo, kāi xīn de zhǔn bèi qù shàng xué.
Zài xué xiào de jiào xué lóu qián, tā jiàn dào le tā de hǎo tóng xué Xiǎo Hóng.
Xiǎo Hóng shì yí gè hěn cōng míng de nǚ shēng, ér Xiǎo míng shì yí gè huó pō de nán shēng.
Tā men yì qǐ zǒu jìn jiào shì, zhǔn bèi shàng dì yī jié kè.
Tā men de lǎo shī xìng Lǐ, dà jiā dōu jiào tā Lǐ xiān sheng.
Lǐ xiān sheng gào su xué sheng men, xué xí fēi cháng zhòng yào.
Xiǎo míng xiǎng, tā yǐ hòu xiǎng chéng wéi yì míng zhōng xué shēng, rán hòu chéng wéi yì míng dà xué shēng.
Tā xī wàng yǒu yì tiān néng jìn rù zhù míng de yì shù xué yuàn xué xí huì huà.
Zài xué xiào lǐ, měi gè děng jí de děng hòu qū dōu yǒu hěn duō bù tóng nián líng de xué sheng.
Wú lùn xiǎo xué shēng hái shì dà hái zi, dà jiā dōu rè ài dú shū.
Shí jiān guò de hěn kuài, zhōng yú dào le fàng xué de shí jiān.
Xiǎo míng zǒu chū xiào mén, kàn dào fù qīn zài děng tā.
Fù qīn kàn zhe zhè gè cōng míng de xiǎo zǐ, liǎn shàng lù chū le xiào róng.
Xiǎo míng xìng fèn de fēn xiǎng jīn tiān zài xué xiào fā shēng de shì qing.
Tā jué de xué xí xīn zhī shi shì yí jiàn kuài lè de shì qing.
Tā qī dài zhe míng tiān de xiào yuán shēng huó.

stories.story_english:
Wang Xiaoming is a cute little child.
He is currently a primary school student, studying at a primary school in the city center.
Every morning, he gets up from his comfortable bed.
He puts on his blue schoolbag and happily prepares to go to school.
In front of the school building, he meets his good classmate Xiao Hong.
Xiao Hong is a very clever girl, while Xiaoming is a lively boy.
They walk into the classroom together, preparing for the first class.
Their teacher's surname is Li, and everyone calls him Mr. Li.
Mr. Li tells the students that learning is very important.
Xiaoming thinks that he wants to become a middle-school student in the future, and then a university student.
He hopes that one day he can enter a famous arts college to study painting.
In the school, there are many students of different ages in each grade's waiting area.
Whether they are primary school students or older children, everyone loves reading.
Time passes quickly, and finally, it is time for school to be dismissed.
Xiaoming walks out of the school gate and sees his father waiting for him.
Looking at this clever son, the father has a smile on his face.
Xiaoming excitedly shares what happened at school today.
He feels that learning new knowledge is a happy thing.
He looks forward to tomorrow's campus life.

stories.story_chinese:
大卫是一个来自美国的学生。
他现在在中国学习。
他住在北京，这里的学校很大。
大卫在一家中学学习汉语。
他的老师是一个很亲切的人。
有一天，大卫发现他的课本丢了。
他很着急，因为明天有中文课。
他先去了学校的图书馆找书。
但是，图书馆里没有他的书。
于是，他跑到了学校外面的书店。
他在书店买了一本新的课本。
回到家后，他认真地阅读课文。
大卫希望以后能去一家著名的大学学习。

David is a student from America.
He is currently studying in China.
He lives in Beijing, and the school here is very large.
David is studying Chinese in a middle school.
His teacher is a very kind person.
One day, David discovered that his textbook was lost.
He was very anxious because he had a Chinese class tomorrow.
He first went to the school library to look for the book.
However, his book was not in the library.
So, he ran to the bookstore outside the school.
He bought a new textbook at the bookstore.
After returning home, he carefully read the text.
David hopes to study at a famous university in the future.

stories.story_chinese:
大卫是一个来自美国这个国家的男人。
他现在在中国学习写汉字。
今天是一个特别的月，因为他的妈妈要来中国看他。
大卫住在北京的一座房子里。
他的桌子上放着一个杯子和一本汉语书。
大卫在用电脑准备迎接妈妈。
突然，他发现了一件很重要的事情。
他找不到去机场的机票了！
他赶紧拿起手机，给爸爸打电话。
“爸爸，我的机票不见了！”大卫很紧张。
爸爸在电话里说：“别担心，看看你的电视机旁边。”
大卫跑过去，发现机票就在电视机下面。
他松了一口气，现在是下午三点。
他得赶紧出门，因为去机场的汽车很快就来了。
大卫走出家门，走在宽阔的路上。
他先去了一家商店买了一些水果。
然后他去了一个很大的商场买了一件女衣服送给妈妈。
在商场里，他遇到了一个认识的人。
那个人问他的名字，大卫告诉了他自己的名字。
大卫问那个人的地点在哪里，对方说在电影院旁边。
大卫想，以后可以带妈妈去那个电影院看电影。
在商场里，大卫觉得有点累，于是去了洗手间洗了洗脸。
他走出洗手间，看到一个小男孩在玩球。
大卫想起爸爸也喜欢玩球。
他再次检查手机，确认了机场的时间。
他坐上汽车，看着窗外的风景。
他想，妈妈一定会喜欢这个城市的。
到了机场，他看到了妈妈的身影。
妈妈笑着说：“我的儿子长大了！”
大卫开心地抱住了妈妈。
他们一起回到了家。
晚上，大卫和妈妈一起吃了晚饭。
他们坐在电视前，看着电视上的新闻。
这是一个温暖的夜晚。

stories.story_pinyin:
Dà wèi shì yí gè lái zì Měi guó zhè gè guó jiā de nán rén.
Tā xiàn zài zài Zhōng guó xué xí xiě hàn zì.
Jīn tiān shì yí gè tè bié de yuè, yīn wèi tā de mā ma yào lái Zhōng guó kàn tā.
Dà wèi zhù zài Běi jīng de yí zuò fáng zi lǐ.
Tā de zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe yí gè bēi zi hé yì běn hàn yǔ shū.
Dà wèi zài yòng diàn nǎo zhǔn bèi yíng jiē mā ma.
Tū rán, tā fā xiàn le yí jiàn hěn zhòng yào de shì qing.
Tā zhǎo bú dào qù jī chǎng de jī piào le!
Tā gǎn jǐn ná qǐ shǒu jī, gěi bà ba dǎ diàn huà.
“Bà ba, wǒ de jī piào bú jiàn le!” Dà wèi hěn jǐn zhāng.
Bà ba zài diàn huà lǐ shuō: “Bié dān xīn, kàn kàn nǐ de diàn shì jī páng biān.”
Dà wèi pǎo guò qù, fā xiàn jī piào jiù zài diàn shì jī xià miàn.
Tā sōng le yì kǒu qì, xiàn zài shì xià wǔ sān diǎn.
Tā děi gǎn jǐn chū mén, yīn wèi qù jī chǎng de qì chē hěn kuài jiù lái le.
Dà wèi zǒu chū jiā mén, zǒu zài kuān kuò de lù shang.
Tā xiān qù le yì jiā shāng diàn mǎi le yì xiē shuǐ guǒ.
 rán hòu tā qù le yí gè hěn dà de shāng chǎng mǎi le yí jiàn nǚ yī fu sòng gěi mā ma.
Zài shāng chǎng lǐ, tā yù dào le yí gè rèn shi de rén.
Nà gè rén wèn tā de míng zi, Dà wèi gào su le tā zì jǐ de míng zi.
Dà wèi wèn nà gè rén de dì diǎn zài nǎ lǐ, duì fāng shuō zài diàn yǐng yuàn páng biān.
Dà wèi xiǎng, yǐ hòu kě yǐ dài mā ma qù nà gè diàn yǐng yuàn kàn diàn yǐng.
Zài shāng chǎng lǐ, Dà wèi jué de yǒu diǎn lèi, yú shì qù le xǐ shǒu jiān xǐ le xǐ liǎn.
Tā zǒu chū xǐ shǒu jiān, kàn dào yí gè xiǎo nán hái zài wán qiú.
Dà wèi xiǎng qǐ bà ba yě xǐ huan wán qiú.
Tā zài cì jiǎn chá shǒu jī, què rèn le jī chǎng de shí jiān.
Tā zuò shàng qì chē, kàn zhe chuāng wài de fēng jǐng.
Tā xiǎng, mā ma yí dìng huì xǐ huan zhè gè chéng shì de.
Dào le jī chǎng, tā kàn dào le mā ma de shēn yǐng.
Mā ma xiào zhe shuō: “Wǒ de ér zi zhǎng dà le!”
Dà wèi kāi xīn de bào zhù le mā ma.
Tā men yì qǐ huí dào le jiā.
Wǎn shang, Dà wèi hé mā ma yì qǐ chī le wǎn fàn.
Tā men zuò zài diàn shì qián, kàn zhe diàn shì shàng de xīn wén.
Zhè shì yí gè wēn nuǎn de yè wǎn.

stories.story_english:
David is a man from the country of the United States.
He is currently in China learning to write Chinese characters.
Today is a special month because his mother is coming to China to visit him.
David lives in a house in Beijing.
On his table, there is a cup and a Chinese textbook.
David is using his computer to prepare for his mother's arrival.
Suddenly, he discovered a very important matter.
He couldn't find the plane ticket to the airport!
He quickly picked up his cell phone and called his father.
"Dad, my ticket is gone!" David was very nervous.
Dad said over the phone, "Don't worry, look next to your television set."
David ran over and found the ticket right under the television set.
He breathed a sigh of relief; it was 3 o'clock in the afternoon.
He had to leave quickly because the car to the airport would arrive soon.
David walked out of the house and walked on the wide road.
First, he went to a shop to buy some fruit.
Then he went to a large shopping mall to buy a woman's piece of clothing for his mother.
In the mall, he met someone he knew.
That person asked for his name, and David told him his name.
David asked where the other person's location was, and the other person said it was next to the cinema.
David thought that he could take his mother to that cinema to watch a movie in the future.
In the mall, David felt a bit tired, so he went to the washroom to wash his face.
Walking out of the washroom, he saw a little boy playing with a ball.
David remembered that his dad also likes playing with balls.
He checked his phone again to confirm the airport time.
He got in the car and looked at the scenery outside the window.
He thought that his mother would definitely like this city.
Arriving at the airport, he saw his mother's figure.
Mom said with a smile, "My son has grown up!"
David happily hugged his mother.
They went home together.
In the evening, David and his mother had dinner together.
They sat in front of the TV, watching the news on the television.
It was a warm night.

stories.story_chinese:
王先生今天很忙。
他在马路上走，想去车站买车票。
在路口，他突然发现自己的钱包不见了。
他很担心，因为钱包里有他的票。
他在路上走来走去，寻找丢失的东西。
这时，他的手机响了，是一个朋友在说话。
朋友问他：“你在哪里？”
王先生说：“我在车站门口。”
朋友说：“我在饭店等你，我们一起吃饭吧。”
王先生很高兴，走进了那家饭店。
饭店里的人排成了一行。
他点了一些菜，有肉和鸡蛋。
他还点了一杯热茶。
吃完饭后，服务员告诉他，他在门口找到了钱包。
钱包里除了钱，还有一张电影门票。
王先生笑着说：“太好了！”
他现在可以愉快地回家了。

stories.story_pinyin:
Wáng xiān sheng jīn tiān hěn máng.
Tā zài mǎ lù shang zǒu, xiǎng qù chē zhàn mǎi chē piào.
Zài lù kǒu, tā tū rán fā xiàn zì jǐ de qián bāo bù jiàn le.
Tā hěn dān xīn, yīn wèi qián bāo lǐ yǒu tā de piào.
Tā zài lù shang zǒu lái zǒu qù, xún zhǎo diū shī de dōng xi.
Zhè shí, tā de shǒu jī xiǎng le, shì yí gè péng you zài shuō huà.
Péng you wèn tā: “Nǐ zài nǎ lǐ?”
Wáng xiān sheng shuō: “Wǒ zài chē zhàn mén kǒu.”
Péng you shuō: “Wǒ zài fàn diàn děng nǐ, wǒ men yì qǐ chī fàn ba.”
Wáng xiān sheng hěn gāo xìng, zǒu jìn le nà jiā fàn diàn.
Fàn diàn lǐ de rén pái chéng le yì háng.
Tā diǎn le yì xiē cài, yǒu ròu hé jī dàn.
Tā hái diǎn le yì bēi rè chá.
Chī wán fàn hòu, fú wù yuán gào su tā, tā zài mén kǒu zhǎo dào le qián bāo.
Qián bāo lǐ chú le qián, hái yǒu yì zhāng diàn yǐng mén piào.
Wáng xiān sheng xiào zhe shuō: “Tài hǎo le!”
Tā xiàn zài kě yǐ yú kuài de huí jiā le.

stories.story_english:
Mr. Wang is very busy today.
He is walking on the street, wanting to go to the station to buy a bus ticket.
At the intersection, he suddenly discovered that his wallet was missing.
He was very worried because there were tickets in his wallet.
He walked back and forth on the road, searching for the lost item.
At this moment, his phone rang; it was a friend speaking.
The friend asked him, "Where are you?"
Mr. Wang said, "I am at the station entrance."
The friend said, "I am waiting for you at the restaurant, let's have a meal together."
Mr. Wang was very happy and walked into that restaurant.
The people in the restaurant were lined up in a row.
He ordered some dishes, including meat and eggs.
He also ordered a cup of hot tea.
After finishing the meal, the waiter told him that the wallet was found at the entrance.
In the wallet, besides money, there was also a movie ticket.
Mr. Wang said with a smile, "Great!"
Now he can go home happily.

stories.story_chinese:
在一个小镇上，有几个好朋友。
他们是三先生、关先生和冷先生。
有一天，天气很冷，他们想吃热的东西。
他们来到包先生的小店。
包先生做了很多好吃的包子。
南先生和山先生也来了。
班先生带来了白色的桌布。
百先生带来了很多水。
大家在一起很高兴。
这个早晨非常温暖。

Everyone was very happy together.

stories.story_chinese:
大卫是一个美国人，他现在住在北京。
他在这里学习汉语，每天都要去上课。
大卫非常喜欢学习，因为他觉得汉语很有意思。
有一天，他的中国朋友王明向他介绍了一份工作。
王明告诉他，这家公司需要一个会说英语的人。
大卫很开心，他准备好去面试了。
面试那天，大卫早早地就到了公司。
他看到很多人在开会，办公室里很忙。
经理问他：“你能帮我们做这个项目吗？”
大卫回答说：“我可以，我想帮忙。”
经理对他很满意，大卫就这样开始上班了。
他的工作很简单，主要是上网找资料。
每天早晨，大卫会喝一杯热奶，然后开始工作。
他工作的时候很认真，身体不动，只有手指在动。
他的打字动作很快，效率很高。
中午，他和同事们一起去吃饭。
他们去买了一些好吃的点心和水果。
大卫问王明：“你现在在干什么？”
王明说：“我在分这些文件，请帮我一下。”
下午下班以后，大卫回到了家。
他觉得今天很累，但心情很好。
他想做一些让自己开心的事情。
大卫喜欢唱歌，他开始大声地唱起歌来。
这时，他的猫跑了出来，在房间里跳舞。
大卫看着猫，觉得它的样子很好看。
他想起明天还要去上课，所以决定早点休息。
他拿出书，学习了几个新词语。
他想把这些词语告诉他的父母。
他拿起手机，给父母发了一条消息。
他说他在北京生活得很好，工作也很有趣。
他希望能快点把汉语学好。
这样他就能在公司里独立工作了。
大卫闭上眼睛，进入了甜美的梦乡。
他期待着明天又是充满希望的一天。

stories.story_pinyin:
Dà wèi shì yí gè Měi guó rén, tā xiàn zài zhù zài Běi jīng.
Tā zài zhè lǐ xué xí Hàn yǔ, měi tiān dōu yào qù shàng kè.
Dà wèi fēi cháng xǐ huan xué xí, yīn wèi tā jué de Hàn yǔ hěn yǒu yì si.
Yǒu yì tiān, tā de Zhōng guó péng you Wáng Míng xiàng tā jiè shào le yí fèn gōng zuò.
Wáng Míng gào su tā, zhè jiā gōng sī xū yào yí gè huì shuō Yīng yǔ de rén.
Dà wèi hěn kāi xīn, tā zhǔn bèi hǎo qù miàn shì le.
Miàn shì nà tiān, Dà wèi zǎo zǎo de jiù dào le gōng sī.
Tā kàn dào hěn duō rén zài kāi huì, bàn gōng shì lǐ hěn máng.
Jīng lǐ wèn tā: “Nǐ néng bāng wǒ men zuò zhè gè xiàng mù ma?”
Dà wèi huí dá shuō: “Wǒ kě yǐ, wǒ xiǎng bāng máng.”
Jīng lǐ duì tā hěn mǎn yì, Dà wèi jiù zhè yàng kāi shǐ shàng bān le.
Tā de gōng zuò hěn jiǎn dān, zhǔ yào shì shàng wǎng zhǎo zī liào.
Měi tiān zǎo chen, Dà wèi huì hē yì bēi rè nǎi, rán hòu kāi shǐ gōng zuò.
Tā gōng zuò de shí hou hěn rèn zhēn, shēn tǐ bú dòng, zhǐ yǒu shǒu zhǐ zài dòng.
Tā de dǎ zì dòng zuò hěn kuài, xiào lǜ hěn gāo.
Zhōng wǔ, tā hé tóng shì men yì qǐ qù chī fàn.
Tā men qù mǎi le yì xiē hǎo chī de diǎn xin hé shuǐ guǒ.
Dà wèi wèn Wáng Míng: “Nǐ xiàn zài zài gàn shén me?”
Wáng Míng shuō: “Wǒ zài fēn zhè xiē wén jiàn, qǐng bāng wǒ yí xià.”
Xià wǔ xià bān yǐ hòu, Dà wèi huí dào le jiā.
Tā jué de jīn tiān hěn lèi, dàn xīn qíng hěn hǎo.
Tā xiǎng zuò yì xiē ràng zì jǐ kāi xīn de shì qíng.
Dà wèi xǐ huan chàng gē, tā kāi shǐ dà shēng de chàng qǐ gē lái.
Zhè shí, tā de māo pǎo le chū lái, zài fáng jiān lǐ tiào wǔ.
Dà wèi kàn zhe māo, jué de tā de yàng zi hěn hǎo kàn.
Tā xiǎng qǐ míng tiān hái yào qù shàng kè, suǒ yǐ jué dìng zǎo diǎn xiū xi.
Tā ná chū shū, xué xí le jǐ gè xīn cí yǔ.
Tā xiǎng bǎ zhè xiē cí yǔ gào su tā de fù mǔ.
Tā ná qǐ shǒu jī, gěi fù mǔ fā le yì tiáo xiāo xi.
Tā shuō tā zài Běi jīng shēng huó de hěn hǎo, gōng zuò yě hěn yǒu qù.
Tā xī wàng néng kuài diǎn bǎ Hàn yǔ xué hǎo.
Zhè yàng tā jiù néng zài gōng sī lǐ dú lì gōng zuò le.
Dà wèi bì shàng yǎn jing, jìn rù le tián měi de mèng xiāng.
Tā qī dài zhe míng tiān yòu shì chōng mǎn xī wàng de yì tiān.

stories.story_english:
David is an American, and he now lives in Beijing.
He is studying Chinese here and has to go to class every day.
David likes studying very much because he thinks Chinese is very interesting.
One day, his Chinese friend Wang Ming introduced a job to him.
Wang Ming told him that this company needed someone who could speak English.
David was very happy and prepared himself for the interview.
On the day of the interview, David arrived at the company very early.
He saw many people in a meeting, and the office was very busy.
The manager asked him, "Can you do this project for us?"
David replied, "I can, I want to help."
The manager was very satisfied with him, and thus David started going to work.
His job is very simple, mainly searching for information online.
Every morning, David drinks a glass of hot milk and then starts working.
When he works, he is very focused; his body doesn't move, only his fingers move.
His typing movements are very fast, and his efficiency is very high.
At noon, he goes to have a meal with his colleagues.
They went to buy some delicious dim sum and fruit.
David asked Wang Ming, "What are you doing now?"
Wang Ming said, "I am dividing these documents, please help me for a moment."
After getting off work in the afternoon, David returned home.
He felt very tired today, but his mood was very good.
He wanted to do some things to make himself happy.
David likes singing, and he began to sing loudly.
At this moment, his cat ran out and danced in the room.
David looked at the cat and thought it looked very cute.
He remembered he still had to go to class tomorrow, so he decided to rest early.
He took out a book and studied a few new words.
He wanted to tell these words to his parents.
He picked up his phone and sent a message to his parents.
He said he is living very well in Beijing and the work is also very interesting.
He hopes to learn Chinese well soon.
This way, he can work independently in the company.
David closed his eyes and entered a sweet dream.
He looks forward to tomorrow being another day full of hope.

stories.story_chinese:
大卫是一个来自比利时的年轻人。
他现在在中国工作，他的生活非常忙。
今天早上，天气很热。
大卫穿上白色的衣服，准备去公司。
他在车站站了一会儿，然后决定打车去办公室。
他在车上想，今天的工作会很多吗？
来到公司后，他打开电脑开始工作。
大卫爱他的工作，因为他的爱好就是学习语言。
中午，他的同事小王对他开玩笑说，大卫的中文比老师还好。
大卫笑了，他知道小王是在开玩笑。
下午，大卫觉得身体不舒服，他好像生病了。
他觉得很累，头也疼。
他告诉老板，他要去医院看病。
在医院，大卫看见很多人在排队。
医生告诉他，他需要休息，不能太累。
大卫得到了医生的建议，决定回家休息。
回到家，他先洗了手，然后把药放在桌子上。
他想听一首歌，让心情好一点。
这时，他的朋友小李给他打电话。
小李问他：“你想去公园玩儿吗？”
大卫说：“我现在有病，不能去。”
小李有点生气，因为他想和大卫一起去打球。
但大卫解释说，他明天还要参加一个重要的考试。
他必须用今天的时间来复习，不能浪费。
他需要找一些书来准备这次考试。
他告诉小李，考好这次考试对他很重要。
小李听了之后，不再生气了。
他决定给大卫买一些水果，帮他看病。
傍晚，大卫走到窗边，看见窗外有一棵大树。
树上的叶子在风中摇摆。
大卫觉得生活虽然辛苦，但很有意思。
他走了一步棋，在棋盘上走了一着。
他现在准备好面对明天了。

Huí dào jiā, tā xiān xǐ le shǒu, rán hòu bǎ yào fàng zài zhuō zi shàng.
Tā xiǎng tīng yī shǒu gē, ràng xīn qíng hǎo yī diǎn.
Zhè shí, tā de péng you Xiǎo Lǐ gěi tā dǎ diàn huà.
Xiǎo Lǐ wèn tā: “Nǐ xiǎng qù gōng yuán wán r ma?”
Dà wèi shuō: “Wǒ xiàn zài yǒu bìng, bù néng qù.”
Xiǎo Lǐ yǒu diǎn shēng qì, yīn wèi tā xiǎng hé Dà wèi yī qǐ qù dǎ qiú.
Dàn Dà wèi jiě shì shuō, tā míng tiān hái yào cān jiā yī gè zhòng yào de kǎo shì.
Tā bì xū yòng jīn tiān de shí jiān lái fù xí, bù néng làng fèi.
Tā xū yào zhǎo yī xiē shū lái zhǔn bèi zhè cì kǎo shì.
Tā gào su Xiǎo Lǐ, kǎo hǎo zhè cì kǎo shì duì tā hěn zhòng yào.
Xiǎo Lǐ tīng le zhī hòu, bù zài shēng qì le.
Tā jué dìng gěi Dà wèi mǎi yī xiē shuǐ guǒ, bāng tā kàn bìng.
Bàng wǎn, Dà wèi zǒu dào chuāng biān, kàn jiàn chuāng wài yǒu yī kē dà shù.
Shù shàng de yè zi zài fēng zhōng yáo bǎi.
Dà wèi jué de shēng huó suī rán xīn kǔ, dàn hěn yǒu yì si.
Tā zǒu le yī bù qí, zài qí pán shàng zǒu le yī zhāo.
Tā xiàn zài zhǔn bèi hǎo miàn duì míng tiān le.
stories.story_english:
David is a young man from Belgium.
He is currently working in China, and his life is very busy.
This morning, the weather was very hot.
David put on white clothes and prepared to go to the company.
He stood at the station for a while, then decided to take a taxi to the office.
In the car, he thought, will there be a lot of work today?
After arriving at the company, he opened the computer and started working.
David loves his work because his hobby is learning languages.
At noon, his colleague Xiao Wang joked with him, saying David's Chinese is even better than the teacher's.
David laughed; he knew Xiao Wang was joking.
In the afternoon, David felt unwell; he seemed to have fallen ill.
He felt very tired, and his head also hurt.
He told his boss that he needed to go to the hospital to see a doctor.
At the hospital, David saw many people queuing up.
The doctor told him that he needed to rest and could not be too tired.
David received the doctor's advice and decided to go home to rest.
Returning home, he first washed his hands, then put the medicine on the table.
He wanted to listen to a song to make his mood a bit better.
At this time, his friend Xiao Li gave him a phone call.
Xiao Li asked him, "Do you want to go to the park to hang out?"
David said, "I am sick right now, I cannot go."
Xiao Li was a bit angry because he wanted to go play ball with David.
But David explained that he still had to take an important exam tomorrow.
He must use today's time to review and cannot waste it.
He needs to find some books to prepare for this exam.
He told Xiao Li that passing this exam is very important to him.
After hearing this, Xiao Li was no longer angry.
He decided to buy some fruit for David to help him recover.
In the evening, David walked to the window and saw a big tree outside.
The leaves on the tree were swaying in the wind.
David felt that although life is hard, it is very interesting.
He made a move in chess, playing one move on the board.
He is now ready to face tomorrow.

stories.story_chinese:
大卫每天六点起床。
他起床以后，很快就起来洗脸。
今天他要去公司工作，他决定走路去。
在路上，他见到了一个新同事，叫王明。
大卫很高兴能认识王明。
他们一起走，一边走路一边说话。
大卫问王明：“你在这里工作多久了？”
王明告诉他很多关于公司的事情。
大卫努力地记这些信息。
他想记住每个人的名字。
到了公司门口，王明请大卫进办公室。
王明说：“我想试一下这个新机器，你来看看。”
大卫跟在王明后面进去了。
工作了一整天，大卫觉得很饿。
下班时，王明决定送大卫回家。
在回家的路上，他们约定明天再次见面。
大卫觉得今天过得很开心。
他现在终于知道怎么在公司工作了。
他期待着明天再次见到王明。

Gōng zuò le yī zhěng tiān, Dà wèi jué de hěn è.

Dà wèi jué de jīn tiān guò de hěn kāi xīn.

Tā qī dài zhe míng tiān zài cì jiàn dào Wáng Míng.
stories.story_english:
David gets up at six o'clock every day.
After getting out of bed, he quickly stands up to wash his face.
Today he is going to the company to work, and he decided to go on foot.
On the way, he saw a new colleague named Wang Ming.
David was very happy to get to know Wang Ming.
They walked together, talking while walking.
David asked Wang Ming, "How long have you been working here?"
Wang Ming told him many things about the company.
David worked hard to record this information.
He wanted to remember everyone's name.
Arriving at the company entrance, Wang Ming invited David to enter the office.
Wang Ming said, "I want to try this new machine, come and take a look."
David followed behind Wang Ming and went in.
After working all day, David felt very hungry.
When getting off work, Wang Ming decided to see David home.
On the way home, they agreed to meet again tomorrow.
David felt that today went very happily.
He finally knows how to work at the company now.
He looks forward to seeing Wang Ming again tomorrow.

stories.story_chinese:
在一个小村庄里，住着一个大家庭。
爷爷和奶奶是家里最年长的人。
他们是心地善良的老人。
家里有三个孩子：一个哥哥，一个姐姐和一个弟弟。
哥哥是大孩子，他今年十二岁。
姐姐是一个聪明的女孩儿，她喜欢读书。
弟弟是一个活泼的男孩儿，他才五岁。
在这个家里，每个人都被亲切地称呼。
哥哥常被叫作“大哥”。
姐姐被叫作“大姐”。
弟弟则是那个可爱的小妹的哥哥，虽然他是个男孩儿。
哦，家里还有一个小妹妹，她是个可爱的小孩儿。
有一天，姐姐在楼上写作业。
弟弟在楼下跑来跑去，觉得这里很好玩儿。
弟弟想帮姐姐干活，于是他跑上楼。
他拿了一个苹果给姐姐。
姐姐笑了起来，摸了摸弟弟的头。
她说：“谢谢你，我的好弟弟。”
这时，一个邻居家的年轻小姐走进了院子。
她是一位网络作家，经常和很多网友聊天。
她看到孩子们在一起，觉得这个家庭很和谐。
她问奶奶：“您家的人都这么爱对方吗？”
奶奶笑着说：“是的，家人之间就是要互相帮助。”
奶奶给每个人准备了午餐。
那是每个人都爱吃的面条儿。
弟弟和妹妹抢着要吃面条儿。
哥哥帮着奶奶把碗放到桌子上。
这个充满爱的家里，每天都充满了欢笑。

stories.story_pinyin:
Zài yí gè xiǎo cūn zhuāng lǐ, zhù zhe yí gè dà jiā tíng.
Yé ye hé nǎi nai shì jiā lǐ zuì nián zhǎng de rén.
Tā men shì xīn dì shàn liáng de lǎo rén.
Jiā lǐ yǒu sān gè hái zi: yí gè gē ge, yí gè jiě jie hé yí gè dì di.
Gē ge shì dà hái zi, tā jīn nián shí èr suì.
Jiě jie shì yí gè cōng míng de nǚ hái r, tā xǐ huan dú shū.
Dì di shì yí gè huó pō de nán hái r, tā cái wǔ suì.
Zài zhè gè jiā lǐ, měi gè rén dōu bèi qīn qiè de chēng hu.
Gē ge cháng bèi jiào zuò “dà gē”.
Jiě jie bèi jiào zuò “dà jiě”.
Dì di zé shì nà gè kě ài de xiǎo mèi de gē ge, suī rán tā shì gè nán hái r.
Ó, jiā lǐ hái yǒu yí gè xiǎo mèi mei, tā shì gè kě ài de xiǎo hái r.
Yǒu yì tiān, jiě jie zài lóu shàng xiě zuò yè.
Dì di zài lóu xià pǎo lái pǎo qù, jué de zhè lǐ hěn hǎo wán r.
Dì di xiǎng bāng jiě jie gàn huó, yú shì tā pǎo shàng lóu.
Tā ná le yí gè píng guǒ gěi jiě jie.
Jiě jie xiào le qǐ lái, mō le mō dì di de tóu.
Tā shuō: “Xiè xie nǐ, wǒ de hǎo dì di.”
Zhè shí, yí gè lín jū jiā de nián qīng xiǎo jie zǒu jìn le yuàn zi.
Tā shì yí wèi wǎng luò zuò jiā, jīng cháng hé hěn duō wǎng yǒu liáo tiān.
Tā kàn dào hái zi men zài yì qǐ, jué de zhè gè jiā tíng hěn hé xié.
Tā wèn nǎi nai: “Nín jiā de rén dōu zhè me ài duì fāng ma?”
Nǎi nai xiào zhe shuō: “Shì de, jiā rén zhī jiān jiù shì yào hù xiāng bāng zhù.”
Nǎi nai gěi měi gè rén zhǔn bèi le wǔ cān.
Nà shì měi gè rén dōu ài chī de miàn tiáo r.
Dì di hé mèi mei qiǎng zhe yào chī miàn tiáo r.
Gē ge bāng zhe nǎi nai bǎ wǎn fàng dào zhuō zi shàng.
Zhè gè chōng mǎn ài de jiā lǐ, měi tiān dōu chōng mǎn le huān xiào.

stories.story_english:
In a small village, there lived a large family.
Grandfather and grandmother were the oldest people in the house.
They were kind-hearted elderly people.
There were three children in the family: an older brother, an older sister, and a younger brother.
The older brother was the eldest child; he is twelve years old this year.
The older sister is a clever girl who likes to read books.
The younger brother is a lively boy; he is only five years old.
In this home, everyone is called by affectionate names.
The older brother is often called "Big Brother".
The older sister is called "Big Sister".
The younger brother is the brother of that cute little sister, although he is a boy.
Oh, there is also a little younger sister in the family; she is a cute child.
One day, the older sister was doing homework upstairs.
The younger brother was running around downstairs, thinking it was very fun here.
The younger brother wanted to help the older sister with work, so he ran upstairs.
He took an apple to give to the older sister.
The older sister laughed and patted the younger brother's head.
She said, "Thank you, my good little brother."
At this time, a young lady from a neighbor's house walked into the yard.
She is a web writer who often chats with many online friends.
She saw the children together and felt that this family was very harmonious.
She asked the grandmother, "Do the people in your family love each other this much?"
The grandmother smiled and said, "Yes, family members should help each other."
Grandmother prepared lunch for everyone.
It was the noodles that everyone loved to eat.
The younger brother and younger sister scrambled to eat the noodles.
The older brother helped grandmother put the bowls on the table.
In this home full of love, every day is filled with laughter.

sentences.english: In this home, everyone is called by affectionate names.

sentences.chinese: 哥哥常被叫作“大哥”。
sentences.pinyin: Gē ge cháng bèi jiào zuò “dà gē”.

sentences.chinese: 姐姐被叫作“大姐”。

sentences.chinese: 弟弟则是那个可爱的小妹的哥哥，虽然他是个男孩儿。

sentences.chinese: 哦，家里还有一个小妹妹，她是个可爱的小孩儿。

sentences.chinese: 有一天，姐姐在楼上写作业。

sentences.chinese: 弟弟在楼下跑来跑去，觉得这里很好玩儿。

sentences.chinese: 弟弟想帮姐姐干活，于是他跑上楼。

sentences.chinese: 他拿了一个苹果给姐姐。

sentences.english: He took an apple to give to the older sister.

sentences.chinese: 姐姐笑了起来，摸了摸弟弟的头。

sentences.chinese: 她说：“谢谢你，我的好弟弟。”

sentences.chinese: 她是一位网络作家，经常和很多网友聊天。

sentences.chinese: 她看到孩子们在一起，觉得这个家庭很和谐。

sentences.chinese: 她问奶奶：“您家的人都这么爱对方吗？”

sentences.chinese: 奶奶笑着说：“是的，家人之间就是要互相帮助。”

sentences.chinese: 奶奶给每个人准备了午餐。

sentences.english: Grandmother prepared lunch for everyone.

sentences.chinese: 那是每个人都爱吃的面条儿。

sentences.english: It was the noodles that everyone loved to eat.

sentences.chinese: 弟弟和妹妹抢着要吃面条儿。

sentences.english: The younger brother and younger sister scrambled to eat the noodles.

sentences.chinese: 哥哥帮着奶奶把碗放到桌子上。

sentences.english: The older brother helped grandmother put the bowls on the table.

sentences.chinese: 这个充满爱的家里，每天都充满了欢笑。

sentences.english: In this home full of love, every day is filled with laughter.

stories.story_chinese:
王先生是一个勤快的工人。
他住在北京的一个小房间里。
去年，他一直很忙，没有时间休息。
今年，他想做一些不同的事情。
前天，他去医院看望了他的老朋友。
他的朋友是一位医生。
他们在医院里聊了两个小时。
医生告诉他，身体健康最重要。
上午，王先生在公园里散步。
他看到一个女人带着她的女儿在玩。
那个小孩子在草地上跑得很慢。
王先生笑了，他觉得这个小朋友很可爱。
他想起了自己的儿子和女儿。
他们现在住在另一个城市。
半年以前，他的儿子带女朋友来看他。
那个女朋友是一个很温柔的人。
王先生记得上次见面时，他们一起吃了午饭。
他记得那个日期的天气非常好。
现在，他看着桌子上的地图。
他想在新年之前去旅行。
他拿起一个小几，把地图放在上面。
他想从北京出发，去南方看他们。
他想问问他们：“你们现在有时间吗？”
他希望下次见面时，全家人能在一起。
他听到窗外有鸟在唱歌，他安静地听着。
他在学习中文，练习上声的发音。
他写了几个字，虽然写得很慢。
他买了一打漂亮的信纸。
他想给孩子们写信。
他写道：“我想你们，想我的孩子。”
他觉得生活虽然简单，但很温暖。
他期待着新年的到来。
他准备好迎接新的生活。
他现在感到非常快乐。

Wáng xiān sheng shì yī gè qín kuài de gōng rén.

Qián tiān, tā qù yī yuàn kàn wàng le tā de lǎo péng you.

Wáng xiān sheng jì de shàng cì jiàn miàn shí, tā men yī qǐ chī le wǔ fàn.

Tā xiǎng wèn wèn tā men: “Nǐ men xiàn zài yǒu shí jiān ma?”

Tā tīng dào chuāng wài yǒu niǎo zài chàng gē, tā ān jìng de tīng zhe.
Tā zài xué xí zhōng wén, liàn xí shǎng shēng de fā yīn.
Tā xiě le jǐ gè zì, suī rán xiě de hěn màn.
Tā mǎi le yī dá piào liang de xìn zhǐ.
Tā xiǎng gěi hái zi men xiě xìn.
Tā xiě dào: “Wǒ xiǎng nǐ men, xiǎng wǒ de hái zi.”
Tā jué de shēng huó suī rán jiǎn dān, dàn hěn wēn nuǎn.
Tā qī dài zhe xīn nián de dào lái.
Tā zhǔn bèi hǎo yíng jiē xīn de shēng huó.
Tā xiàn zài gǎn dào fēi cháng kuài lè.

stories.story_english:
Mr. Wang is a hardworking worker.
He lives in a small room in Beijing.
Last year, he was busy all the time and had no time to rest.
This year, he wants to do some different things.
The day before yesterday, he went to the hospital to visit an old friend.
His friend is a doctor.
They chatted in the hospital for two hours.
The doctor told him that health is the most important thing.
In the morning, Mr. Wang took a walk in the park.
He saw a woman playing with her daughter.
That small child was running very slowly on the grass.
Mr. Wang smiled; he thought this child was very cute.
He thought of his own son and daughter.
They now live in another city.
Half a year ago, his son brought his girlfriend to see him.
That girlfriend is a very gentle person.
Mr. Wang remembers that last time they met, they had lunch together.
He remembers the weather on that date was very good.
Now, he is looking at the map on the table.
He wants to go traveling before the New Year.
He picked up a small table and put the map on top of it.
He wants to set out from Beijing to visit them in the south.
He wants to ask them, "Do you have time now?"
He hopes that next time they meet, the whole family can be together.
He heard birds singing outside the window, and he listened quietly.
He is studying Chinese and practicing the third tone pronunciation.
He wrote a few characters, although he wrote them slowly.
He bought a dozen sheets of beautiful stationery.
He wants to write letters to the children.
He wrote: "I miss you, I miss my children."
He feels that although life is simple, it is very warm.
He looks forward to the arrival of the New Year.
He is ready to welcome a new life.
He feels very happy now.

sentences.pinyin: Shàng wǔ, Wáng xiān sheng zài gōng yuán lǐ sàn bù.
sentences.english: In the morning, Mr. Wang took a walk in the park.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个女人带着她的女儿在玩。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào yī gè nǚ rén dài zhe tā de nǚ ér zài wán.
sentences.english: He saw a woman playing with her daughter.

sentences.chinese: 那个小孩子在草地上跑得很慢。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè xiǎo hái zi zài cǎo dì shàng pǎo de hěn màn.
sentences.english: That small child was running very slowly on the grass.

sentences.chinese: 王先生笑了，他觉得这个小朋友很可爱。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng xiān sheng xiào le, tā jué de zhè gè xiǎo péng yǒu hěn kě ài.
sentences.english: Mr. Wang smiled; he thought this child was very cute.

sentences.chinese: 他想起了自己的儿子和女儿。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ le zì jǐ de ér zi hé nǚ ér.
sentences.english: He thought of his own son and daughter.

sentences.chinese: 他们现在住在另一个城市。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men xiàn zài zhù zài lìng yī gè chéng shì.
sentences.english: They now live in another city.

sentences.chinese: 半年以前，他的儿子带女朋友来看他。
sentences.pinyin: Bàn nián yǐ qián, tā de ér zi dài nǚ péng you lái kàn tā.
sentences.english: Half a year ago, his son brought his girlfriend to see him.

sentences.chinese: 那个女朋友是一个很温柔的人。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè nǚ péng you shì yī gè hěn wēn róu de rén.
sentences.english: That girlfriend is a very gentle person.

sentences.chinese: 王先生记得上次见面时，他们一起吃了午饭。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng xiān sheng jì de shàng cì jiàn miàn shí, tā men yī qǐ chī le wǔ fàn.
sentences.english: Mr. Wang remembers that last time they met, they had lunch together.

sentences.chinese: 他记得那个日期的天气非常好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì de nà gè rì qī de tiān qì fēi cháng hǎo.
sentences.english: He remembers the weather on that date was very good.

sentences.chinese: 现在，他看着桌子上的地图。

sentences.english: Now, he is looking at the map on the table.

sentences.chinese: 他想在新年之前去旅行。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng zài xīn nián zhī qián qù lǚ xíng.
sentences.english: He wants to go traveling before the New Year.

sentences.chinese: 他拿起一个小几，把地图放在上面。

sentences.english: He picked up a small table and put the map on top of it.

sentences.chinese: 他想从北京出发，去南方看他们。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng cóng Běi jīng chū fā, qù nán fāng kàn tā men.
sentences.english: He wants to set out from Beijing to visit them in the south.

sentences.chinese: 他想问问他们：“你们现在有时间吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng wèn wèn tā men: “Nǐ men xiàn zài yǒu shí jiān ma?”
sentences.english: He wants to ask them, "Do you have time now?"

sentences.chinese: 他希望下次见面时，全家人能在一起。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xī wàng xià cì jiàn miàn shí, quán jiā rén néng zài yī qǐ.
sentences.english: He hopes that next time they meet, the whole family can be together.

sentences.chinese: 他听到窗外有鸟在唱歌，他安静地听着。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīng dào chuāng wài yǒu niǎo zài chàng gē, tā ān jìng de tīng zhe.
sentences.english: He heard birds singing outside the window, and he listened quietly.

sentences.chinese: 他在学习中文，练习上声的发音。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài xué xí zhōng wén, liàn xí shǎng shēng de fā yīn.
sentences.english: He is studying Chinese and practicing the third tone pronunciation.

sentences.chinese: 他写了几个字，虽然写得很慢。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiě le jǐ gè zì, suī rán xiě de hěn màn.
sentences.english: He wrote a few characters, although he wrote them slowly.

sentences.chinese: 他买了一打漂亮的信纸。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mǎi le yī dá piào liang de xìn zhǐ.
sentences.english: He bought a dozen sheets of beautiful stationery.

sentences.chinese: 他想给孩子们写信。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng gěi hái zi men xiě xìn.
sentences.english: He wants to write letters to the children.

sentences.chinese: 他写道：“我想你们，想我的孩子。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiě dào: “Wǒ xiǎng nǐ men, xiǎng wǒ de hái zi.”
sentences.english: He wrote: "I miss you, I miss my children."

sentences.chinese: 他觉得生活虽然简单，但很温暖。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué de shēng huó suī rán jiǎn dān, dàn hěn wēn nuǎn.
sentences.english: He feels that although life is simple, it is very warm.

sentences.chinese: 他期待着新年的到来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qī dài zhe xīn nián de dào lái.
sentences.english: He looks forward to the arrival of the New Year.

sentences.chinese: 他准备好迎接新的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǔn bèi hǎo yíng jiē xīn de shēng huó.
sentences.english: He is ready to welcome a new life.

sentences.chinese: 他现在感到非常快乐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàn zài gǎn dào fēi cháng kuài lè.
sentences.english: He feels very happy now.

stories.story_chinese:
大卫是一个住在北京的美国人。
他有一个很好的中国朋友，叫小李。
昨天是星期天，也是星期日。
大卫在网上买了很多衣服。
早上，他起床后先喝了一杯牛奶。
然后，他吃了一点面包作为早饭。
小李告诉他：“明天是你的生日！”
大卫很开心，因为他最喜欢生日。
但是，大卫觉得有点渴，他想喝水。
他走到楼下，看见了小李。
小李问：“请问，你想去哪里？”
大卫说：“我想去买一些水果。”
他们走在街上，突然下雨了。
大卫说：“这些雨太大了，我们快走吧。”
小李说：“那儿有一家商店，我们去那里。”
在商店里，大卫看到了那些漂亮的书。
他翻开书的第一页，觉得很有用。
有时候，阅读能让人心情愉快。
大卫的男朋友也来了，他从美国坐飞机回来。
他在车上给大卫打了一个电话。
他说：“我坐火车到了北京，现在在车站。”
大卫很激动，赶紧跑向车站。
他们在一起吃了很多米饭和好吃的菜。
大卫问：“明年你还会来吗？”
小李笑着说：“当然会，这儿的环境很好。”
这里的人们都非常友好。
大卫看着窗外，心想生活真美好。
他们讨论了关于正月的传统节日。
大卫觉得学习中文非常有意思。
虽然他才学了半年，但进步很大。
他们计划下次一起去旅行。
这就是大卫最快乐的一天。
他爱他的朋友们和这个城市。

stories.story_pinyin:
Dà wèi shì yí gè zhù zài Běi jīng de Měi guó rén.
Tā yǒu yí gè hěn hǎo de Zhōng guó péng you, jiào Xiǎo Lǐ.
Zuó tiān shì Xīng qī tiān, yě shì Xīng qī rì.
Dà wèi zài wǎng shàng mǎi le hěn duō yī fu.
Zǎo shang, tā qǐ chuáng hòu xiān hē le yì bēi niú nǎi.
 Rán hòu, tā chī le yì diǎn miàn bāo zuò wéi zǎo fàn.
Xiǎo Lǐ gào su tā: “Míng tiān shì nǐ de shēng rì!”
Dà wèi hěn kāi xīn, yīn wèi tā zuì xǐ huan shēng rì.
Dàn shì, Dà wèi jué de yǒu diǎn kě, tā xiǎng hē shuǐ.
Tā zǒu dào lóu xià, kàn jiàn le Xiǎo Lǐ.
Xiǎo Lǐ wèn: “Qǐng wèn, nǐ xiǎng qù nǎ lǐ?”
Dà wèi shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng qù mǎi yì xiē shuǐ guǒ.”
Tā men zǒu zài jiē shàng, tū rán xià yǔ le.
Dà wèi shuō: “Zhè xiē yǔ tài dà le, wǒ men kuài zǒu ba.”
Xiǎo Lǐ shuō: “Nà r yǒu yì jiā shāng diàn, wǒ men qù nà lǐ.”
Zài shāng diàn lǐ, Dà wèi kàn dào le nà xiē piào liang de shū.
Tā fān kāi shū de dì yī yè, jué de hěn yǒu yòng.
Yǒu shí hou, yuè dú néng ràng rén xīn qíng yú kuài.
Dà wèi de nán péng you yě lái le, tā cóng Měi guó zuò fēi jī huí lái.
Tā zài chē shàng gěi Dà wèi dǎ le yí gè diàn huà.
Tā shuō: “Wǒ zuò huǒ chē dào le Běi jīng, xiàn zài zài chē zhàn.”
Dà wèi hěn jī dòng, gǎn jǐn pǎo xiàng chē zhàn.
Tā men zài yì qǐ chī le hěn duō mǐ fàn hé hǎo chī de cài.
Dà wèi wèn: “Míng nián nǐ hái huì lái ma?”
Xiǎo Lǐ xiào zhe shuō: “Dāng rán huì, zhè r de huán jìng hěn hǎo.”
Zhè lǐ de rén men dōu fēi cháng yǒu hǎo.
Dà wèi kàn zhe chuāng wài, xīn xiǎng shēng huó zhēn měi hǎo.
Tā men tǎo lùn le guān yú zhēng yuè de chuán tǒng jié rì.
Dà wèi jué de xué xí Zhōng wén fēi cháng yǒu yì si.
Suī rán tā cái xué le bàn nián, dàn jìn bù hěn dà.
Tā men jì huà xià cì yì qǐ qù lǚ xíng.
Zhè jiù shì Dà wèi zuì kuài lè de yì tiān.
Tā ài tā de péng you men hé zhè gè chéng shì.

stories.story_english:
David is an American living in Beijing.
He has a very good Chinese friend named Xiao Li.
Yesterday was Sunday, also known as Xingqiri.
David bought a lot of clothes online.
In the early morning, after waking up, he drank a glass of milk.
Then, he ate some bread for breakfast.
Xiao Li told him, "Tomorrow is your birthday!"
David was very happy because he likes birthdays the most.
However, David felt a bit thirsty and wanted to drink water.
He walked downstairs and saw Xiao Li.
Xiao Li asked, "Excuse me, where do you want to go?"
David said, "I want to buy some fruit."
They were walking on the street when it suddenly rained.
David said, "This rain is too heavy, let's hurry."
Xiao Li said, "There is a shop over there, let's go there."
In the shop, David saw those beautiful books.
He flipped to the first page of the book and felt it was very useful.
Sometimes, reading can make people feel happy.
David's boyfriend also came; he flew back from America by airplane.
He made a phone call to David while in the car.
He said, "I took the train to Beijing and am now at the station."
David was very excited and rushed to the station.
They ate a lot of rice and delicious dishes together.
David asked, "Will you come again next year?"
Xiao Li smiled and said, "Of course, the environment here is great."
The people here are all very friendly.
David looked out the window and thought that life is truly beautiful.
They discussed the traditional festivals of the first lunar month.
David feels that learning Chinese is very interesting.
Although he has only studied for half a year, he has made great progress.
They planned to go on a trip together next time.
This was David's happiest day.
He loves his friends and this city.

stories.title_english: The Old Doctor in the North
stories.story_chinese:
在北边的一个小地方，住着一位老医生。
他是一个很温和的男人。
有一天，一个外国年轻人来到了这里。
这个年轻人学习外语，但是觉得汉字很难。
他想在医生这里学习一点中文。
年轻人走进诊所，很有礼貌地说：“您好！”
医生笑着说：“你好！你学习中文是不是很有趣？”
年轻人不好意思地说：“对不起，我觉得太难了。”
医生看着他，觉得他学习得不多。
“没关系，我们可以再试一次。”医生说。
这时候，一个病人走进了房间。
这个病人觉得身体很坏，很不舒服。
医生认真地检查了病人。
年轻人想帮医生，但他忘了拿药。
医生轻声说：“不对，药在那个桌子上。”
年轻人赶紧去拿，结果拿错了药。
医生说：“这个不对，药量太多了，应该少一点。”
年轻人觉得很尴尬，他觉得自己很笨。
医生温和地说：“没关系，学习需要时间。”
他们聊了半个小时。
医生告诉他，这里的医院离城市很远。
医生说：“在这个地方，只有二个医生。”
年轻人觉得医生很伟大。
他决定每天来这里读中文书。
他不再觉得学习外语很累。
他发现，只要有耐心，就没什么是不可能的。
现在，他每天都在这里练习说话。

stories.story_pinyin:
Zài běi bian de yī gè xiǎo dì fāng, zhù zhe yī wèi lǎo yī shēng.
Tā shì yī gè hěn wēn hé de nán rén.
Yǒu yī tiān, yī gè wài guó nián qīng rén lái dào le zhè lǐ.
Zhè gè nián qīng rén xué xí wài yǔ, dàn shì jué de hàn zì hěn nán.
Tā xiǎng zài yī shēng zhè lǐ xué xí yī diǎn zhōng wén.
Nián qīng rén zǒu jìn zhěn suǒ, hěn yǒu lǐ mào de shuō: “Nín hǎo!”
Yī shēng xiào zhe shuō: “Nǐ hǎo! Nǐ xué xí zhōng wén shì bù shì hěn yǒu qù?”
Nián qīng rén bù hǎo yì si de shuō: “Duì bu qǐ, wǒ jué de tài nán le.”
Yī shēng kàn zhe tā, jué de tā xué xí de bù duō.
“Méi guān xi, wǒ men kě yǐ zài shì yī cì.” yī shēng shuō.
Zhè shí hou, yī gè bìng rén zǒu jìn le fáng jiān.
Zhè gè bìng rén jué de shēn tǐ hěn huài, hěn bù shū fu.
Yī shēng rèn zhēn de jiǎn chá le bìng rén.
Nián qīng rén xiǎng bāng yī shēng, dàn tā wàng le ná yào.
Yī shēng qīng shēng shuō: “Bù duì, yào zài nà gè zhuō zi shàng.”
Nián qīng rén gǎn jǐn qù ná, jié guǒ ná cuò le yào.
Yī shēng shuō: “Zhè gè bù duì, yào liàng tài duō le, yīng gāi shǎo yī diǎn.”
Nián qīng rén jué de hěn gān gà, tā jué de zì jǐ hěn bèn.
Yī shēng wēn hé de shuō: “Méi guān xi, xué xí xū yào shí jiān.”
Tā men liáo le bàn gè xiǎo shí.
Yī shēng gào su tā, zhè lǐ de yī yuàn lí chéng shì hěn yuǎn.
Yī shēng shuō: “Zài zhè gè dì fāng, zhǐ yǒu èr gè yī shēng.”
Nián qīng rén jué de yī shēng hěn wěi dà.
Tā jué dìng měi tiān lái zhè lǐ dú zhōng wén shū.
Tā bù zài jué de xué xí wài yǔ hěn lèi.
Tā fā xiàn, zhǐ yào yǒu nài xīn, jiù méi shén me shì bù kě néng de.
Xiàn zài, tā měi tiān dōu zài zhè lǐ liàn xí shuō huà.

stories.story_english:
In a small place in the north, lived an old doctor.
He was a very gentle man.
One day, a foreign young man came here.
This young man studied foreign languages, but felt that Chinese characters were very difficult.
He wanted to study a bit of Chinese here with the doctor.
The young man walked into the clinic and said politely, "Hello (formal)!"
The doctor smiled and said, "Hello (informal)! Is studying Chinese interesting or not?"
The young man said shyly, "I'm sorry, I feel it is too difficult."
The doctor looked at him and felt he hadn't studied much.
"It's okay, we can try again," the doctor said.
At that moment, a patient walked into the room.
This patient felt his health was very bad and was very uncomfortable.
The doctor carefully examined the patient.
The young man wanted to help the doctor, but he forgot to get the medicine.
The doctor said softly, "That's not right, the medicine is on that table."
The young man hurried to get it, but ended up taking the wrong medicine.
The doctor said, "This is incorrect; the dosage is too much, it should be a bit less."
The young man felt very embarrassed; he felt he was very stupid.
The doctor said gently, "It's okay, learning takes time."
They chatted for half an hour.
The doctor told him that the hospital here was very far from the city.
The doctor said, "In this place, there are only two doctors."
The young man felt the doctor was very great.
He decided to come here every day to read Chinese books.
He no longer felt that studying foreign languages was tiring.
He discovered that as long as one has patience, nothing is impossible.
Now, he practices speaking here every day.

stories.story_chinese:
大卫是一个来自国外的学生。
他住在学校南边的宿舍里。
大卫想给他的中国朋友买一些东西。
他拿出一张地图，想看看哪里有商店。
地图的东边是一个大公园，北边是一个图书馆。
大卫在地图的中间看到了一个红色的点。
那是他要去的商店，就在公园的前边。
他一边走，一边看地图。
路边有四棵大树，两棵在左边，两棵在右边。
大卫想，这里的树长得一样高。
他看到地上有一个小球，在树的下边。
他把球捡起来，放在上边的一个长椅上。
这时，他遇到了一个好心的别人。
那个人问他：“你想找什么？”
大卫说：“我想找那家商店。”
那个人笑着说：“就在前边，走六步就到了。”
大卫数着步子：一，二，三，四，五，六。
他看到了商店，店门外有十个漂亮的灯笼。
商店里有很多东西，有七种颜色的书，还有八个小杯子。
大卫想买九个苹果，但店员说没有那么多了。
店员问他：“你还需要哪些别的礼物吗？”
大卫想了想，决定买一个中国的小扇子。
他问店员：“这个扇子在哪个方向？”
店员指了指：“在那个架子的下边。”
大卫买完东西，走出外边。
他看到外面天气很好，阳光灿烂。
他想和朋友一起去公园玩。
他想，在国外的时候，他没有这么多好朋友。
现在他在这里，感到非常开心。
他走在路中间，看着天空。
他发现生活就是这样，简单而快乐。
他对着地图笑了笑。
他把地图放在口袋里。
然后他快步向公园走去。

stories.story_pinyin:
Dà wèi shì yī gè lái zì guó wài de xué sheng.
Tā zhù zài xué xiào nán bian de sù shè lǐ.
Dà wèi xiǎng gěi tā de Zhōng guó péng you mǎi yī xiē dōng xī.
Tā ná chū yī zhāng dì tú, xiǎng kàn kàn nǎ lǐ yǒu shāng diàn.
Dì tú de dōng bian shì yī gè dà gōng yuán, běi bian shì yī gè tú shū guǎn.
Dà wèi zài dì tú de zhōng jiān kàn dào le yī gè hóng sè de diǎn.
Nà shì tā yào qù de shāng diàn, jiù zài gōng yuán de qián bian.
Tā yī biān zǒu, yī biān kàn dì tú.
Lù biān yǒu sì kē dà shù, liǎng kē zài zuǒ bian, liǎng kē zài yòu bian.
Dà wèi xiǎng, zhè lǐ de shù zhǎng de yī yàng gāo.
Tā kàn dào dì shang yǒu yī gè xiǎo qiú, zài shù de xià bian.
Tā bǎ qiú jiǎn qǐ lái, fàng zài shàng bian de yī gè cháng yǐ shàng.
Zhè shí, tā yù dào le yī gè hǎo xīn de bié ren.
Nà gè rén wèn tā: "Nǐ xiǎng zhǎo shén me?"
Dà wèi shuō: "Wǒ xiǎng zhǎo nà jiā shāng diàn."
Nà gè rén xiào zhe shuō: "Jiù zài qián bian, zǒu liù bù jiù dào le."
Dà wèi shǔ zhe bù zi: yī, èr, sān, sì, wǔ, liù.
Tā kàn dào le shāng diàn, diàn mén wài yǒu shí gè piào liang de dēng long.
Shāng diàn lǐ yǒu hěn duō dōng xī, yǒu qī zhǒng yán sè de shū, hái yǒu bā gè xiǎo bēi zi.
Dà wèi xiǎng mǎi jiǔ gè píng guǒ, dàn diàn yuán shuō méi yǒu nà me duō le.
Diàn yuán wèn tā: "Nǐ hái xū yào nǎ xiē bié de lǐ wù ma?"
Dà wèi xiǎng le xiǎng, jué dìng mǎi yī gè Zhōng guó de xiǎo shàn zi.
Tā wèn diàn yuán: "Zhè gè shàn zi zài nǎ gè fāng xiàng?"
Diàn yuán zhǐ le zhǐ: "Zài nà gè jià zi de xià bian."
Dà wèi mǎi wán dōng xī, zǒu chū wài bian.
Tā kàn dào wài mian tiān qì hěn hǎo, yáng guāng càn làn.
Tā xiǎng hé péng you yī qǐ qù gōng yuán wán.
Tā xiǎng, zài guó wài de shí hou, tā méi yǒu zhè me duō hǎo péng you.
Xiàn zài tā zài zhè lǐ, gǎn dào fēi cháng kāi xīn.
Tā zǒu zài lù zhōng jiān, kàn zhe tiān kōng.
Tā fā xiàn shēng huó jiù shì zhè yàng, jiǎn dān ér kuài lè.
Tā duì zhe dì tú xiào le xiào.
Tā bǎ dì tú fàng zài kǒu dài lǐ.
Rán hòu tā kuài bù xiàng gōng yuán zǒu qù.

stories.story_english:
David is a student from abroad.
He lives in a dormitory on the south side of the school.
David wants to buy some things for his Chinese friends.
He took out a map to see where there are shops.
The east side of the map is a big park, and the north side is a library.
David saw a red dot in the middle of the map.
That is the shop he wants to go to, right in front of the park.
He walked while looking at the map.
There were four big trees by the road, two on the left and two on the right side.
David thought the trees here grew to the same height.
He saw a small ball on the ground, under the tree.
He picked up the ball and placed it on a bench above.
At this moment, he met a kind stranger.
That person asked him, "What are you looking for?"
David said, "I am looking for that shop."
That person smiled and said, "It's just ahead, six steps and you'll be there."
David counted the steps: one, two, three, four, five, six.
He saw the shop; there were ten beautiful lanterns outside the shop door.
There were many things in the shop, seven colors of books, and eight small cups.
David wanted to buy nine apples, but the clerk said there weren't that many left.
The clerk asked him, "Which other gifts do you need?"
David thought for a while and decided to buy a small Chinese fan.
He asked the clerk, "Which direction is this fan in?"
The clerk pointed: "It is under that shelf."
David finished shopping and walked outside.
He saw that the weather outside was very good, with bright sunshine.
He wanted to go to the park to play together with his friends.
He thought that when he was abroad, he didn't have so many good friends.
Now that he is here, he feels very happy.
He walked in the middle of the road, looking at the sky.
He discovered that life is just like this, simple and happy.
He smiled at the map.
He put the map in his pocket.
Then he walked quickly toward the park.

The clerk asked him, "Which other gifts do you need?"
David thought for a while and decided to buy a small Chinese fan.
He asked the clerk, "Which direction is this fan in?"
The clerk pointed: "It is under that shelf."
David finished shopping and walked outside.
He saw that the weather outside was very good, with bright sunshine.
He wanted to go to the park to play together with his friends.
He thought that when he was abroad, he didn't have so many good friends.
Now that he is here, he feels very happy.
He walked in the middle of the road, looking at the sky.
He discovered that life is just like this, simple and happy.
He smiled at the map.
He put the map in his pocket.
Then he walked quickly toward the park.

stories.story_chinese:
今天天气很好，我去了市中心的公园。
公园很大，西边有一个漂亮的小湖。
我走在湖边，看到那边有一些人在跑步。
其中有两个女孩，她们正在说话，看起来很高兴。
我走近了一些，发现她们旁边有一只小狗。
小狗在左边跑，在右边跳，非常可爱。
我想知道这只狗是谁的，于是我走过去问她们。
我说：“你好，请问这只狗是多少岁了？”
一个女孩笑着对我说：“它两岁了。”
我想帮她们照顾小狗，因为有些狗很调皮。
公园里的人很多，有的在看书，有的在喝茶。
我问她们：“你们是从哪个地方来的？”
她们告诉我，她们来自一个很远的西边城市。
我问：“怎么走才能到那里？”
她们指了指远方，说：“从这里走，在那边转弯。”
我看着她们，发现她们身上穿着漂亮的衣服。
她们身体很好，看起来非常有活力。
在湖边的第二棵树下面，有一个休息的地方。
我们坐在那里的长椅上，开始聊天。
长椅里边放着一些书，还有几瓶水。
在这个安静的空间间，我们成了好朋友。
我指着这边说：“这里的花真美。”
她们点头说：“对，这里的花非常漂亮。”
我们一起在公园里度过了一个快乐的下午。

stories.story_pinyin:
Jīn tiān tiān qì hěn hǎo, wǒ qù le shì zhōng xīn de gōng yuán.
Gōng yuán hěn dà, xī biān yǒu yī gè piào liang de xiǎo hú.
Wǒ zǒu zài hú biān, kàn dào nà bian yǒu yī xiē rén zài pǎo bù.
Qí zhōng yǒu liǎng gè nǚ hái, tā men zhèng zài shuō huà, kàn qǐ lái hěn gāo xìng.
Wǒ zǒu jìn le yī xiē, fā xiàn tā men páng biān yǒu yī zhī xiǎo gǒu.
Xiǎo gǒu zài zuǒ bian pǎo, zài yòu bian tiào, fēi cháng kě ài.
Wǒ xiǎng zhī dào zhè zhī gǒu shì shéi de, yú shì wǒ zǒu guò qù wèn tā men.
Wǒ shuō: “Nǐ hǎo, qǐng wèn zhè zhī gǒu shì duō shǎo suì le?”
Yī gè nǚ hái xiào zhe duì wǒ shuō: “Tā liǎng suì le.”
Wǒ xiǎng bāng tā men zhào gù xiǎo gǒu, yīn wèi yǒu xiē gǒu hěn tiáo pí.
Gōng yuán lǐ de rén hěn duō, yǒu de zài kàn shū, yǒu de zài hē chá.
Wǒ wèn tā men: “Nǐ men shì cóng nǎ gè dì fang lái de?”
Tā men gào su wǒ, tā men lái zì yī gè hěn yuǎn de xī biān chéng shì.
Wǒ wèn: “Zěn me zǒu cái néng dào nà li?”
Tā men zhǐ le zhǐ yuǎn fāng, shuō: “Cóng zhè lǐ zǒu, zài nà bian zhuǎn wān.”
Wǒ kàn zhe tā men, fā xiàn tā men shēn shang chuān zhe piào liang de yī fu.
Tā men shēn tǐ hěn hǎo, kàn qǐ lái fēi cháng yǒu huó lì.
Zài hú biān de dì èr kē shù xià miàn, yǒu yī gè xiū xī de dì fang.
Wǒ men zuò zài nà lǐ de cháng yǐ shàng, kāi shǐ liáo tiān.
Cháng yǐ lǐ bian fàng zhe yī xiē shū, hái yǒu jǐ píng shuǐ.
Zài zhè gè ā jìng de kōng jiān jiān, wǒ men chéng le hǎo péng yǒu.
Wǒ zhǐ zhe zhè biān shuō: “Zhè lǐ de huā zhēn měi.”
Tā men diǎn tóu shuō: “Duì, zhè lǐ de huā fēi cháng piào liang.”
Wǒ men yī qǐ zài gōng yuán lǐ dù guò le yī gè kuài lè de xià wǔ.

stories.story_english:
The weather was great today, so I went to the city center park.
The park is very large, and there is a beautiful small lake on the west side.
As I walked by the lake, I saw some people running over there.
Among them were two girls; they were talking and seemed very happy.
I walked a bit closer and noticed there was a small dog beside them.
The puppy ran to the left and jumped to the right, it was very cute.
I wanted to know whose dog it was, so I walked over to ask them.
I said, "Hello, may I ask how old this dog is?"
One girl smiled and said to me, "It is two years old."
I wanted to help them take care of the puppy because some dogs are very naughty.
There were many people in the park; some were reading books, and some were drinking tea.
I asked them, "Where are you from?"
They told me that they came from a very distant western city.
I asked, "How do I get there?"
They pointed into the distance and said, "Go from here and turn over there."
I looked at them and noticed they were wearing beautiful clothes on their bodies.
Their health was very good, and they seemed very energetic.
Under the second tree by the lake, there was a place to rest.
We sat on the bench there and started chatting.
Inside the bench area, there were some books and also a few bottles of water.
In this quiet space, we became good friends.

As I walked by the lake, I saw some people running over there.
Among them were two girls; they were talking and seemed very happy.
I walked a bit closer and noticed there was a small dog beside them.
The puppy ran to the left and jumped to the right, it was very cute.
I wanted to know whose dog it was, so I walked over to ask them.
I said, "Hello, may I ask how old this dog is?"
One girl smiled and said to me, "It is two years old."
I wanted to help them take care of the puppy because some dogs are very naughty.

stories.story_chinese:
今天是一个星期五。
白天的天气非常好，没有风。
大卫是一个非常认真的人。
他常常在图书馆学习，因为他觉得知识很重要。
中午的时候，大卫觉得有点饿。
他去了一家非常有名的餐厅吃饭。
那里的菜真的很好吃，但是有点贵。
大卫想，虽然贵，但今天是一个好天。
下午，大卫在书店看了半天书。
他想买一本关于历史的书，但时间不够了。
他告诉店员：“我现在必须走了，下次再来。”
店员说：“没关系，再见！”
大卫走在回家的路上，觉得天快黑了。
现在的时间已经很晚了，应该是晚上七点了。
他走得很快，因为他想马上回家。
回家后，他发现家里没有电了。
他想，这太糟糕了，因为他还要学习。
他决定先洗手，让手变得干净。
然后，他点了一根蜡烛，坐在桌子前。
他有时会觉得黑暗很安静，好思考。
他开始认真地读他的书，虽然光线很弱。
一会儿，他的朋友小明来了。
小明说：“大卫，你在这里做什么？”
大卫说：“我在学习，但是我家没电。”
小明笑了，他说：“你还是太认真了。”
大卫问：“你明白我的意思吗？学习是重要的。”
小明点头说：“我明白，但现在是休息的时候。”
小明带来了一些好吃的点心。
大卫说：“谢谢你，小明！”
他们在一起聊天，谈到了很多有趣的事情。
大卫发现，虽然学习很重要，但朋友更重要。
小明告诉大卫，最好的学习方法是休息好。
大卫听了，觉得非常有道理。
他决定今天不再学习了。
他们重复地谈论着小时候的故事。
这个晚上变得真温暖。
最后，小明准备回家了。
他告诉大卫：“早点睡觉，明天见。”
大卫笑着说：“好，再见。”
大卫看着窗外的天空，觉得心情很好。
他意识到，生活中的每一个瞬间都很珍贵。

stories.story_pinyin:
Jīn tiān shì yī gè xīng qī wǔ.
Bái tiān de tiān qì fēi cháng hǎo, méi yǒu fēng.
Dà wèi shì yī gè fēi cháng rèn zhēn de rén.
Tā cháng cháng zài tú shū guǎn xué xí, yīn wèi tā jué de zhī shi hěn zhòng yào.
Zhōng wǔ de shí hou, Dà wèi jué de yǒu diǎn è.
Tā qù le yī jiā fēi cháng yǒu míng de cān tīng chī fàn.
Nà lǐ de cài zhēn de hěn hǎo chī, dàn shì yǒu diǎn guì.
Dà wèi xiǎng, suī rán guì, dàn jīn tiān shì yī gè hǎo tiān.
Xià wǔ, Dà wèi zài shū diàn kàn le bàn tiān shū.
Tā xiǎng mǎi yī běn guān yú lì shǐ de shū, dàn shí jiān bù gòu le.
Tā gào su diàn yuán: "Wǒ xiàn zài bì xū zǒu le, xià cì zài lái."
Diàn yuán shuō: "Méi guān xi, zài jiàn!"
Dà wèi zǒu zài huí jiā de lù shàng, jué de tiān kuài hēi le.
Xiàn zài de shí jiān yǐ jīng hěn wǎn le, yīng gāi shì wǎn shang qī diǎn le.
Tā zǒu de hěn kuài, yīn wèi tā xiǎng mǎ shàng huí jiā.
Huí jiā hòu, tā fā xiàn jiā lǐ méi yǒu diàn le.
Tā xiǎng, zhè tài zāo gāo le, yīn wèi tā hái yào xué xí.
Tā jué dìng xiān xǐ shǒu, ràng shǒu biàn de gān jìng.
Rán hòu, tā diǎn le yī gēn là zhú, zuò zài zhuō zi qián.
Tā yǒu shí huì jué de hēi àn hěn ānjìng, hǎo sī kǎo.
Tā kāi shǐ rèn zhēn de dú tā de shū, suī rán guāng xiàn hěn ruò.
Yī huì r, tā de péng you Xiǎo Míng lái le.
Xiǎo Míng shuō: "Dà wèi, nǐ zài zhè lǐ zuò shén me?"
Dà wèi shuō: "Wǒ zài xué xí, dàn shì wǒ jiā méi diàn."
Xiǎo Míng xiào le, tā shuō: "Nǐ hái shi tài rèn zhēn le."
Dà wèi wèn: "Nǐ míng bai wǒ de yì si ma? Xué xí shì zhòng yào de."
Xiǎo Míng diǎn tóu shuō: "Wǒ míng bai, dàn xiàn zài shì xiū xi de shí hou."
Xiǎo Míng dài lái le yī xiē hǎo chī de diǎn xīn.
Dà wèi shuō: "Xiè xie nǐ, Xiǎo Míng!"
Tā men zài yī qǐ liáo tiān, tán dào le hěn duō yǒu qù de shì qing.
Dà wèi fā xiàn, suī rán xué xí hěn zhòng yào, dàn péng you gèng zhòng yào.
Xiǎo Míng gào su Dà wèi, zuì hǎo de xué xí fāng fǎ shì xiū xi hǎo.
Dà wèi tīng le, jué de fēi cháng yǒu dào lǐ.
Tā jué dìng jīn tiān bù zài xué xí le.
Tā men chóng fù de tán lùn zhe xiǎo shí hou de gù shi.
Zhè gè wǎn shang biàn de zhēn wēn nuǎn.
Zuì hòu, Xiǎo Míng zhǔn bèi huí jiā le.
Tā gào su Dà wèi: "Zǎo diǎn shuì jiào, míng tiān jiàn."
Dà wèi xiào zhe shuō: "Hǎo, zài jiàn."
Dà wèi kàn zhe chuāng wài de tiān kōng, jué de xīn qíng hěn hǎo.
Tā yì shí dào, shēng huó zhōng de měi yī gè shùn jiān dōu hěn zhēn guì.

Xiǎo Míng shuō: "Dà wèi, nǐ zài zhè lǐ zuò shén me?"
Dà wèi shuō: "Wǒ zài xué xí, dàn shì wǒ jiā méi diàn."
Xiǎo Míng xiào le, tā shuō: "Nǐ hái shi tài rèn zhēn le."
Dà wèi wèn: "Nǐ míng bai wǒ de yì si ma? Xué xí shì zhòng yào de."
Xiǎo Míng diǎn tóu shuō: "Wǒ míng bai, dàn xiàn zài shì xiū xi de shí hou."
Xiǎo Míng dài lái le yī xiē hǎo chī de diǎn xīn.
Dà wèi shuō: "Xiè xie nǐ, Xiǎo Míng!"
Tā men zài yī qǐ liáo tiān, tán dào le hěn duō yǒu qù de shì qing.
Dà wèi fā xiàn, suī rán xué xí hěn zhòng yào, dàn péng you gèng zhòng yào.
Xiǎo Míng gào su Dà wèi, zuì hǎo de xué xí fāng fǎ shì xiū xi hǎo.
Dà wèi tīng le, jué de fēi cháng yǒu dào lǐ.
Tā jué dìng jīn tiān bù zài xué xí le.
Tā men chóng fù de tán lùn zhe xiǎo shí hou de gù shi.
Zhè gè wǎn shang biàn de zhēn wēn nuǎn.
Zuì hòu, Xiǎo Míng zhǔn bèi huí jiā le.
Tā gào su Dà wèi: "Zǎo diǎn shuì jiào, míng tiān jiàn."
Dà wèi xiào zhe shuō: "Hǎo, zài jiàn."
Dà wèi kàn zhe chuāng wài de tiān kōng, jué de xīn qíng hěn hǎo.
Tā yì shí dào, shēng huó zhōng de měi yī gè shùn jiān dōu hěn zhēn guì.
stories.story_english:
Today is Friday.
The weather during the day is very good, and there is no wind.
David is a very conscientious person.
He often studies in the library because he feels that knowledge is very important.
At noon, David felt a bit hungry.
He went to a very famous restaurant to eat.
The food there is really delicious, but a bit expensive.
David thought, although it is expensive, today is a good day.
In the afternoon, David read books in the bookstore for a long time.
He wanted to buy a book about history, but there wasn't enough time.
He told the clerk, "I must leave now, I will come again next time."
The clerk said, "No problem, goodbye!"
David walked on the way home and felt the sky was getting dark quickly.
The time now is already very late; it should be seven o'clock in the evening.
He walked very fast because he wanted to go home immediately.
After returning home, he found there was no electricity in the house.
He thought, this is too terrible because he still needs to study.
He decided to wash his hands first to make them clean.
Then, he lit a candle and sat in front of the table.
Sometimes he feels the darkness is very quiet, good for thinking.
He began to seriously read his book, although the light was very weak.
After a while, his friend Xiao Ming came.
Xiao Ming said, "David, what are you doing here?"
David said, "I am studying, but my house has no electricity."
Xiao Ming laughed and said, "You are still too serious."
David asked, "Do you understand what I mean? Studying is important."
Xiao Ming nodded and said, "I understand, but now is the time to rest."
Xiao Ming brought some delicious snacks.
David said, "Thank you, Xiao Ming!"
They chatted together and talked about many interesting things.
David discovered that although studying is very important, friends are more important.
Xiao Ming told David that the best way to study is to rest well.
David listened and felt it made a lot of sense.
He decided not to study anymore today.
They repeatedly discussed stories from their childhood.
This evening became truly warm.
Finally, Xiao Ming prepared to go home.
He told David, "Go to sleep early, see you tomorrow."
David smiled and said, "Okay, goodbye."
David looked at the sky outside the window and felt in a very good mood.
He realized that every moment in life is very precious.

stories.story_chinese:
老王是一位很有名的汉语老师。
他每天在学校教学生们学习中文。
今天是星期五，第一节课是听写。
学生们在纸上认真地写字。
一个学生叫大卫，他是来自日本的学生。
大卫在写字的时候，手有点儿抖。
他觉得写汉字很难，但是他很喜欢学习。
下课了，同学们都走了。
只有大卫还坐在教室里，看着他的本子。
老王走过来，轻轻地对他笑了笑。
“大卫，你为什么不走呢？”老王问。
大卫说：“老师，我有一个问题。”
他指着本子右边的字说：“这个字怎么读？”
老王看着那个字，说：“这个字很简单。”
老王拿了一杯水，喝了一口。
他告诉大卫，学习语言需要时间。
“你看，这块橡皮是给你的，你可以用它改错。”
大卫高兴地接过橡皮，说：“谢谢老师！”
老王说：“后天是星期日，你打算去哪儿？”
大卫想了想，说：“我想去书店买几本书。”
“那我们一块儿去吧！”老王热情地邀请他。
大卫很惊讶，因为他觉得老王很严肃。
“真的吗？太好了！”大卫开心地跳了起来。
老王看了看表，现在差五分四点。
他提醒大卫：“快点走吧，我们要关上窗户。”
大卫赶紧帮老师关上窗户。
他们走出教室，走在学校的后边。
阳光很温暖，空气里有一点儿花香。
大卫觉得在这个城市学习中文是一件快乐的事。
他想，如果能多跟老王聊天，学习就会更快。
这就是大卫和老王之间简单的友谊。

stories.story_pinyin:
Lǎo Wáng shì yī wèi hěn yǒu míng de hànyǔ lǎoshī.
Tā měitiān zài xuéxiào jiāo xuéshengmen xuéxí zhōngwén.
Jīntiān shì xīngqīwǔ, dì yī jié kè shì tīngxiě.
Xuéshengmen zài zhǐ shàng rènzhēn de xiězì.
Yī gè xuésheng jiào Dàwèi, tā shì láizì Rìběn de xuésheng.
Dàwèi zài xiězì de shíhou, shǒu yǒu diǎnr dǒu.
Tā juéde xiě hànzì hěn nán, dànshì tā hěn xǐhuan xuéxí.
Xiàkè le, tóngxuémen dōu zǒu le.
Zhǐyǒu Dàwèi hái zuò zài jiàoshì lǐ, kànzhe tā de běnzi.
Lǎo Wáng zǒu guòlái, qīngqīng de duì tā xiào le xiào.
“Dàwèi, nǐ wèishéme bù zǒu ne?” Lǎo Wáng wèn.
Dàwèi shuō: “Lǎoshī, wǒ yǒu yī gè wèntí.”
Tā zhǐzhe běnzi yòubiān de zì shuō: “Zhège zì zěnme dú?”
Lǎo Wáng kànzhe nàge zì, shuō: “Zhège zì hěn jiǎndān.”
Lǎo Wáng ná le yī bēi shuǐ, hē le yī kǒu.
Tā gàosù Dàwèi, xuéxí yǔyán xūyào shíjiān.
“Nǐ kàn, zhè kuài xiàngpí shì gěi nǐ de, nǐ kěyǐ yòng tā gǎicuò.”
Dàwèi gāoxìng de jiēguò xiàngpí, shuō: “Xièxie lǎoshī!”
Lǎo Wáng shuō: “Hòutiān shì xīngqīrì, nǐ dǎsuàn qù nǎr?”
Dàwèi xiǎng le xiǎng, shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng qù shūdiàn mǎi jǐ běn shū.”
“Nà wǒmen yīkuàir qù ba!” Lǎo Wáng rèqíng de yāoqǐng tā.
Dàwèi hěn jīngyà, yīnwèi tā juéde Lǎo Wáng hěn yánsù.
“Zhēn de ma? Tài hǎo le!” Dàwèi kāixīn de tiào le qǐlái.
Lǎo Wáng kàn le kàn biǎo, xiànzài chà wǔ fēn sì diǎn.
Tā tíxǐng Dàwèi: “Kuài diǎn zǒu ba, wǒmen yào guānshàng chuānghu.”
Dàwèi gǎnjǐn bāng lǎoshī guānshàng chuānghu.
Tāmen zǒuchū jiàoshì, zǒu zài xuéxiào de hòubian.
Yángguāng hěn wēnnuǎn, kōngqì lǐ yǒu yīdiǎnr huāxiāng.
Dàwèi juéde zài zhège chéngshì xuéxí zhōngwén shì yī jiàn kuàilè de shì.
Tā xiǎng, rúguǒ néng duō gēn Lǎo Wáng liáotiān, xuéxí jiù huì gèng kuài.
Zhè jiùshì Dàwèi hé Lǎo Wáng zhījiān jiǎndān de yǒuyì.

stories.story_english:
Old Wang is a very famous Chinese teacher.
Every day he is at school teaching the students to study Chinese.
Today is Friday, and the first lesson is dictation.
The students are writing characters seriously on the paper.
One student is called David; he is a student from Japan.
While writing, David's hand shook a little bit.
He feels writing Chinese characters is very difficult, but he loves studying.
Class is over, and the classmates have all left.
Only David is still sitting in the classroom, looking at his notebook.
Old Wang walked over and smiled gently at him.
"David, why aren't you leaving?" Old Wang asked.
David said, "Teacher, I have a question."
He pointed to the character on the right side of the notebook and said, "How do you read this character?"
Old Wang looked at the character and said, "This character is very simple."
Old Wang took a glass of water and took a sip.
He told David that learning a language takes time.
"Look, this piece of eraser is for you; you can use it to correct mistakes."
David happily took the eraser and said, "Thank you, teacher!"
Old Wang said, "The day after tomorrow is Sunday, where do you plan to go?"
David thought for a while and said, "I want to go to the bookstore to buy a few books."
"Then let's go together!" Old Wang invited him warmly.
David was very surprised because he thought Old Wang was very serious.
"Really? That's great!" David jumped up happily.
Old Wang looked at his watch; it is five minutes to four.
He reminded David, "Let's go quickly, we need to close the windows."
David hurried to help the teacher close the windows.
They walked out of the classroom and walked at the back of the school.
The sunlight was warm, and there was a little bit of flower fragrance in the air.
David feels that studying Chinese in this city is a happy thing.
He thought that if he could chat more with Old Wang, learning would be faster.
This is the simple friendship between David and Old Wang.

stories.story_chinese:
在城市的一个小图书馆里，周老师正在准备一场特殊的聚会。
他想邀请一群姓氏非常罕见的朋友。
他拿出一张白纸，开始写一个邀请名单。
首先，他写下了自己的姓名：周明。
然后，他想到了住在东方的老朋友东方先生。
接着，他写下了来自加拿大的加先生。
他想，如果能把这些有趣的人聚在一起，一定很有名。
名单上的名字越来越长。
他写下了平先生，写下了怕先生。
成先生和查先生是最好的朋友，所以他把他们写在一起。
海先生和米先生都喜欢画画。
红先生和组先生则喜欢唱歌。
蓝先生和角先生是著名的音乐家。
闻先生和阴先生经常一起讨论历史。
雪先生和题先生是大学的教授。
鱼先生和黄先生则是很有名的厨师。
但是，周老师突然发现了一个问题。
他忘记写邀请的时间和地点了。
他很担心大家会因为没有信息而不能来。
他赶紧给每一个人打电话。
大家在电话里都哈哈大笑，觉得这个聚会太有趣了。
最后，这群拥有奇特姓氏的人在周六下午聚在了一起。
他们分享故事，谈论生活，度过了一个温暖的下午。
story_chinese_sentences: 在城市的一个小图书馆里，周老师正在准备一场特殊的聚会。
他想邀请一群姓氏非常罕见的朋友。
他拿出一张白纸，开始写一个邀请名单。
首先，他写下了自己的姓名：周明。
然后，他想到了住在东方的老朋友东方先生。
接着，他写下了来自加拿大的加先生。
他想，如果能把这些有趣的人聚在一起，一定很有名。
名单上的名字越来越长。
他写下了平先生，写下了怕先生。
成先生和查先生是最好的朋友，所以他把他们写在一起。
海先生和米先生都喜欢画画。
红先生和组先生则喜欢唱歌。
蓝先生和角先生是著名的音乐家。
闻先生和阴先生经常一起讨论历史。
雪先生和题先生是大学的教授。
鱼先生和黄先生则是很有名的厨师。
但是，周老师突然发现了一个问题。
他忘记写邀请的时间和地点了。
他很担心大家会因为没有信息而不能来。
他赶紧给每一个人打电话。
大家在电话里都哈哈大笑，觉得这个聚会太有趣了。
最后，这群拥有奇特姓氏的人在周六下午聚在了一起。
他们分享故事，谈论生活，度过了一个温暖的下午。
stories.story_pinyin:
Zài chéng shì de yī gè xiǎo tú shū guǎn lǐ, Zhōu lǎo shī zhèng zài zhǔn bèi yī chǎng tè shū de jù huì.
Tā xiǎng yāo qǐng yī qún xìng shì fēi cháng hǎn jiàn de péng yǒu.
Tā ná chū yī zhāng bái zhǐ, kāi shǐ xiě yī gè yāo qǐng míng dān.
Shǒu xiān, tā xiě xià le zì jǐ de xìng míng: Zhōu Míng.
Rán hòu, tā xiǎng dào zhù zài dōng fāng de lǎo péng yǒu Dōng fāng xiān sheng.
Jiē zhe, tā xiě xià le lái zì jiā ná dà de Jiā xiān sheng.
Tā xiǎng, rú guǒ néng bǎ zhè xiē yǒu qù de rén jù zài yī qǐ, yī dìng hěn yǒu míng.
Míng dān shàng de míng zì yuè lái yuè cháng.
Tā xiě xià le Píng xiān sheng, xiě xià le Pà xiān sheng.
Chéng xiān sheng hé Zhā xiān sheng shì zuì hǎo de péng yǒu, suǒ yǐ tā bǎ tā men xiě zài yī qǐ.
Hǎi xiān sheng hé Mǐ xiān sheng dōu xǐ huan huà huà.
Hóng xiān sheng hé Zǔ xiān sheng zé xǐ huan chàng gē.
Lán xiān sheng hé Jué xiān sheng shì zhù míng de yīn yuè jiā.
Wén xiān sheng hé Yīn xiān sheng jīng cháng yī qǐ tǎo lùn lì shǐ.
Xuě xiān sheng hé Tí xiān sheng shì dà xué de jiào shòu.
Yú xiān sheng hé Huáng xiān sheng zé shì hěn yǒu míng de chú shī.
Dàn shì, Zhōu lǎo shī tū rán fā xiàn le yī gè wèn tí.
Tā wàng jì xiě yāo qǐng de shí jiān hé dì diǎn le.
Tā hěn dān xīn dà jiā huì yīn wèi méi yǒu xìn xī ér bù néng lái.
Tā gǎn jǐn gěi měi yī gè rén dǎ diàn huà.
Dà jiā zài diàn huà lǐ dōu hā hā dà xiào, jué de zhè gè jù huì tài yǒu qù le.
Zuì hòu, zhè qún yōng yǒu qí tè xìng shì de rén zài Zhōu liù xià wǔ jù zài le yī qǐ.
Tā men fēn xiǎng gù shì, tán lùn shēng huó, dù guò le yī gè wēn nuǎn de xià wǔ.

stories.story_english:
In a small library in the city, Teacher Zhou was preparing for a special gathering.
He wanted to invite a group of friends with very rare surnames.
He took out a piece of white paper and began to write an invitation list.
First, he wrote down his own full name: Zhou Ming.
Then, he thought of his old friend, Mr. Dongfang, who lived in the East.
Next, he wrote down Mr. Jia, who came from Canada.
He thought that if he could gather these interesting people together, it would certainly be famous.
The names on the list grew longer and longer.
He wrote down Mr. Ping and Mr. Pa.
Mr. Cheng and Mr. Zha were best friends, so he wrote them together.
Mr. Hai and Mr. Mi both liked to paint.
Mr. Hong and Mr. Zu liked to sing.
Mr. Lan and Mr. Jue were famous musicians.
Mr. Wen and Mr. Yin often discussed history together.
Mr. Xue and Mr. Ti were university professors.
Mr. Yu and Mr. Huang were very famous chefs.
However, Teacher Zhou suddenly discovered a problem.
He had forgotten to write the time and location of the invitation.
He was very worried that everyone would be unable to come because there was no information.
He quickly called everyone.
Everyone laughed out loud on the phone, thinking this gathering was too interesting.
Finally, this group of people with peculiar surnames gathered on Saturday afternoon.
They shared stories, talked about life, and spent a warm afternoon together.

stories.story_chinese:
在小镇的尽头，老林住在一座有白墙的小房子里。
他每天早起，把一碗温水放在窗台边。
有一天，他发现花园里的草长得太快，占了路。
他决定清理一下，顺便给植物浇水。
老林背着一个旧水桶，慢慢走在小路上。
他看到一片奇怪的药叶子，样子很特别。
他想起以前在书上读过的词，这可能是某种名贵植物。
他轻轻地碰了一下那片叶子，感觉很柔软。
这时，一只小鸟落在他的肩膀上，好奇地看着他。
老林笑着说：“咱俩一起看看这个花园吧。”
他举起手，试图逗弄那只小鸟。
突然，他发现墙角有一张旧纸，上面写着几句诗。
他读了一遍，发现那是他年轻时留下的记录。
他想起年轻时曾坐船去远方旅行的日子。
那时候的他，总觉得生活像个假故事一样精彩。
夜深了，他坐在灯下，重新写了几句感悟。
他把这些记忆像蛋一样小心地呵护着。
他觉得生活虽然简单，但每一天都很温暖。
他闭上眼，听着窗外的风声入睡了。

stories.story_pinyin:
Zài xiǎo zhèn de jìn tóu, lǎo lín zhù zài yī zuò yǒu bái qiáng de xiǎo fáng zi lǐ.
Tā měi tiān zǎo qǐ, bǎ yī wǎn wēn shuǐ fàng zài chuāng tái biān.
Yǒu yī tiān, tā fā xiàn huā yuán lǐ de cǎo zhǎng de tài kuài, zhàn le lù.
Tā jué dìng qīng lǐ yī xià, shùn biàn gěi zhí wù jiāo shuǐ.
Lǎo lín bēi zhe yī gè jiù shuǐ tǒng, màn màn zǒu zài xiǎo lù shàng.
Tā kàn dào yī piàn qí guài de yào yè zi, yàng zi hěn tè bié.
Tā xiǎng qǐ yǐ qián zài shū shàng dú guò de cí, zhè kě néng shì mǒu zhǒng míng guì zhí wù.
Tā qīng qīng de pèng le yī xià nà piàn yè zi, gǎn jué hěn róu ruǎn.
Zhè shí, yī zhǐ xiǎo niǎo luò zài tā de jiān bǎng shàng, hào qí de kàn zhe tā.
Lǎo lín xiào zhe shuō: “Zán liǎ yī qǐ kàn kàn zhè gè huā yuán ba.”
Tā jǔ qǐ shǒu, shì tú dòu nòng nà zhǐ xiǎo niǎo.

stories.story_english:
At the end of the small town, Old Lin lived in a small house with white walls.
Every day he woke up early and placed a bowl of warm water on the windowsill.
One day, he found that the grass in the garden grew too fast and took up the path.
He decided to clean it up and water the plants at the same time.
Old Lin carried an old water bucket on his back, walking slowly along the path.
He saw a strange medicinal leaf that looked very special.
He remembered a word he had read in a book before; this might be some kind of precious plant.
He gently touched the leaf and felt it was very soft.
Just then, a small bird landed on his shoulder, looking at him curiously.
Old Lin smiled and said, "Let's look at this garden together."
He raised his hand, trying to tease the little bird.
Suddenly, he found a piece of old paper in the corner of the wall with a few lines of poetry written on it.
He read it once and found it was a record he had left when he was young.
He remembered the days when he used to take a boat to travel to distant places.
At that time, he always felt that life was as exciting as a fake story.
As night fell, he sat under the lamp and wrote a few reflections again.
He cherished these memories as carefully as an egg.
He felt that although life was simple, every day was very warm.
He closed his eyes and fell asleep listening to the sound of the wind outside the window.

stories.story_chinese:
在热闹的城市里，有一个安静的小巷。
这里住着很多不同年纪的人。
林先生是一位中年人，他是一名著名的中医。
他的太太是一位温柔的西医，两人在同一家医院工作。
他们结婚三十周年了，生活非常幸福。
林先生每天习惯在晚餐后读一份晚报。
他喜欢在夜里思考中医和西医的不同之处。
在这个小巷里，还有很多年轻的青年。
其中有一个叫小明的少年，他正在读高中。
小明现在是高二年级，学习非常努力。
这个学期，他决定学习一种更高级的数学课程。
他参加了一个中级数学班，希望能提高成绩。
小明有一个好朋友叫大卫，大卫是一名留学生。
大卫想学好普通话，所以经常请教小明。
他们每天一起在笔记本上写新的生词。
大卫说，学习中文的日子虽然辛苦，但很有意思。
有一天，大卫问小明：“在中国过年是什么感觉？”
小明笑着说：“春节是我们最重要、最热闹的节日。”
那天晚上，他们骑着自行车在街上走走。
街道上的行人很多，其中不少是来自各地的游客。
他们看到一位老年人在公园里散步，那是林先生的老朋友。
林先生告诉小明，青少年时期是人生最美好的时光。
小明觉得，大人看待世界的眼光和孩子不一样。
有一天半夜，小明突然醒来，发现窗外下雪了。
他想起学校的校长曾经说过，冬天的夜晚最安静。
小明想，如果他能成为一名优秀的医生，就能够帮助更多的人。
他决定在未来的日子里更加刻苦地学习。
第二天，林先生邀请小明和大卫去家里吃中餐。
林先生做了很多好吃的菜，而且火候很熟。
大卫尝试了宫保鸡丁，觉得味道非常好。
晚餐结束后，林先生给他们讲了许多关于中医的故事。
小明和大卫听得非常认真，觉得中医非常有魅力。
临走时，大卫对林先生和太太说：“晚安，谢谢你们的晚餐。”
在这个温暖的夜晚，青春的梦想在灯火中闪光。

stories.story_pinyin:
Zài rè nao de chéng shì lǐ, yǒu yí gè ān jìng de xiǎo xiàng.
Zhè lǐ zhù zhe hěn duō bù tóng nián jì de rén.
Lín xiān sheng shì yí wèi zhōng nián rén, tā shì yì míng zhù míng de zhōng yī.
Tā de tài tai shì yí wèi wēn róu de xī yī, liǎng rén zài tóng yì jiā yī yuàn gōng zuò.
Tā men jié hūn sān shí zhōu nián le, shēng huó fēi cháng xìng fú.
Lín xiān sheng měi tiān xí guàn zài wǎn cān hòu dú yí fèn wǎn bào.
Tā xǐ huan zài yè lǐ sī kǎo zhōng yī hé xī yī de bù tóng zhī chù.
Zài zhè ge xiǎo xiàng lǐ, hái yǒu hěn duō nián qīng de qīng nián.
Qí zhōng yǒu yí gè jiào Xiǎo Míng de shào nián, tā zhèng zài dú gāo zhōng.
Xiǎo Míng xiàn zài shì gāo èr nián jí, xué xí fēi cháng nǔ lì.
Zhè ge xué qī, tā jué dìng xué xí yì zhǒng gèng gāo jí de shù xué kè chéng.
Tā cān jiā le yí gè zhōng jí shù xué bān, xī wàng néng tí gāo chéng jī.
Xiǎo Míng yǒu yí gè hǎo péng you jiào Dà Wèi, Dà Wèi shì yì míng liú xué shēng.
Dà Wèi xiǎng xué hǎo pǔ tōng huà, suǒ yǐ jīng cháng qǐng jiào Xiǎo Míng.
Tā men měi tiān yì qǐ zài bǐ jì běn shàng xiě xīn de shēng cí.
Dà Wèi shuō, xué xí zhōng wén de rì zi suī rán xīn kǔ, dàn hěn yǒu yì si.
Yǒu yì tiān, Dà Wèi wèn Xiǎo Míng: “Zài Zhōng guó guò nián shì shén me gǎn jué?”
Xiǎo Míng xiào zhe shuō: “Chūn jié shì wǒ men zuì zhòng yào, zuì rè nao de jié rì.”
Nà tiān wǎn shang, tā men qí zhe zì xíng chē zài jiē shàng zǒu zǒu.
Jiē dào shàng de xíng rén hěn duō, qí zhōng bù shǎo shì lái zì gè dì de yóu kè.
Tā men kàn dào yí wèi lǎo nián rén zài gōng yuán lǐ sàn bù, nà shì Lín xiān sheng de lǎo péng you.
Lín xiān sheng gào su Xiǎo Míng, qīng shào nián shí qī shì rén shēng zuì měi hǎo de shí guāng.
