stories.story_english:
Mr. Lin was a retired pharmacist with an abnormally sensitive sense of smell.
He could distinguish minute changes in the air; even a faint fishy smell could instantly remind him of his childhood by the sea.
In his view, scents were anchors of memory, while most people turned a blind eye to them.
He lived in a quiet alley, steeping a pot of clear tea every morning and quietly observing the swallows flying past the window.
His life was extremely disciplined; even when bathing, he would carefully compare the fragrances of different brands of shower gel.
But this sensitivity was sometimes like a side effect, making it impossible for him to endure the noisy and chaotic smells of the modern city.
He hated the smell of cheap MSG, believing it masked the purity of the ingredients themselves.
He preferred soups stewed over a slow fire, the rich aroma of which could soothe his throat.
However, his son, Lin Feng, was completely different; young Lin Feng always chewed gum and wore clothes smelling of industrial fragrances.
The two often quarreled over their living habits; Lin Feng felt his father was too old-fashioned, while Mr. Lin felt his son lacked an appreciation for detail.
Lin Feng had a slight stammer when under great pressure, which made him sensitive and irritable.
Once, during an argument, Lin Feng accidentally splashed a glass of soy milk onto the pages of Mr. Lin's antique book.
Mr. Lin trembled with rage and instinctively wiped the liquid from the book, only to find a tear in the page.
Lin Feng tried to apologize in his guilt, but due to nervousness, his words knotted in his throat, making a strange sound.
Mr. Lin looked at his son, and in his heart, there was no anger, only a deep sense of helplessness.
He remembered that Lin Feng was very naughty as a child, often blowing a loud whistle and running around the yard.
At that time, Lin Feng was still very young, and he would occasionally drool while speaking, which led to sneers from the neighborhood children.
Mr. Lin had stood in front of his son then, sternly stopping the ridicule, although he himself had a short temper.
He remembered one time when Lin Feng had mistakenly eaten some contaminated food, triggering violent vomiting.
At that time, the doctor said that if not handled promptly, it could develop into severe cholera; Mr. Lin wept by the bedside, heartbroken.
During those days, Mr. Lin brewed cough-suppressing medicinal soups for his son every day, carefully tending to his cough.
He remembered his son choking on the medicinal juice during his illness, coughing violently, his face turning bright red.
Mr. Lin gently patted his son's back and used warm water to help him rinse his mouth until he could normally swallow saliva.
Time passed, and the relationship between father and son became stiff in silence, like a dried piece of soap.
Until one day, Lin Feng suddenly fell seriously ill, resulting in the complete loss of his sense of smell.
He could no longer smell food, nor could he feel the colors of the world; life became bland and tasteless.
He finally realized that his father's so-called "old-fashionedness" was actually the most delicate observation of life.
Lin Feng returned home and saw his father carefully brushing his teeth with toothpaste, then grinning with warmth in his eyes.
He walked over and gently hugged his father, although his throat felt dry from emotion.
He no longer complained, nor did he have any further complaints, just quietly feeling the faint scent of herbal medicine on his father.
Mr. Lin felt his son's tears fall on his shoulder, like a long-overdue baptism.
He didn't speak, but just patted his son's back with his rough hand, as if comforting, and as if forgiving.
The rift that once existed between them was dissolved in this moment by a silent understanding.
In this world full of scents, they finally found each other's frequency again.

sentences.pinyin: Tā jì de Lín Fēng xiǎo shí hòu hěn tiáo pí, jīng cháng chuī qǐ xiǎng liàng de kǒu shào, zài yuàn zi lǐ pǎo lái pǎo qù.
sentences.english: He remembered that Lin Feng was very naughty as a child, often blowing a loud whistle and running around the yard.

sentences.chinese: 那时林峰还很稚嫩，说话时偶尔会流出一些口水，被邻居的孩子讥笑。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shí Lín Fēng hái hěn zhì nèn, shuō huà shí ǒu ér huì liú chū yī xiē kǒu shuǐ, bèi lín jū de hái zi jī xiào.
sentences.english: At that time, Lin Feng was still very young, and he would occasionally drool while speaking, which led to sneers from the neighborhood children.

sentences.chinese: 林先生当时挡在儿子面前，严厉地制止了那些嘲笑，虽然他自己脾气也不好。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng dāng shí dǎng zài ér zi miàn qián, yán lì de zhì zhǐ le nà xiē cháo xiào, suī rán tā zì jǐ pí qi yě bù hǎo.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin had stood in front of his son then, sternly stopping the ridicule, although he himself had a short temper.

sentences.chinese: 他记得有一次，林峰因为误食了某种不洁的食物，引发了剧烈的呕吐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì de yǒu yī cì, Lín Fēng yīn wèi wù shí le mǒu zhǒng bù jié de shí wù, yǐn fā le jù liè de ǒu tù.
sentences.english: He remembered one time when Lin Feng had mistakenly eaten some contaminated food, triggering violent vomiting.

sentences.chinese: 那时医生说，如果处理不及时，可能会演变成严重的霍乱，林先生在病床前流泪，心疼不已。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shí yī shēng shuō, rú guǒ chǔ lǐ bù jí shí, kě néng huì yǎn biàn chéng yán zhòng de huò luàn, Lín xiān sheng zài bìng chuáng qián liú lèi, xīn téng bù yǐ.
sentences.english: At that time, the doctor said that if not handled promptly, it could develop into severe cholera; Mr. Lin wept by the bedside, heartbroken.

sentences.chinese: 在那段日子里，林先生每天为儿子熬制止咳的汤药，细心地照顾他的咳嗽。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nà duàn rì zi lǐ, Lín xiān sheng měi tiān wèi ér zi áo zhì zhǐ ké de tāng yào, xì xīn de zhào gù tā de ké sou.
sentences.english: During those days, Mr. Lin brewed cough-suppressing medicinal soups for his son every day, carefully tending to his cough.

sentences.chinese: 他记得儿子在病中被药汁呛到，剧烈地咳嗽起来，脸涨得通红。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì de ér zi zài bìng zhōng bèi yào zhī qiāng dào, jù liè de ké sou qǐ lái, liǎn zhǎng de tōng hóng.
sentences.english: He remembered his son choking on the medicinal juice during his illness, coughing violently, his face turning bright red.

sentences.chinese: 林先生轻轻拍着儿子的背，用温水帮他清洗口腔，直到他能正常吞咽唾液。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng qīng qīng pāi zhe ér zi de bèi, yòng wēn shuǐ bāng tā xǐ qǐ kǒu qiāng, zhí dào tā néng zhèng cháng tūn yàn tuò yè.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin gently patted his son's back and used warm water to help him rinse his mouth until he could normally swallow saliva.

sentences.chinese: 时间流逝，父子关系在沉默中变得僵硬，像是一块干涸的肥皂。
sentences.pinyin: Shí jiān liú shì, fù zǐ guān xì zài chén mò zhōng biàn de jiāng yì, xiàng shì yī kuài gān hé de féi zào.
sentences.english: Time passed, and the relationship between father and son became stiff in silence, like a dried piece of soap.

sentences.chinese: 直到有一天，林峰突然生了一场重病，导致他的嗅觉完全丧失。
sentences.pinyin: Zhí dào yǒu yī tiān, Lín Fēng tū rán shēng le yī chǎng zhòng bìng, dǎo zhì tā de xiù jué wán quán sàng shī.
sentences.english: Until one day, Lin Feng suddenly fell seriously ill, resulting in the complete loss of his sense of smell.

sentences.chinese: 他无法闻到食物的味道，也无法感受到世界的色彩，生活变得索然无味。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wú fǎ wén dào shí wù de wèi dào, yě wú fǎ gǎn shòu shì jiè de sè cǎi, shēng huó biàn de suǒ rán wú wèi.
sentences.english: He could no longer smell food, nor could he feel the colors of the world; life became bland and tasteless.

sentences.chinese: 他终于意识到，父亲那些所谓的“古板”，其实是对生命最细腻的体察。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhōng yú yì shí dào, fù qīn nà xiē suǒ wèi de “gǔ bǎn”, qí shí shì duì shēng mìng zuì xì nì de tǐ chá.
sentences.english: He finally realized that his father's so-called "old-fashionedness" was actually the most delicate observation of life.

sentences.chinese: 林峰回到家，看到父亲正用牙膏仔细地刷着牙，然后咧嘴笑了笑，眼神中带着温情。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng huí dào jiā, kàn dào fù qīn zhèng yòng yá gāo zǐ xì de shuā zhe yá, rán hòu liě zuǐ xiào le xiào, yǎn shén zhōng dài zhe wēn qíng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng returned home and saw his father carefully brushing his teeth with toothpaste, then grinning with warmth in his eyes.

sentences.chinese: 他走过去，轻轻抱住父亲，虽然他的喉咙因为激动而感到干涩。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu guò qù, qīng qīng bào zhù fù qīn, suī rán tā de hóu lóng yīn wèi jī dòng ér gǎn dào gān sè.
sentences.english: He walked over and gently hugged his father, although his throat felt dry from emotion.

sentences.chinese: 他不再抱怨，也不再有任何怨言，只是静静地感受着父亲身上淡淡的药草香。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zài bào yuàn, yě bù zài yǒu rèn hé yuàn yán, zhǐ shì jì jìng de gǎn shòu zhe fù qīn shēn shàng dàn dàn de yào cǎo xiāng.
sentences.english: He no longer complained, nor did he have any further complaints, just quietly feeling the faint scent of herbal medicine on his father.

sentences.chinese: 林先生感觉到儿子的眼泪落在他的肩头，像是一场迟来的洗礼。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng gǎn jué dào ér zi de yǎn lèi luò zài tā de jiān tóu, xiàng shì yī chǎng chí lái de xǐ lǐ.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin felt his son's tears fall on his shoulder, like a long-overdue baptism.

sentences.chinese: 他没有说话，只是用粗糙的手拍了拍儿子的背，像是安慰，也像是原谅。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méi yǒu shuō huà, zhǐ shì yòng cū cāo de shǒu pāi le pāi ér zi de bèi, xiàng shì ān wèi, yě xiàng shì yuán liàng.
sentences.english: He didn't speak, but just patted his son's back with his rough hand, as if comforting, and as if forgiving.

sentences.chinese: 他们之间曾经的隔阂，在这一刻被一种无声的理解所化解。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zhī jiān céng jīng de gé hé, zài zhè yī kè bèi yī zhǒng wú shēng de lǐ jiě suǒ huà jiě.
sentences.english: The rift that once existed between them was dissolved in this moment by a silent understanding.

sentences.chinese: 在这个充满气味的世界上，他们终于找回了彼此的频率。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè ge chōng mǎn qì wèi de shì jiè shàng, tā men zhōng yú zhǎo huí le bǐ cǐ de pín lǜ.
sentences.english: In this world full of scents, they finally found each other's frequency again.

stories.story_chinese:
林教授习惯在月初整理他的旧信件。
他翻开上期的学术期刊，想起与老友的约定。
两人约定在腊月重逢，共同探讨古籍的真伪。
三月上旬，春寒料峭，他写信告知对方进度。
到了中旬，窗外的柳树开始抽芽，信件终于有了回音。
对方在信中提到，由于研究繁忙，预计要到下旬才能动身。
林教授笑了，他在日历上标注了下期的会面日期。
时间在笔尖流转，而友谊在等待中愈发深厚。

stories.story_english:
Professor Lin was in the habit of organizing his old letters at the beginning of the month.
He flipped through the previous issue of the academic journal and remembered an agreement with an old friend.
The two had agreed to reunite in the twelfth lunar month to jointly discuss the authenticity of ancient texts.
In the first ten days of March, while the spring chill was still biting, he wrote a letter to inform the other party of his progress.
By the middle of the month, the willows outside the window began to bud, and the letter finally received a reply.
The other party mentioned in the letter that due to a busy research schedule, they were expected to set out only in the last ten days of the month.
Professor Lin smiled and marked the date of the next period's meeting on his calendar.
Time flowed beneath the tip of the pen, and friendship grew deeper in the waiting.

stories.story_chinese:
林教授是一位退休的城市规划师，他习惯在黄昏时分漫步于这座城市的大街小巷。
他认为城市的灵魂隐藏在那些交织的线条之中。
今天，他走在宽阔的人行道上，看着人们匆匆而过。
偶尔，他会离开主路，走上一条狭窄的便道，去寻找那些被遗忘的旧建筑。
在一个喧闹的十字路口，他停下脚步，等待着绿灯亮起。
他观察着车道上川流不息的车辆，思考着现代城市路况的复杂性。
林教授记得年轻时，他曾负责设计一段连接郊区与市中心的关键路段。
那时的路面还不够平整，但充满了开拓的勇气。
他曾在无数个夜晚，在狭长的走廊里对着图纸苦思冥想。
他试图将僵硬的直线改为柔美的曲线，让道路与自然和谐共处。
为了实现这个想法，他不得不寻找各种门路，向资深的工程师请教。
最终，他在城市边缘规划了一片绿地，将自然之美引入钢筋水泥之中。
如今，他沿着那条熟悉的道路前行，路灯一盏接一盏地亮起。
路途虽然漫长，但每一步都像是在回顾自己的青春。
他路过一家古色古香的书店，门上贴着一副气势磅礴的对联。
书店一旁的小路通向一片幽静的竹林。
林教授想起多年前的一次考察，他曾翻山越岭走在崎岖的山路上。
那时他发现一个古老的地道，隐藏在茂密的植被之下。
他在半路遇到了一位当地的农夫，两人就地坐下，讨论起古道的历史。
农夫告诉他，真正的公道不在于道路的宽窄，而在于人心的是非。
这句话让林教授陷入了沉思，他意识到规划的本质是服务于人。
他记得在学校的跑道上，学生们在起跑线前紧张地等待着。
他们奔跑的姿态，像极了这座城市在发展初期的那种急切。
如今，他走在宽敞的过道中，看着窗外的风景在沿线缓缓展开。
沿途的风景已然改变，但那些基础的线条依然支撑着城市的骨架。
他轻轻触摸着墙壁，仿佛能听到城市在呼吸。
他决定顺路去拜访一位老友，分享这些关于线条的感悟。
他知道，无论世界如何改变，寻找方向的路永远在脚下。

stories.story_pinyin:
Lín jiàoshòu shì yī wèi tuìxiū de chéngshì guīhuàshī, tā xíguàn zài huánghūn shí fēn mànbù yú zhè zuò chéngshì de dàjiē xiǎoxiàng.
Tā rènwéi chéngshì de línghún yǐncáng zài nàxiē jiāozhī de xiàntiáo zhī zhōng.
Jīntiān, tā zǒu zài kuānkuò de rénxíngdào shàng, kànzhe rénmen cōngcōng ér guò.
Ǒu'ěr, tā huì líkāi zhǔlù, zǒu shàng yī tiáo xiǎozhǎi de biàndào, qù xúnzhǎo nàxiē bèi yíwàng de jiù jiànzhù.
Zài yī gè xuānnào de shízì lùkǒu, tā tíng xià jiǎobù, děngdàizhe lǜdēng liàngqǐ.
Tā guāncházhe chēdào shàng chuānliú bù xī de chēliàng, sīkǎozhe xiàndài chéngshì lùkuàng de fùzá xìng.
Lín jiàoshòu jìde niánqīng shí, tā céng fùzé shèjì yī duàn liánjiē jiāoqū yǔ shì zhōngxīn de guānjiàn lùduàn.
Nà shí de lùmiàn hái bùgòu píngzhěng, dàn chōngmǎnle kāituò de yǒngqì.
Tā céng zài wúshù gè yèwǎn, zài xiápáng de zǒuláng lǐ duìzhe túzhǐ kǔsī míngxiǎng.
Tā shìtú jiāng jiāngyìng de zhíxiàn gǎi wéi róuměi de qūxiàn, ràng dàolù yǔ zìrán héxié gòngchǔ.
Wèile shíxiàn zhège xiǎngfǎ, tā bùdébù xúnzhǎo gèzhǒng ménlù, xiàng zīshēn de gōngchéngshī qǐngjiào.
Zuìzhōng, tā zài chéngshì biānyuán guīhuàle yī piàn lǜdì, jiāng zìrán zhī měi yǐnrù gāngjīn shūní zhī zhōng.
Rújīn, tā yánzhe nà tiáo shúxī de dàolù qiánxíng, lùdēng yī zhǎn yī zhǎn de liàngqǐ.
Lùtú suīrán màncháng, dàn měi yī bù dōu xiàng shì zài huígù zìjǐ de qīngchūn.
Tā lùguò yī jiā gǔsè gǔxiāng de shūdiàn, mén shàng tiēzhe yī fù qìshì pángbó de duìlián.
Shūdiàn yīpáng de xiǎolù tōngxiàng yī piàn yōujìng de zhúlín.
Lín jiàoshòu xiǎngqǐ duō nián qián de yī cì kǎochá, tā céng fānshān yuèlǐng zǒu zài qīqū de shānlù shàng.
Nà shí tā fāxiàn yī gè gǔlǎo de dìdào, yǐncáng zài màomì de zhíbèi zhī xià.
Tā zài bànlù yùdàole yī wèi dāngdì de nóngfū, liǎng rén jiùdì zuò xià, tǎolùn qǐ gǔdào de lìshǐ.
Nóngfū gàosù tā, zhēnzhèng de gōngdào bù zàiyú dàolù de kuānzhǎi, ér zàiyú rénxīn de shìfēi.
Zhè jù huà ràng Lín jiàoshòu xiànrùle chénsī, tā yìshí dào guīhuà de běnzhì shì fúwù yú rén.
Tā jìde zài xuéxiào de pǎodào shàng, xuéshēngmen zài qǐpǎoxiàn qián jǐnzhāng de děngdàizhe.
Tāmen bēnpǎo de zītài, xiàng jíle zhè zuò chéngshì zài fāzhǎn chūqī de nà zhǒng jíqiè.
Rújīn, tā zǒu zài kuānchǎng de guòdào zhōng, kànzhe chuāngwài de fēngjǐng zài yánxiàn huǎnhuǎn zhǎnkāi.
Yántú de fēngjǐng yǐrán gǎibiàn, dàn nàxiē jīchǔ de xiàntiáo yīrán zhīchēngzhe chéngshì de gǔjià.
Tā qīngqīng chùmōzhe qiángbì, fǎngfú néng tīngdào chéngshì zài hūxī.
Tā juédìng shùnlù qù bàifǎng yī wèi lǎoyǒu, fēnxiǎng zhèxiē guānyú xiàntiáo de gǎnwù.
Tā zhīdào, wúlùn shìjiè rúhé gǎibiàn, xúnzhǎo fāngxiàng de lù yǒngyuǎn zài jiǎoxià.

stories.story_english:
Professor Lin is a retired urban planner who is accustomed to strolling through the great streets and small alleys of this city at dusk.
He believes the soul of the city is hidden within those interwoven lines.
Today, he walks on the wide sidewalk, watching people pass by in a hurry.
Occasionally, he leaves the main road and takes a narrow pavement to find those forgotten old buildings.
At a bustling intersection, he stops and waits for the green light to turn on.
He observes the ceaseless flow of vehicles in the traffic lanes, reflecting on the complexity of modern city road conditions.
Professor Lin remembers that when he was young, he was responsible for designing a critical stretch of road connecting the suburbs to the city center.
The road surface was not smooth enough back then, but it was full of the courage of pioneering.
He spent countless nights in a narrow corridor, pondering over blueprints.
He tried to change the rigid straight lines into graceful curves, allowing the roads to coexist harmoniously with nature.
To realize this idea, he had to seek various social connections to seek advice from senior engineers.
Ultimately, he planned a green area on the outskirts of the city, introducing the beauty of nature into the reinforced concrete.
Now, he moves forward along that familiar road, and the street lamps light up one by one.
Although the journey is long, every step feels like a review of his own youth.
He passes an antique bookstore with a pair of imposing rhyming couplets pasted on the door.
A small path beside the bookstore leads to a quiet bamboo forest.
Professor Lin recalled a survey from many years ago, when he had crossed mountains and rivers on a rugged mountain road.
At that time, he discovered an ancient tunnel hidden beneath dense vegetation.
Halfway through, he encountered a local farmer, and the two sat down on the spot to discuss the history of the ancient road.
The farmer told him that true justice does not lie in the width of the road, but in the right and wrong of the human heart.
This sentence left Professor Lin in deep thought; he realized the essence of planning is to serve people.
He remembers on the school athletic track, students waiting nervously before the starting line.
Their posture as they ran was very similar to the urgency of this city in the early stages of its development.
Now, he walks in a spacious passageway, watching the scenery outside the window unfold slowly along the line.
The scenery along the way has already changed, but those basic lines still support the skeleton of the city.
He gently touches the wall, as if he can hear the city breathing.
He decides to visit an old friend by the way to share these insights about lines.
He knows that no matter how the world changes, the road to finding direction is always under one's feet.

sentences.chinese: 他观察着车道上川流不息的车辆，思考着现代城市路况的复杂性。
sentences.pinyin: Tā guāncházhe chēdào shàng chuānliú bù xī de chēliàng, sīkǎozhe xiàndài chéngshì lùkuàng de fùzá xìng.
sentences.english: He observes the ceaseless flow of vehicles in the traffic lanes, reflecting on the complexity of modern city road conditions.

sentences.chinese: 林教授记得年轻时，他曾负责设计一段连接郊区与市中心的关键路段。
sentences.pinyin: Lín jiàoshòu jìde niánqīng shí, tā céng fùzé shèjì yī duàn liánjiē jiāoqū yǔ shì zhōngxīn de guānjiàn lùduàn.
sentences.english: Professor Lin remembers that when he was young, he was responsible for designing a critical stretch of road connecting the suburbs to the city center.

sentences.chinese: 那时的路面还不够平整，但充满了开拓的勇气。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shí de lùmiàn hái bùgòu píngzhěng, dàn chōngmǎnle kāituò de yǒngqì.
sentences.english: The road surface was not smooth enough back then, but it was full of the courage of pioneering.

sentences.chinese: 他曾在无数个夜晚，在狭长的走廊里对着图纸苦思冥想。
sentences.pinyin: Tā céng zài wúshù gè yèwǎn, zài xiápáng de zǒuláng lǐ duìzhe túzhǐ kǔsī míngxiǎng.
sentences.english: He spent countless nights in a narrow corridor, pondering over blueprints.

sentences.chinese: 他试图将僵硬的直线改为柔美的曲线，让道路与自然和谐共处。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shìtú jiāng jiāngyìng de zhíxiàn gǎi wéi róuměi de qūxiàn, ràng dàolù yǔ zìrán héxié gòngchǔ.
sentences.english: He tried to change the rigid straight lines into graceful curves, allowing the roads to coexist harmoniously with nature.

sentences.chinese: 为了实现这个想法，他不得不寻找各种门路，向资深的工程师请教。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile shíxiàn zhège xiǎngfǎ, tā bùdébù xúnzhǎo gèzhǒng ménlù, xiàng zīshēn de gōngchéngshī qǐngjiào.
sentences.english: To realize this idea, he had to seek various social connections to seek advice from senior engineers.

sentences.chinese: 最终，他在城市边缘规划了一片绿地，将自然之美引入钢筋水泥之中。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìzhōng, tā zài chéngshì biānyuán guīhuàle yī piàn lǜdì, jiāng zìrán zhī měi yǐnrù gāngjīn shūní zhī zhōng.
sentences.english: Ultimately, he planned a green area on the outskirts of the city, introducing the beauty of nature into the reinforced concrete.

sentences.chinese: 如今，他沿着那条熟悉的道路前行，路灯一盏接一盏地亮起。
sentences.pinyin: Rújīn, tā yánzhe nà tiáo shúxī de dàolù qiánxíng, lùdēng yī zhǎn yī zhǎn de liàngqǐ.
sentences.english: Now, he moves forward along that familiar road, and the street lamps light up one by one.

sentences.chinese: 路途虽然漫长，但每一步都像是在回顾自己的青春。
sentences.pinyin: Lùtú suīrán màncháng, dàn měi yī bù dōu xiàng shì zài huígù zìjǐ de qīngchūn.
sentences.english: Although the journey is long, every step feels like a review of his own youth.

sentences.chinese: 他路过一家古色古香的书店，门上贴着一副气势磅礴的对联。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lùguò yī jiā gǔsè gǔxiāng de shūdiàn, mén shàng tiēzhe yī fù qìshì pángbó de duìlián.
sentences.english: He passes an antique bookstore with a pair of imposing rhyming couplets pasted on the door.

sentences.chinese: 书店一旁的小路通向一片幽静的竹林。

sentences.english: A small path beside the bookstore leads to a quiet bamboo forest.

sentences.chinese: 那时他发现一个古老的地道，隐藏在茂密的植被之下。

sentences.english: At that time, he discovered an ancient tunnel hidden beneath dense vegetation.

sentences.chinese: 他在半路遇到了一位当地的农夫，两人就地坐下，讨论起古道的历史。

sentences.chinese: 农夫告诉他，真正的公道不在于道路的宽窄，而在于人心的是非。

sentences.chinese: 这句话让林教授陷入了沉思，他意识到规划的本质是服务于人。

sentences.english: This sentence left Professor Lin in deep thought; he realized the essence of planning is to serve people.

sentences.chinese: 他记得在学校的跑道上，学生们在起跑线前紧张地等待着。

sentences.english: He remembers on the school athletic track, students waiting nervously before the starting line.

sentences.chinese: 他们奔跑的姿态，像极了这座城市在发展初期的那种急切。

sentences.english: Their posture as they ran was very similar to the urgency of this city in the early stages of its development.

sentences.chinese: 如今，他走在宽敞的过道中，看着窗外的风景在沿线缓缓展开。
sentences.pinyin: Rújīn, tā zǒu zài kuānchǎng de guòdào zhōng, kànzhe chuāngwài de fēngjǐng zài yánxiàn huǎnhuǎn zhǎnkāi.
sentences.english: Now, he walks in a spacious passageway, watching the scenery outside the window unfold slowly along the line.

sentences.chinese: 沿途的风景已然改变，但那些基础的线条依然支撑着城市的骨架。
sentences.pinyin: Yántú de fēngjǐng yǐrán gǎibiàn, dàn nàxiē jīchǔ de xiàntiáo yīrán zhīchēngzhe chéngshì de gǔjià.
sentences.english: The scenery along the way has already changed, but those basic lines still support the skeleton of the city.

sentences.chinese: 他轻轻触摸着墙壁，仿佛能听到城市在呼吸。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qīngqīng chùmōzhe qiángbì, fǎngfú néng tīngdào chéngshì zài hūxī.
sentences.english: He gently touches the wall, as if he can hear the city breathing.

sentences.chinese: 他决定顺路去拜访一位老友，分享这些关于线条的感悟。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juédìng shùnlù qù bàifǎng yī wèi lǎoyǒu, fēnxiǎng zhèxiē guānyú xiàntiáo de gǎnwù.
sentences.english: He decides to visit an old friend by the way to share these insights about lines.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，无论世界如何改变，寻找方向的路永远在脚下。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīdào, wúlùn shìjiè rúhé gǎibiàn, xúnzhǎo fāngxiàng de lù yǒngyuǎn zài jiǎoxià.
sentences.english: He knows that no matter how the world changes, the road to finding direction is always under one's feet.

stories.title_english: The Obsession of the Ancient Text Restorer
stories.story_chinese:
在城市的一隅，有一间名为“拾光”的古籍修复店。
店主林远是一位成年人心中理想的匠人，他的一言一行都透着一种古朴的优雅。
他向来认为，修复古籍不仅仅是修补纸张，更是与古人的灵魂对话。
店里陈列着各式各样的工具，从精细的毛刷到特制的浆糊，可谓一应俱全。
林远一天到晚都沉浸在那些泛黄的卷轴中，浑身散发着淡淡的墨香。
他的一举一动都极其谨慎，仿佛在触碰一件极其脆弱的艺术品。
在他看来，古今中外的文化精髓都凝聚在这些文字里。
很多时候，他会全心全意地对待每一页残卷，力求将缺失的部分还原得完备。
然而，现代社会的快节奏让这种慢艺术变得稀有，修复店的生意比比皆是挑战。
有一天，一位年迈的教授带着一本破损严重的家谱来到店里。
这本书全长约三十厘米，但由于年代久远，纸张已经酥脆，很多地方被虫蛀得一干二净。
教授当众向林远倾诉，这本书承载着他整个家族的记忆，是千家万户中罕见的私人史料。
林远接过书，发现其内容宽泛，涵盖了家族成员在四面八方的迁徙轨迹。
他意识到，这本书的修复不能采取一揽子方案，必须针对不同材质采取不同手段。
他告诉教授，虽然大体上可以通过化学药剂加固，但细节需要纯手工处理。
林远决定在接下来的半年里，全方位地对这本书进行抢救性修复。
他成天在工作室里忙碌，一年到头几乎没有休息过。
他不仅要考虑局部，更要把握全局，确保修复后的书籍在视觉上是一个整体。
在修复过程中，他发现不同朝代的纸张虽然形形色色，但其纤维结构有某种共性。
这种共性让他能够更精准地选择填充材料，使其与原件融为一体。
林远在日记中写道，广义上的修复是延续生命，而狭义上的修复是还原真相。
他对待工作一心一意，无论多么琐碎的细节，他都照顾得无微不至。
每当夜深人静，他会阅读全文，试图理清书中记载的家族脉络。
他发现这个家族的人历来重视教育，书中的记载总计达数万字。
每逢遇到无法破解的古字，他会查阅环球各地的语言学资料。
他意识到，世界上没有万能的修复药水，只有匠人的耐心。
在这个过程中，林远与教授朝夕相处，两人成了像一家人一样亲密的朋友。
教授经常感叹，林远简直是个全能的学者，对历史的理解如此深厚。
然而，林远却认为自己只是一个执行者，不能任意更改原作者的意图。
他认为，无论外界如何评价，必须始终服务于大局，即保护文物的真实性。
他一概不接受任何为了美观而牺牲真实性的要求。
有一天，众人聚集在店里，见证这本书最终完成的时刻。
林远向大家展示了全程的修复记录，从第一道清洗到最后一次装订。
他将修复后的成本总计为一个整数，象征着圆满。
总的来说，这次修复不仅救回了一本书，更唤醒了一个家族的记忆。
林远看着教授欣慰的眼神，觉得所有的辛苦都值得了。
他深知，在这个数字化时代，人们容易忘记触感的温度。
但只要还有人愿意为了一个目标而全心投入，文化之火就不会熄灭。
他继续在店里等待，等待那些来自世界各地的、形形色色的故事再次敲开他的门。
他知道，每一次修复都是一次修行，是对生命完整性的追求。
在这种追求中，他找到了自己存在于这个世界的意义。

他深知，在这个数字化时代，人们容易忘记触感的温度。
但只要还有人愿意为了一个目标而全心投入，文化之火就不会熄灭。
他继续在店里等待，等待那些来自世界各地的、形形色色的故事再次敲开他的门。
他知道，每一次修复都是一次修行，是对生命完整性的追求。
在这种追求中，他找到了自己存在于这个世界的意义。

Zài chéng shì de yī yú, yǒu yī jiān míng wéi “shí guāng” de gǔ jí xiū fù diàn.
Diàn zhǔ Lín Yuǎn shì yī wèi chéng nián rén xīn zhōng lǐ xiǎng de jiàng rén, tā de yī yán yī xíng dōu tòu zhe yī zhǒng gǔ pǔ de yōu yǎ.
Tā xiàng lái rèn wéi, xiū fù gǔ jí bù jǐn jǐn shì xiū bǔ zhǐ zhāng, gèng shì yǔ gǔ rén de líng hún duì huà.
Diàn lǐ chén liè zhe gè shì gè yàng de gōng jù, cóng jīng xì de máo shuā dào tè zhì de jiāng hú, kě wèi yī yīng jù quán.
Lín Yuǎn yī tiān dào wǎn dōu chén jìn zài nà xiē fàn huáng de juàn zhóu zhōng, hún shēn sàn fā zhe dàn dàn de mò xiāng.
Tā de yī jǔ yī dòng dōu jí qí jǐn shèn, fǎng fú zài chù pèng yī jiàn jí qí cuì ruò de yì shù pǐn.
Zài tā kàn lái, gǔ jīn zhōng wài de wén huà jīng suǐ dōu níng jù zài zhè xiē wén zì lǐ.
Tā hěn duō shí hòu, huì quán xīn quán yì de duì dài měi yī yè cán juàn, lì qiú jiāng quē shī de bù fèn huán yuán dé wán bèi.
 rán ér, xiàn dài shè huì de kuài jié zòu ràng zhè zhǒng màn yì shù biàn dé xī yǒu, xiū fù diàn de shēng yì bǐ bǐ jiē shì tiǎo zhàn.
Yī tiān, yī wèi nián mài de jiào shòu dài zhe yī běn pò sǔn yán zhòng de jiā pǔ lái dào diàn lǐ.
Zhè běn shū quán cháng yuē sān shí lǐ mǐ, dàn yóu yú nián dài jiǔ yuǎn, zhǐ zhāng yǐ jīng sū cuì, hěn duō dì fāng bèi chóng zhòu dé yī gān èr jìng.
Jiào shòu dāng zhòng xiàng Lín Yuǎn qīng sù, zhè běn shū chéng zài zhe tā zhěng gè jiā zú de jì yì, shì qiān jiā wàn hù zhōng hán jiàn de sī rén shǐ liào.
Lín Yuǎn jiē guò shū, fā xiàn qí nèi róng kuān fàn, hán gài le jiā zú chéng yuán zài sì miàn bā fāng de qiān xǐ guǐ jì.
Tā yì shí dào, zhè běn shū de xiū fù bù néng cǎi qǔ yī lǎn zi fāng àn, bì xū zhēn duì bù tóng cái zhì cǎi qǔ bù tóng shǒu duàn.
Tā gào sù jiào shòu, suī rán dà tǐ shàng kě yǐ tōng guò huà xué yào jì jiā gù, dàn xì jié xū yào chún shǒu gōng chǔ lǐ.
Lín Yuǎn jué dìng zài jiē xià lái de bàn nián lǐ, quán fāng wèi de duì zhè běn shū jìn xíng qiǎng jiù xìng xiū fù.
Tā chéng tiān zài gōng zuò shì lǐ máng lù, yī nián dào tóu jī hū méi yǒu xiū xī guò.
Tā bù jǐn yào kǎo lǜ jú bù, gèng yào bǎ wò quán jú, què bǎo xiū fù hòu de shū jí zài shì jué shàng shì yī gè zhěng tǐ.
Zài xiū fù guò chéng zhōng, tā fā xiàn bù tóng cháo dài de zhǐ zhāng suī rán xíng xíng sè sè, dàn qí xiān wéi jié gòu yǒu mǒu zhǒng gòng xìng.
Zhè zhǒng gòng xìng ràng tā néng gòu gèng jīng zhǔn de xuǎn zé tián chōng cái liào, shǐ qí yǔ yuán jiàn róng wéi yī tǐ.
Lín Yuǎn zài rì jì zhōng xiě dào, guǎng yì shàng de xiū fù shì yán xù shēng mìng, ér xiá yì shàng de xiū fù shì huán yuán zhēn xiàng.
Tā duì dài gōng zuò yī xīn yī yì, wú lùn duō me suǒ suì de xì jié, tā dōu zhào gù dé wú wēi bù zhì.
Měi dāng yè shēn rén jìng, tā huì yuè dú quán wén, shì tú lǐ qīng shū zhōng jì zǎi de jiā zú mài luò.
Tā fā xiàn zhè gè jiā zú de rén lì lái zhòng shì jiào yù, shū zhōng de jì zǎi zǒng jì dá shù wàn zì.
Měi féng yù dào wú fǎ pò jiě de gǔ zì, tā huì chá yuè huán qiú gè dì de yǔ yán xué zī liào.
Tā yì shí dào, shì jiè shàng méi yǒu wàn néng de xiū fù yào shuǐ, zhǐ yǒu jiàng rén de nài xīn.
Zài zhè gè guò chéng zhōng, Lín Yuǎn yǔ jiào shòu zhāo xī xiāng chǔ, liǎng rén chéng le xiàng yī jiā rén yī yàng qīn mì de péng yǒu.
Jiào shòu jīng cháng gǎn tàn, Lín Yuǎn jiǎn zhí shì gè quán néng de xué zhě, duì lì shǐ de lǐ jiě rú cǐ shēn hòu.
 rán ér, Lín Yuǎn què rèn wéi zì jǐ zhǐ shì yī gè zhí xíng zhě, bù néng rèn yì gēng gǎi yuán zuò zhě de yì tú.
Tā rèn wéi, wú lùn wài jiè rú hé píng jià, bì xū shǐ zhōng fú wù yú dà jú, jí bǎo hù wén wù de zhēn shí xìng.
Tā yī gài bù jiē shòu rèn hé wèi le měi guān ér xī shēng zhēn shí xìng de yāo qiú.
Yī tiān, zhòng rén jù jí zài diàn lǐ, jiàn zhèng zhè běn shū zuì zhōng wán chéng de shí kè.
Lín Yuǎn xiàng dà jiā zhǎn shì le quán chéng de xiū fù jì lù, cóng dì yī dào qīng xǐ dào zuì hòu yī cì zhuāng dìng.
Tā jiāng xiū fù hòu de chéng běn zǒng jì wèi yī gè zhěng shù, xiàng zhēng zhe yuán mǎn.
Zǒng de lái shuō, zhè cì xiū fù bù jǐn jiù huí le yī běn shū, gèng huàn xǐng le yī gè jiā zú de jì yì.
Lín Yuǎn kàn zhe jiào shòu xīn wèi de yǎn shén, jué dé suǒ yǒu de xīn kǔ dōu zhí dé le.
Tā shēn zhī, zài zhè gè shù zì huà shí dài, rén men róng yì wàng jì chù gǎn de wēn dù.
Dàn zhǐ yào hái yǒu rén yuàn yì wèi le yī gè mù biāo ér quán xīn tóu rù, wén huà zhī huǒ jiù bù huì xī miè.
Tā jì xù zài diàn lǐ děng dài, děng dài nà xiē lái zì shì jiè gè dì de, xíng xíng sè sè de gù shì zài cì qiāo kāi tā de mén.
Tā zhī dào, měi yī cì xiū fù dōu shì yī cì xiū xíng, shì duì shēng mìng wán zhěng xìng de zhuī qiú.
Zài zhè zhǒng zhuī qiú zhōng, tā zhǎo dào le zì jǐ cún zài yú zhè gè shì jiè de yì yì.

stories.story_english:
In a corner of the city, there was an ancient book restoration shop called "Time Retrieval."
Its owner, Lin Yuan, was the kind of craftsman ideal in an adult's heart, and his every word and action exuded an ancient elegance.
He had always believed that restoring ancient books was not just about repairing paper, but about conversing with the souls of the ancients.
Various tools were displayed in the shop, from fine brushes to specially made paste, with everything needed available.
Lin Yuan spent all day long immersed in those yellowed scrolls, his whole body emanating a faint scent of ink.
Every movement he made was extremely cautious, as if he were touching an incredibly fragile piece of art.
In his view, the essence of culture from all times and places was condensed in these words.
Often, he would treat every fragment of a page wholeheartedly, striving to restore the missing parts to perfection.
However, the fast pace of modern society made this slow art rare, and the business of the restoration shop was fraught with challenges everywhere.
One day, an elderly professor brought a severely damaged genealogy book to the shop.
The overall length of the book was about thirty centimeters, but due to its age, the paper had become brittle, and many parts had been eaten away completely by insects.
In public, the professor poured out his heart to Lin Yuan, saying that this book carried the memories of his entire family and was a rare piece of private historical material among every household.
Lin Yuan took the book and found that its content was wide-ranging, covering the migration tracks of family members in all directions.
He realized that the restoration of this book could not take an all-inclusive approach; different methods had to be used for different materials.
He told the professor that while overall it could be reinforced using chemical agents, the details required pure hand-processing.
Lin Yuan decided to carry out a complete, all-around rescue restoration of the book over the next six months.
He was busy in the studio all day, and almost never rested all year round.
He had to consider not only the local parts but also grasp the overall situation to ensure the restored book was a unified whole visually.
During the restoration process, he discovered that although papers from different dynasties were of all kinds, their fiber structures shared a certain common character.
This commonality allowed him to choose filling materials more accurately, integrating them into a single whole with the original.
Lin Yuan wrote in his diary that in a broad sense, restoration is the continuation of life, while in a narrow sense, it is the restoration of truth.
He was wholeheartedly dedicated to his work, taking care of even the most trivial details meticulously.
Whenever the night grew deep and quiet, he would read the entire text, attempting to clarify the family lineage recorded in the book.
He found that the people of this family had always valued education, and the records in the book totaled tens of thousands of words.
Whenever he encountered an ancient character he could not decipher, he would consult linguistic materials from around the world.
He realized that there is no omnipotent restoration fluid in the world, only the patience of the craftsman.
During this process, Lin Yuan spent all his time together with the professor, and the two became close friends, like a whole family.
The professor often marveled that Lin Yuan was simply an all-round scholar with such a profound understanding of history.
However, Lin Yuan believed he was merely an executor and could not arbitrarily change the intentions of the original author.
He believed that regardless of external evaluations, he must always serve the big picture, namely protecting the authenticity of the cultural relic.
He categorically refused any requests to sacrifice authenticity for the sake of aesthetics.
One day, everyone gathered in the shop to witness the moment this book was finally completed.
Lin Yuan showed everyone the record of the whole process, from the first cleaning to the final binding.
He totaled the restoration cost into a round figure, symbolizing completeness.
Generally speaking, this restoration not only saved a book but also awakened the memory of a family.
Looking at the professor's gratified expression, Lin Yuan felt that all the hardship was worth it.
He knew that in this digital age, people easily forget the warmth of touch.
But as long as there are people willing to commit themselves wholeheartedly to a goal, the fire of culture will not be extinguished.
He continued to wait in the shop, waiting for all sorts of stories from all over the world to knock on his door again.
He knew that every restoration was a form of spiritual practice, a pursuit of the completeness of life.
In this pursuit, he found the meaning of his existence in this world.

stories.story_chinese:
林先生是一位退休的建筑师，他将终生的热情都倾注在了后院的小花园里。
纵观这座花园，每一寸土地都经过他的精心统筹。
他并不满足于笼统的规划，而是为每一种植物制定了详尽的生长方案。
在他看来，真正的美绝非面面俱到，而是在于对细节的极致追求。
春天时，各种奇花异草皆在阳光下盛开，色彩浓郁且饱满。
花园里遍布着精心设计的石径，让访客可以随时随地停下来沉思。
他的朋友常开玩笑说，这里的植被已经饱和，再也塞不下一棵草了。
林先生笑着回答：“我的生活通通都在这里，这就是我的世界。”
有一天，他决定将自己的生平记录在一本笔记中。
他将那些关于建筑的枯燥理论统统抛在脑后，只记录花开的瞬间。
他意识到，人生不应只是追求完美的蓝图，而应是感受当下的呼吸。
在这片小天地里，他终于找到了内心的宁静。

stories.story_pinyin:
Lín xiān sheng shì yī wèi tuì xiū de jiàn zhù shī, tā jiāng zhōng shēng de rè qíng dōu qīng zhù zài hòu yuàn de xiǎo huā yuán lǐ.
Zòng guān zhè zuò huā yuán, měi yī cùn tǔ dì dōu jīng guò tā de jīng xīn tǒng chóu.
Tā bìng bù mǎn zú yú lǒng tǒng de guī huà, ér shì wèi měi yī zhǒng zhí wù zhì dìng le xiáng jìn de shēng zhǎng fāng àn.
Zài tā kàn lái, zhēn zhèng de měi jué fēi miàn miàn jù dào, ér shì zài yú duì xì jié de jí zhì zhuī qiú.
Chūn tiān shí, gè zhǒng qí huā yì cǎo jiē zài yáng guāng xià shèng kāi, sè cǎi nóng yù qiě bǎo mǎn.
Huā yuán lǐ biàn bù zhe jīng xīn shè jì de shí jìng, ràng fǎng kè kě yǐ suí shí suí dì tíng xià lái chén sī.
Tā de péng you cháng kāi wán xiào shuō, zhè lǐ de zhí bèi yǐ jīng bǎo hé, zài yě sāi bù xià yī kē cǎo le.
Lín xiān sheng xiào zhe huí dá: “Wǒ de shēng huó tōng tōng dōu zài zhè lǐ, zhè jiù shì wǒ de shì jiè.”
Yǒu yī tiān, tā jué dìng jiāng zì jǐ de shēng píng jì lù zài yī běn bǐ jì zhōng.
Tā jiāng nà xiē guān yú jiàn zhù de kū zào lǐ lùn tǒng tǒng pāo zài nǎo hòu, zhǐ jì lù huā kāi de shùn jiān.
Tā yì shí dào, rén shēng bù yīng zhǐ shì zhuī qiú wán měi de lán tú, ér yīng shì gǎn shòu dāng xià de hū xī.
Zài zhè piàn xiǎo tiān dì lǐ, tā zhōng yú zhǎo dào le nèi xīn de níng jìng.

stories.story_english:
Mr. Lin was a retired architect who poured his lifelong passion into the small garden in his backyard.
Surveying the garden comprehensively, every inch of land had undergone his careful overall planning.
He was not satisfied with a general plan, but instead developed thorough and detailed growth schemes for every type of plant.
In his view, true beauty was not about handling everything perfectly, but lay in the ultimate pursuit of detail.
In spring, all kinds of exotic flowers and plants bloomed under the sunlight, with rich and full colors.
Carefully designed stone paths were found throughout the garden, allowing visitors to stop and meditate anytime and anywhere.
His friends often joked that the vegetation here was already saturated, and not a single blade of grass more could be squeezed in.
Mr. Lin answered with a smile, "My entire life is all here; this is my world."
One day, he decided to record his life story in a notebook.
He cast all those tedious theories about architecture completely behind him, recording only the moments of flowers blooming.
He realized that life should not just be about pursuing a perfect blueprint, but about feeling the breath of the present.
In this small piece of heaven, he finally found inner peace.

stories.story_chinese:
在青翠的云雾山脚下，林老先生经营着一家古旧的药圃。
他不仅精通中药的栽培，更将这里视为孕育生命的圣地。
林老先生一生致力于养生，每日清晨都会在山间漫步，以保持身心健康。
他曾是一名名医，早年间救治过无数危在旦夕的病人。
在他看来，医者的天职不仅是拯救生命，更是要捍卫人类生存的尊严。
然而，林老先生的晚年并不平静，他唯一的儿子在一次意外中去世了。
政府给予了一笔抚恤金，但这对孤独的老人来说毫无意义。
在最绝望的时候，他收留了一个被遗弃在山门前的孤儿，取名阿诚。
林老先生决定领养这个孩子，用尽全力抚养他长大。
他不仅为阿诚提供基本的喂养，更在细节上给予他无微不至的呵护。
阿诚在林老先生的监护下，逐渐成长为一个温润如玉的青年。
林老先生对他管教极严，认为良好的家教是一个人立身之本。
他教会阿诚如何饲养药圃里的灵禽，以及如何科学地进行水产养殖。
他告诉阿诚，要养活一个生命需要极大的耐心与责任感。
阿诚在长辈的教养下，学会了谦逊与感恩。
他每天早晨起来，就细心地伺候老人的起居，端茶递水。
这种侍候并非出于压力，而是发自内心的孝敬。
林老先生常说：“孩子，以后你要多留神，生活中有许多不易察觉的陷阱。”
他总是叮嘱阿诚在处理药材时要当心，以免损伤药效。
每当阿诚想要独立承担所有家务时，林老先生总会笑着说：“别见外，我们是一家人。”
随着年岁增长，林老先生的身体每况愈下，需要专业的护理。
阿诚在照顾老人的同时，还学习了现代医疗知识，以便更好地照料他的健康。
他时刻看护在床边，确保老人的饮食起居得到最完善的保障。
他深知，一个人的生育能力决定了种群的延续，但真正的哺育则是精神的传递。
他试图用自己的努力，来造就一个更有温度的未来。
有一天，林老先生把阿诚叫到身边，递给他一本古旧的笔记本。
“这里记录了药圃的所有秘密，以及如何处置那些罕见药材的方法。”
阿诚接过笔记本，心中充满了对这份传承的敬畏。
林老先生轻声说：“我希望你能继续守护这片土地，让它继续产出治病救人的良药。”
他看着阿诚，眼神中充满了欣慰，仿佛看到了某种希望在心中生长。
他祈祷上苍保佑阿诚能走得更远，成为一名真正的医者。
在林老先生最后的日子里，阿诚尽心尽力地赡养他，从未有过半点抱怨。
他知道，这是他对养育之恩最好的回报。
在临终前，林老先生拉着阿诚的手，低声叮嘱道：“保重身体，不要太劳累。”
阿诚泪流满面，承诺会永远记得老人的教诲。
后来，阿诚将药圃改造成了一家公益诊所，为贫困患者提供免费救治。
他甚至为诊所的医疗设备购买了长期保修，以确保诊疗的稳定性。
他请当地的志愿者来关照那些无家可归的病人。
他用一生在实践林老先生教会他的爱与责任。
在云雾山的微风中，那片药圃依然青翠，见证着两代人关于关怀的传承。

stories.story_pinyin:
Zài qīng cuì de Yún Wù Shān jiǎo xià, Lín lǎo xiān sheng jīng yíng zhe yī jiā gǔ jiù de yào pǔ.
Tā bù jǐn jīng tōng zhōng yào de zāi péi, gèng jiāng zhè lǐ shì wéi yùn yù shēng mìng de shèng dì.
Lín lǎo xiān sheng yī shēng zhì lì yú yǎng shēng, měi rì qīng chén dōu huì zài shān jiān màn bù, yǐ bǎo chí shēn xīn jiàn kāng.
Tā céng shì yī míng míng yī, zǎo nián jiān jiù zhì guò wú shù wēi zài dàn xī de bìng rén.
Zài tā kàn lái, yī zhě de tiān zhí bù jǐn shì zhěng jiù shēng mìng, gèng shì yào hàn wèi rén lèi shēng cún de zūn yán.
Rán ér, Lín lǎo xiān sheng de wǎn nián bìng bù píng jìng, tā wéi yī de ér zi zài yī cì yì wài zhōng qù shì le.
Zhèng fǔ jǐ yǔ le yī bǐ fǔ xù jīn, dàn zhè duì gū dú de lǎo rén lái shuō háo wú yì yì.
Zài zuì jué wàng de shí hòu, tā shōu liú le yī gè bèi yí qì zài shān mén qián de gū ér, qǔ míng Ā Chéng.
Lín lǎo xiān sheng jué dìng lǐng yǎng zhè gè hái zi, yòng jìn quán lì fǔ yǎng tā zhǎng dà.
Tā bù jǐn wèi Ā Chéng tí gōng jī běn de wèi yǎng, gèng zài xì jié shàng jǐ yǔ tā wú wēi bù zhì de hē hù.
Ā Chéng zài Lín lǎo xiān sheng de jiān hù xià, zhú jiàn chéng zhǎng wéi yī gè wēn rùn rú yù de qīng nián.
Lín lǎo xiān sheng duì tā guǎn jiào jí yán, rèn wéi liáng hǎo de jiā jiào shì yī gè rén lì shēn zhī běn.
Tā jiào huì Ā Chéng rú hé sì yǎng yào pǔ lǐ de líng qín, yǐ jí rú hé kē xué dì jìn xíng shuǐ chǎn yǎng zhí.
Tā gào sù Ā Chéng, yào yǎng huó yī gè shēng mìng xū yào jí dà de nài xīn yǔ zé rèn gǎn.
Ā Chéng zài zhǎng bèi de jiào yǎng xià, xué huì le qiān xùn yǔ gǎn ēn.
Tā měi tiān zǎo chén qǐ lái, jiù xì xīn dì cì hou lǎo rén de qǐ jū, duān chá dì shuǐ.
Zhè zhǒng shì hòu bìng fēi chū yú yā lì, ér shì fā zì nèi xīn de xiào jìng.
Lín lǎo xiān sheng cháng shuō: "Hái zi, yǐ hòu nǐ yào duō liú shén, shēng huó zhōng yǒu xǔ duō bù yì chá jué de xiàn jǐng."
Tā zǒng shì dīng zhǔ Ā Chéng zài chǔ lǐ yào cái shí yào dāng xīn, yǐ miǎn sǔn sāng yào xiào.
Měi dāng Ā Chéng xiǎng yào dú lì chéng dān suǒ yǒu jiā wù shí, Lín lǎo xiān sheng zǒng huì xiào zhe shuō: "Bié jiàn wài, wǒ men shì yī jiā rén."
Suí zhe nián suì zēng zhǎng, Lín lǎo xiān sheng de shēn tǐ měi kuàng yù xià, xū yào zhuān yè de hù lǐ.
Ā Chéng zài zhào gù lǎo rén de tóng shí, hái xué xí le xiàn dài yī liáo zhī shi, yǐ biàn gèng hǎo dì zhào liào tā de jiàn kāng.
Tā shí kè kān hù zài chuáng biān, què bǎo lǎo rén de yǐn shí qǐ jū dé dào zuì wán shàn de bǎo zhàng.
Tā shēn zhī, yī gè rén de shēng yù néng lì jué dìng le zhǒng qún de yán xù, dàn zhēn zhèng de bǔ yù zé shì jīng shén de chuán dì.
Tā shì tú yòng zì jǐ de nǔ lì, lái zào jiù yī gè gèng yǒu wēn dù de wèi lái.
Yǒu yī tiān, Lín lǎo xiān sheng bǎ Ā Chéng jiào dào shēn biān, dì gěi tā yī běn gǔ jiù de bǐ jì běn.
"Zhè lǐ jì lù le yào pǔ de suǒ yǒu mì mì, yǐ jí rú hé chǔ zhì nà xiē hǎn jiàn yào cái de fāng fǎ."
Ā Chéng jiē guò bǐ jì běn, xīn zhōng chōng mǎn le duì zhè fèn chuán chéng de jìng wèi.
Lín lǎo xiān sheng qīng shēng shuō: "Wǒ xī wàng nǐ néng jì xù shǒu hù zhè piàn tǔ dì, ràng tā jì xù chǎn chū zhì bìng jiù rén de liáng yào."
Tā kàn zhe Ā Chéng, yǎn shén zhōng chōng mǎn le xīn wèi, fǎng fú kàn dào le mǒu zhǒng xī wàng zài xīn zhōng shēng zhǎng.
Tā qí dǎo shàng cāng bǎo yòu Ā Chéng néng zǒu dé gèng yuǎn, chéng wéi yī míng zhēn zhèng de yī zhě.
Zài Lín lǎo xiān sheng zuì hòu de rì zi lǐ, Ā Chéng jìn xīn jìn lì dì shàn yǎng tā, cóng wèi yǒu guò bàn diǎn bào yuàn.
Tā zhī dào, zhè shì tā duì yǎng yù zhī ēn zuì hǎo de huí bào.
Zài lín zhōng qián, Lín lǎo xiān sheng lā zhe Ā Chéng de shǒu, dī shēng dīng zhǔ dào: "Bǎo zhòng shēn tǐ, bù yào tài láo lèi."
Ā Chéng lèi liú mǎn miàn, chéng nuò huì yǒng yuǎn jì dé lǎo rén de jiào huì.
Hòu lái, Ā Chéng jiāng yào pǔ gǎi zào chéng le yī jiā gōng yì zhěn suǒ, wèi pín kùn huàn zhě tí gōng miǎn fèi jiù zhì.
Tā shèn zhì wèi zhěn suǒ de yī liáo shè bèi gòu mǎi le cháng qī bǎo xiū, yǐ què bǎo zhěn liáo de wěn dìng xìng.
Tā qǐng dāng dì de zhì yuàn zhě lái guān zhào nà xiē wú jiā kě guī de bìng rén.
Tā yòng yī shēng zài shí jiàn Lín lǎo xiān sheng jiào huì tā de ài yǔ zé rèn.
Zài Yún Wù Shān de wēi fēng zhōng, nà piàn yào pǔ yī rán qīng cuì, jiàn zhèng zhe liǎng dài rén guān yú guān huái de chuán chéng.

stories.story_english:
At the foot of the lush misty mountains, Old Mr. Lin operated an old medicinal garden.
He was not only proficient in the cultivation of Chinese herbs, but also regarded this place as a sacred land for nurturing life.
Old Mr. Lin dedicated his life to maintaining good health, walking through the mountains every morning to keep his mind and body healthy.
He was once a famous doctor, and in his early years, he provided critical care to countless patients who were in critical condition.
In his view, the duty of a doctor was not only to save lives, but also to defend the dignity of human existence.
However, Old Mr. Lin's later years were not peaceful; his only son passed away in an accident.
The government provided a sum of compassionate payment, but for the lonely old man, this was meaningless.
In his moment of greatest despair, he offered shelter to an orphan abandoned in front of the mountain gate, naming him A Cheng.
Old Mr. Lin decided to adopt the child and did everything in his power to raise him.
He not only provided basic feeding for A Cheng, but also gave him meticulous care in every detail.
Under Old Mr. Lin's guardianship, A Cheng gradually grew into a gentle and refined young man.
Old Mr. Lin disciplined him strictly, believing that a good upbringing was the foundation for a person's success in life.
He taught A Cheng how to raise the spiritual birds in the medicinal garden, as well as how to scientifically carry out aquaculture.
He told A Cheng that providing for a life requires great patience and a sense of responsibility.
Under the nurturing of his elder, A Cheng learned humility and gratitude.
Every morning upon waking, he would carefully serve the old man's daily needs, bringing tea and water.
This waiting upon was not out of pressure, but came from a heart of filial respect.
Old Mr. Lin often said, "Child, you must be more careful in the future; there are many hidden traps in life."
He always reminded A Cheng to be cautious when handling medicinal materials to avoid damaging their effectiveness.
Whenever A Cheng wanted to independently take over all the housework, Old Mr. Lin would always smile and say, "Don't treat me as a stranger; we are family."
As the years passed, Old Mr. Lin's health deteriorated, and he required professional nursing.
While taking care of the old man, A Cheng also studied modern medical knowledge to better tend to his health.
He constantly watched over him by the bedside, ensuring that the old man's diet and daily life were perfectly guaranteed.
He deeply understood that a person's ability to give birth determines the continuation of a species, but true nurturing is the transmission of spirit.
He attempted to use his efforts to create a warmer future.
One day, Old Mr. Lin called A Cheng to his side and handed him an old notebook.
"This records all the secrets of the garden, as well as the methods of how to handle those rare medicinal materials."
A Cheng took the notebook, his heart filled with awe for this heritage.
Old Mr. Lin said softly, "I hope you can continue to guard this land, letting it continue to produce medicines that cure diseases and save people."
He looked at A Cheng with eyes full of gratification, as if seeing some hope growing in his heart.
He prayed that heaven would bless and protect A Cheng to go further and become a true healer.
In Old Mr. Lin's final days, A Cheng did his utmost to support him, never complaining once.
He knew this was the best way to repay the grace of being raised.
Before passing away, Old Mr. Lin held A Cheng's hand and whispered, "Take care of your health; do not overwork yourself."
A Cheng was in tears and promised to always remember the old man's teachings.
Later, A Cheng transformed the medicinal garden into a non-profit clinic, providing free critical care for impoverished patients.
He even purchased long-term warranties for the clinic's medical equipment to ensure the stability of treatment.
He invited local volunteers to look after those homeless patients.
He spent his life practicing the love and responsibility that Old Mr. Lin had taught him.
In the breeze of the Misty Mountains, that medicinal garden remained lush, witnessing the transmission of care across two generations.

sentences.chinese: 在青翠的云雾山脚下，林老先生经营着一家古旧的药圃。
sentences.pinyin: Zài qīng cuì de Yún Wù Shān jiǎo xià, Lín lǎo xiān sheng jīng yíng zhe yī jiā gǔ jiù de yào pǔ.
sentences.english: At the foot of the lush misty mountains, Old Mr. Lin operated an old medicinal garden.

sentences.chinese: 他不仅精通中药的栽培，更将这里视为孕育生命的圣地。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù jǐn jīng tōng zhōng yào de zāi péi, gèng jiāng zhè lǐ shì wéi yùn yù shēng mìng de shèng dì.
sentences.english: He was not only proficient in the cultivation of Chinese herbs, but also regarded this place as a sacred land for nurturing life.

sentences.chinese: 林老先生一生致力于养生，每日清晨都会在山间漫步，以保持身心健康。
sentences.pinyin: Lín lǎo xiān sheng yī shēng zhì lì yú yǎng shēng, měi rì qīng chén dōu huì zài shān jiān màn bù, yǐ bǎo chí shēn xīn jiàn kāng.
sentences.english: Old Mr. Lin dedicated his life to maintaining good health, walking through the mountains every morning to keep his mind and body healthy.

sentences.chinese: 他曾是一名名医，早年间救治过无数危在旦夕的病人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā céng shì yī míng míng yī, zǎo nián jiān jiù zhì guò wú shù wēi zài dàn xī de bìng rén.
sentences.english: He was once a famous doctor, and in his early years, he provided critical care to countless patients who were in critical condition.

sentences.chinese: 在他看来，医者的天职不仅是拯救生命，更是要捍卫人类生存的尊严。
sentences.pinyin: Zài tā kàn lái, yī zhě de tiān zhí bù jǐn shì zhěng jiù shēng mìng, gèng shì yào hàn wèi rén lèi shēng cún de zūn yán.
sentences.english: In his view, the duty of a doctor was not only to save lives, but also to defend the dignity of human existence.

sentences.chinese: 然而，林老先生的晚年并不平静，他唯一的儿子在一次意外中去世了。
sentences.pinyin: Rán ér, Lín lǎo xiān sheng de wǎn nián bìng bù píng jìng, tā wéi yī de ér zi zài yī cì yì wài zhōng qù shì le.
sentences.english: However, Old Mr. Lin's later years were not peaceful; his only son passed away in an accident.

sentences.chinese: 政府给予了一笔抚恤金，但这对孤独的老人来说毫无意义。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèng fǔ jǐ yǔ le yī bǐ fǔ xù jīn, dàn zhè duì gū dú de lǎo rén lái shuō háo wú yì yì.
sentences.english: The government provided a sum of compassionate payment, but for the lonely old man, this was meaningless.

sentences.chinese: 在最绝望的时候，他收留了一个被遗弃在山门前的孤儿，取名阿诚。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zuì jué wàng de shí hòu, tā shōu liú le yī gè bèi yí qì zài shān mén qián de gū ér, qǔ míng Ā Chéng.
sentences.english: In his moment of greatest despair, he offered shelter to an orphan abandoned in front of the mountain gate, naming him A Cheng.

sentences.chinese: 林老先生决定领养这个孩子，用尽全力抚养他长大。
sentences.pinyin: Lín lǎo xiān sheng jué dìng lǐng yǎng zhè gè hái zi, yòng jìn quán lì fǔ yǎng tā zhǎng dà.
sentences.english: Old Mr. Lin decided to adopt the child and did everything in his power to raise him.

sentences.chinese: 他不仅为阿诚提供基本的喂养，更在细节上给予他无微不至的呵护。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù jǐn wèi Ā Chéng tí gōng jī běn de wèi yǎng, gèng zài xì jié shàng jǐ yǔ tā wú wēi bù zhì de hē hù.
sentences.english: He not only provided basic feeding for A Cheng, but also gave him meticulous care in every detail.

sentences.chinese: 阿诚在林老先生的监护下，逐渐成长为一个温润如玉的青年。
sentences.pinyin: Ā Chéng zài Lín lǎo xiān sheng de jiān hù xià, zhú jiàn chéng zhǎng wéi yī gè wēn rùn rú yù de qīng nián.
sentences.english: Under Old Mr. Lin's guardianship, A Cheng gradually grew into a gentle and refined young man.

sentences.chinese: 林老先生对他管教极严，认为良好的家教是一个人立身之本。
sentences.pinyin: Lín lǎo xiān sheng duì tā guǎn jiào jí yán, rèn wéi liáng hǎo de jiā jiào shì yī gè rén lì shēn zhī běn.
sentences.english: Old Mr. Lin disciplined him strictly, believing that a good upbringing was the foundation for a person's success in life.

sentences.chinese: 他教会阿诚如何饲养药圃里的灵禽，以及如何科学地进行水产养殖。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiào huì Ā Chéng rú hé sì yǎng yào pǔ lǐ de líng qín, yǐ jí rú hé kē xué dì jìn xíng shuǐ chǎn yǎng zhí.
sentences.english: He taught A Cheng how to raise the spiritual birds in the medicinal garden, as well as how to scientifically carry out aquaculture.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉阿诚，要养活一个生命需要极大的耐心与责任感。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù Ā Chéng, yào yǎng huó yī gè shēng mìng xū yào jí dà de nài xīn yǔ zé rèn gǎn.
sentences.english: He told A Cheng that providing for a life requires great patience and a sense of responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 阿诚在长辈的教养下，学会了谦逊与感恩。
sentences.pinyin: Ā Chéng zài zhǎng bèi de jiào yǎng xià, xué huì le qiān xùn yǔ gǎn ēn.
sentences.english: Under the nurturing of his elder, A Cheng learned humility and gratitude.

sentences.chinese: 他每天早晨起来，就细心地伺候老人的起居，端茶递水。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎo chén qǐ lái, jiù xì xīn dì cì hou lǎo rén de qǐ jū, duān chá dì shuǐ.
sentences.english: Every morning upon waking, he would carefully serve the old man's daily needs, bringing tea and water.

sentences.chinese: 这种侍候并非出于压力，而是发自内心的孝敬。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shì hòu bìng fēi chū yú yā lì, ér shì fā zì nèi xīn de xiào jìng.
sentences.english: This waiting upon was not out of pressure, but came from a heart of filial respect.

sentences.chinese: 林老先生常说：“孩子，以后你要多留神，生活中有许多不易察觉的陷阱。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín lǎo xiān sheng cháng shuō: "Hái zi, yǐ hòu nǐ yào duō liú shén, shēng huó zhōng yǒu xǔ duō bù yì chá jué de xiàn jǐng."
sentences.english: Old Mr. Lin often said, "Child, you must be more careful in the future; there are many hidden traps in life."

sentences.chinese: 他总是叮嘱阿诚在处理药材时要当心，以免损伤药效。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒng shì dīng zhǔ Ā Chéng zài chǔ lǐ yào cái shí yào dāng xīn, yǐ miǎn sǔn sāng yào xiào.
sentences.english: He always reminded A Cheng to be cautious when handling medicinal materials to avoid damaging their effectiveness.

sentences.chinese: 每当阿诚想要独立承担所有家务时，林老先生总会笑着说：“别见外，我们是一家人。”
sentences.pinyin: Měi dāng Ā Chéng xiǎng yào dú lì chéng dān suǒ yǒu jiā wù shí, Lín lǎo xiān sheng zǒng huì xiào zhe shuō: "Bié jiàn wài, wǒ men shì yī jiā rén."
sentences.english: Whenever A Cheng wanted to independently take over all the housework, Old Mr. Lin would always smile and say, "Don't treat me as a stranger; we are family."

sentences.chinese: 随着年岁增长，林老先生的身体每况愈下，需要专业的护理。
sentences.pinyin: Suí zhe nián suì zēng zhǎng, Lín lǎo xiān sheng de shēn tǐ měi kuàng yù xià, xū yào zhuān yè de hù lǐ.
sentences.english: As the years passed, Old Mr. Lin's health deteriorated, and he required professional nursing.

sentences.chinese: 阿诚在照顾老人的同时，还学习了现代医疗知识，以便更好地照料他的健康。
sentences.pinyin: Ā Chéng zài zhào gù lǎo rén de tóng shí, hái xué xí le xiàn dài yī liáo zhī shi, yǐ biàn gèng hǎo dì zhào liào tā de jiàn kāng.
sentences.english: While taking care of the old man, A Cheng also studied modern medical knowledge to better tend to his health.

sentences.chinese: 他时刻看护在床边，确保老人的饮食起居得到最完善的保障。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shí kè kān hù zài chuáng biān, què bǎo lǎo rén de yǐn shí qǐ jū dé dào zuì wán shàn de bǎo zhàng.
sentences.english: He constantly watched over him by the bedside, ensuring that the old man's diet and daily life were perfectly guaranteed.

sentences.chinese: 他深知，一个人的生育能力决定了种群的延续，但真正的哺育则是精神的传递。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shēn zhī, yī gè rén de shēng yù néng lì jué dìng le zhǒng qún de yán xù, dàn zhēn zhèng de bǔ yù zé shì jīng shén de chuán dì.
sentences.english: He deeply understood that a person's ability to give birth determines the continuation of a species, but true nurturing is the transmission of spirit.

sentences.chinese: 他试图用自己的努力，来造就一个更有温度的未来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì tú yòng zì jǐ de nǔ lì, lái zào jiù yī gè gèng yǒu wēn dù de wèi lái.
sentences.english: He attempted to use his efforts to create a warmer future.

sentences.chinese: 有一天，林老先生把阿诚叫到身边，递给他一本古旧的笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu yī tiān, Lín lǎo xiān sheng bǎ Ā Chéng jiào dào shēn biān, dì gěi tā yī běn gǔ jiù de bǐ jì běn.
sentences.english: One day, Old Mr. Lin called A Cheng to his side and handed him an old notebook.

sentences.chinese: “这里记录了药圃的所有秘密，以及如何处置那些罕见药材的方法。”
sentences.pinyin: "Zhè lǐ jì lù le yào pǔ de suǒ yǒu mì mì, yǐ jí rú hé chǔ zhì nà xiē hǎn jiàn yào cái de fāng fǎ."
sentences.english: "This records all the secrets of the garden, as well as the methods of how to handle those rare medicinal materials."

sentences.chinese: 阿诚接过笔记本，心中充满了对这份传承的敬畏。
sentences.pinyin: Ā Chéng jiē guò bǐ jì běn, xīn zhōng chōng mǎn le duì zhè fèn chuán chéng de jìng wèi.
sentences.english: A Cheng took the notebook, his heart filled with awe for this heritage.

sentences.chinese: 林老先生轻声说：“我希望你能继续守护这片土地，让它继续产出治病救人的良药。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín lǎo xiān sheng qīng shēng shuō: "Wǒ xī wàng nǐ néng jì xù shǒu hù zhè piàn tǔ dì, ràng tā jì xù chǎn chū zhì bìng jiù rén de liáng yào."
sentences.english: Old Mr. Lin said softly, "I hope you can continue to guard this land, letting it continue to produce medicines that cure diseases and save people."

sentences.chinese: 他看着阿诚，眼神中充满了欣慰，仿佛看到了某种希望在心中生长。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe Ā Chéng, yǎn shén zhōng chōng mǎn le xīn wèi, fǎng fú kàn dào le mǒu zhǒng xī wàng zài xīn zhōng shēng zhǎng.
sentences.english: He looked at A Cheng with eyes full of gratification, as if seeing some hope growing in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 他祈祷上苍保佑阿诚能走得更远，成为一名真正的医者。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qí dǎo shàng cāng bǎo yòu Ā Chéng néng zǒu dé gèng yuǎn, chéng wéi yī míng zhēn zhèng de yī zhě.
sentences.english: He prayed that heaven would bless and protect A Cheng to go further and become a true healer.

sentences.chinese: 在林老先生最后的日子里，阿诚尽心尽力地赡养他，从未有过半点抱怨。
sentences.pinyin: Zài Lín lǎo xiān sheng zuì hòu de rì zi lǐ, Ā Chéng jìn xīn jìn lì dì shàn yǎng tā, cóng wèi yǒu guò bàn diǎn bào yuàn.
sentences.english: In Old Mr. Lin's final days, A Cheng did his utmost to support him, never complaining once.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，这是他对养育之恩最好的回报。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhī dào, zhè shì tā duì yǎng yù zhī ēn zuì hǎo de huí bào.
sentences.english: He knew this was the best way to repay the grace of being raised.

sentences.chinese: 在临终前，林老先生拉着阿诚的手，低声叮嘱道：“保重身体，不要太劳累。”
sentences.pinyin: Zài lín zhōng qián, Lín lǎo xiān sheng lā zhe Ā Chéng de shǒu, dī shēng dīng zhǔ dào: "Bǎo zhòng shēn tǐ, bù yào tài láo lèi."
sentences.english: Before passing away, Old Mr. Lin held A Cheng's hand and whispered, "Take care of your health; do not overwork yourself."

sentences.chinese: 阿诚泪流满面，承诺会永远记得老人的教诲。
sentences.pinyin: Ā Chéng lèi liú mǎn miàn, chéng nuò huì yǒng yuǎn jì dé lǎo rén de jiào huì.
sentences.english: A Cheng was in tears and promised to always remember the old man's teachings.

sentences.chinese: 后来，阿诚将药圃改造成了一家公益诊所，为贫困患者提供免费救治。
sentences.pinyin: Hòu lái, Ā Chéng jiāng yào pǔ gǎi zào chéng le yī jiā gōng yì zhěn suǒ, wèi pín kùn huàn zhě tí gōng miǎn fèi jiù zhì.
sentences.english: Later, A Cheng transformed the medicinal garden into a non-profit clinic, providing free critical care for impoverished patients.

sentences.chinese: 他甚至为诊所的医疗设备购买了长期保修，以确保诊疗的稳定性。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shèn zhì wèi zhěn suǒ de yī liáo shè bèi gòu mǎi le cháng qī bǎo xiū, yǐ què bǎo zhěn liáo de wěn dìng xìng.
sentences.english: He even purchased long-term warranties for the clinic's medical equipment to ensure the stability of treatment.

sentences.chinese: 他请当地的志愿者来关照那些无家可归的病人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qǐng dāng dì de zhì yuàn zhě lái guān zhào nà xiē wú jiā kě guī de bìng rén.
sentences.english: He invited local volunteers to look after those homeless patients.

sentences.chinese: 他用一生在实践林老先生教会他的爱与责任。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng yī shēng zài shí jiàn Lín lǎo xiān sheng jiào huì tā de ài yǔ zé rèn.
sentences.english: He spent his life practicing the love and responsibility that Old Mr. Lin had taught him.

sentences.chinese: 在云雾山的微风中，那片药圃依然青翠，见证着两代人关于关怀的传承。

stories.title_english: The Breath of the Ancient Clock
stories.story_chinese:
老林在狭小的工作室里，正面对着一座巨大的古董钟。
他试图修复这个复杂的机械装置，但钟摆的运行状态时好时坏。
他发现内部的一个核心部件出现了严重的磨损。
为了寻找匹配的配件，他翻遍了所有旧仓库的库存。
他小心翼翼地检查每一个微小的零件，确保尺寸分毫不差。
在进行最后的调试时，他发现局部齿轮的咬合并不流畅。
他意识到，如果不能精准调整，这个钟永远无法在半场时间里保持精准。
工作室里半数的工具都被他摊在桌上，像是一场精密的手术。
当钟声终于响起时，老林感到自己在这个古老艺术的传承中，分得了一小块精神份额。

stories.story_english:
Old Lin was in his small workshop, facing a massive antique clock.
He was trying to repair this complex mechanical device, but the movement of the pendulum was sometimes good and sometimes bad.
He discovered that a core component inside had suffered severe wear and tear.
To find matching spare parts, he searched through all the inventory in the old warehouses.
He carefully inspected every tiny part, ensuring the dimensions were exactly correct.
During the final debugging and adjustment, he found that the engagement of the local gears was not smooth.
He realized that if he couldn't adjust it precisely, the clock would never remain accurate over the duration of a half-game's time.
Half of the tools in the workshop were spread across the table, like a precision surgery.
When the clock finally chimed, Old Lin felt that he had earned a small spiritual share in the heritage of this ancient art.

stories.title_english: Shadows and Lights of the City
stories.story_chinese:
林远的生活像是被撕裂成了两半。
黄昏时分，他结束了在工厂从早到晚的繁重劳作。
他并不休息，而是匆匆赶往夜校，在昏黄的灯光下学习法律。
为了维持生计，他必须在晚间接一份清理街道的临时工作。
他记得那个潮湿的深夜，他不得不清理积在巷子里的动物粪便。
这种昼夜颠倒的生活让他疲惫不堪，但他的眼神中透着坚毅。
当晚，他在回家的路上经过了繁华的夜市，空气中弥漫着食物的香气。
街道另一头，霓虹闪烁的夜总会里传出喧闹的音乐，与他的沉默形成鲜明对比。
林远习惯了在夜晚寻找自己的方向。
为了准备期末考试，他不得不频繁地熬夜复习。
有时他需要通宵阅读法律卷宗，直到窗外透出凌晨的第一缕微光。
他的室友经常抱怨他彻夜不眠地翻页声，但林远从不分心。
一次突发的机遇让他获得了去省城面试的机会。
他连夜收拾好简单的行李，在黎明前出发了。
他想起自己曾为了照顾生病的母亲而连续一个月上夜班的日子。
那些艰苦的岁月成了他心中最坚硬的盔甲。
最终，他走出阴影，在城市的晨曦中找到了属于自己的光芒。

Yǒu shí tā xū yào tōng xiāo yuè dú fǎ lǜ juàn zōng, zhí dào chuāng wài tòu chū líng chén de dì yī lǚ wēi guāng.

Tā lián yè shōu shí hǎo jiǎn dān de xíng lǐ, zài lí míng qián chū fā le.
Tā xiǎng qǐ zì jǐ céng wèi le zhào gù shēng bìng de mǔ qīn ér lián xù yī gè yuè shàng yè bān de rì zi.

stories.story_english:
Lin Yuan's life seemed to be torn in two.
At dusk, he finished his heavy labor at the factory that lasted from morning till night.
He didn't rest, but hurried to night school to study law under the dim lights.
To make a living, he had to take a temporary job cleaning the streets in the evening.
He remembered that damp, late night when he had to clean animal excrement accumulated in the alley.
This life of reversed day and night left him exhausted, but his eyes showed determination.
That evening, on his way home, he passed through a bustling night market, with the aroma of food filling the air.
At the other end of the street, noisy music drifted from a neon-lit nightclub, forming a sharp contrast with his silence.
Lin Yuan was used to finding his direction in the night.
To prepare for final exams, he had to frequently stay up late to review.
Sometimes he needed to read legal files all night, until the first glimmer of the wee hours leaked through the window.
His roommate often complained about the sound of him turning pages the whole night without sleep, but Lin Yuan never got distracted.
A sudden opportunity gave him a chance to interview in the provincial capital.
He packed his simple luggage that very night and set off before dawn.
He recalled the days when he worked the night shift for a whole month to take care of his sick mother.
Those hardships became the hardest armor in his heart.
Ultimately, he stepped out of the shadows and found his own light in the city's dawn.

stories.title_english: The Guardian of the Ancient City
stories.story_chinese:
在青州这座古城中，林远一直被视为未来的栋梁之材。
他年轻时曾应聘进入市文物局，凭借卓越的才干被迅速提拔。
在正式就职之前，他必须先在基层岗位上岗，学习如何保护古迹。
林远为人正直，在同事中享有极高的声誉。
他深知自己的使命不仅是管理，更是守护文明的碎片。
当他被任命出任文物局副局长时，他郑重地宣誓，将竭尽全力履行职责。
他的前任在任期结束前，详细地向他交接了所有掌管的档案。
林远接手的工作量极大，他需要兼顾行政管理与学术研究。
为了提高效率，他决定在局内设立一个专职的数字化团队。
他不仅是行政领导，还兼任技术指导，甚至在业余时间兼职给学生讲课。
在一次重要的文化项目承包过程中，林远发现有人试图操控招标结果。
这个项目涉及巨额资金，某些贪婪的人想要宰掉承包商的利润来中饱私囊。
林远意识到，权力如果被欲望主宰，将会毁掉整个部门。
他决定以身作则，带头清理内部的腐败之风。
他首先拜见现任市长，将搜集到的证据详细上报。
市长对此高度重视，立即指派执法部门介入调查。
在调查过程中，林远充当了关键的参谋，提供了决定性的线索。
他利用自己的人脉天线，迅速锁定了涉案人员的资金流向。
最终，那些违规者被制服，法律的公正得到了维护。
原本那些试图通过关系受理不正当申请的人，现在全部被取而代之。
林远在职期间，极大地改善了部门的用人机制。
他认为，每个员工都应该守好自己的本分，而不是追求特权。
为了进一步深化改革，他带领一支专家团队带队前往偏远乡村。
他亲自带路，引领同事们深入那些被遗忘的古村落。
在这些地方，他不仅负责招待外来学者，还担负起抢救性挖掘的重任。
他深知，承担起这份责任意味着要担起沉重的心理压力。
他要求团队成员在工作中要敢于担当，面对困难不退缩。
在一次跨国合作项目中，林远搭乘飞机前往欧洲，与当地理事会进行磋商。
他希望通过国际合作，让古城的文化效力在全世界范围内传播。
在会议上，他详细介绍了青州古城的历史，赢得了对方的尊重。
回到国内后，他开始培养一批优秀的年轻人接班。
他告诉他们，无论未来就任什么样的职位，都要保持初心。
他不仅关注工作结果，更关注年轻人在职业道路上的成长。
林远在局里的影响力日益增加，但他始终保持谦逊。
他经常在深夜的办公室里思考，如何让文化遗产与现代生活共生。
他意识到，真正的领导力不是命令，而是服务。
在这个过程中，他逐渐成为了整个城市的文化精神领袖。
他用实际行动证明，正直与才干可以共存。
随着时间的推移，林远在文物保护领域取得了举世瞩目的成就。
他的管理模式被推广到全国，成为了行业标杆。
他让人们看到，一个真正的公务员应该如何服务于公众。
在他的引领下，青州古城重新焕发了生机。
人们开始意识到，保护古迹就是保护自己的根。
林远在一次访谈中提到，他最自豪的不是职位的高低。
而是他能够在这个岗位上，为后代留下真实的文明见证。
他将继续在自己的岗位上奋斗，直到退休的那一天。
他相信，只要有人愿意坚守，正义和美德永远不会消失。
这座古城在他的守护下，变得更加宁静而深邃。
每一个砖瓦，每一块石碑，都记录着他的辛勤付出。
林远的故事在青州流传，激励着无数年轻人投身于文化事业。
他用一生诠释了什么叫作对事业的忠诚。
最终，他成为了这座城市历史上最受尊敬的文化守护者。

市长对此高度重视，立即指派执法部门介入调查。
在调查过程中，林远充当了关键的参谋，提供了决定性的线索。
他利用自己的人脉天线，迅速锁定了涉案人员的资金流向。
最终，那些违规者被制服，法律的公正得到了维护。
原本那些试图通过关系受理不正当申请的人，现在全部被取而代之。
林远在职期间，极大地改善了部门的用人机制。
他认为，每个员工都应该守好自己的本分，而不是追求特权。
为了进一步深化改革，他带领一支专家团队带队前往偏远乡村。
他亲自带路，引领同事们深入那些被遗忘的古村落。
在这些地方，他不仅负责招待外来学者，还担负起抢救性挖掘的重任。
他深知，承担起这份责任意味着要担起沉重的心理压力。
他要求团队成员在工作中要敢于担当，面对困难不退缩。
在一次跨国合作项目中，林远搭乘飞机前往欧洲，与当地理事会进行磋商。
他希望通过国际合作，让古城的文化效力在全世界范围内传播。
在会议上，他详细介绍了青州古城的历史，赢得了对方的尊重。
回到国内后，他开始培养一批优秀的年轻人接班。
他告诉他们，无论未来就任什么样的职位，都要保持初心。
他不仅关注工作结果，更关注年轻人在职业道路上的成长。
林远在局里的影响力日益增加，但他始终保持谦逊。
他经常在深夜的办公室里思考，如何让文化遗产与现代生活共生。
他意识到，真正的领导力不是命令，而是服务。
在这个过程中，他逐渐成为了整个城市的文化精神领袖。
他用实际行动证明，正直与才干可以共存。
随着时间的推移，林远在文物保护领域取得了举世瞩目的成就。
他的管理模式被推广到全国，成为了行业标杆。
他让人们看到，一个真正的公务员应该如何服务于公众。
在他的引领下，青州古城重新焕发了生机。
人们开始意识到，保护古迹就是保护自己的根。
林远在一次访谈中提到，他最自豪的不是职位的高低。
而是他能够在这个岗位上，为后代留下真实的文明见证。
他将继续在自己的岗位上奋斗，直到退休的那一天。
他相信，只要有人愿意坚守，正义和美德永远不会消失。
这座古城在他的守护下，变得更加宁静而深邃。
每一个砖瓦，每一块石碑，都记录着他的辛勤付出。
林远的故事在青州流传，激励着无数年轻人投身于文化事业。
他用一生诠释了什么叫作对事业的忠诚。
最终，他成为了这座城市历史上最受尊敬的文化守护者。
stories.story_pinyin:
Zài Qīngzhōu zhè zuò gǔchéng zhōng, Lín Yuǎn yīzhí bèi shì wéi wèilái de dòngliáng zhī cái.
Tā niánqīng shí céng yìngpìn jìnrù shì wénwùjú, píngjiè zhuóyuè de cáigàn bèi xùnsù tíbá.
Zài zhèngshì jiùzhí zhīqián, tā bìxū xiān zài jīcéng gǎngwèi shànggǎng, xuéxí rúhé bǎohù gǔjì.
Lín Yuǎn wéirén zhèngzhí, zài tóngshì zhōng xiǎngyǒu jí gāo de shēngyù.
Tā shēnzhī zìjǐ de shǐmìng bùjǐn shì guǎnlǐ, gèng shì shǒuhù wénmíng de suìpiàn.
Dāng tā bèi rènming chūrèn wénwùjú fùjúzhǎng shí, tā zhèngzhòng de xuānshì, jiāng jiéjìn quánlì lǚxíng zhízé.
Tā de qiánrèn zài rènqī jiéshù qián, xiángxì de xiàng tā jiāojiē le suǒyǒu zhǎngguǎn de dàng'àn.
Lín Yuǎn jiēshǒu de gōngzuòliàng jídà, tā xūyào jiāngù xíngzhèng guǎnlǐ yǔ xuéshù yánjiū.
Wèile tígāo xiàolǜ, tā juédìng zài jú nèi shèlì yī gè zhuānzhí de shùzìhuà tuánduì.
Tā bùjǐn shì xíngzhèng lǐngdǎo, hái jiānrèn jìshù zhǐdǎo, shènzhì zài yèyú shíjiān jiānzhí gěi xuéshēng jiǎngkè.
Zài yī cì zhòngyào de wénhuà xiàngmù chéngbāo guòchéng zhōng, Lín Yuǎn fāxiàn yǒurén shìtú cāokòng zhāobiāo jiéguǒ.
Zhège xiàngmù shèjí jù'é zījīn, mǒu xiē tānlán de rén xiǎngyào zǎi diào chéngbāoshāng de lìrùn lái zhōngbǎo sīnáng.
Lín Yuǎn yìshí dào, quánlì rúguǒ bèi yùwàng zhǔzǎi, jiāng huǐ diào zhěnggè bùmén.
Tā juédìng yǐshēnzuòzé, dàitóu qǐnglǐ nèibù de fǔbài zhī fēng.
Tā shǒuxiān bàijiàn xiànrèn shìzhǎng, jiāng sōují dào de zhèngjù xiángxì shàngbào.
Shìzhǎng duì cǐ gāodù zhòngshì, lìjí zhǐpài zhífǎ bùmén jièrù diàochá.
Zài diàochá guòchéng zhōng, Lín Yuǎn chōngdāng le guānjiàn de cānmóu, tígōng le juédìngxìng de xiànsuǒ.
Tā lìyòng zìjǐ de rénmài tiānxiàn, xùnsù suǒdìng le shè'àn rényuán de zījīn liúxiàng.
Zuìzhōng, nàxiē wéiguīzhě bèi zhìfú, fǎlǜ de gōngzhèng dédào le wéihù.
Yuánběn nàxiē shìtú tōngguò guānxì shòulǐ bù zhèngdàng shēnqǐng de rén, xiànzài quánbù bèi qǔ'érdàizhī.
Lín Yuǎn zàizhí qījiān, jídà de gǎishàn le bùmén de yòngrén jīzhì.
Tā rènwéi, měi gè yuángōng dōu yīnggāi shǒu hǎo zìjǐ de běnfèn, ér bùshì zhuīqiú tèquán.
Wèile jìn yī bù shēnhuà gǎigé, tā dàilǐ yī zhī zhuānjiā tuánduì dàiduì qiánwǎng piānyuǎn xiāngcūn.
Tā qīnzì dàilù, yǐnlǐng tóngshìmen shēnrù nàxiē bèi yíwàng de gǔcūnluò.
Zài zhèxiē dìfāng, tā bùjǐn fùzé zhāodài wàilái xuézhě, hái dānfù qǐ qiǎngjiùxìng wājué de zhòngrèn.
Tā shēnzhī, chéngdān qǐ zhè fèn zérèn yìwèizhe yào dān qǐ chénzhòng de xīnlǐ yālì.
Tā yāoqiú tuánduì chéngyuán zài gōngzuò zhōng yào gǎnyú dāndāng, miànduì kùnnán bù tuìsuō.
Zài yī cì kuàguó hézuò xiàngmù zhōng, Lín Yuǎn dāchéng fēijī qiánwǎng Ōuzhōu, yǔ dāngdì lǐshìhuì jìnxíng cuōshāng.
Tā xīwàng tōngguò guójì hézuò, ràng gǔchéng de wénhuà xiàolì zài quán shìjiè fànwéi nèi chuánbō.
Zài huìyì shàng, tā xiángxì jièshào le Qīngzhōu gǔchéng de lìshǐ, yíngdé le duìfāng de zūnzhòng.
Huí dào guónèi hòu, tā kāishǐ péiyǎng yī pī yōuxiù de niánqīng rén jiēbān.
Tā gàosù tāmen, wúlùn wèilái jiùrèn shénme yàng de zhíwèi, dōu yào bǎochí chūxīn.
Tā bùjǐn guānzhù gōngzuò jiéguǒ, gèng guānzhù niánqīng rén zài zhíyè dàolù shàng de chéngzhǎng.
Lín Yuǎn zài jú lǐ de yǐngxiǎnglì rìyì zēngjiā, dàn tā shǐzhōng bǎochí qiānxù.
Tā jīngcháng zài shēnyè de bàngōngshì lǐ sīkǎo, rúhé ràng wénhuà yíchǎn yǔ xiàndài shēnghuó gòngshēng.
Tā yìshí dào, zhēnzhèng de lǐngdǎolì bùshì mìnglìng, ér shì fúwù.
Zài zhège guòchéng zhōng, tā zhújiàn chéngwéi le zhěnggè chéngshì de wénhuà jīngshén lǐngxiù.
Tā yòng shíjì xíngdòng zhèngmíng, zhèngzhí yǔ cáigàn kěyǐ gòngcún.
Suízhe shíjiān de tuīyí, Lín Yuǎn zài wénwù bǎohù lǐngyù qǔdé le jǔshì zhùmù de chéngjiù.
Tā de guǎnlǐ móshì bèi tuīguǎng dào quánguó, chéngwéi le hángyè biāogān.
Tā ràng rénmen kàndào, yī gè zhēnzhèng de gōngwùyuán yīnggāi rúhé fúwù yú gōngzhòng.
Zài tā de yǐnlǐng xià, Qīngzhōu gǔchéng chóngxīn huànfā le shēngjī.
Rénmen kāishǐ yìshí dào, bǎohù gǔjì jiùshì bǎohù zìjǐ de gēn.
Lín Yuǎn zài yī cì fǎntán zhōng tídào, tā zuì zìháo de bùshì zhíwèi de gāodī.
Ér shì tā nénggòu zài zhège gǎngwèi shàng, wèi hòudài liú xià zhēnshí de wénmíng jiànzhèng.
Tā jiāng jìxù zài zìjǐ de gǎngwèi shàng fèndòu, zhídào tuìxiū de nà yī tiān.
Tā xiāngxìn, zhǐyào yǒurén yuànyì jiānshǒu, zhèngyì hé měidé yǒngyuǎn bù huì xiāoshī.
Zhè zuò gǔchéng zài tā de shǒuhù xià, biàn dé gèngjiā níngjìng ér shēnsù.
Měi yī gè zhuānwǎ, měi yī kuài shíbēi, dōu jìlù zhe tā de xīnqín fùchū.
Lín Yuǎn de gùshì zài Qīngzhōu liúchuán, jīlì zhe wúshù niánqīng rén tóushēn yú wénhuà shìyè.
Tā yòng yīshēng quànshì le shénme jiào zuò duì shìyè de zhōngchéng.
Zuìzhōng, tā chéngwéi le zhè zuò chéngshì lìshǐ shàng zuì shòu zūnzhòng de wénhuà shǒuhùzhě.

stories.story_english:
In the ancient city of Qingzhou, Lin Yuan had always been regarded as a pillar of the future.
In his youth, he applied for a position at the Municipal Cultural Relics Bureau and was quickly promoted due to his outstanding talent.
Before officially taking office, he had to first start his duty at the grassroots level to learn how to protect ancient sites.
Lin Yuan conducted himself with integrity and enjoyed a very high reputation among his colleagues.
He deeply understood that his mission was not only to manage but to protect the fragments of civilization.
When he was appointed to take up the post of Deputy director of the Cultural Relics Bureau, he solemnly swore to fulfill his duties to the best of his ability.
Before his term of office ended, his predecessor handed over all the managed archives to him in detail.
The workload Lin Yuan took over was enormous; he needed to balance administrative management and academic research.
To improve efficiency, he decided to establish a full-time digitalization team within the bureau.
He was not only an administrative leader but also concurrently served as a technical advisor, and even moonlighted as a lecturer for students in his spare time.
During the contracting process of an important cultural project, Lin Yuan discovered that some people were trying to manipulate the bidding results.
This project involved huge sums of money, and some greedy people wanted to rip off the contractor's profits for their own pockets.
Lin Yuan realized that if power were dominated by desire, it would ruin the entire department.
He decided to set an example and take the lead in cleaning up the wind of corruption within the organization.
He first paid a formal visit to the current mayor and reported the collected evidence in detail.
The mayor attached great importance to this and immediately dispatched law enforcement departments to intervene in the investigation.
During the investigation, Lin Yuan acted as a key advisor and provided decisive clues.
Using his network of high-level connections, he quickly locked onto the fund flow of the suspects.

stories.title_english: The Game of Power in the Capital
stories.story_chinese:
在这座繁华的首府，权力如同无形的丝线，交织在每一座办公楼之间。
林远曾是这座城市最顶尖的法律顾问，被特聘为市议会的首席监管官。
他秉承着公正的原则，试图在复杂的官僚体系中建立新的秩序。
然而，现任议长赵诚并不欢迎他的到来。
赵诚在位多年，凭借强硬的手段统治着这个部门，并试图通过操纵选举来寻求连任。
他习惯于利用自己的职权，将公共资源视为私产一般霸占。
为了稳固地位，赵诚聘任了一批唯命是从的下属，将他们当作自己的政治管家。
这些下属在赵诚的遥控下，在各个行政区域内行使管辖权，排挤异己。
林远很快意识到，要打破这种僵局，必须有人在接下来的竞选中挑战赵诚。
他找到了年轻的才俊周恒，督促他勇敢地站出来表态。
周恒虽然才华横溢，但面对赵诚的势力，他担心自己无法胜任如此高压的职位。
林远告诉他：“驾驭权力的关键不在于强悍，而在于能够调度人心。”
为了准备竞选，周恒决定赴多个基层社区调研，倾听民众的真实心声。
他不再像以往那样由一名领队带领，而是亲自走访每一个角落。
在这次旅程中，周恒逐渐展现出领军人物的潜质，赢得了广泛的支持。
最终，在公开的辩论会上，周恒用犀利的逻辑揭露了赵诚的贪婪。
民众不再愿意忍受那个将权力私有化的统治者。
投票结果出炉，周恒以压倒性优势赢得了胜利。
他接手了那个曾经被权力腐蚀的办公室，开始了真正的服务。
林远看着新任议长的背影，知道这座城市终于迎来了一场必要的洗礼。
权力不再是禁锢的枷锁，而变成了推动进步的引擎。

stories.story_pinyin:
Zài zhè zuò fán huá de shǒu fǔ, quán lì rú tóng wú xíng de sī xiàn, jiāo zhī zài měi yī zuò bàn gōng lóu zhī jiān.
Lín Yuǎn céng shì zhè zuò chéng shì zuì dǐng jiān de fǎ lǜ gù wèn, bèi tè pìn wéi shì yì huì de shǒu xí jiān guǎn guān.
Tā bǐng chéng zhe gōng zhèng de yuán zé, shì tú zài fù zá de guān liáo tǐ xì zhōng jiàn lì xīn de zhì xù.
Rán ér, xiàn rèn yì zhǎng Zhào Chéng bìng bù huān yíng tā de dào lái.
Zhào Chéng zài wèi duō nián, píng jiè qiáng yìng de shǒu duàn tǒng zhì zhe zhè ge bù mén, bìng shì tú tōng guò cāo zòng xuǎn jǔ lái xún qiú lián rèn.
Tā xí guàn yú lì yòng zì jǐ de zhí quán, jiāng gōng gòng zī yuán shì wéi sī chǎn yī bān bà zhàn.
Wèi le wěn gù dì wèi, Zhào Chéng pìn rèn le yī pī wéi mì cóng shùn de xià shǔ, jiāng tā men dàng zuò zì jǐ de zhèng zhì guǎn jiā.
Zhè xiē xià shǔ zài Zhào Chéng de yáo kòng xià, zài gè gè xíng zhèng qū yù nèi xíng shǐ guǎn xiá quán, pái jǐ yì jì.
Lín Yuǎn hěn kuài yì shí dào, yào dǎ pò zhè zhǒng jiāng jú, bì xū yǒu rén zài jiē xià lái de jìng xuǎn zhōng tiǎo zhàn Zhào Chéng.
Tā zhǎo dào le nián qīng de cái jùn Zhōu Héng, dū cù tā yǒng gǎn de zhàn chū lái biǎo tài.
Zhōu Héng suī rán cái huá héng yì, dàn miàn duì Zhào Chéng de shì lì, tā dān xīn zì jǐ wú fǎ shèng rèn rú cǐ gāo yā de zhí wèi.
Lín Yuǎn gào sù tā: “Jià yù quán lì de guān jiàn bù zài yú qiáng hàn, ér zài yú néng gòu diào dù rén xīn.”
Wèi le zhǔn bèi jìng xuǎn, Zhōu Héng jué dìng fù duō gè jī céng shè qū diào yán, qīng tīng mín zhòng de zhēn shí xīn shēng.
Tā bù zài xiàng yǐ wǎng ná yàng yóu yī míng lǐng duì dài lǐng, ér shì qīn zì zǒu fǎng měi yī gè jiǎo luò.
Zài zhè cì lǚ chéng zhōng, Zhōu Héng zhú jiàn zhǎn xiàn chū lǐng jūn rén wù de qián zhì, yíng dé le guǎng fàn de zhī chí.
Zuì zhōng, zài gōng kāi de biàn lùn huì shàng, Zhōu Héng yòng xī lì de luó jí jiē lù le Zhào Chéng de tān lán.
Mín zhòng bù zài yuàn yì rěn shòu nèi gè jiāng quán lì sī yǒu huà de tǒng zhì zhě.
Tóu piào jié guǒ chū lú, Zhōu Héng yǐ yā dǎo xìng yōu shì yíng dé le shèng lì.
Tā jiē shǒu le nèi gè céng jīng bèi quán lì fǔ shí de bàn gōng shì, kāi shǐ le zhēn zhèng de fú wù.
Lín Yuǎn kàn zhe xīn rèn yì zhǎng de bèi yǐng, zhī dào zhè zuò chéng shì zhōng yú yíng lái le yī chǎng bì yào de xǐ lǐ.
Quán lì bù zài shì jìn gù de jiǎ suǒ, ér biàn chéng le tuī dòng jìn bù de yǐn qíng.

Zuì zhōng, zài gōng kāi de biàn lùn huì shàng, Zhōu Héng yòng xī lì de luó jí jiē lù le Zhào Chéng de tān lán.
Mín zhòng bù zài yuàn yì rěn shòu nèi gè jiāng quán lì sī yǒu huà de tǒng zhì zhě.
Tóu piào jié guǒ chū lú, Zhōu Héng yǐ yā dǎo xìng yōu shì yíng dé le shèng lì.
Tā jiē shǒu le nèi gè céng jīng bèi quán lì fǔ shí de bàn gōng shì, kāi shǐ le zhēn zhèng de fú wù.
Lín Yuǎn kàn zhe xīn rèn yì zhǎng de bèi yǐng, zhī dào zhè zuò chéng shì zhōng yú yíng lái le yī chǎng bì yào de xǐ lǐ.
Quán lì bù zài shì jìn gù de jiǎ suǒ, ér biàn chéng le tuī dòng jìn bù de yǐn qíng.
stories.story_english:
In this prosperous capital city, power was like invisible threads, interwoven between every office building.
Lin Yuan was once the top legal consultant in the city and was specially hired as the chief oversight officer of the city council.
Adhering to the principle of fairness, he attempted to establish a new order within the complex bureaucracy.
However, the current council speaker, Zhao Cheng, did not welcome his arrival.
Zhao Cheng had been in office for many years, ruling the department with a heavy hand and attempting to seek re-election by manipulating the polls.
He was accustomed to using his authority to seize public resources as if they were private property.
To consolidate his position, Zhao Cheng appointed a group of obedient subordinates, treating them as his political stewards.
Under Zhao Cheng's remote control, these subordinates exercised jurisdiction across various administrative regions to squeeze out dissidents.
Lin Yuan soon realized that to break this deadlock, someone had to challenge Zhao Cheng in the upcoming election.
He found a talented young man named Zhou Heng and urged him to bravely stand up and declare his position.
Although Zhou Heng was brilliantly talented, he worried that he would not be competent for such a high-pressure position in the face of Zhao Cheng's power.
Lin Yuan told him: "The key to steering power lies not in toughness, but in the ability to manage people's hearts."
To prepare for the election, Zhou Heng decided to visit several grassroots communities to conduct research and listen to the true voices of the people.
He no longer let himself be led by a team leader as before, but visited every corner personally.
During this journey, Zhou Heng gradually demonstrated the potential of a leading figure and won widespread support.
Ultimately, at the public debate, Zhou Heng used sharp logic to expose Zhao Cheng's greed.
The people were no longer willing to endure a ruler who privatized power.
The voting results were released, and Zhou Heng won a landslide victory.
He took over that office which had once been corrupted by power and began true service.
Lin Yuan looked at the new speaker's back, knowing that the city had finally welcomed a necessary baptism.
Power was no longer a confining shackle, but had become an engine driving progress.

stories.story_chinese:
老林曾是一名受人尊敬的市长，但因贪污公款而身败名裂。
他在深夜的雨中徘徊，心中充满了无法弥补的愧疚。
他想起多年前那场突如其来的轰炸，城市被重创，无数建筑化为废墟。
当时，他在混乱中遇险，被一名年轻的消防员拼死救出。
然而，那名消防员在随后的救援行动中不幸遇难。
老林试图用金钱去赎回内心的平静，但良心让他无法停止自我责备。
他的家人也对他失望透顶，不再责怪他的过错，而是选择了沉默。
他在破产后赔钱偿还所有债务，试图在贫困中寻找真正的救赎。
最终，他在那座纪念碑前跪下，泪水洗净了曾经的贪婪。

rán ér, nà míng xiāo fáng yuán zài suí hòu de jiù yuán xíng dòng zhōng bù xìng yù nàn.

stories.story_english:
Old Lin was once a respected mayor, but he fell from grace due to embezzling public funds.
He wandered in the rain late at night, his heart filled with irreparable guilt.
He remembered the sudden bombing many years ago, which inflicted heavy losses on the city and turned countless buildings into ruins.
At that time, he encountered danger in the chaos and was saved by a young firefighter at the risk of his life.
However, that firefighter unfortunately perished in a subsequent rescue operation.
Old Lin tried to use money to redeem the peace in his heart, but his conscience prevented him from stopping his self-condemnation.
His family was also utterly disappointed in him; they no longer rebuked him for his mistakes, but chose silence instead.
After going bankrupt, he paid for damages to settle all his debts, attempting to find true redemption in poverty.
Finally, he knelt before the monument, and his tears washed away his former greed.

stories.title_english: The Mystery of the Ancient Painting and the Artisan's Heart
stories.story_chinese:
在古城的一条深巷里，住着一位名叫林远的老修复师。
他生活朴素，每天在昏黄的灯光下与古旧的卷轴为伴。
林远性格质朴，在圈内以无私著称，经常无偿地为年轻人指导修复技巧。
有一天，一位名叫赵强的商人匆匆敲开了他的门。
赵强为人大大咧咧，说话声音极大，且显得有些急躁。
他带来了一幅残破的山水画，声称这幅画是无敌的艺术珍品，价值连城。
林远接过画卷，发现画作未经妥善保存，受潮严重。
赵强要求林远在三天内将其修复，并承诺只要结果万无一失，将给予巨额报酬。
林远看着画上的笔触，意识到这并非简单的修复，而是需要极大的耐心。
他毫不犹豫地接下了这个挑战，因为他热爱艺术，而非金钱。
在修复的第一天，林远发现画中隐藏着一个奇怪的印章。
他意识到这幅画可能涉及一段不为人知的往事。
他决定不耻下问，向住在隔壁的古籍专家请教。
专家告诉他，这幅画曾被一个无恶不作的贪官私藏，后来被抢走。
赵强听到这里，突然脸色大变，一言不发地盯着林远。
林远好奇地询问画的来源，赵强却冷漠地回答说无可奉告。
林远心中疑惑，但并没有大惊小怪，而是继续专注于工作。
他发现修复这幅画其实不难，只要掌握了特殊的药水配比，就能轻而易举地去除污渍。
他在工作中从容不迫，每一个动作都精准无比。
然而，赵强却在旁边不停地催促，甚至出言不逊。
林远认为他可能是有口无心，并未将这些话放在心上。
有一天，林远顺便在整理旧物时，发现赵强偷偷潜入工作室试图拿走画作。
被抓现行后，赵强反而大吼大叫，指责林远无故扣押他的财产。
林远面对这种指责，感到无话可说，只能无奈地摇头。
赵强试图用金钱诱导林远在修复过程中篡改作者签名，以提高其市场价值。
林远对此感到愤怒，他认为这种行为是对艺术的亵渎。
他告诉赵强，即便对方提供无条件的支持，他也不会违背职业道德。
他心安理得地拒绝了诱惑，并要求赵强离开。
赵强离开后，林远终于可以安静地完成最后一步。
他顺手将画卷封好，将其交还给真正的原主——当地的一家博物馆。
博物馆馆长对林远的工艺赞不绝口，直言其水平没说的。
两人在茶室里畅谈起艺术的真谛，讨论了整整一个下午。
林远看着窗外无忧无虑地飞翔的鸟儿，心中感到无比平静。
他意识到，真正的价值在于对纯粹之美的追求，而非世俗的名利。
那些被贪婪遮蔽的真相，在光阴的洗涤下，无不显现出原本的色彩。
面对那些无辜的艺术品，他深知自己无须追求名声，只要守护住匠心即可。
他想起年轻时的自己，说干就干，不惜花费所有积蓄去购买古籍。
如今，他终于明白，简单而纯粹的生活才是最高级的艺术。
他坐在椅子上，面对着窗外的夕阳，一声不吭地笑了。
