stories.title_english: The Secret of the Deep Valley
stories.story_chinese:
林教授是一位潜心研究植物学的学者，他一生都在寻找一种罕见的幽兰。
在深山之中，这种植物极为稀少，绝大多数同行都认为它早已灭绝。
他曾听闻在极少数的古籍中，记载过这种兰花生长在终年大雾的深谷。
对他而言，能亲眼见到这种花是人生中少有的机遇。
经过数月的艰苦跋涉，他终于进入了那片被世人遗忘的秘境。
谷底生长着各种奇花异草，色彩斑斓得令人心惊。
林教授惊叹道：“如此瑰丽的景象，在现代都市中实在太少见了。”
他注意到这里的土壤水分充足，但养分却显得很稀，这让兰花的生长环境变得异常苛刻。
在这种极端环境下，能生存下来的品种简直稀奇。
就在这时，一朵晶莹剔透的幽兰在岩缝中悄然绽放。
这种难得一见的绝美之花，让林教授瞬间忘记了所有的疲惫。
他轻轻记录下观察结果，心中充满了对自然的敬畏。

stories.story_pinyin:
Lín jiàoshòu shì yī wèi qiánxīn yánjiū zhíwùxué de xuézhě, tā yīshēng dōu zài xúnzhǎo yī zhǒng hǎnjiàn de yōulán.
Zài shēnshān zhīzhōng, zhè zhǒng zhíwù jíwéi xīshǎo, jué dàduōshù tóngháng dōu rènwéi tā zǎoyǐ mièjué.
Tā céng tīngwén zài jí shǎoshù de gǔjí zhōng, jìzǎi guò zhè zhǒng lánhuā shēngzhǎng zài zhōngnián dàwù de shēngǔ.
Duì tā ér yán, néng qīnyǎn jiàndào zhè zhǒng huā shì rénshēng zhōng shǎoyǒu de jīyù.
Jīngguò shù yuè de jiānkǔ báshè, tā zhōngyú jìnrù le nà piàn bèi shìrén yíwàng de mìjìng.
Gǔdǐ shēngzhǎng zhe gèzhǒng qíhuā yìcǎo, sècǎi bānlán de lìngrén xīnjīng.
Lín jiàoshòu jīngtàn dào: “Rúcǐ guīlì de jǐngxiàng, zài xiàndài dūshì zhōng shízài tài shǎojiàn le.”
Tā zhùyì dào zhèlǐ de tǔrǎng shuǐfèn chōngzú, dàn yǎngfèn què xiǎnde hěn xī, zhè ràng lánhuā de shēngzhǎng huánjìng biànde yìcháng kēkè.
Zài zhè zhǒng jíduān huánjìng xià, néng shēngcún xiàlái de pǐnzhǒng jiǎnzhí xīqí.
Jiù zài zhè shí, yī duǒ jīngyíng tìtòu de yōulán zài yánfèng zhōng qiǎorán zhànfàng.
Zhè zhǒng nándé yī jiàn de juéměi zhī huā, ràng Lín jiàoshòu shùnjiān wàngjì le suǒyǒu de píbèi.
Tā qīngqīng jìlù xià guānchá jiéguǒ, xīnzhōng chōngmǎn le duì zìrán de jìngwèi.

stories.story_english:
Professor Lin was a scholar devoted to botany, and he spent his entire life searching for a rare幽 orchid.
In the deep mountains, this plant is extremely sparse, and the vast majority of his colleagues believed it had already gone extinct.
He had heard that in a very small number of ancient texts, it was recorded that this orchid grew in a deep valley covered in perennial fog.
For him, being able to see this flower with his own eyes was a rare opportunity in his life.
After several months of arduous trekking, he finally entered that secret realm forgotten by the world.
Various rare and exotic plants grew at the bottom of the valley, with colors so vibrant they were startling.
Professor Lin exclaimed, "Such a magnificent sight is truly rare to see in modern cities."
He noticed that the soil here was rich in moisture, but the nutrients were very sparse, which made the growing environment for the orchid exceptionally harsh.
Under such extreme conditions, the species that could survive were simply strange and rare.
Just then, a crystal-clear orchid quietly bloomed in a crevice of the rock.
This rarely seen, exquisitely beautiful flower made Professor Lin instantly forget all his exhaustion.
He gently recorded the observations, his heart filled with awe for nature.

stories.story_chinese:
在繁华的都市深处，林远生活在一个由谎言构成的迷宫里。
他是一名顶级的伪造专家，擅长制造足以乱真的古董。
对于他来说，造假不仅仅是为了金钱，更像是一种艺术的模拟。
但在这个圈子里，每个人都在演戏，试图掩盖真实的自我。
林远习惯于乔装打扮，在不同的社交场合扮演不同的角色。
有时他扮成一个落魄的学者，有时则冒充一名成功的投资商。
他发现，人们很容易被虚假的外表所误导。
只要你足够自信，即便是在说谎，别人也会认为那是真理。
然而，这种生活让他感到极其虚伪，仿佛自己只是在跑龙套。
他每天在真实与虚构之间徘徊，讲述着半真半假的往事。
直到有一天，他遇到了苏晴，一个同样擅长伪装的女人。
苏晴表面上是个温柔的画廊主，实际上却在利用艺术品进行诈骗。
她用精美的辞藻引诱那些贪婪的收藏家，让他们心甘情愿地受骗。
林远起初以为遇到了知己，却没发现自己成了她钓鱼计划的目标。
苏晴试图通过敲诈的方式，逼迫林远为她伪造一批绝世名画。
她威胁说，如果林远不配合，她就向警方泄露他的秘密。
这种讹诈手段让林远感到愤怒，因为他最厌恶的就是背叛。
他意识到，苏晴所谓的爱情不过是一场精心设计的欺骗。
她试图歪曲他的意图，将他描述成一个贪婪的骗子。
林远决定反击，他不再假装顺从，而是开始在暗中搞鬼。
他故意在作品中留下细微的破绽，这在行内被称为画蛇添足。
他想看看这个自以为聪明的女人何时会出洋相。
在一次高端拍卖会上，苏晴正得意地向买家吹嘘画作的由来。
林远在人群中偷窥，看着她用谎话编织一个完美的陷阱。
他突然走上前，用讽刺的语气调侃起那幅画的笔触。
周围的人开始窃窃私语，怀疑这件作品是否在弄虚作假。
苏晴脸色大变，试图用胡说的方式掩盖漏洞。
但林远拿出了证据，揭露了她长期以来欺诈的行径。
他告诉众人，这幅画不过是他在模拟古人风格时的习作。
面对真相，苏晴试图认错，但此时已太晚了。
那些被她涮过的人纷纷站出来，用嘲笑地眼神看着她。
她曾经嘲弄那些被骗的人，现在却成了被耻笑的对象。
林远看着她崩溃的样子，心中却没有多少快感。
因为他意识到，在这个充满欺诈的世界里，谁也没有真正诚实。
他想起小时候玩捉迷藏的日子，那时候的隐藏是为了游戏，而不是为了生存。
成年人的世界里，隐藏变成了生存的本能，而诚实则成了奢侈品。
他曾以为可以通过出卖灵魂来换取财富，结果却发现这买卖亏本了。
他厌倦了每天地撒谎，厌倦了用谎言来掩盖谎言。
他想起那些曾经被他欺骗的人，心中充满了愧疚。
他不再想通过作弊来获得成功，也不想再通过假冒他人来获得尊重。
他决定离开这个城市，抛弃所有伪装的身份。
在离开的前一夜，他躺在冰冷的床上，静静地卧在黑暗中思考。
他意识到，一个人如果一直生活在虚假之中，最终会丢失自我。
他不再需要用吓唬别人的方式来获得掌控感。
他也不再需要通过说谎来维持一个完美的形象。
他将所有的伪造工具全部销毁，那是他对过去生活的最后告别。
他不再想通过欺骗来获取利益，因为那种成功毫无意义。
他走出房门，感受着清晨的第一缕阳光照射在脸上。
没有了面具，他感到一种前所未有的轻松。
虽然未来的路充满了不确定，但他愿意面对真实的自己。
他知道，诚实虽然有时会让人显得笨拙，但它是唯一能让人安睡的良药。
在这个喧嚣的世界里，他终于找回了丢失的灵魂。
他不再是一个跑龙套的伪装者，而是一个真实的人。
他对着镜子微笑，这一次，没有谎言，只有真实的喜悦。

stories.story_pinyin:
Zài fán huá de dū shì shēn chù, Lín Yuǎn shēng huó zài yī gè yóu huǎng yán gòu chéng de mí gōng lǐ.
Tā shì yī míng dǐng jí de wěi zào zhuān jiā, shàn cháng zhì zào zú nǐng luàn zhēn de gǔ dǒng.
Duì yú tā lái shuō, zào jiǎ bù jǐn jǐn shì wèi le jīn qián, gèng xiàng shì yī zhǒng yì shù de mó nǐ.
Dàn zài zhè gè quān zi lǐ, měi gè rén dōu zài yǎn xì, shì tú yǎn gài zhēn shí de zì wǒ.
Lín Yuǎn xí guàn yú qiáo zhuāng dǎ bàn, zài bù tóng de shè jiāo chǎng hé bàn yǎn bù tóng de jué sè.
Yǒu shí tā bàn chéng yī gè luò pò de xué zhě, yǒu shí zé mào chōng yī míng chéng gōng de tóu zī shāng.
Tā fā xiàn, rén men hěn róng yì bèi xū jiǎ de wài biǎo suǒ wù dǎo.
Zhǐ yào nǐ zú gòu zì xìn, jí biàn shì zài shuō huǎng, bié rén yě huì rèn wéi nà shì zhēn lǐ.
Rán ér, zhè zhǒng shēng huó ràng tā gǎn dào jí qí xū wěi, fǎng fú zì jǐ zhǐ shì zài pǎo lóng tào.
Tā měi tiān zài zhēn shí yǔ xū gòu zhī jiān pái huái, jiǎng shù zhe bàn zhēn bàn jiǎ de wǎng shì.
Zhí dào yǒu yī tiān, tā yù dào le Sū Qíng, yī gè tóng yàng shàn cháng wěi zhuāng de nǚ rén.
Sū Qíng biǎo miàn shàng shì gè wēn róu de huà láng zhǔ, shí jì shàng què zài lì yòng yì shù pǐn jìn xíng zhà piàn.
Tā yòng jīng měi de cí zǎo yǐn yòu nà xiē tān lán de shōu cáng jiā, ràng tā men xīn gān qíng yuàn de shòu piàn.
Lín Yuǎn qǐ chū yǐ wéi yù dào le zhī jǐ, què méi fā xiàn zì jǐ chéng le tā diào yú jì huà de mù biāo.
Sū Qíng shì tú tōng guò qiāo zhà de fāng shì, bī pò Lín Yuǎn wèi tā wěi zào yī pī jué shì míng huà.
Tā wēi xié shuō, rú guǒ Lín Yuǎn bù pèi hé, tā jiù xiàng jǐng fāng xiè lù tā de mì mì.
Zhè zhǒng é zhà shǒu duàn ràng Lín Yuǎn gǎn dào fèn nù, yīn wèi tā zuì yàn wù de jiù shì bèi pàn.
Tā yì shí dào, Sū Qíng suǒ wèi de ài qíng bù guò shì yī chǎng jīng xīn shè jì de qī piàn.
Tā shì tú wāi qū tā de yì tú, jiāng tā miáo shù chéng yī gè tān lán de piàn zi.
Lín Yuǎn jué dìng fǎn jī, tā bù zài jiǎ zhuāng shùn cóng, ér shì kāi shǐ zài àn zhōng gǎo guǐ.
Tā gù yì zài zuò pǐn zhōng liú xià xì wēi de pò zhàn, zhè zài háng nèi bèi chēng wéi huà shé tiān zú.
Tā xiǎng kàn kàn zhè gè zì yǐ wéi cōng míng de nǚ rén hé shí huì chū yáng xiàng.
Zài yī cì gāo duān pāi mài huì shàng, Sū Qíng zhèng dé yì de xiàng mǎi jiā chuī xú huà zuò de yóu lái.
Lín Yuǎn zài rén qún zhōng tōu kuī, kàn zhe tā yòng huǎng huà biān zhī yī gè wán měi de xiàn jǐng.
Tā tū rán zǒu shàng qián, yòng fěng cì de yǔ qì tiáo kǎn qǐ nà fú huà de bǐ chù.
Zhōu wéi de rén kāi shǐ qiè qiè sī yǔ, huái yí zhè jiàn zuò pǐn shì fǒu zài nòng xū zuò jiǎ.
Sū Qíng liǎn sè dà biàn, shì tú yòng hú shuō de fāng shì yǎn gài lòu dòng.
Dàn Lín Yuǎn ná chū le zhèng jù, jiē lù le tā cháng qī yǐ lái qī zhà de xíng jìng.
Tā gào su zhòng rén, zhè fú huà bù guò shì tā zài mó nǐ gǔ rén fēng gé shí de xí zuò.
Miàn duì zhēn xiàng, Sū Qíng shì tú rèn cuò, dàn cǐ shí yǐ tài wǎn le.
Nà xiē bèi tā shuàn guò de rén fēn fēn zhàn chū lái, yòng cháo xiào de yǎn shén kàn zhe tā.
Tā céng jīng cháo nòng nà xiē bèi piàn de rén, xiàn zài què chéng le bèi chǐ xiào de duì xiàng.
Lín Yuǎn kàn zhe tā bēng kuì de yàng zi, xīn zhōng què méi yǒu duō shǎo kuài gǎn.
Yīn wèi tā yì shí dào, zài zhè gè chōng mǎn qī zhà de shì jiè lǐ, shéi yě méi yǒu zhēn zhèng chéng shí.
Tā xiǎng qǐ xiǎo shí hòu wán zhuō mí cáng de rì zi, nà shí hòu de yǐn cáng shì wèi le yóu xì, ér bù shì wèi le shēng cún.
Chéng nián rén de shì jiè lǐ, yǐn cáng biàn chéng le shēng cún de běn néng, ér chéng shí zé chéng le shē chǐ pǐn.
Tā céng yǐ wéi kě yǐ tōng guò chū mài líng hún lái huàn qǔ cái fù, jié guǒ què fā xiàn zhè mǎi mài kuī běn le.
Tā yàn juàn le měi tiān dì sǎ huǎng, yàn juàn le yòng huǎng yán lái yǎn gài huǎng yán.
Tā xiǎng qǐ nà xiē céng jīng bèi tā qī piàn de rén, xīn zhōng chōng mǎn le kuì jiù.
Tā bù zài xiǎng tōng guò zuò bì lái huò dé chéng gōng, yě bù xiǎng zài tōng guò jiǎ mào tā rén lái huò dé zūn zhòng.
Tā jué dìng lí kāi zhè gè chéng shì, pāo qì suǒ yǒu wěi zhuāng de shēn fèn.
Zài lí kāi de qián yī yè, tā tǎng zài bīng lěng de chuáng shàng, jìng jìng de wò zài hēi àn zhōng sī kǎo.
Tā yì shí dào, yī gè rén rú guǒ yī zhí shēng huó zài xū jiǎ zhī zhōng, zuì zhōng huì diū shī zì wǒ.
Tā bù zài xū yào yòng xià hu rén de fāng shì lái huò dé zhǎng kòng gǎn.
Tā yě bù zài xū yào tōng guò shuō huǎng lái wéi chí yī gè wán měi de xíng xiàng.
Tā jiāng suǒ yǒu de wěi zào gōng jù quán bù xiāo huǐ, nà shì tā duì guò qù shēng huó de zuì hòu gào bié.
Tā bù zài xiǎng tōng guò piàn rén lái huò qǔ lì yì, yīn wèi nà zhǒng chéng gōng háo wú yì yì.
Tā zǒu chū fáng mén, gǎn shòu zhe qīng chén de dì yī lǚ yáng guāng zhào shè zài liǎn shàng.
Méi yǒu le miàn jù, tā gǎn dào yī zhǒng qián suǒ wèi yǒu de qīng sōng.
Suī rán wèi lái de lù chōng mǎn le bù què dìng, dàn tā yuàn yì miàn duì zhēn shí de zì jǐ.
Tā zhī dào, chéng shí suī rán yǒu shí huì ràng rén xiǎn dé bèn zhuō, dàn tā shì wéi yī néng ràng rén ān shuì de liáng yào.
Zài zhè gè xuān xiāo de shì jiè lǐ, tā zhōng yú zhǎo huí le diū shī de líng hún.
Tā bù zài shì yī gè pǎo lóng tào de wěi zhuāng zhě, ér shì yī gè zhēn shí de rén.
Tā duì zhe jìng zi wēi xiào, zhè yī cì, méi yǒu huǎng yán, zhǐ yǒu zhēn shí de xǐ yuè.

Lín Yuǎn qǐ chū yǐ wéi yù dào le zhī jǐ, què méi fā xiàn zì jǐ chéng le tā diào yú jì huà de mù biāo.
Sū Qíng shì tú tōng guò qiāo zhà de fāng shì, bī pò Lín Yuǎn wèi tā wěi zào yī pī jué shì míng huà.
Tā wēi xié shuō, rú guǒ Lín Yuǎn bù pèi hé, tā jiù xiàng jǐng fāng xiè lù tā de mì mì.
Zhè zhǒng é zhà shǒu duàn ràng Lín Yuǎn gǎn dào fèn nù, yīn wèi tā zuì yàn wù de jiù shì bèi pàn.
Tā yì shí dào, Sū Qíng suǒ wèi de ài qíng bù guò shì yī chǎng jīng xīn shè jì de qī piàn.
Tā shì tú wāi qū tā de yì tú, jiāng tā miáo shù chéng yī gè tān lán de piàn zi.
Lín Yuǎn jué dìng fǎn jī, tā bù zài jiǎ zhuāng shùn cóng, ér shì kāi shǐ zài àn zhōng gǎo guǐ.
Tā gù yì zài zuò pǐn zhōng liú xià xì wēi de pò zhàn, zhè zài háng nèi bèi chēng wéi huà shé tiān zú.
Tā xiǎng kàn kàn zhè gè zì yǐ wéi cōng míng de nǚ rén hé shí huì chū yáng xiàng.
Zài yī cì gāo duān pāi mài huì shàng, Sū Qíng zhèng dé yì de xiàng mǎi jiā chuī xú huà zuò de yóu lái.
Lín Yuǎn zài rén qún zhōng tōu kuī, kàn zhe tā yòng huǎng huà biān zhī yī gè wán měi de xiàn jǐng.
Tā tū rán zǒu shàng qián, yòng fěng cì de yǔ qì tiáo kǎn qǐ nà fú huà de bǐ chù.
Zhōu wéi de rén kāi shǐ qiè qiè sī yǔ, huái yí zhè jiàn zuò pǐn shì fǒu zài nòng xū zuò jiǎ.
Sū Qíng liǎn sè dà biàn, shì tú yòng hú shuō de fāng shì yǎn gài lòu dòng.
Dàn Lín Yuǎn ná chū le zhèng jù, jiē lù le tā cháng qī yǐ lái qī zhà de xíng jìng.
Tā gào su zhòng rén, zhè fú huà bù guò shì tā zài mó nǐ gǔ rén fēng gé shí de xí zuò.
Miàn duì zhēn xiàng, Sū Qíng shì tú rèn cuò, dàn cǐ shí yǐ tài wǎn le.
Nà xiē bèi tā shuàn guò de rén fēn fēn zhàn chū lái, yòng cháo xiào de yǎn shén kàn zhe tā.
Tā céng jīng cháo nòng nà xiē bèi piàn de rén, xiàn zài què chéng le bèi chǐ xiào de duì xiàng.
Lín Yuǎn kàn zhe tā bēng kuì de yàng zi, xīn zhōng què méi yǒu duō shǎo kuài gǎn.
Yīn wèi tā yì shí dào, zài zhè gè chōng mǎn qī zhà de shì jiè lǐ, shéi yě méi yǒu zhēn zhèng chéng shí.
Tā xiǎng qǐ xiǎo shí hòu wán zhuō mí cáng de rì zi, nà shí hòu de yǐn cáng shì wèi le yóu xì, ér bù shì wèi le shēng cún.
Chéng nián rén de shì jiè lǐ, yǐn cáng biàn chéng le shēng cún de běn néng, ér chéng shí zé chéng le shē chǐ pǐn.
Tā céng yǐ wéi kě yǐ tōng guò chū mài líng hún lái huàn qǔ cái fù, jié guǒ què fā xiàn zhè mǎi mài kuī běn le.
Tā yàn juàn le měi tiān dì sǎ huǎng, yàn juàn le yòng huǎng yán lái yǎn gài huǎng yán.
Tā xiǎng qǐ nà xiē céng jīng bèi tā qī piàn de rén, xīn zhōng chōng mǎn le kuì jiù.
Tā bù zài xiǎng tōng guò zuò bì lái huò dé chéng gōng, yě bù xiǎng zài tōng guò jiǎ mào tā rén lái huò dé zūn zhòng.
Tā jué dìng lí kāi zhè gè chéng shì, pāo qì suǒ yǒu wěi zhuāng de shēn fèn.
Zài lí kāi de qián yī yè, tā tǎng zài bīng lěng de chuáng shàng, jìng jìng de wò zài hēi àn zhōng sī kǎo.
Tā yì shí dào, yī gè rén rú guǒ yī zhí shēng huó zài xū jiǎ zhī zhōng, zuì zhōng huì diū shī zì wǒ.
Tā bù zài xū yào yòng xià hu rén de fāng shì lái huò dé zhǎng kòng gǎn.
Tā yě bù zài xū yào tōng guò shuō huǎng lái wéi chí yī gè wán měi de xíng xiàng.
Tā jiāng suǒ yǒu de wěi zào gōng jù quán bù xiāo huǐ, nà shì tā duì guò qù shēng huó de zuì hòu gào bié.
Tā bù zài xiǎng tōng guò piàn rén lái huò qǔ lì yì, yīn wèi nà zhǒng chéng gōng háo wú yì yì.
Tā zǒu chū fáng mén, gǎn shòu zhe qīng chén de dì yī lǚ yáng guāng zhào shè zài liǎn shàng.
Méi yǒu le miàn jù, tā gǎn dào yī zhǒng qián suǒ wèi yǒu de qīng sōng.
Suī rán wèi lái de lù chōng mǎn le bù què dìng, dàn tā yuàn yì miàn duì zhēn shí de zì jǐ.
Tā zhī dào, chéng shí suī rán yǒu shí huì ràng rén xiǎn dé bèn zhuō, dàn tā shì wéi yī néng ràng rén ān shuì de liáng yào.
Zài zhè gè xuān xiāo de shì jiè lǐ, tā zhōng yú zhǎo huí le diū shī de líng hún.
Tā bù zài shì yī gè pǎo lóng tào de wěi zhuāng zhě, ér shì yī gè zhēn shí de rén.
Tā duì zhe jìng zi wēi xiào, zhè yī cì, méi yǒu huǎng yán, zhǐ yǒu zhēn shí de xǐ yuè.
stories.story_english:
Deep in the heart of a bustling metropolis, Lin Yuan lived in a maze constructed of lies.
He was a top-tier forgery expert, skilled at creating antiques that were indistinguishable from the real thing.
For him, counterfeiting was not just about money, but more like a simulation of art.
But in this circle, everyone was performing, trying to conceal their true selves.
Lin Yuan was accustomed to disguising himself, playing different roles in various social settings.
Sometimes he dressed as a downtrodden scholar, and sometimes he passed himself off as a successful investor.
He discovered that people were easily misled by false appearances.
As long as you were confident enough, even when lying, others would believe it was the truth.
However, this life made him feel extremely hypocritical, as if he were merely playing a small role.
Every day he wavered between reality and fabrication, telling stories that were half true and half false.
Until one day, he met Su Qing, a woman who was equally skilled at pretense.
On the surface, Su Qing was a gentle gallery owner, but in reality, she used artworks to commit fraud.
She used exquisite words to lure greedy collectors, making them willingly be hoodwinked.
Lin Yuan initially thought he had found a kindred spirit, but didn't realize he had become the target of her phishing plan.
Su Qing tried to use extortion to force Lin Yuan to forge a batch of peerless famous paintings for her.
She threatened that if Lin Yuan did not cooperate, she would leak his secrets to the police.
This method of blackmail made Lin Yuan feel angry, because he detested betrayal the most.
He realized that Su Qing's so-called love was nothing more than a carefully designed deception.
She tried to distort his intentions, describing him as a greedy swindler.
Lin Yuan decided to fight back; he stopped pretending to be obedient and began to play tricks in secret.
He intentionally left subtle flaws in the works, which in the industry is called 'drawing legs on a snake'.
He wanted to see when this woman, who thought herself clever, would make a fool of herself.
At a high-end auction, Su Qing was proudly boasting to buyers about the origin of the painting.
Lin Yuan peeked from the crowd, watching her weave a perfect trap with lies.
He suddenly stepped forward, using a satirical tone to mock the brushwork of the painting.
People around began to whisper, doubting whether this piece was a product of fraud.
Su Qing's face changed drastically, and she tried to cover the loopholes by talking nonsense.
But Lin Yuan produced evidence, revealing her long-term fraudulent behavior.
He told the crowd that this painting was merely a practice piece from when he was imitating the style of the ancients.
Facing the truth, Su Qing tried to admit her error, but it was already too late.
Those who had been tricked by her stepped forward one by one, looking at her with ridiculing eyes.
She had once teased those who were cheated, but now she became the object of ridicule.
Lin Yuan looked at her breakdown, but felt little pleasure in his heart.
Because he realized that in this world full of deception, no one was truly honest.
He remembered the days of playing hide-and-seek as a child; back then, hiding was for a game, not for survival.
In the adult world, hiding became a survival instinct, while honesty became a luxury.
He once thought he could exchange his soul for wealth, but found that this deal was a loss.
He grew tired of lying every day, tired of using lies to cover lies.
He thought of the people he had once deceived, and his heart was filled with guilt.
He no longer wanted to achieve success through cheating, nor did he want to gain respect by impersonating others.
He decided to leave this city and abandon all his disguised identities.
On the night before his departure, he lay on the cold bed, crouching quietly in the darkness in thought.
He realized that if a person lives in falsehood for too long, they will eventually lose themselves.
He no longer needed to use the method of scaring others to gain a sense of control.
Nor did he need to maintain a perfect image by telling untruths.
He destroyed all his forgery tools; that was his final farewell to his past life.
He no longer wanted to obtain benefits by cheating people, because that kind of success was meaningless.
He walked out the door, feeling the first ray of morning sunlight on his face.
Without the mask, he felt an unprecedented sense of relief.
Although the road ahead was full of uncertainty, he was willing to face his true self.
He knew that while honesty sometimes makes one seem clumsy, it is the only medicine that allows one to sleep peacefully.
In this noisy world, he finally recovered his lost soul.
He was no longer a disguised person playing a small role, but a real human being.
He smiled at the mirror; this time, there were no lies, only genuine joy.

sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng kàn kàn zhè gè zì yǐ wéi cōng míng de nǚ rén hé shí huì chū yáng xiàng.
sentences.english: He wanted to see when this woman, who thought herself clever, would make a fool of herself.

sentences.chinese: 在一次高端拍卖会上，苏晴正得意地向买家吹嘘画作的由来。
sentences.pinyin: Zài yī cì gāo duān pāi mài huì shàng, Sū Qíng zhèng dé yì de xiàng mǎi jiā chuī xú huà zuò de yóu lái.
sentences.english: At a high-end auction, Su Qing was proudly boasting to buyers about the origin of the painting.

sentences.chinese: 林远在人群中偷窥，看着她用谎话编织一个完美的陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuǎn zài rén qún zhōng tōu kuī, kàn zhe tā yòng huǎng huà biān zhī yī gè wán měi de xiàn jǐng.
sentences.english: Lin Yuan peeked from the crowd, watching her weave a perfect trap with lies.

sentences.chinese: 他突然走上前，用讽刺的语气调侃起那幅画的笔触。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tū rán zǒu shàng qián, yòng fěng cì de yǔ qì tiáo kǎn qǐ nà fú huà de bǐ chù.
sentences.english: He suddenly stepped forward, using a satirical tone to mock the brushwork of the painting.

sentences.chinese: 周围的人开始窃窃私语，怀疑这件作品是否在弄虚作假。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōu wéi de rén kāi shǐ qiè qiè sī yǔ, huái yí zhè jiàn zuò pǐn shì fǒu zài nòng xū zuò jiǎ.
sentences.english: People around began to whisper, doubting whether this piece was a product of fraud.

sentences.chinese: 苏晴脸色大变，试图用胡说的方式掩盖漏洞。
sentences.pinyin: Sū Qíng liǎn sè dà biàn, shì tú yòng hú shuō de fāng shì yǎn gài lòu dòng.
sentences.english: Su Qing's face changed drastically, and she tried to cover the loopholes by talking nonsense.

sentences.chinese: 但林远拿出了证据，揭露了她长期以来欺诈的行径。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Lín Yuǎn ná chū le zhèng jù, jiē lù le tā cháng qī yǐ lái qī zhà de xíng jìng.
sentences.english: But Lin Yuan produced evidence, revealing her long-term fraudulent behavior.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉众人，这幅画不过是他在模拟古人风格时的习作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su zhòng rén, zhè fú huà bù guò shì tā zài mó nǐ gǔ rén fēng gé shí de xí zuò.
sentences.english: He told the crowd that this painting was merely a practice piece from when he was imitating the style of the ancients.

sentences.chinese: 面对真相，苏晴试图认错，但此时已太晚了。
sentences.pinyin: Miàn duì zhēn xiàng, Sū Qíng shì tú rèn cuò, dàn cǐ shí yǐ tài wǎn le.
sentences.english: Facing the truth, Su Qing tried to admit her error, but it was already too late.

sentences.chinese: 那些被她涮过的人纷纷站出来，用嘲笑地眼神看着她。
sentences.pinyin: Nà xiē bèi tā shuàn guò de rén fēn fēn zhàn chū lái, yòng cháo xiào de yǎn shén kàn zhe tā.
sentences.english: Those who had been tricked by her stepped forward one by one, looking at her with ridiculing eyes.

sentences.chinese: 她曾经嘲弄那些被骗的人，现在却成了被耻笑的对象。
sentences.pinyin: Tā céng jīng cháo nòng nà xiē bèi piàn de rén, xiàn zài què chéng le bèi chǐ xiào de duì xiàng.
sentences.english: She had once teased those who were cheated, but now she became the object of ridicule.

sentences.chinese: 林远看着她崩溃的样子，心中却没有多少快感。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuǎn kàn zhe tā bēng kuì de yàng zi, xīn zhōng què méi yǒu duō shǎo kuài gǎn.
sentences.english: Lin Yuan looked at her breakdown, but felt little pleasure in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 因为他意识到，在这个充满欺诈的世界里，谁也没有真正诚实。
sentences.pinyin: Yīn wèi tā yì shí dào, zài zhè gè chōng mǎn qī zhà de shì jiè lǐ, shéi yě méi yǒu zhēn zhèng chéng shí.
sentences.english: Because he realized that in this world full of deception, no one was truly honest.

sentences.chinese: 他想起小时候玩捉迷藏的日子，那时候的隐藏是为了游戏，而不是为了生存。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ xiǎo shí hòu wán zhuō mí cáng de rì zi, nà shí hòu de yǐn cáng shì wèi le yóu xì, ér bù shì wèi le shēng cún.
sentences.english: He remembered the days of playing hide-and-seek as a child; back then, hiding was for a game, not for survival.

sentences.chinese: 成年人的世界里，隐藏变成了生存的本能，而诚实则成了奢侈品。
sentences.pinyin: Chéng nián rén de shì jiè lǐ, yǐn cáng biàn chéng le shēng cún de běn néng, ér chéng shí zé chéng le shē chǐ pǐn.
sentences.english: In the adult world, hiding became a survival instinct, while honesty became a luxury.

sentences.chinese: 他曾以为可以通过出卖灵魂来换取财富，结果却发现这买卖亏本了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā céng yǐ wéi kě yǐ tōng guò chū mài líng hún lái huàn qǔ cái fù, jié guǒ què fā xiàn zhè mǎi mài kuī běn le.
sentences.english: He once thought he could exchange his soul for wealth, but found that this deal was a loss.

sentences.chinese: 他厌倦了每天地撒谎，厌倦了用谎言来掩盖谎言。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yàn juàn le měi tiān dì sǎ huǎng, yàn juàn le yòng huǎng yán lái yǎn gài huǎng yán.
sentences.english: He grew tired of lying every day, tired of using lies to cover lies.

sentences.chinese: 他想起那些曾经被他欺骗的人，心中充满了愧疚。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ nà xiē céng jīng bèi tā qī piàn de rén, xīn zhōng chōng mǎn le kuì jiù.
sentences.english: He thought of the people he had once deceived, and his heart was filled with guilt.

sentences.chinese: 他不再想通过作弊来获得成功，也不想再通过假冒他人来获得尊重。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zài xiǎng tōng guò zuò bì lái huò dé chéng gōng, yě bù xiǎng zài tōng guò jiǎ mào tā rén lái huò dé zūn zhòng.
sentences.english: He no longer wanted to achieve success through cheating, nor did he want to gain respect by impersonating others.

sentences.chinese: 他决定离开这个城市，抛弃所有伪装的身份。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué dìng lí kāi zhè gè chéng shì, pāo qì suǒ yǒu wěi zhuāng de shēn fèn.
sentences.english: He decided to leave this city and abandon all his disguised identities.

sentences.chinese: 在离开的前一夜，他躺在冰冷的床上，静静地卧在黑暗中思考。
sentences.pinyin: Zài lí kāi de qián yī yè, tā tǎng zài bīng lěng de chuáng shàng, jìng jìng de wò zài hēi àn zhōng sī kǎo.
sentences.english: On the night before his departure, he lay on the cold bed, crouching quietly in the darkness in thought.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，一个人如果一直生活在虚假之中，最终会丢失自我。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, yī gè rén rú guǒ yī zhí shēng huó zài xū jiǎ zhī zhōng, zuì zhōng huì diū shī zì wǒ.
sentences.english: He realized that if a person lives in falsehood for too long, they will eventually lose themselves.

sentences.chinese: 他不再需要用吓唬别人的方式来获得掌控感。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zài xū yào yòng xià hu rén de fāng shì lái huò dé zhǎng kòng gǎn.
sentences.english: He no longer needed to use the method of scaring others to gain a sense of control.

sentences.chinese: 他也不再需要通过说谎来维持一个完美的形象。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yě bù zài xū yào tōng guò shuō huǎng lái wéi chí yī gè wán měi de xíng xiàng.
sentences.english: Nor did he need to maintain a perfect image by telling untruths.

sentences.chinese: 他将所有的伪造工具全部销毁，那是他对过去生活的最后告别。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiāng suǒ yǒu de wěi zào gōng jù quán bù xiāo huǐ, nà shì tā duì guò qù shēng huó de zuì hòu gào bié.
sentences.english: He destroyed all his forgery tools; that was his final farewell to his past life.

sentences.chinese: 他不再想通过欺骗来获取利益，因为那种成功毫无意义。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zài xiǎng tōng guò piàn rén lái huò qǔ lì yì, yīn wèi nà zhǒng chéng gōng háo wú yì yì.
sentences.english: He no longer wanted to obtain benefits by cheating people, because that kind of success was meaningless.

sentences.chinese: 他走出房门，感受着清晨的第一缕阳光照射在脸上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu chū fáng mén, gǎn shòu zhe qīng chén de dì yī lǚ yáng guāng zhào shè zài liǎn shàng.
sentences.english: He walked out the door, feeling the first ray of morning sunlight on his face.

sentences.chinese: 没有了面具，他感到一种前所未有的轻松。
sentences.pinyin: Méi yǒu le miàn jù, tā gǎn dào yī zhǒng qián suǒ wèi yǒu de qīng sōng.
sentences.english: Without the mask, he felt an unprecedented sense of relief.

sentences.chinese: 虽然未来的路充满了不确定，但他愿意面对真实的自己。
sentences.pinyin: Suī rán wèi lái de lù chōng mǎn le bù què dìng, dàn tā yuàn yì miàn duì zhēn shí de zì jǐ.
sentences.english: Although the road ahead was full of uncertainty, he was willing to face his true self.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，诚实虽然有时会让人显得笨拙，但它是唯一能让人安睡的良药。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhī dào, chéng shí suī rán yǒu shí huì ràng rén xiǎn dé bèn zhuō, dàn tā shì wéi yī néng ràng rén ān shuì de liáng yào.
sentences.english: He knew that while honesty sometimes makes one seem clumsy, it is the only medicine that allows one to sleep peacefully.

sentences.chinese: 在这个喧嚣的世界里，他终于找回了丢失的灵魂。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè gè xuān xiāo de shì jiè lǐ, tā zhōng yú zhǎo huí le diū shī de líng hún.
sentences.english: In this noisy world, he finally recovered his lost soul.

sentences.chinese: 他不再是一个跑龙套的伪装者，而是一个真实的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zài shì yī gè pǎo lóng tào de wěi zhuāng zhě, ér shì yī gè zhēn shí de rén.
sentences.english: He was no longer a disguised person playing a small role, but a real human being.

sentences.chinese: 他对着镜子微笑，这一次，没有谎言，只有真实的喜悦。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì zhe jìng zi wēi xiào, zhè yī cì, méi yǒu huǎng yán, zhǐ yǒu zhēn shí de xǐ yuè.
sentences.english: He smiled at the mirror; this time, there were no lies, only genuine joy.

stories.story_chinese:
林医生在医院的医务办公室里坐了很久。
他习惯性地戴上口罩，遮住了大半个面部。
作为一名资深的临床医生，他见过太多关于生死的挣扎。
今天，他的手术台上躺着一个特殊的病人，那是他的亲生弟弟。
他们之间流淌着相同的血缘，这种血脉的纽带在此时显得如此沉重。
弟弟的身躯在无影灯下显得格外瘦削。
他患有严重的癌症，且并发了多处器官的炎症。
林医生轻轻触摸弟弟的脸颊，感觉到皮肤冰冷。
他检查了体温，数值低得令人心惊。
为了维持基本的生理机能，医疗团队已经使用了最高剂量的药物。
但抗生素无法对抗这种毁灭性的病变。
林医生观察着监护仪上的液晶屏幕，那起伏的波形是唯一的生命线。
他小心地检查弟弟的头部和颈部。
脖子上的皮肤苍白，几乎能看到下方搏动的颈动脉。
在手术过程中，林医生必须确保口腔和呼吸道畅通。
他看着弟弟起伏的胸膛，每一次呼吸都显得异常艰难。
由于肾功能衰竭，液体在组织中积聚，导致肢体水肿。
林医生轻轻抬起弟弟的胳膊，发现肩膀处有一块淤青。
他记得小时候，弟弟总是把头靠在他的肩膀上寻求安慰。
而现在，弟弟在长期的病痛中患上了严重的抑郁症。
那种精神上的痛苦，有时比身体的疼痛更难忍受。
手术开始了，手术刀切开皮肤，鲜血瞬间涌出。
林医生精准地避开了重要的腺体，试图切除病灶。
他深知这次手术关乎弟弟的性命。
然而，人体是一个极其复杂的系统，任何微小的失误都不可原谅。
在长达十小时的奋战后，监护仪发出了一声长鸣。
那道生命线变成了一道冰冷的直线。
林医生愣在原地，手术刀在手中微微颤抖。
他看着眼前这个已经失去生气的身躯，心中充满了无力感。
他缓缓摘下口罩，掩面痛哭。
几天后，他站在冰冷的遗体前，最后一次抚摸弟弟的额头。
他意识到，医学可以修复血脉，却无法挽回逝去的时光。
他在日记中写道：生命如此脆弱，而爱是唯一的解药。

他患有严重的癌症，且并发了多处器官的炎症。
林医生轻轻触摸弟弟的脸颊，感觉到皮肤冰冷。
他检查了体温，数值低得令人心惊。
为了维持基本的生理机能，医疗团队已经使用了最高剂量的药物。
但抗生素无法对抗这种毁灭性的病变。
林医生观察着监护仪上的液晶屏幕，那起伏的波形是唯一的生命线。
他小心地检查弟弟的头部和颈部。
脖子上的皮肤苍白，几乎能看到下方搏动的颈动脉。
在手术过程中，林医生必须确保口腔和呼吸道畅通。
他看着弟弟起伏的胸膛，每一次呼吸都显得异常艰难。
由于肾功能衰竭，液体在组织中积聚，导致肢体水肿。
林医生轻轻抬起弟弟的胳膊，发现肩膀处有一块淤青。
他记得小时候，弟弟总是把头靠在他的肩膀上寻求安慰。
而现在，弟弟在长期的病痛中患上了严重的抑郁症。
那种精神上的痛苦，有时比身体的疼痛更难忍受。
手术开始了，手术刀切开皮肤，鲜血瞬间涌出。
林医生精准地避开了重要的腺体，试图切除病灶。
他深知这次手术关乎弟弟的性命。
然而，人体是一个极其复杂的系统，任何微小的失误都不可原谅。
在长达十小时的奋战后，监护仪发出了一声长鸣。
那道生命线变成了一道冰冷的直线。
林医生愣在原地，手术刀在手中微微颤抖。
他看着眼前这个已经失去生气的身躯，心中充满了无力感。
他缓缓摘下口罩，掩面痛哭。
几天后，他站在冰冷的遗体前，最后一次抚摸弟弟的额头。
他意识到，医学可以修复血脉，却无法挽回逝去的时光。
他在日记中写道：生命如此脆弱，而爱是唯一的解药。
stories.story_pinyin:
Lín yīshēng zài yīyuàn de yīwù bàngōngshì lǐ zuòle hěnjiǔ.
Tā xíguànxìng de dàishàng kǒuzhào, zhēzhùle dàbàn gè miànbù.
Zuòwéi yī míng zīshēn de línchuáng yīshēng, tā jiànguò tài duō guānyú shēngsǐ de zhēngzhá.
Jīntiān, tā de shǒushùtái shàng tǎngzhe yī gè tèshū de bìngrén, nà shì tā de qīnshēng dìdi.
Tāmen zhījiān liútǎngzhe xiāngtóng de xuèyuán, zhè zhǒng xuèmài de niǔdài zài cǐshí xiǎndé rúcǐ chénzhòng.
Dìdi de shēnqū zài wúyǐngdēng xià xiǎndé géwài shòuxuē.
Tā huàn yǒu yánzhòng de áizhèng, qiě bìngfāle duō chù qìguān de yánzhèng.
Lín yīshēng qīngqīng chùmō dìdi de liǎnjiá, gǎnjué dào pífū bīnglěng.
Tā jiǎnchále tǐwēn, shùzhí dī dé lìngrén xīnjīng.
Wèile wéichí jīběn de shēnglǐ jīnéng, yīliáo tuánduì yǐjīng shǐyòngle zuì gāo jìliàng de yàowù.
Dàn kàngshēngsù wúfǎ duìkàng zhè zhǒng huǐmièxìng de bìngbiàn.
Lín yīshēng guāncházhe jiānhùyí shàng de yèjīng píngmù, nà qǐfú de bōxíng shì wéiyī de shēngmìngxiàn.
Tā xiǎoxīn de jiǎnchále dìdi de tóubù hé jǐngbù.
Bózi shàng de pífū cāngbái, jīhū néng kàndào xiàfāng bódòng de jǐng dòngmài.
Zài shǒushù guòchéng zhōng, Lín yīshēng bìxū quèbǎo kǒuqiāng hé hūxīdào chàngtōng.
Tā kànzhe dìdi qǐfú de xiōngtáng, měi yī cì hūxī dōu xiǎndé yìcháng jiānnán.
Yóuyú shèn gōngnéng shuāijié, yètǐ zài zǔzhī zhōng jījù, dǎozhì zhītǐ shuǐzhǒng.
Lín yīshēng qīngqīng táiqǐ dìdi de gēbo, fāxiàn jiānbǎng chù yǒu yī kuài yūqīng.
Tā jìde xiǎoshíhòu, dìdi zǒng shì bǎ tóu kào zài tā de jiānbǎng shàng xúnqiú ānwèi.
Ér xiànzài, dìdi zài chángqī de bìngtòng zhōng huàn shàngle yánzhòng de yìyùzhèng.
Nà zhǒng jīngshén shàng de tòngkǔ, yǒu shí bǐ shēntǐ de téngtòng gèng nán rěnshòu.
Shǒushù kāishǐle, shǒushùdāo qiēkāi pífū, xiānxuè shùnjiān yǒngchū.
Lín yīshēng jīngzhǔn de bìkāile zhòngyào de xiàntǐ, shìtú qiēchú bìngzào.
Tā shēnzhī zhè cì shǒushù guānhū dìdi de xìngmìng.
Rán'ér, réntǐ shì yī gè jíqí fùzá de xìtǒng, rènhé wēixiǎo de shīwù dōu bùkě yuánliàng.
Zài cháng dá shí xiǎoshí de fènzhàn hòu, jiānhùyí fāchūle yī shēng chángmíng.
Nà dào shēngmìngxiàn biànchéngle yī dào bīnglěng de zhíxiàn.
Lín yīshēng lèng zài yuándì, shǒushùdāo zài shǒuzhōng wēiwēi chàndǒu.
Tā kànzhe yǎnqián zhège yǐjīng shīqù shēngqì de shēnqū, xīnzhōng chōngmǎnle wú lì gǎn.
Tā huǎnhuǎn zhāixià kǒuzhào, yǎnmiàn tòngkū.
Jǐ tiān hòu, tā zhàn zài bīnglěng de yítǐ qián, zuìhòu yī cì fǔmō dìdi de étóu.
Tā yìshí dào, yīxué kěyǐ xiūfù xuèmài, què wúfǎ wǎnhuí shìqù de shíguāng.
Tā zài rìjì zhōng xiě dào: Shēngmìng rúcǐ cuìruò, ér ài shì wéiyī de jiěyào.

stories.story_english:
Dr. Lin sat in the hospital's medical affairs office for a long time.
He habitually put on a mask, covering most of his face.
As a veteran clinical doctor, he had seen too many struggles between life and death.
Today, lying on his operating table was a special patient, his own biological younger brother.
They shared the same bloodline; this bond of blood vessels felt incredibly heavy at this moment.
His brother's body looked exceptionally thin under the shadowless lamp.
He suffered from severe cancer, complicated by inflammation in several organs.
Dr. Lin gently touched his brother's cheek, feeling the skin was cold.
He checked the body temperature; the value was alarmingly low.
To maintain basic physiological functions, the medical team had already used the highest dose of medication.
But antibiotics could not fight this destructive lesion.
Dr. Lin observed the liquid crystal screen of the monitor; the undulating waveform was the only lifeline.
He carefully examined his brother's head and neck.
The skin on the neck was pale, and the pulsating carotid artery below was almost visible.
During the surgery, Dr. Lin had to ensure that the oral cavity and airway were clear.
He watched his brother's heaving chest; every breath seemed exceptionally difficult.
Due to kidney failure, liquid accumulated in the tissues, leading to edema in the limbs.
Dr. Lin gently lifted his brother's arm and found a bruise on the shoulder.
He remembered when they were children, his brother would always lean his head on his shoulder for comfort.
And now, his brother had developed severe clinical depression from prolonged illness.
That kind of mental suffering was sometimes harder to bear than physical pain.
The surgery began; the scalpel cut through the skin, and fresh blood surged out instantly.
Dr. Lin precisely avoided important glands, attempting to excise the lesion.
He knew well that this surgery concerned his brother's life.
However, the human body is an extremely complex system, and any tiny mistake is unforgivable.
After ten hours of struggle, the monitor emitted a long beep.
That lifeline turned into a cold straight line.
Dr. Lin froze in place, the scalpel trembling slightly in his hand.
Looking at the lifeless body before him, his heart was filled with a sense of helplessness.
He slowly took off his mask and wept, covering his face.
A few days later, he stood before the cold remains, touching his brother's forehead one last time.
He realized that medicine could repair blood vessels, but it could not bring back lost time.
He wrote in his diary: Life is so fragile, and love is the only antidote.

stories.story_chinese:
在那个炎热的盛夏，空气被灼热的阳光撕裂。
陆远站在荒原之上，脚下的土地坚硬得像一块巨大的墓碑。
他面对的是一个严峻的局面：他的村庄被一个自称“暴君”的歹徒率领的匪帮摧毁了。
那个男人不仅凶恶，而且极其凶残，将整个村庄变成了人间地狱。
陆远记得那些污秽的街道，以及村民们惨白的脸庞。
这场浩劫给村庄带来了惨重的损失，而他成了唯一的幸存者。
他心中燃起火热的复仇之情，尽管这种情绪让他感到心口火辣辣地疼。
他的对手是一个奸诈且无情的怪物，在当地人眼中简直像个妖怪。
这个匪首大肆抢夺财物，将所有不顺从的人视为害虫般清理掉。
陆远在逃亡中经历了无数惊险的时刻，身体疲惫得不堪地支撑。
他在混浊的泥沼中潜行，忍受着恶劣的天气和饥饿的折磨。
他知道，面对这样一个暴躁且残忍的仇人，任何犹豫都是致命的。
在一次潜入营地的尝试中，他发现对方的防御极其强硬。
他潜伏在阴影里，看着那些流氓在营火旁放肆地大笑。
他们的丑恶嘴脸在火光下显得格外可恶，令人恶心。
陆远紧握着手中沉甸甸的长剑，指关节因为用力而变得僵硬。
他想起小时候那个淘气但善良的弟弟，如今却死在对方的恶意之下。
这种恶性循环的仇恨像是一场暴风骤雨，在心中剧烈地翻滚。
他意识到，此时的情况已经到了危急的时刻，必须立刻行动。
他冲出掩体，动作凶猛得像一只受伤的猛虎。
对方的卫兵被吓人的速度震慑住了，瞬间被他斩断喉咙。
陆远与匪首面对面时，对方发出了恐怖的咆哮，像一只远古的恐龙。
匪首嘲笑陆远的侠义之心，认为那是弱者的幻想。
但陆远表现得极其倔强，眼神中充满了气愤和决绝。
两人展开了激烈的搏斗，每一击都带着毁灭的力量。
面对匪首的攻击，陆远好歹在最后一刻闪过了致命的一剑。
虽然他受了伤，但心中的愤怒让他感觉不到疼痛。
他意识到，在这种棘手的局面下，只有彻底摧毁对方才能生存。
最终，陆远用长剑贯穿了匪首的心脏，终结了他的厄运。
匪首在临死前眼神中闪过一丝惊恐，随后身体彻底僵死在地上。
陆远站在血泊之中，看着天空渐渐阴暗。
他知道，虽然仇恨得到了缓解，但内心的创伤将永远存在。
他缓缓走离这片被鲜血染红的土地，走向未知的远方。

stories.story_pinyin:
Zài nà ge yán rè de shèng xià, kōng qì bèi zhuó rè de yáng guāng sī liè.
Lù Yuǎn zhàn zài huāng yuán zhī shàng, jiǎo xià de tǔ dì jiān yìng de xiàng yī kuài jù dà de mù bēi.
Tā miàn duì de shì yī gè yán jùn de jú miàn: tā de cūn zhuāng bèi yī gè zì chēng “bào jūn” de dǎi tú lǜ lǐng de fěi bāng cuī huǐ le.
Nà ge nán rén bù jǐn xiōng è, ér qiě jí qí xiōng cán, jiāng zhěng gè cūn zhuāng biàn chéng le rén jiān dì yù.
Lù Yuǎn jì de nà xiē wū huì de jiē dào, yǐ jí cūn mín men cǎn bái de liǎn páng.
Zhè chǎng hào jié gěi cūn zhuāng dài lái le cǎn zhòng de sǔn shī, ér tā chéng le wéi yī de xìng cún zhě.
Tā xīn zhōng rán qǐ huǒ rè de fù chóu zhī qíng, jǐn guǎn zhè zhǒng qíng xù ràng tā gǎn dào xīn kǒu huǒ là là de téng.
Tā de duì shǒu shì yī gè jiān zhà qiě wú qíng de guài wu, zài dāng dì rén yǎn zhōng jiǎn zhí xiàng gè yāo guài.
Zhè ge fěi shǒu dà sì qiǎng duó cái wù, jiāng suǒ yǒu bù shùn cóng de rén shì wéi hài chóng bān qǐng lǐ diào.
Lù Yuǎn zài táo wáng zhōng jīng lì le wú shù jīng xiǎn de shí kè, shēn tǐ pí bèi de bù kān de zhī chēng.
Tā zài hùn zhuó de ní zhǎo zhōng qián xíng, rěn shòu zhe è liè de tiān qì hé jī è de zhé mó.
Tā zhī dào, miàn duì zhè yàng yī gè bào zào qiě cán rěn de chóu rén, rèn hé yóu yù dōu shì zhì mìng de.
Zài yī cì qián rù yíng dì de cháng shì zhōng, tā fā xiàn duì fāng de fáng yù jí qí qiáng yìng.
Tā qián fú zài yīn yǐng lǐ, kàn zhe nà xiē liú máng zài yíng huǒ páng fàng sì de dà xiào.
Tā men de chǒu è zuǐ liǎn zài huǒ guāng xià xiǎn de gé wài kě wù, lìng rén è xīn.
Lù Yuǎn jǐn wò zhe shǒu zhōng chén diàn diàn de cháng jiàn, zhǐ guān jié yīn yòng lì ér biàn de jiāng yìng.
Tā xiǎng qǐ xiǎo shí hou nà ge táo qì dàn shàn liáng de dì dì, rú jīn què sǐ zài duì fāng de è yì zhī xià.
Zhè zhǒng è xìng xún huán de chóu hèn xiàng shì yī chǎng bào fēng zhòu yǔ, zài xīn zhōng jù liè de fān gǔn.
Tā yì shí dào, cǐ shí de qíng kuàng yǐ jīng dào le wēi jí de shí kè, bì xū lì kè xíng dòng.
Tā chōng chū yǎn tǐ, dòng zuò xiōng měng de xiàng yī zhī shòu shāng de měng hǔ.
Duì fāng de wèi bīng bèi xià rén de sù dù zhèn shè zhù le, shùn jiān bèi tā zhǎn duàn hóu lóng.
Lù Yuǎn yǔ fěi shǒu miàn duì miàn shí, duì fāng fā chū le kǒng bù de pào xiào, xiàng yī zhī yuǎn gǔ de kǒng lóng.
Fěi shǒu cháo xiào Lù Yuǎn de xiá yì zhī xīn, rèn wéi nà shì ruò zhě de huàn xiǎng.
Dàn Lù Yuǎn biǎo xiàn de jí qí jué jiàng, yǎn shén zhōng chōng mǎn le qì fèn hé jué jué.
Liǎng rén zhǎn kāi le jī liè de bó dòu, měi yī jī dōu dài zhe huǐ miè de lì liàng.
Miàn duì fěi shǒu de gōng jī, Lù Yuǎn hǎo dǎi zài zuì hòu yī kè shǎn guò le zhì mìng de yī jiàn.
Suī rán tā shòu le shāng, dàn xīn zhōng de fèn nù ràng tā gǎn bù dào téng tòng.
Tā yì shí dào, zài zhè zhǒng jí shǒu de jú miàn xià, zhǐ yǒu chè dǐ cuī huǐ duì fāng cái néng shēng cún.
Zuì zhōng, Lù Yuǎn yòng cháng jiàn guàn chuān le fěi shǒu de xīn zàng, zhōng jié le tā de è yùn.
Fěi shǒu zài lín sǐ qián yǎn shén zhōng shǎn guò yī sī jīng kǒng, suí hòu shēn tǐ chè dǐ jiāng sǐ zài dì shàng.
Lù Yuǎn zhàn zài xuè pō zhī zhōng, kàn zhe tiān kōng jiàn jiàn yīn àn.
Tā zhī dào, suī rán chóu hèn dé dào le huǎn jiě, dàn nèi xīn de chuāng shāng jiāng yǒng yuǎn cún zài.
Tā huǎn huǎn zǒu lí zhè piàn bèi xiān xuè rǎn hóng de tǔ dì, zǒu xiàng wèi zhī de yuǎn fāng.

Tā xīn zhōng rán qǐ huǒ rè de fù chóu zhī qíng, jǐn guǎn zhè zhǒng qíng xù ràng tā gǎn dào xīn kǒu huǒ là là de téng.
Tā de duì shǒu shì yī gè jiān zhà qiě wú qíng de guài wu, zài dāng dì rén yǎn zhōng jiǎn zhí xiàng gè yāo guài.
Zhè ge fěi shǒu dà sì qiǎng duó cái wù, jiāng suǒ yǒu bù shùn cóng de rén shì wéi hài chóng bān qǐng lǐ diào.
Lù Yuǎn zài táo wáng zhōng jīng lì le wú shù jīng xiǎn de shí kè, shēn tǐ pí bèi de bù kān de zhī chēng.
Tā zài hùn zhuó de ní zhǎo zhōng qián xíng, rěn shòu zhe è liè de tiān qì hé jī è de zhé mó.
Tā zhī dào, miàn duì zhè yàng yī gè bào zào qiě cán rěn de chóu rén, rèn hé yóu yù dōu shì zhì mìng de.
Zài yī cì qián rù yíng dì de cháng shì zhōng, tā fā xiàn duì fāng de fáng yù jí qí qiáng yìng.
Tā qián fú zài yīn yǐng lǐ, kàn zhe nà xiē liú máng zài yíng huǒ páng fàng sì de dà xiào.
Tā men de chǒu è zuǐ liǎn zài huǒ guāng xià xiǎn de gé wài kě wù, lìng rén è xīn.
Lù Yuǎn jǐn wò zhe shǒu zhōng chén diàn diàn de cháng jiàn, zhǐ guān jié yīn yòng lì ér biàn de jiāng yìng.
Tā xiǎng qǐ xiǎo shí hou nà ge táo qì dàn shàn liáng de dì dì, rú jīn què sǐ zài duì fāng de è yì zhī xià.
Zhè zhǒng è xìng xún huán de chóu hèn xiàng shì yī chǎng bào fēng zhòu yǔ, zài xīn zhōng jù liè de fān gǔn.
Tā yì shí dào, cǐ shí de qíng kuàng yǐ jīng dào le wēi jí de shí kè, bì xū lì kè xíng dòng.
Tā chōng chū yǎn tǐ, dòng zuò xiōng měng de xiàng yī zhī shòu shāng de měng hǔ.
Duì fāng de wèi bīng bèi xià rén de sù dù zhèn shè zhù le, shùn jiān bèi tā zhǎn duàn hóu lóng.
Lù Yuǎn yǔ fěi shǒu miàn duì miàn shí, duì fāng fā chū le kǒng bù de pào xiào, xiàng yī zhī yuǎn gǔ de kǒng lóng.
Fěi shǒu cháo xiào Lù Yuǎn de xiá yì zhī xīn, rèn wéi nà shì ruò zhě de huàn xiǎng.
Dàn Lù Yuǎn biǎo xiàn de jí qí jué jiàng, yǎn shén zhōng chōng mǎn le qì fèn hé jué jué.
Liǎng rén zhǎn kāi le jī liè de bó dòu, měi yī jī dōu dài zhe huǐ miè de lì liàng.
Miàn duì fěi shǒu de gōng jī, Lù Yuǎn hǎo dǎi zài zuì hòu yī kè shǎn guò le zhì mìng de yī jiàn.
Suī rán tā shòu le shāng, dàn xīn zhōng de fèn nù ràng tā gǎn bù dào téng tòng.
Tā yì shí dào, zài zhè zhǒng jí shǒu de jú miàn xià, zhǐ yǒu chè dǐ cuī huǐ duì fāng cái néng shēng cún.
Zuì zhōng, Lù Yuǎn yòng cháng jiàn guàn chuān le fěi shǒu de xīn zàng, zhōng jié le tā de è yùn.
Fěi shǒu zài lín sǐ qián yǎn shén zhōng shǎn guò yī sī jīng kǒng, suí hòu shēn tǐ chè dǐ jiāng sǐ zài dì shàng.
Lù Yuǎn zhàn zài xuè pō zhī zhōng, kàn zhe tiān kōng jiàn jiàn yīn àn.
Tā zhī dào, suī rán chóu hèn dé dào le huǎn jiě, dàn nèi xīn de chuāng shāng jiāng yǒng yuǎn cún zài.
Tā huǎn huǎn zǒu lí zhè piàn bèi xiān xuè rǎn hóng de tǔ dì, zǒu xiàng wèi zhī de yuǎn fāng.
stories.story_english:
In that blistering hot midsummer, the air was torn apart by the scorching sunlight.
Lu Yuan stood on the wasteland, the ground beneath his feet as hard as a giant tombstone.
He faced a grim situation: his village had been destroyed by a bandit gang led by a malefactor who called himself the "Tyrant."
That man was not only fierce but also extremely savage, turning the entire village into a living hell.
Lu Yuan remembered those filthy streets and the deathly pale faces of the villagers.
This catastrophe brought disastrous losses to the village, and he became the sole survivor.
A fiery desire for revenge ignited in his heart, although this emotion made his chest feel a scorching pain.
His opponent was a devious and ruthless monster, who seemed like a devil in the eyes of the locals.
This bandit leader wantonly plundered wealth, clearing away all who did not submit as if they were pests.
During his flight, Lu Yuan experienced countless perilous moments, his body so exhausted he could barely bear to support himself.
He crept through turbid mud, enduring vile weather and the torment of hunger.
He knew that facing such an irascible and cruel foe, any hesitation would be fatal.
During an attempt to infiltrate the camp, he found that the opponent's defenses were extremely tough.
He lurked in the shadows, watching those rogues laughing presumptuously by the campfire.
Their repulsive faces looked particularly vile in the firelight, making one feel nauseous.
Lu Yuan tightly gripped the heavy longsword in his hand, his knuckles becoming rigid from the force.
He thought of his mischievous but kind younger brother, who had now died under the malice of the enemy.
This vicious cycle of hatred was like a tempest, churning violently in his heart.
He realized that the situation had reached a critical moment and he had to act immediately.
He rushed out of cover, his movements as ferocious as a wounded tiger.
The opponent's guards were stunned by his frightening speed and were instantly slit across the throat.
When Lu Yuan stood face-to-face with the bandit leader, the latter let out a terrible roar, like an ancient dinosaur.
The leader mocked Lu Yuan's sense of chivalry, considering it a fantasy of the weak.
But Lu Yuan remained extremely stubborn, his eyes filled with indignation and determination.
The two engaged in a fierce struggle, every blow carrying the power of destruction.
Facing the leader's attack, Lu Yuan managed in any case to dodge the fatal sword at the last moment.
Although he was wounded, the anger in his heart made him unable to feel the pain.
He realized that in such a thorny situation, only the complete destruction of the opponent would allow him to survive.
Finally, Lu Yuan pierced the leader's heart with his longsword, ending his misfortune.
A flash of terror crossed the leader's eyes before death, and then his body became completely stiff on the ground.
Lu Yuan stood in the pool of blood, watching the sky gradually darken.
He knew that although the hatred had been relieved, the trauma in his heart would exist forever.
He slowly walked away from this land stained red with blood, heading toward the unknown distance.

stories.story_chinese:
在被诅咒的黑岩山脉中，生存是一场永无止境的折磨。
这里的地形极其陡峭，岩石像锯齿一样锋利。
林峰曾是一个痴迷于古文明的学者，但现在他只是一个在废墟中挣扎的幸存者。
他曾以为探索古迹是某种神圣的狂热，直到他见证了那些骇人听闻的祭祀仪式。
那座山上的统治者被称为“阎王”，一个贪婪且邪恶的暴君。
他通过非法手段强迫幸存者在矿区进行繁重的体力劳动。
这里的管理方式极其野蛮，任何微小的失误都会遭到粗暴的对待。
阎王对待属下的语气生硬且粗鲁，从不掩饰自己的轻蔑。
他盛气凌人地坐在高座上，俯视着那些像牲畜一样劳作的人们。
林峰的手掌因为长期的劳作而变得粗糙，指甲缝里永远嵌着黑色的矿尘。
在这种苛刻的环境下，人们的精神状态渐渐崩溃，有些人变成了真正的疯子。
他们会在深夜里对着虚无的墙壁低语，仿佛在与死者对话。
在这个被瘟疫侵袭的营地里，死亡比呼吸更加频繁。
一次意外的塌方导致了致命的后果，许多工友在瞬间被埋在地下。
林峰在混乱中受了重伤，左腿被巨大的岩石压断。
他躺在冰冷的泥土中，感到疲惫不堪，意识逐渐模糊。
就在这时，一个鲁莽的年轻人试图冲上前去抢夺死者的财物，像个卑鄙的贼。
那个年轻人动作粗糙，毫无技巧地撕扯着同伴的衣服。
在林峰看来，这种在生死边缘仍不放弃贪婪的行为简直像野兽一样。
但林峰知道，生存的艰辛让人们失去了作为人的底线。
他强撑着身体，开始了艰巨的自我救赎之旅。
他必须穿越那些艰险的山路，逃离这个地狱般的矿区。
在逃亡的途中，他遭遇了守卫的猛烈攻击。
守卫们猖狂地大笑着，将猎犬放出来追捕他。
林峰在绝望中发现，只要蛮干是不行的，必须利用地形。
他诱导守卫进入一个狭窄的峡谷，在那里，一个巨大的岩石崩塌将敌人掩埋。
他躲在潮湿的草丛中，看着一只青蛙在水洼里跳跃，那是他很久没见过的生命迹象。
他意识到，文明的缺失会让一个人变得多么野蛮。
虽然身体在颤抖，但他的心中燃起了一丝希望。
他终于翻过了最后一座陡峭的山峰，看到了地平线上的曙光。
他回头望去，那座黑色的山脉像一个巨大的坟墓，埋葬了无数纯洁的灵魂。

stories.story_pinyin:
Zài bèi zǔ zhòu de hēi yán shān mài zhōng, shēng cún shì yī chǎng yǒng wú zhǐ jìng de zhé mó.
Zhè lǐ de dì xíng jí qí dǒu qiào, yán shí xiàng jù chǐ yī yàng fēng lì.
Lín Fēng céng shì yī gè chī mí yú gǔ wén míng de xué zhě, dàn xiàn zài tā zhǐ shì yī gè zài fèi xū zhōng zhēng zhá de xìng cún zhě.
Tā céng yǐ wéi tàn suǒ gǔ jì shì mǒu zhǒng shén sheng de kuáng rè, zhí dào tā jiàn zhèng le nà xiē hài rén tīng wén de jì sì yí shì.
Nà zuò shān shàng de tǒng zhì zhě bèi chēng wéi “Yán wáng”, yī gè tān lán qiě xié è de bào jūn.
Tā tōng guò fēi fǎ shǒu duàn qiáng pò xìng cún zhě zài kuàng qū jìn xíng fán zhòng de tǐ lì láo dòng.
Zhè lǐ de guǎn lǐ fāng shì jí qí yě mán, rèn hé wēi xiǎo de shī wù dōu huì zāo dào cū bào de duì dài.
Yán wáng duì dài shǔ xià de yǔ qì shēng yìng qiě cū lǔ, cóng bù yǎn shì zì jǐ de qīng miè.
Tā shèng qì líng rén de zuò zài gāo zuò shàng, fǔ shì zhe nà xiē xiàng shēng chù yī yàng láo zuò de rén men.
Lín Fēng de shǒu zhǎng yīn wèi cháng qī de láo zuò ér biàn de cū cāo, zhǐ jia fèng lǐ yǒng yuǎn qiàn zhe hēi sè de kuàng chén.
Zài zhè zhǒng kē kè de huán jìng xià, rén men de jīng shén zhuàng tài jiàn jiàn bēng kuì, yǒu xiē rén biàn chéng le zhēn zhèng de fēng zi.
Tā men huì zài shēn yè lǐ duì zhe xū wú de qiáng bì dī yǔ, fǎng fú zài yǔ sǐ zhě duì huà.
Zài zhè gè bèi wēn yì qīn xí de yíng dì lǐ, sǐ wáng bǐ hū xī gèng jiā pín fán.
Yī cì yì wài de tā fāng dǎo zhì le zhì mìng de hòu guǒ, xǔ duō gōng yǒu zài shùn jiān bèi mái zài dì xià.
Lín Fēng zài hùn luàn zhōng shòu le zhòng shāng, zuǒ tuǐ bèi jù dà de yán shí yā duàn.
Tā tǎng zài bīng lěng de ní tǔ zhōng, gǎn dào pí bèi bù kān, yì shí zhú jiàn mó hu。
Jiù zài zhè shí, yī gè lǔ mǎng de nián qīng rén shì tú chōng shàng qián qù qiǎng duó sǐ zhě de cái wù, xiàng gè bēi bǐ de zéi.
Nà gè nián qīng rén dòng zuò cū cāo, háo wú jì qiǎo de sī chě zhe tóng bàn de yī fú.
Zài Lín Fēng kàn lái, zhè zhǒng zài shēng sǐ biān yuán réng bù fàng qì tān lán de xíng wéi jiǎn zhí xiàng yě shòu yī yàng.
Dàn Lín Fēng zhī dào, shēng cún de jiān xīn ràng rén men shī qù le zuò wéi rén de dǐ xiàn.
Tā qiáng chēng zhe shēn tǐ, kāi shǐ le jiān jù de zì wǒ jiù shú zhī lǚ.
Tā bì xū chuān yuè nà xiē jiān xiǎn de shān lù, táo lí zhè gè dì yù bān de kuàng qū.
Zài táo wáng de tú zhōng, tā zāo yù le shǒu wèi de měng liè gōng jī.
Shǒu wèi men chāng kuáng de dà xiào zhe, jiāng liè quǎn fàng chū lái zhuī bǔ tā.
Lín Fēng zài jué wàng zhōng fā xiàn, zhǐ yào mán gàn shì bù xíng de, bì xū lì yòng dì xíng.
Tā yòu dǎo shǒu wèi jìn rù yī gè xiá zhǎi de xiá gǔ, zài nà lǐ, yī gè jù dà de yán shí bēng tā jiāng dí rén yǎn mái.
Tā duǒ zài chāo shī de cǎo cóng zhōng, kàn zhe yī zhǐ qīng wā zài shuǐ wā lǐ tiào yuè, nà shì tā hěn jiǔ méi jiàn guò de shēng mìng zhì xiàng.
Tā yì shí dào, wén míng de quē shī huì ràng yī gè rén biàn de duō me yě mán.
Suī rán shēn tǐ zài chàn dǒu, dàn tā de xīn zhōng rán qǐ le yī sī xī wàng.
Tā zhōng yú fān guò le zuì hòu yī zuò dǒu qiào de shān fēng, kàn dào le dì píng xiàn shàng de shǔ guāng.
Tā huí tóu wàng qù, nà zuò hēi sè de shān mài xiàng yī gè jù dà de fén mù, mái zàng le wú shù chún jié de líng hún.

Tā tǎng zài bīng lěng de ní tǔ zhōng, gǎn dào pí bèi bù kān, yì shí zhú jiàn mó hu。
Jiù zài zhè shí, yī gè lǔ mǎng de nián qīng rén shì tú chōng shàng qián qù qiǎng duó sǐ zhě de cái wù, xiàng gè bēi bǐ de zéi.
Nà gè nián qīng rén dòng zuò cū cāo, háo wú jì qiǎo de sī chě zhe tóng bàn de yī fú.

Dàn Lín Fēng zhī dào, shēng cún de jiān xīn ràng rén men shī qù le zuò wéi rén de dǐ xiàn.
Tā qiáng chēng zhe shēn tǐ, kāi shǐ le jiān jù de zì wǒ jiù shú zhī lǚ.
Tā bì xū chuān yuè nà xiē jiān xiǎn de shān lù, táo lí zhè gè dì yù bān de kuàng qū.
Zài táo wáng de tú zhōng, tā zāo yù le shǒu wèi de měng liè gōng jī.
Shǒu wèi men chāng kuáng de dà xiào zhe, jiāng liè quǎn fàng chū lái zhuī bǔ tā.
Lín Fēng zài jué wàng zhōng fā xiàn, zhǐ yào mán gàn shì bù xíng de, bì xū lì yòng dì xíng.
Tā yòu dǎo shǒu wèi jìn rù yī gè xiá zhǎi de xiá gǔ, zài nà lǐ, yī gè jù dà de yán shí bēng tā jiāng dí rén yǎn mái.
Tā duǒ zài chāo shī de cǎo cóng zhōng, kàn zhe yī zhǐ qīng wā zài shuǐ wā lǐ tiào yuè, nà shì tā hěn jiǔ méi jiàn guò de shēng mìng zhì xiàng.
Tā yì shí dào, wén míng de quē shī huì ràng yī gè rén biàn de duō me yě mán.
Suī rán shēn tǐ zài chàn dǒu, dàn tā de xīn zhōng rán qǐ le yī sī xī wàng.
Tā zhōng yú fān guò le zuì hòu yī zuò dǒu qiào de shān fēng, kàn dào le dì píng xiàn shàng de shǔ guāng.
Tā huí tóu wàng qù, nà zuò hēi sè de shān mài xiàng yī gè jù dà de fén mù, mái zàng le wú shù chún jié de líng hún.
stories.story_english:
In the cursed Black Rock Mountains, survival is an endless torture.
The terrain here is extremely steep, and the rocks are as sharp as sawteeth.
Lin Feng was once a scholar obsessed with ancient civilizations, but now he is just a survivor struggling in the ruins.
He once thought exploring ruins was a kind of sacred zealotry, until he witnessed those horrifying sacrificial rituals.
The ruler of that mountain was called "Yama," a greedy and wicked tyrant.
He used illegal means to force survivors into burdensome physical labor in the mining area.
The management style here was extremely barbarous, and any small mistake would be met with rough treatment.
Yama's tone toward his subordinates was stiff and coarse, never hiding his contempt.
He sat on his high throne overbearingly, looking down at the people working like livestock.
Lin Feng's palms became rough due to long-term labor, with black mineral dust forever embedded in his fingernails.
In such a harsh environment, people's mental states gradually collapsed, and some became true madmen.
They would whisper to empty walls in the middle of the night, as if talking to the dead.
In this camp ravaged by plague, death was more frequent than breathing.
An accidental cave-in led to fatal consequences, and many coworkers were buried underground in an instant.
Lin Feng was seriously injured in the chaos, his left leg crushed by a huge rock.
Lying in the cold mud, he felt exhausted to the extreme, and his consciousness gradually blurred.
Just then, a reckless young man tried to rush forward to steal the belongings of the dead, like a despicable thief.
The young man's movements were crude, tearing at his companion's clothes without any skill.
In Lin Feng's eyes, this behavior of not giving up greed even on the brink of life and death was simply like a beast.
But Lin Feng knew that the hardships of survival made people lose their bottom line as human beings.
Forcing his body, he began an arduous journey of self-redemption.
He had to cross those difficult and dangerous mountain paths to escape this hellish mining area.
During his escape, he encountered a fierce attack from the guards.
The guards laughed savagely, releasing hounds to hunt him down.
In desperation, Lin Feng discovered that simply bullying one's way through (brute force) would not work; he had to use the terrain.
He lured the guards into a narrow canyon where a massive rock collapse buried the enemies.
He hid in the damp grass, watching a frog leaping in a puddle—a sign of life he hadn't seen in a long time.
He realized how barbarous a person could become when civilization is missing.
Although his body was trembling, a spark of hope ignited in his heart.
He finally crossed the last steep mountain peak and saw the dawn on the horizon.
Looking back, the black mountains looked like a giant grave, burying countless pure souls.

stories.story_chinese:
林教授是一位研究古籍的学者，他一生都在追寻文字的起源。
他出生于一个书香门第，出身决定了他对知识的天然渴望。
为了完成新书，他决定回到自己的祖籍——一座深山中的古镇。
他认为，真实的创作素材不能仅来源于图书馆的故纸堆。
抵达古镇后，他站在村口的古槐树原地，陷入了沉思。
这里的每一块青砖似乎都讲述着这座城镇的由来。
他向当地的长辈打听，试图理清家族的来历。
长辈告诉他，这里的传统工艺源于数百年前的迁徙。
林教授发现，当地出产的名茶产地正是这座山谷。
他意识到，文化与土地之间有着深厚的渊源。
他沿着溪流向上走，试图寻找这条河流的源头。
在山顶的泉眼处，他终于找到了这座文明的发源地。
他意识到，很多现代的社会矛盾其实根源于对传统的遗忘。
他的研究出发点并非为了名声，而是为了找回失落的记忆。
他在日记中写道：“真正的智慧往往出自于对自然的敬畏。”
这次旅程让他明白了，人的灵魂终究要回到最初的地方。

stories.story_pinyin:
Lín jiào shòu shì yī wèi yán jiū gǔ jí de xué zhě, tā yī shēng dōu zài zhuī xún wén zì de qǐ yuán.
Tā chū shēng yú yī gè shū xiāng mén dì, chū shēn jué dìng le tā duì zhī shi de tiān rán kě wàng.
Wèi le wán chéng xīn shū, tā jué dìng huí dào zì jǐ de zǔ jí —— yī zuò shēn shān zhōng de gǔ zhèn.
Tā rèn wéi, zhēn shí de chuàng zuò sù cái bù néng jǐn lái yuán yú tú shū guǎn de gù zhǐ duī.
Dǐ dá gǔ zhèn hòu, tā zhàn zài cūn kǒu de gǔ huái shù yuán dì, xiàn rù le chén sī.
Zhè lǐ de měi yī kuài qīng zhuān sì hū dōu jiǎng shù zhe zhè zuò chéng zhèn de yóu lái.
Tā xiàng dāng dì de zhǎng bèi dǎ tīng, shì tú lǐ qīng jiā zú de lái lì.
Zhǎng bèi gào su tā, zhè lǐ de chuán tǒng gōng yì yuán yú shù bǎi nián qián de qiān xǐ.
Lín jiào shòu fā xiàn, dāng dì chū chǎn de míng chá chǎn dì zhèng shì zhè zuò shān gǔ.
Tā yì shí dào, wén huà yǔ tǔ dì zhī jiān yǒu zhe shēn hòu de yuān yuán.
Tā yán zhe xī liú xiàng shàng zǒu, shì tú xún zhǎo zhè tiáo hé liú de yuán tóu.
Zài shān dǐng de quán yǎn chù, tā zhōng yú zhǎo dào le zhè zuò wén míng de fā yuán dì.
Tā yì shí dào, hěn duō xiàn dài de shè huì máo dùn qí shí gēn yuán yú duì chuán tǒng de yí wàng.
Tā de yán jiū chū fā diǎn bìng fēi wèi le míng shēng, ér shì wèi le zhǎo huí shī luò de jì yì.
Tā zài rì jì zhōng xiě dào: “Zhēn zhèng de zhì huì wǎng wǎng chū zì yú duì zì rán de jìng wèi.”
Zhè cì lǚ chéng ràng tā míng bái le, rén de líng hún zhōng jiū yào huí dào zuì chū de dì fang.

stories.story_english:
Professor Lin was a scholar of ancient texts who spent his entire life pursuing the origin of characters.
He was born into a family of intellectuals; his background determined his natural thirst for knowledge.
To complete his new book, he decided to return to his ancestral hometown—an ancient town deep in the mountains.
He believed that authentic creative source material could not originate solely from the old papers in libraries.
After arriving at the ancient town, he stood in the original place by the old locust tree at the village entrance, lost in thought.
Every blue brick here seemed to tell the story of how this town came to be.
He inquired with the local elders, attempting to clarify the history of his family.
The elders told him that the traditional crafts here originated from a migration hundreds of years ago.
Professor Lin discovered that the place of origin for the famous local tea was exactly this valley.
He realized that there was a deep connection between culture and the land.
He walked upstream along the creek, trying to find the source of this river.
At the spring on the mountain peak, he finally found the birthplace of this civilization.
He realized that many modern social conflicts are actually rooted in the forgetting of tradition.
The starting point of his research was not for fame, but to recover lost memories.
He wrote in his diary: "True wisdom often comes from a reverence for nature."
This journey made him understand that the human soul must eventually return to its original place.

stories.title_english: The Secret of the Old Bookstore
stories.story_chinese:
在城市的一条狭窄巷子里，坐落着一家破旧的书店。
店主林先生已经年过古稀，他正处于孤独的晚年。
这家店的装潢陈旧，空气中弥漫着陈年纸张的味道。
长期以来，林先生在这里度过了他的人生，日复一日地整理书籍。
近年来，人们渐渐忘记了纸质书的魅力，书店的客流量愈来愈少。
但林先生并不在乎，他宁愿在寂静中与文字为伴，也不愿去追逐现代的喧嚣。
然而，关于林先生的传闻在当地居民中从未停止。
有人说他曾是某个名门望族的后裔，有人则在议论一些毫无根据的绯闻。
甚至有人将这些八卦编造成离奇的故事，在街头巷尾传播。
说起来，这些谣言大多是无聊之辈的想象，但其中却隐藏着一个谜。
多年来，林先生一直挂念着一个失踪的故人。
那个人的离去留下了一个巨大的悬念，成为了林先生心中根深蒂固的痛。
直到有一天，一个名叫苏然的年轻记者走进了书店。
苏然别看年纪轻，但她对真相有着近乎执着的追求。
她试图询问林先生关于那段往事，但林先生总是以那是私事为由而拒绝。
苏然在调查过程中碰钉子是常有的事，但她没有迟疑。
她发现林先生的讲述中存在一个可疑的疑点，关于一张消失的旧照片。
随着调查的深入，关于林先生年轻时卷入的一场丑闻逐渐浮出水面。
当时的情况错综复杂，各种利益纠葛让真相被掩盖了数十年。
苏然在档案库中翻找，试图破案一般地还原当年的真相。
她发现当年的指控其实是一场精心策划的阴谋。
随着证据的增加，真相与谎言的斗争愈演愈烈。
林先生在苏然的追问下，终于不再回避，开始讲述那个故事。
他缓缓说道：“其实我当年并不是被驱逐，而是选择了离开。”
他解释道，当时的压力让他觉得与其在谎言中苟活，不如说是在自我救赎。
苏然问他，既然真相可以被揭开，当年何苦承受这么多苦楚？
林先生苦笑一声，轻声说：“谁知道命运会如何安排呢？”
哪知道，就在苏然准备发表报道的前一天，林先生突然病重。
他在病榻上将一本泛黄的日记交给苏然，那是所有谜底的所在地。
苏然读完日记，泪流满面，她终于明白了林先生的坚守。
林先生在意识模糊中，依然恋恋不舍地看向窗外的书店。
他不再害怕那些被歪曲的传闻，因为他已经与自己达成了和解。
苏然没有在报纸上大肆渲染那场丑闻，而是写了一篇关于时间与原谅的文章。
她意识到，有些真相不需要向世界证明，只需要被理解即可。
她为林先生出难题的岁月画上了句号，给了他最后的平静。
书店依然破旧，但在阳光下显得格外温暖。

stories.story_pinyin:
Zài chéngshì de yītiáo xiázhǎi xiàngzi lǐ, zuòluòzhe yījiā pòjiù de shūdiàn.
Diànzhǔ Lín xiānshēng yǐjīng nián guò gǔxī, tā zhèng chǔyú gūdú de wǎnnián.
Zhè jiā diàn de zhuānghuáng chénjiù, kōngqì zhōng mímànzhe chénnián zhǐzhāng de wèidào.
Chángqī yǐlái, Lín xiānshēng zài zhèlǐ dùguòle tā de rénshēng, rì fù yī rì de zhěnglǐ shūjí.
Jìnnián lái, rénmen jiànjiàn wàngjìle zhǐzhì shū de mèilì, shūdiàn de kèliú liàng yù lái yù shǎo.
Dàn Lín xiānshēng bìng bù zàihū, tā nìngyuàn zài jìjìng zhōng yǔ wénzì wéi bàn, yě bù yuàn qù zhuīzhú xiàndài de xuānxiāo.
Rán'ér, guānyú Lín xiānshēng de chuánwén zài dāngdì jūmín zhōng cóngwèi tíngzhǐ.
Yǒurén shuō tā céng shì mǒu gè míngmén wàngzú de hòuyì, yǒurén zé zài yìlùn yīxiē háowú gēnjù de fēiwén.
Shènzhì yǒurén jiāng zhèxiē bāguà biānzào chéng líqí de gùshì, zài jiētóu xiàngwěi chuánbō.
Shuō qǐlái, zhèxiē yáoyán dàduō shì wúliáo zhī bèi de xiǎngxiàng, dàn qízhōng què yǐncángzhe yīgè mí.
Duōnián lái, Lín xiānshēng yīzhí guàniànzhe yīgè shīzōng de gùrén.
Nàgè rén de líqù liú xiàle yīgè jùdà de xuánniàn, chéngwéile Lín xiānshēng xīnzhōng gēn shēn dì gù de tòng.
Zhídào yǒu yītiān, yīgè míngjiào Sū Rán de niánqīng jìzhě zǒujìnle shūdiàn.
Sū Rán bié kàn niánjì qīng, dàn tā duì zhēnxiàng yǒuzhe jìn hū zhízhuó de zhuīqiú.
Tā shìtú xúnwèn Lín xiānshēng guānyú nà duàn wǎngshì, dàn Lín xiānshēng zǒng shì yǐ nà shì sīshì wéi yóu ér jùjué.
Sū Rán zài diàochá guòchéng zhōng pèng dīngzi shì chángyǒu de shì, dàn tā méiyǒu chíyí.
Tā fāxiàn Lín xiānshēng de jiǎngshù zhōng cúnzài yīgè kěyí de yídiǎn, guānyú yī zhāng xiāoshī de jiù zhàopiàn.
Suízhe diàochá de shēnrù, guānyú Lín xiānshēng niánqīng shí juǎnrù de yī chǎng chǒuwén zhújiàn fúchū shuǐmiàn.
Dāngshí de qíngkuàng cuòzōng fùzá, gèzhǒng lìyì jiūgé ràng zhēnxiàng bèi yǎngài le shù shí nián.
Sū Rán zài dàng'àn kù zhōng fānzhǎo, shìtú pò'àn yīyàng de huányuán dāngnián de zhēnxiàng.
Tā fāxiàn dāngnián de zhǐkòng qíshí shì yī chǎng jīngxīn cèhuà de yīnmóu.
Suízhe zhèngjù de zēngjiā, zhēnxiàng yǔ huǎngyán de dòuzhēng yù yǎn yù liè.
Lín xiānshēng zài Sū Rán de zhuīwèn xià, zhōngyú bù zài huíbì, kāishǐ jiǎngshù nàgè gùshì.
Tā huǎnhuǎn shuōdào: "Qíshí wǒ dāngnián bìng bùshì bèi qūzhú, ér shì xuǎnzéle líkāi."
Tā jiěshì dào, dāngshí de yālì ràng tā juédé yǔqí zài huǎngyán zhōng gǒuhuó, bùrú shuō shì zài zìwǒ jiùshú.
Sū Rán wèn tā, jìrán zhēnxiàng kěyǐ bèi jiēkāi, dāngnián hé kǔ chéngshòu zhème duō kǔchǔ?
Lín xiānshēng kǔxiào yīshēng, qīngshēng shuō: "Shéi zhīdào mìngyùn huì rúhé ānpái ne?"
Nǎ zhīdào, jiù zài Sū Rán zhǔnbèi fābiǎo bàodào de qián yītiān, Lín xiānshēng tūrán bìngzhòng.
Tā zài bìngtà shàng jiāng yī běn fànhuáng de rìjì jiāo gěi Sū Rán, nà shì suǒyǒu mídǐ de suǒzàidì.
Sū Rán dú wán rìjì, lèi liú mǎnmiàn, tā zhōngyú míngbáile Lín xiānshēng de jiānshǒu.
Lín xiānshēng zài yìshí móhú zhōng, yīrán liànliàn bùshě de kàn xiàng chuāngwài de shūdiàn.
Tā bù zài hàipà nàxiē bèi wāiqū de chuánwén, yīnwèi tā yǐjīng yǔ zìjǐ dáchéngle héjiě.
Sū Rán méiyǒu zài bàozhǐ shàng dàsì xuǎnrǎn nà chǎng chǒuwén, ér shì xiěle yī piān guānyú shíjiān yǔ yuánliàng de wénzhāng.
Tā yìshí dào, yǒuxiē zhēnxiàng bù xūyào xiàng shìjiè zhèngmíng, zhǐ xūyào bèi lǐjiě jí kě.
Tā wèi Lín xiānshēng chū nán tí de suìyuè huà shàngle jùhào, gěile tā zuìhòu de píngjìng.
Shūdiàn yīrán pòjiù, dàn zài yángguāng xià xiǎndé géwài wēnnuǎn.

stories.story_english:
In a narrow alley of the city, there sat a shabby bookstore.
The owner, Mr. Lin, was already over seventy and was spending his lonely later years.
The decor of the shop was old-fashioned, and the air was filled with the smell of aged paper.
For a long time, Mr. Lin spent his life here, organizing books day after day.
In recent years, people have gradually forgotten the charm of printed books, and the foot traffic in the bookstore has become more and more sparse.
But Mr. Lin didn't care; he would rather be accompanied by words in silence than chase the noise of modernity.
However, rumors about Mr. Lin never stopped among the local residents.
Some said he was a descendant of a prestigious clan, while others discussed baseless sex scandals.
Some even turned these pieces of gossip into bizarre stories, spreading them throughout the streets.
Speaking of which, these rumors were mostly the imagination of bored people, but a riddle was hidden within them.
For many years, Mr. Lin had been concerned about a missing old friend.
That person's departure left a huge suspense, becoming a deep-rooted pain in Mr. Lin's heart.
Until one day, a young journalist named Su Ran entered the bookstore.
Don't be fooled by her youth; Su Ran had an almost obsessive pursuit of the truth.
She tried to ask Mr. Lin about that past, but Mr. Lin always refused on the grounds that it was a personal matter.
Meeting with rebuffs during the investigation was common for Su Ran, but she did not hesitate.
She found a suspicious doubtful point in Mr. Lin's narrative regarding a missing old photograph.
As the investigation deepened, a scandal that Mr. Lin had been involved in when he was young gradually surfaced.
The situation at the time was tangled and complicated, and various conflicts of interest had hidden the truth for decades.
Su Ran searched through the archives, attempting to reconstruct the truth of those years as if solving a case.
She discovered that the accusations at the time were actually a carefully planned conspiracy.
As evidence mounted, the struggle between truth and lies became more and more intense.
Under Su Ran's questioning, Mr. Lin finally stopped avoiding it and began to tell the story.
He said slowly, "Actually, I wasn't expelled back then; I chose to leave."
He explained that the pressure at the time made him feel that rather than surviving in lies, it was better to say he was seeking self-redemption.
Su Ran asked him, since the truth could be revealed, why bother enduring so much suffering back then?
Mr. Lin gave a bitter smile and said softly, "Who knows how fate would arrange things?"
Who would have thought that just the day before Su Ran was ready to publish the report, Mr. Lin suddenly became seriously ill.
On his sickbed, he handed a yellowed diary to Su Ran; that was where all the answers to the riddle lay.
After reading the diary, Su Ran was in tears; she finally understood Mr. Lin's persistence.
In his fading consciousness, Mr. Lin was still reluctant to part from the bookstore outside the window.
He was no longer afraid of those distorted rumors because he had reached a reconciliation with himself.
Su Ran did not sensationalize the scandal in the newspaper, but instead wrote an article about time and forgiveness.
She realized that some truths do not need to be proven to the world; they only need to be understood.
She put an end to the years of tough questions for Mr. Lin, giving him final peace.
The bookstore remained shabby, but it looked exceptionally warm under the sunlight.

She tried to ask Mr. Lin about that past, but Mr. Lin always refused on the grounds that it was a personal matter.
Meeting with rebuffs during the investigation was common for Su Ran, but she did not hesitate.
She found a suspicious doubtful point in Mr. Lin's narrative regarding a missing old photograph.
As the investigation deepened, a scandal that Mr. Lin had been involved in when he was young gradually surfaced.
The situation at the time was tangled and complicated, and various conflicts of interest had hidden the truth for decades.
Su Ran searched through the archives, attempting to reconstruct the truth of those years as if solving a case.
She discovered that the accusations at the time were actually a carefully planned conspiracy.
As evidence mounted, the struggle between truth and lies became more and more intense.
Under Su Ran's questioning, Mr. Lin finally stopped avoiding it and began to tell the story.
He said slowly, "Actually, I wasn't expelled back then; I chose to leave."
He explained that the pressure at the time made him feel that rather than surviving in lies, it was better to say he was seeking self-redemption.
Su Ran asked him, since the truth could be revealed, why bother enduring so much suffering back then?
Mr. Lin gave a bitter smile and said softly, "Who knows how fate would arrange things?"
Who would have thought that just the day before Su Ran was ready to publish the report, Mr. Lin suddenly became seriously ill.
On his sickbed, he handed a yellowed diary to Su Ran; that was where all the answers to the riddle lay.
After reading the diary, Su Ran was in tears; she finally understood Mr. Lin's persistence.
In his fading consciousness, Mr. Lin was still reluctant to part from the bookstore outside the window.
He was no longer afraid of those distorted rumors because he had reached a reconciliation with himself.
Su Ran did not sensationalize the scandal in the newspaper, but instead wrote an article about time and forgiveness.
She realized that some truths do not need to be proven to the world; they only need to be understood.
She put an end to the years of tough questions for Mr. Lin, giving him final peace.
The bookstore remained shabby, but it looked exceptionally warm under the sunlight.

stories.title_english: The Strings of Memory in the Ancient Capital
stories.story_chinese:
在古都的深巷里，林先生经营着一家名为“墨香阁”的老字号书店。
这家书店并非国有，而是一家典型的私营企业，承载着林家数代人的心血。
林先生并非土生土长于此，他曾是一名在海外生活多年的华侨，后来决定回国寻找根源。
他的祖先曾是当地著名的国学大师，将儒家的仁爱思想深深烙印在家族的血脉中。
对于林先生来说，这种文化传承并非一种世袭的权力，而是一种精神的责任。
他记得父亲生前常说，真正的学问不是人为的雕琢，而是先天与后天共同的修行。
书店的一角摆放着一些祖传的古籍，这些书记录了古人对天地自然的深刻洞察。
林先生希望通过这些文字，让后人能够感知到某种跨越时空的共鸣。
然而，时代的浪潮席卷而来，周围出现了许多规模宏大的外企办公楼和民办教育机构。
在这些私有财产的包围下，小小的书店显得格外孤寂。
有一天，一位年轻的华裔学者来到店里，自称是林家远房的后裔。
他告诉林先生，他在海内外寻找散落的家族记录，试图确认自己的亲生血缘关系。
这位学者对生物进化论感兴趣，他将人类的演化比作一种物种的接力，认为后代是祖先意志的延伸。
他好奇地询问林先生，在那个纯朴的年代，人们如何看待牲畜与自然的关系。
林先生微笑着指了指窗外，那里正有农人地在贩卖当地的特产。
他感叹道，无论外界如何变化，子孙们都不应忘记脚下的土地。
两人在书店里探讨了很久，从古老的经书聊到了现代的社会结构。
他们意识到，尽管身份在变，但血脉中的某种东西是不可磨灭的。
最终，这位学者决定资助书店的数字化改造，让更多后代能接触到这些珍贵的文献。

这家书店并非国有，而是一家典型的私营企业，承载着林家数代人的心血。
林先生并非土生土长于此，他曾是一名在海外生活多年的华侨，后来决定回国寻找根源。
他的祖先曾是当地著名的国学大师，将儒家的仁爱思想深深烙印在家族的血脉中。

他记得父亲生前常说，真正的学问不是人为的雕琢，而是先天与后天共同的修行。
书店的一角摆放着一些祖传的古籍，这些书记录了古人对天地自然的深刻洞察。
林先生希望通过这些文字，让后人能够感知到某种跨越时空的共鸣。

stories.story_pinyin:
Zài gǔ dū de shēn xiàng lǐ, Lín xiān sheng jīng yíng zhe yī jiā míng wèi “Mò xiāng gé” de lǎo zì hào shū diàn.
Zhè jiā shū diàn bìng fēi guó yǒu, ér shì yī jiā diǎn xíng de sī yíng qǐ yè, chéng zài zhe Lín jiā shù dài rén de xīn xuè.
Lín xiān sheng bìng fēi tǔ shēng tǔ zhǎng yú cǐ, tā céng shì yī míng zài hǎi wài shēng huó duō nián de Huá qiáo, hòu lái jué dìng huí guó xún zhǎo gēn yuán.
Tā de zǔ xiān céng shì dāng dì zhù míng de guó xué dà shī, jiāng Rú jiā de rén ài sī xiǎng shēn shēn lào yìn zài jiā zú de xuè mài zhōng.
Duì yú Lín xiān sheng lái shuō, zhè zhǒng wén huà chuán chéng bìng fēi yī zhǒng shì xí de quán lì, ér shì yī zhǒng jīng shén de zé rèn.
Tā jì de fù qīn shēng qián cháng shuō, zhēn zhèng de xué wèn bú shì rén wéi de diāo zhuó, ér shì xiān tiān yǔ hòu tiān gòng tóng de xiū xíng.
Shū diàn de yī jiǎo bǎi fàng zhe yī xiē zǔ chuán de gǔ jí, zhè xiē shū jì lù le gǔ rén duì tiān dì zì rán de shēn kè dòng chá.
Lín xiān sheng xī wàng tōng guò zhè xiē wén zì, ràng hòu rén néng gǎn zhī dào mǒu zhǒng kuà yuè shí kōng de gòng míng.
 Rán ér, shí dài de làng cáo xí juǎn ér lái, zhōu wéi chū xiàn le xǔ duō guī mó hóng dà de wài qǐ bàn gōng lóu hé mín bàn jiào yù jī gòu.
Zài zhè xiē sī yǒu cái chǎn de bāo wéi xià, xiǎo xiǎo de shū diàn xiǎn de gé wài gū jì.
Yǒu yī tiān, yī wèi nián qīng de Huá yì xué zhě lái dào diàn lǐ, zì chēng shì Lín jiā yuǎn fáng de hòu yì.
Tā gào su Lín xiān sheng, tā zài hǎi nèi wài xún zhǎo sàn luò de jiā zú jì lù, shì tú què rèn zì jǐ de qīn shēng xuè yuán guān xì.
Zhè wèi xué zhě duì shēng wù jìn huà lùn gǎn xìng qù, tā jiāng rén lèi de yǎn huà bǐ zuò yī zhǒng wù zhǒng de jiē lì, rèn wéi hòu dài shì zǔ xiān yì zhì de yán shēn.
Tā hào qí de xún wèn Lín xiān sheng, zài nà gè chún pú de nián dài, rén men rú hé kàn dài shēng chù yǔ zì rán de guān xì.
Lín xiān sheng wēi xiào zhe zhǐ le zhǐ chuāng wài, nà lǐ zhèng yǒu nóng rén zài fàn mài dāng dì de tè chǎn.
Tā gǎn tàn dào, wú lùn wài jiè rú hé biàn huà, zǐ sūn men dōu bù yìng wàng jì jiǎo xià de tǔ dì.
Liǎng rén zài shū diàn lǐ tàn tǎo le hěn jiǔ, cóng gǔ lǎo de jīng shū liáo dào le xiàn dài de shè huì jié gòu.
Tā men yì shí dào, jǐn guǎn shēn fèn zài biàn, dàn xuè mài zhōng de mǒu zhǒng dōng xī shì bù kě mó miè de.
Zuì zhōng, zhè wèi xué zhě jué dìng zī zhù shū diàn de shù zì huà gǎi zào, ràng gèng duō hòu dài néng jiē chù dào zhè xiē zhēn guì de wén xiàn.
Lín xiān sheng kàn zhe chuāng wài de xī yáng, xīn zhōng gǎn dào yī zhǒng jiǔ wéi de píng jìng.
Tā zhī dào, zhǐ yào yǒu rén yuàn yì yuè dú, nà xiē gǔ lǎo de líng hún jiù yǒng yuǎn bú huì xiāo wáng.
Wén huà jiù xiàng yī tiáo hé liú, liú jīng bù tóng de shí dài, zī yǎng zhe bù tóng de shēng mìng.
Ér tā, zhǐ shì zhè gè màn cháng guò chéng zhōng de yī míng shǒu hù zhě.
Tā jiāng jì xù zài zhè lǐ, děng dài xià yī gè xún zhǎo guī tú de lǚ rén.
Zài zhè zuò chéng shì zhōng, gǔ lǎo yǔ xiàn dài zhèng yǐ yī zhǒng qí miào de fāng shì gòng cún.
Zhè jiù shì tā suǒ zhuī qiú de shēng mìng yì yì.
Zhè jiù shì tā xiǎng yào liú gěi wèi lái de dá àn.

stories.story_english:
In the deep alleys of the ancient capital, Mr. Lin operated a long-established bookstore called "Ink Fragrance Pavilion."
This bookstore was not state-owned, but a typical privately-owned enterprise, carrying the blood and sweat of several generations of the Lin family.
Mr. Lin was not locally born and bred here; he was once an overseas Chinese who had lived abroad for many years before deciding to return to China to find his roots.
His ancestors were once famous masters of Chinese national studies in the area, deeply imprinting the Confucian ideal of benevolence in the family's bloodline.
For Mr. Lin, this cultural inheritance was not a hereditary power, but a spiritual responsibility.
He remembered his father often saying during his life that true scholarship is not man-made embellishment, but a combined cultivation of innate and acquired nature.
In a corner of the bookstore were placed some ancestral books, which recorded the ancients' profound insights into heaven, earth, and nature.
Mr. Lin hoped that through these words, later generations could feel a kind of resonance that transcends time and space.
However, the tide of the era swept in, and many large foreign enterprise office buildings and privately operated educational institutions appeared around him.
Surrounded by these private properties, the small bookstore seemed exceptionally lonely.
One day, a young ethnic Chinese scholar came to the store, claiming to be a distant descendant of the Lin family.
He told Mr. Lin that he had been searching for scattered family records both domestically and internationally, attempting to confirm his biological blood relation.
This scholar was interested in the theory of biological evolution; he compared human evolution to a relay of species, believing that descendants are an extension of their ancestors' will.
He curiously asked Mr. Lin how people in those simple times viewed the relationship between livestock and nature.
Mr. Lin smiled and pointed out the window, where farmers were selling local specialties.
He sighed that no matter how the outside world changes, offspring should not forget the land beneath their feet.
The two discussed for a long time in the bookstore, chatting from ancient classics to modern social structures.
They realized that although identities change, something in the bloodline is indelible.
Eventually, the scholar decided to fund the digital transformation of the bookstore, allowing more descendants to access these precious documents.
Mr. Lin looked at the sunset outside the window and felt a long-lost peace in his heart.
He knew that as long as there were people willing to read, those ancient souls would never perish.
Culture is like a river, flowing through different eras, nourishing different lives.
And he was merely a guardian in this long process.
He would continue to stay here, waiting for the next traveler searching for the way home.
In this city, the ancient and the modern coexist in a wonderful way.
This was the meaning of life he pursued.
This was the answer he wanted to leave for the future.

sentences.chinese: 林先生希望通过这些文字，让后人能够感知到某种跨越时空的共鸣。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng xī wàng tōng guò zhè xiē wén zì, ràng hòu rén néng gǎn zhī dào mǒu zhǒng kuà yuè shí kōng de gòng míng.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin hoped that through these words, later generations could feel a kind of resonance that transcends time and space.

sentences.chinese: 然而，时代的浪潮席卷而来，周围出现了许多规模宏大的外企办公楼和民办教育机构。
sentences.pinyin: Rán ér, shí dài de làng cáo xí juǎn ér lái, zhōu wéi chū xiàn le xǔ duō guī mó hóng dà de wài qǐ bàn gōng lóu hé mín bàn jiào yù jī gòu.
sentences.english: However, the tide of the era swept in, and many large foreign enterprise office buildings and privately operated educational institutions appeared around him.

sentences.chinese: 在这些私有财产的包围下，小小的书店显得格外孤寂。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè xiē sī yǒu cái chǎn de bāo wéi xià, xiǎo xiǎo de shū diàn xiǎn de gé wài gū jì.
sentences.english: Surrounded by these private properties, the small bookstore seemed exceptionally lonely.

sentences.chinese: 有一天，一位年轻的华裔学者来到店里，自称是林家远房的后裔。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu yī tiān, yī wèi nián qīng de Huá yì xué zhě lái dào diàn lǐ, zì chēng shì Lín jiā yuǎn fáng de hòu yì.
sentences.english: One day, a young ethnic Chinese scholar came to the store, claiming to be a distant descendant of the Lin family.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林先生，他在海内外寻找散落的家族记录，试图确认自己的亲生血缘关系。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su Lín xiān sheng, tā zài hǎi nèi wài xún zhǎo sàn luò de jiā zú jì lù, shì tú què rèn zì jǐ de qīn shēng xuè yuán guān xì.
sentences.english: He told Mr. Lin that he had been searching for scattered family records both domestically and internationally, attempting to confirm his biological blood relation.

sentences.chinese: 这位学者对生物进化论感兴趣，他将人类的演化比作一种物种的接力，认为后代是祖先意志的延伸。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi xué zhě duì shēng wù jìn huà lùn gǎn xìng qù, tā jiāng rén lèi de yǎn huà bǐ zuò yī zhǒng wù zhǒng de jiē lì, rèn wéi hòu dài shì zǔ xiān yì zhì de yán shēn.
sentences.english: This scholar was interested in the theory of biological evolution; he compared human evolution to a relay of species, believing that descendants are an extension of their ancestors' will.

sentences.chinese: 他好奇地询问林先生，在那个纯朴的年代，人们如何看待牲畜与自然的关系。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hào qí de xún wèn Lín xiān sheng, zài nà gè chún pú de nián dài, rén men rú hé kàn dài shēng chù yǔ zì rán de guān xì.
sentences.english: He curiously asked Mr. Lin how people in those simple times viewed the relationship between livestock and nature.

sentences.chinese: 林先生微笑着指了指窗外，那里正有农人地在贩卖当地的特产。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng wēi xiào zhe zhǐ le zhǐ chuāng wài, nà lǐ zhèng yǒu nóng rén zài fàn mài dāng dì de tè chǎn.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin smiled and pointed out the window, where farmers were selling local specialties.

sentences.chinese: 他感叹道，无论外界如何变化，子孙们都不应忘记脚下的土地。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎn tàn dào, wú lùn wài jiè rú hé biàn huà, zǐ sūn men dōu bù yìng wàng jì jiǎo xià de tǔ dì.
sentences.english: He sighed that no matter how the outside world changes, offspring should not forget the land beneath their feet.

sentences.chinese: 两人在书店里探讨了很久，从古老的经书聊到了现代的社会结构。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng rén zài shū diàn lǐ tàn tǎo le hěn jiǔ, cóng gǔ lǎo de jīng shū liáo dào le xiàn dài de shè huì jié gòu.
sentences.english: The two discussed for a long time in the bookstore, chatting from ancient classics to modern social structures.

sentences.chinese: 他们意识到，尽管身份在变，但血脉中的某种东西是不可磨灭的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men yì shí dào, jǐn guǎn shēn fèn zài biàn, dàn xuè mài zhōng de mǒu zhǒng dōng xī shì bù kě mó miè de.
sentences.english: They realized that although identities change, something in the bloodline is indelible.

sentences.chinese: 最终，这位学者决定资助书店的数字化改造，让更多后代能接触到这些珍贵的文献。
sentences.pinyin: Zuì zhōng, zhè wèi xué zhě jué dìng zī zhù shū diàn de shù zì huà gǎi zào, ràng gèng duō hòu dài néng jiē chù dào zhè xiē zhēn guì de wén xiàn.
sentences.english: Eventually, the scholar decided to fund the digital transformation of the bookstore, allowing more descendants to access these precious documents.

sentences.chinese: 林先生看着窗外的夕阳，心中感到一种久违的平静。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng kàn zhe chuāng wài de xī yáng, xīn zhōng gǎn dào yī zhǒng jiǔ wéi de píng jìng.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin looked at the sunset outside the window and felt a long-lost peace in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，只要有人愿意阅读，那些古老的灵魂就永远不会消亡。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhī dào, zhǐ yào yǒu rén yuàn yì yuè dú, nà xiē gǔ lǎo de líng hún jiù yǒng yuǎn bú huì xiāo wáng.
sentences.english: He knew that as long as there were people willing to read, those ancient souls would never perish.

sentences.chinese: 文化就像一条河流，流经不同的时代，滋养着不同的生命。
sentences.pinyin: Wén huà jiù xiàng yī tiáo hé liú, liú jīng bù tóng de shí dài, zī yǎng zhe bù tóng de shēng mìng.
sentences.english: Culture is like a river, flowing through different eras, nourishing different lives.

sentences.chinese: 而他，只是这个漫长过程中的一名守护者。
sentences.pinyin: Ér tā, zhǐ shì zhè gè màn cháng guò chéng zhōng de yī míng shǒu hù zhě.
sentences.english: And he was merely a guardian in this long process.

sentences.chinese: 他将继续在这里，等待下一个寻找归途的旅人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiāng jì xù zài zhè lǐ, děng dài xià yī gè xún zhǎo guī tú de lǚ rén.
sentences.english: He would continue to stay here, waiting for the next traveler searching for the way home.

sentences.chinese: 在这座城市中，古老与现代正以一种奇妙的方式共存。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè zuò chéng shì zhōng, gǔ lǎo yǔ xiàn dài zhèng yǐ yī zhǒng qí miào de fāng shì gòng cún.
sentences.english: In this city, the ancient and the modern coexist in a wonderful way.

sentences.chinese: 这就是他所追求的生命意义。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiù shì tā suǒ zhuī qiú de shēng mìng yì yì.
sentences.english: This was the meaning of life he pursued.

sentences.chinese: 这就是他想要留给未来的答案。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiù shì tā xiǎng yào liú gěi wèi lái de dá àn.
sentences.english: This was the answer he wanted to leave for the future.

stories.story_chinese:
林远是一名习惯于在世界各地流浪的自由摄影师。
他的人生像是一场漫长的漫游，没有固定的居所。
为了寻找最纯粹的光影，他决定在今年冬天出境，前往北欧的极地地区度假。
在出发前，他花了好几天时间在网上浏览各种极光拍摄指南。
他意识到这次旅程是一场冒险，因为极地的气候极其恶劣。
起程的那天，天空阴沉，寒风凛冽。
他乘坐的接送车辆在复杂的城市立交桥上穿行。
道路因为积雪而拥堵，司机不得不绕行，通过几条交叉的小路才驶出市区。
当车辆开动时，林远看着窗外忽高忽低的山峦，心中充满了期待。
抵达目的地后，他首先在港口看到了一艘巨大的破冰船正静静地停泊在冰海之中。
船身在波涛中微微摇晃，像是在呼吸。
林远登船后，感觉到船舱在航行过程中不断地摇摆。
由于海浪猛烈，船体时而倾斜，舱内的物品在碰撞中发出冲撞的声音。
他试图在狭小的房间里挪动身体，但由于剧烈的晃荡，他几乎无法站稳。
夜晚，他躺在床上翻来覆去，难以入睡。
不仅是因为兴奋，还因为旅途中的饮食不适导致他出现了轻微的腹泻。
他只能在黑暗中摸索着寻找药物，心中感叹旅途的艰辛。
第二天，他终于登陆在了一片洁白的冰原上。
这里的风景如此壮丽，起伏的雪原环绕着深蓝色的湖泊。
林远决定穿越这片原野，去寻找传说中的冰洞。
他记得当地人说，这里的冰川在阳光下会产生扭曲的视觉效果。
在前往冰洞的路上，他看到一群年轻人正在冰面上滑冰，孩子们则在雪地里滑雪。
他们像是在进行一场激烈的赛跑，在雪地中飞奔。
林远挥动手臂示意他们注意安全，然后继续前行。
突然，一阵强风袭来，冻得他全身发抖。
由于极寒，他的手指开始哆嗦，几乎无法按下快门。
他用力抖了抖外套上的积雪，试图让自己暖和起来。
在冰洞深处，他看到冰川的流水在地下静静流转，发出低沉的轰鸣。
光线在冰晶之间忽悠，折射出梦幻的色彩。
他看着水面荡漾的波纹，心中产生了一种难以言喻的触动，深深地被自然所感。
他想起自己曾经在热带海滩冲浪的时光，与这里的静谧截然不同。
那时候，他喜欢看冲浪板在海面上漂浮，感受海水的力量。
而现在，他被一种孤独而宏大的力量所包围。
为了给拍摄腾出空间，他将沉重的设备包甩在地上。
他看着相机屏幕上滚动播放的预览图，捕捉着每一秒的变幻。
在这次出游中，他意识到生命就像这片海洋，充满了起伏。
他想起多年前为了追求艺术而决定搬迁到异国他乡的决定。
那时候的他，像一只失去方向的飞鸟，在城市间流浪。
但现在，他终于学会了在动荡中寻找平衡。
当他在冰原上行走时，偶尔会看到一些被冰封的古老生物，它们在时间中静止。
他想象着这些生物在千万年前是如何在海中游览的。
这种跨越时空的对话让他感到灵魂在颤抖。
在离开前，他花了一整天时间游览当地的小镇。
他观察着人们简单而纯粹的生活方式，这种生活让他心向往之。
当他准备动身离开时，天空终于出现了极光。
绿色的光带在夜空中前仰后合，像是一场盛大的舞蹈。
林远站在雪地中，看着光芒在头顶交织，感觉自己正渡过一段精神的河流。
他意识到，无论世界如何摇晃，内心深处总有一块地方是宁静的。
他最后一次看向那艘破冰船，它依然在波涛中轻轻摇曳。
他收拾好行囊，带着满载的记忆，踏上了回程的路。
这次旅程不仅是地理上的跨越，更是心灵的洗礼。
他终于明白了，真正的自由不是没有牵挂，而是在流转的岁月中依然能找到归宿。
他闭上眼，仿佛还能听到冰川流水的低语。
