sentences.chinese: 这次失恋成了压垮他的最后一根稻草。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì shī liàn chéng le yā kuǎ tā de zuì hòu yī gēn cáo rǎo.
sentences.english: This breakup became the last straw that crushed him.

sentences.chinese: 他试图寻找失踪多年的父亲，但对方的下落始终是个谜。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì tú xún zhǎo shī zōng duō nián de fù qīn, dàn duì fāng de xià luò shǐ zhōng shì gè mí.
sentences.english: He tried to find his father, who had been missing for many years, but the father's whereabouts remained a mystery.

sentences.chinese: 他记得父亲曾是一名古建筑修复师，但那种精湛的技艺如今已几乎失传。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì dé fù qīn céng shì yī míng gǔ jiàn zhù xiū fù shī, dàn nà zhǒng jīng zhàn de jì yì rù jīn yǐ jī hū shī chuán.
sentences.english: He remembered that his father was once an ancient architecture restoration master, but that exquisite skill has almost died out today.

sentences.chinese: 林远决定前往深山，寻找父亲留下的最后线索。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuǎn jué dìng qián wǎng shēn shān, xún zhǎo fù qīn liú xià de zuì hòu xiàn suǒ.
sentences.english: Lin Yuan decided to go to the deep mountains to find the last clues left by his father.

sentences.chinese: 他在山间行走，看着夕阳缓缓下山，将世界染成血红色。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài shān jiān xíng zǒu, kàn zhe xī yáng huǎn huǎn xià shān, jiāng shì jiè rǎn chéng xuè hóng sè.
sentences.english: He walked among the mountains, watching the sunset slowly set, dyeing the world blood-red.

sentences.chinese: 在半山腰，他发现了一座快要塌掉的古庙。
sentences.pinyin: Zài bàn shān yāo, tā fā xiàn le yī zuò kuài yào tā diào de gǔ miào.
sentences.english: Halfway up the mountain, he discovered an ancient temple that was about to collapse.

sentences.chinese: 庙宇的房梁在重力作用下缓缓下坠，随时可能彻底崩塌。
sentences.pinyin: Miào yǔ de fáng liáng zài zhòng lì zuò yòng xià huǎn huǎn xià zhuì, suí shí kě néng chè dǐ bēng tā.
sentences.english: The beams of the temple were slowly drooping under the effect of gravity, potentially collapsing completely at any moment.

sentences.chinese: 林远试图进入庙中，却在不小心踩空时向深谷坠去。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuǎn shì tú jìn rù miào zhōng, què zài bù xiǎo xīn cǎi kōng shí xiàng shēn gǔ zhuì qù.
sentences.english: Lin Yuan tried to enter the temple, but he fell toward the deep valley after accidentally stepping into a void.

sentences.chinese: 在生死一线间，他猛然意识到生命之脆弱，许多人在这种意外中丧生。
sentences.pinyin: Zài shēng sǐ yī xiàn jiān, tā měng rán yì shí dào shēng mìng zhī cuì ruò, xǔ duō rén zài zhè zhǒng yì wài zhōng sàng shēng.
sentences.english: In the moment between life and death, he suddenly realized the fragility of life; many people lose their lives in such accidents.

sentences.chinese: 幸运的是，他被一棵古松接住，虽然受了伤，但免于死亡。
sentences.pinyin: Xìng yùn de shì, tā bèi yī kē gǔ sōng jiē zhù, suī rán shòu le shāng, dàn miǎn yú sǐ wáng.
sentences.english: Fortunately, he was caught by an ancient pine tree; although injured, he was exempt from death.

sentences.chinese: 他躺在树上，看着周围的环境，心中产生了一种奇怪的解脱感。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tǎng zài shù shàng, kàn zhe zhōu wéi de huán jìng, xīn zhōng chǎn shēng le yī zhǒng qí guài de jiě tuō gǎn.
sentences.english: Lying on the tree, he looked at the surroundings, and a strange sense of liberation arose in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 他决定删除心中所有的执念，去除那些毫无意义的贪欲。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué dìng shān chú xīn zhōng suǒ yǒu de zhí niàn, qù chú nà xiē háo wú yì yì de tān yù.
sentences.english: He decided to delete all obsessions in his heart and remove those meaningless greeds.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，之前的成功其实是一种幻象，而现在的失败反而让他看清了自我。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, zhī qián de chéng gōng qí shí shì yī zhǒng huàn xiàng, ér xiàn zài de shī bài fǎn ér ràng tā kàn qīng le zì wǒ.
sentences.english: He realized that previous success was actually an illusion, and current failure instead allowed him to see himself clearly.

sentences.chinese: 他不再追求那些能让他维持体面的职位，也不在乎是否会被免职或免除责任。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zài zhuī qiú nà xiē néng ràng tā wéi chí tǐ miàn de zhí wèi, yě bù zài hū shì fǒu huì bèi miǎn zhí huò miǎn chú zé rèn.
sentences.english: He no longer pursued those positions that could maintain his dignity, nor did he care whether he would be sacked or excused from responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 他发现，当一个人失去了所有，反而获得了真正的自由。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn, dāng yī gè rén shī qù le suǒ yǒu, fǎn ér huò dé le zhēn zhèng de zì yóu.
sentences.english: He discovered that when a person loses everything, they instead gain true freedom.

sentences.chinese: 他开始在山中修行，试图通过简单的生活来减弱对物质的依赖。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāi shǐ zài shān zhōng xiū xíng, shì tú tōng guò jiǎn dān de shēng huó lái jiǎn ruò duì wù zhì de yī lài.
sentences.english: He began to practice in the mountains, trying to weaken his dependence on material things through a simple life.

sentences.chinese: 他不再担心被这个快节奏的社会剔除，也不在乎是否已经出局。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zài dān xīn bèi zhè gè kuài jié zòu de shè huì tī chú, yě bù zài hū shì fǒu yǐ jīng chū jú.
sentences.english: He no longer worried about being weeded out by this fast-paced society, nor did he care if he had already been eliminated.

sentences.chinese: 有一天，他遇到了一位同样在山中隐居的老人。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu yī tiān, tā yù dào le yī wèi tóng yàng zài shān zhōng yǐn jū de lǎo rén.
sentences.english: One day, he met an old man who was also living in seclusion in the mountains.

sentences.chinese: 老人告诉他，很多世俗的欲望其实就像变质的食物，虽然看起来诱人，但会让人中毒。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén gào sù tā, hěn duō shì sú de yù wàng qí shí jiù xiàng biàn zhì de shí wù, suī rán kàn qǐ lái yòu rén, dàn huì ràng rén zhòng dú.
sentences.english: The old man told him that many worldly desires are actually like deteriorated food; although they look tempting, they can poison a person.

sentences.chinese: 林远听后大笑，觉得自己之前在名利场中吃亏吃得太惨。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuǎn tīng hòu dà xiào, jué dé zì jǐ zhī qián zài míng lì chǎng zhōng chī kuī chī dé tài cǎn.
sentences.english: Lin Yuan laughed after hearing this, feeling that he had suffered too many losses in the pursuit of fame and wealth.

sentences.chinese: 他想起曾经为了升职而不得不下台的竞争对手，心中竟没有一丝快感。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ céng jīng wèi le shēng zhí ér bù dé bù xià tái de jìng zhēng duì shǒu, xīn zhōng jìng méi yǒu yī sī kuài gǎn.
sentences.english: He thought of the competitors who had to step down to get a promotion, and there was not a shred of pleasure in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，权力就像一件沉重的外套，现在他终于可以把它卸下来了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, quán lì jiù xiàng yī jiàn chén zhòng de wài tào, xiàn zài tā zhōng yú kě yǐ bǎ tā xiè xià lái le.
sentences.english: He realized that power is like a heavy coat; now he could finally remove it.

sentences.chinese: 他在山中建立了一个小小的图书馆，收集那些被世人丢弃的古籍。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài shān zhōng jiàn lì le yī gè xiǎo xiǎo de tú shū guǎn, shōu jí nà xiē bèi shì rén diū qì de gǔ jí.
sentences.english: He established a small library in the mountains, collecting ancient books discarded by the world.

sentences.chinese: 他小心地保存这些书籍，防止它们丢失在时间的尘埃里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎo xīn de bǎo cún zhè xiē shū jí, fáng zhǐ tā men diū shī zài shí jiān de chén āi lǐ.
sentences.english: He carefully preserved these books to prevent them from being misplaced in the dust of time.

sentences.chinese: 他不再试图去控制什么，甚至不再担心政府会取缔他的小图书馆。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zài shì tú qù kòng zhì shén me, shèn zhì bù zài dān xīn zhèng fǔ huì qǔ dì tā de xiǎo tú shū guǎn.
sentences.english: He no longer tried to control anything, and did not even worry that the government would crack down on his small library.

sentences.chinese: 他学会了后退，学会了在安静中寻找力量。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xué huì le hòu tuì, xué huì le zài ā jìng zhōng xún zhǎo lì liàng.
sentences.english: He learned to fall back, and learned to find strength in silence.

sentences.chinese: 随着时间的推移，他内心的焦虑开始回落，生活变得平静而简单。
sentences.pinyin: Suí zhe shí jiān de tuī yí, tā nèi xīn de jiāo lǜ kāi shǐ huí luò, shēng huó biàn dé píng jìng ér jiǎn dān.
sentences.english: As time passed, the anxiety in his heart began to fall back, and life became peaceful and simple.

sentences.chinese: 直到有一天，他收到了一封信，告知他曾经的工厂被重新收购，并愿意减免他的部分债务。
sentences.pinyin: Zhí dào yǒu yī tiān, tā shōu dào le yī fēng xìn, gào zhī tā céng jīng de gōng chǎng bèi chóng xīn shōu gòu, bìng yuàn yì jiǎn miǎn tā de bù fèn zhài wù.
sentences.english: Until one day, he received a letter informing him that his former factory had been re-acquired and was willing to waive part of his debt.

sentences.chinese: 面对这个诱惑，林远只是淡淡地笑了笑。
sentences.pinyin: Miàn duì zhè gè yòu huò, Lín Yuǎn zhǐ shì dàn dàn de xiào le xiào.
sentences.english: Facing this temptation, Lin Yuan only smiled faintly.

sentences.chinese: 他决定中止与过去的所有联系，不再回头看那个喧嚣的城市。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué dìng zhōng zhǐ yǔ guò qù de suǒ yǒu lián xì, bù zài huí tóu kàn nà gè xiāo xuō de chéng shì.
sentences.english: He decided to cease all contact with the past and no longer look back at that bustling city.

sentences.chinese: 他不需要任何形式的补偿，因为他已经找回了丢失的灵魂。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù xū yào rèn hé xíng shì de bǔ cháng, yīn wèi tā yǐ jīng zhǎo huí le diū diào de líng hún.
sentences.english: He did not need any form of compensation because he had found his lost soul.

sentences.chinese: 他把最后一件旧衣服丢掉，换上了粗布麻衣。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ zuì hòu yī jiàn jiù yī fú diū diào, huàn shàng le cū bù má yī.
sentences.english: He threw away the last piece of old clothing and changed into coarse hemp clothes.

sentences.chinese: 他对着山谷大喊一声，仿佛把所有的痛苦都释放了出来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì zhe shān gǔ dà hǎn yī shēng, fǎng fú bǎ suǒ yǒu de tòng kǔ dōu shì fàng le chū lái.
sentences.english: He gave a loud shout toward the valley, as if releasing all his pain.

sentences.chinese: 一位路过的旅人问他：“你为什么在这里？”
sentences.pinyin: Yī wèi lù guò de lǚ rén wèn tā: "Nǐ wèi shén me zài zhè lǐ?"
sentences.english: A passing traveler asked him, "Why are you here?"

sentences.chinese: 林远回答道：“别提了，我只是在寻找回家的路。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuǎn huí dá dào: "Bié tí le, wǒ zhǐ shì zài xún zhǎo huí jiā de lù."
sentences.english: Lin Yuan replied, "Say no more, I am just looking for the way home."

sentences.chinese: 随后，他礼貌地向旅人告辞，转身走入深林。
sentences.pinyin: Suí hòu, tā lǐ mào de xiàng lǚ rén gào cí, zhuǎn shēn zǒu rù shēn lín.
sentences.english: Afterward, he politely said goodbye to the traveler and turned to enter the deep forest.

sentences.chinese: 他不再是那个被社会定义的工程师，而是一个自由的行者。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zài shì nà gè bèi shè huì dìng yì de gōng chéng shī, ér shì yī gè zì yóu de xíng zhě.
sentences.english: He was no longer the engineer defined by society, but a free wanderer.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，真正的上升，往往是从学会如何优雅地倒下开始的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhī dào, zhēn zhèng de shàng shēng, wǎng wǎng shì cóng xué huì rú hé yōu yǎ de dǎo xià kāi shǐ de.
sentences.english: He knew that true ascent often begins from learning how to collapse gracefully.

stories.story_chinese:
在这座被时间遗忘的工业小城，空气总是干燥得让人嗓子发紧。
林远曾是这里的首席工程师，直到那场意外让他的职业生涯彻底报废。
那次事故导致工厂的核心设备失控，瞬间摧毁了半个车间。
虽然公司试图掩盖真相，但由于证据不足，他们暂时搁置了调查。
林远记得，当时的警报声震耳欲聋，像是一场暴烈的摇滚音乐会。
在混乱中，一名年轻的助手因为吸入毒气而晕倒，随后不幸失踪。
林远试图救他，但由于安全阀失效，他只能眼睁睁地看着火势蔓延。
火光瞬间烧毁了所有的档案，将无数人的希望化为灰烬。
事后，管理层为了推卸责任，将所有过错推到了林远身上。
他被无情地开除，所有关于他的荣誉都被撤换成了耻辱的标签。
他在失落中徘徊了三年，生活陷入了某种精神上的崩溃。
他开始排斥社交，把自己关在阴暗的房间里，仿佛在等待某种毁灭。
为了生存，他接了一些零碎的修理活，但开销巨大，几乎无法维持生活。
他必须在饮食上严格忌口，因为长期的压力让他患上了严重的胃病。
他看着镜子里的自己，眼神空洞，仿佛已经在精神上失明。
有一天，他在旧货市场发现了一台被砸得破碎的旧打字机。
他决定用这台机器记录下当年的真相，试图破除那些谎言的枷锁。
他不再推辞那些危险的调查请求，决定揭露当年事故的内幕。
他发现，当年公司为了节省成本，竟然废除了关键的安全检查条例。
这种对生命的漠视，最终导致了整个生产线的灭亡。
林远意识到，如果不将这些罪恶扫除，悲剧将会再次上演。
他开始搜集证据，决定打倒那个依然在权力顶端把持的总经理。
那个总经理是个极其狠辣的人，信奉斩草除根的哲学。
他试图用金钱收买林远，但林远将这些诱惑全部撇在脑后。
他抛开所有的恐惧，将那些被刻意省略的细节一一还原。
然而，对方的报复迅速到来，林远的住所被神秘人潜入并毁坏。
他的所有资料被抢走，他感觉自己的世界再次破碎。
在绝望的边缘，他差点屈服于对方的威胁，但最后时刻他挺住了。
他想起那个失踪的助手，如果现在止步，那孩子就永远无法被找到。
他明白，在这个弱肉强食的体系中，不进则会被淘汰。
他决定采取极端措施，在股东大会上公开所有证据。
他不再允许对方通过简单的报销费用来掩盖非法交易。
他要清除掉所有腐败的根源，让那些贪婪者彻底灭绝他们的野心。
会议现场，当他拿出那份绝密文件时，总经理的脸色变得惨白。
对方试图用权力将其撤职，但此时舆论已经失控。
愤怒的员工们不再怠工，而是齐声要求公正。
警察迅速进入会场，将涉事人员疏散，并对主谋实施了抓捕。
虽然法律不会枪毙他，但他的政治生命已经彻底被歼灭。
林远看着对方被带走，心中积压多年的沉重感终于消失了。
他意识到，只有面对残缺的现实，才能迎来真正的重生。
他将那些陈旧的恨意搁在心底，不再让它们折磨自己。
他抛弃了过去的阴影，决定离开这座死气沉沉的小城。
他开车离开时，发动机突然熄火，他苦笑了一声，觉得这是某种预兆。
他终于明白，有些东西一旦毁坏，就再也无法原样修复。
但破灭的幻想往往是清醒的开始。
他不再试图挽回那些失去的岁月，而是看向远方。
他知道，只要勇气不灭，生命就不会在绝望中灭亡。
他把最后一张旧照片扔进火堆，看着它在火焰中消失。
他不再需要任何证明，因为真相本身就是最强的武器。
他轻快地走向车站，将所有的沉重都留在了身后。
这座城市的旧章被废除，一个新的黎明正在地平线上升起。
林远深吸一口气，向着未知的未来坚定地走去。

stories.story_pinyin:
Zài zhè zuò bèi shí jiān yí wàng de gōng yè xiǎo chéng, kōng qì zǒng shì gān zào dé ràng rén sǎng zi fā jǐn.
Lín Yuǎn céng shì zhè lǐ de shǒu xí gōng chéng shī, zhí dào nà chǎng yì wài ràng tā de zhí yè shēng yá chè dǐ bào fèi.
Nà cì shì gù dǎo zhì gōng chǎng de hé xīn shè bèi shī kòng, shùn jiān cuī huǐ le bàn gè chē jiān.
Suī rán gōng sī shì tú yǎn gài zhēn xiàng, dàn yóu yú zhèng jù bù zú, tā men zàn shí gē zhì le diào chá.
Lín Yuǎn jì dé, dāng shí de jǐng bào shēng zhèn ěr dù lún, xiàng shì yì chǎng bào liè de yáo gǔn yīn yuè huì.
Zài hùn luàn zhōng, yì míng nián qīng de zhù shǒu yīn wèi xī rù dú qì ér yūn dǎo, suí hòu bù xìng shī zōng.
Lín Yuǎn shì tú jiù tā, dàn yóu yú ān quán fá shī xiào, tā zhǐ néng yǎn zhèng zhèng de kàn zhe huǒ shì mán yán.
Huǒ guāng shùn jiān shāo huǐ le suǒ yǒu de dàng àn, jiāng wú shù rén de xī wàng huà wéi huī jìn.
Shì hòu, guǎn lǐ céng wèi le tuī xiè zé rèn, jiāng suǒ yǒu guò cuò tuī dào le Lín Yuǎn shēn shang.
Tā bèi wú qíng de kāi chú, suǒ yǒu guān yú tā de róng yù dōu bèi chè huàn chéng le chǐ rǔ de biāo qiān.
Tā zài shī luò zhōng pái huán le sān nián, shēng huó xiàn rù le mǒu zhǒng jīng shén shàng de bēng kuì.
Tā kāi shǐ pái chì shè jiāo, bǎ zì jǐ guān zài yīn àn de fáng jiān lǐ, fǎng fú zài děng dài mǒu zhǒng huǐ miè.
Tā wèi le shēng cún, jiē le yì xiē líng suì de xiū lǐ huó, dàn kāi xiāo jù dà, jī hū wú fǎ wéi chí shēng huó.
Tā bì xū zài yǐn shí shàng yán gé jì kǒu, yīn wèi cháng qī de yā lì ràng tā huàn shàng le yán zhòng de wèi bìng.
Tā kàn zhe jìng zi lǐ de zì jǐ, yǎn shén kōng dòng, fǎng fú yǐ jīng zài jīng shén shàng shī míng.
Yǒu yì tiān, tā zài jiù huò shì chǎng fā xiàn le yì tái bèi zá dé pò suì de jiù dǎ zì jī.
Tā jué dìng yòng zhè tái jī qì jì lù xià dāng nián de zhēn xiàng, shì tú pò chú nà xiē huǎng yán de jiǎ suǒ.
Tā bù zài tuī cí nà xiē wēi xiǎn de diào chá qǐng qiú, jué dìng jiē lù dāng nián shì gù de nèi mù.
Tā fā xiàn, dāng nián gōng sī wèi le jié shěng chéng běn, jìng rán fèi chú le guān jiàn de ān quán jiǎn chá tiáo lì.
Zhè zhǒng duì shēng mìng de mò shì, zuì zhōng dǎo zhì le zhěng gè shēng chǎn xiàn de miè wáng.
Lín Yuǎn yì shí dào, rú guǒ bù jiāng zhè xiē zuì è sǎo chú, bēi jù jiāng huì zài cì shàng yǎn.
Tā kāi shǐ sōu jí zhèng jù, jué dìng dǎ dǎo nà gè yí rán zài quán lì dǐng duān bǎ chí de zǒng jīng lǐ.
Nà gè zǒng jīng lǐ shì gè jí qí hěn là de rén, xìn fèng zhǎn cǎo chú gēn de zhé xué.
Tā shì tú yòng jīn qián shōu mǎi Lín Yuǎn, dàn Lín Yuǎn jiāng zhè xiē yòu huò quán bù piē zài nǎo hòu.
Tā pāo kāi suǒ yǒu de kǒng jù, jiāng nà xiē bèi kè yì shěng lüè de xì jié yì yī huán yuán.
 rán ér, duì fāng de bào fù xùn sù dào lái, Lín Yuǎn de zhù sō bèi mì mí rén qián rù bìng huǐ huài.
Tā de suǒ yǒu zī liào bèi qiǎng zǒu, tā gǎn jué zì jǐ de shì jiè zài cì pò suì.
Zài jué wàng de biān yuán, tā chà diǎn qū fú yú duì fāng de wēi xié, dàn zuì hòu shí kè tā tǐng zhù le.
Tā xiǎng qǐ nà gè shī zōng de zhù shǒu, rú guǒ xiàn zài zhǐ bù, nà hái zi jiù yǒng yuǎn wú fǎ bèi zhǎo dào.
Tā míng bái, zài zhè gè ruò ròu shí gǔ de tǐ xì zhōng, bù jìn zé huì bèi táo tài.
Tā jué dìng cǎi qǔ jí duān cuò shī, zài gǔ dōng dà huì shàng gōng kāi suǒ yǒu zhèng jù.
Tā bù zài yǔn xǔ duì fāng tōng guò jiǎn dān de bào xiāo fèi yòng lái yǎn gài fēi fǎ jiāo yì.
Tā yào qīng chú diào suǒ yǒu fǔ bài de gēn yuán, ràng nà xiē tān lán zhě chè dǐ miè jué tā men de yě xīn.
Huì yì xiàn chǎng, dāng tā ná chū nà fèn jué mì wén jiàn shí, zǒng jīng lǐ de liǎn sè biàn dé cǎn bái.
Duì fāng shì tú yòng quán lì jiāng qí chè zhí, dàn cǐ shí yú lùn yǐ jīng shī kòng.
Fèn nù de yuán gōng men bù zài dài gōng, ér shì qí shēng yào qǐ gōng zhèng.
Jǐng chá xùn sù jìn rù huì chǎng, jiāng shè shì rén yuán shū sàn, bìng duì zhǔ mó shí shī le zhuā bǔ.
Suī rán fǎ lǜ bù huì qiāng bì tā, dàn tā de zhèng zhì shēng mìng yǐ jīng chè dǐ bèi jiān miè.
Lín Yuǎn kàn zhe duì fāng bèi dài zǒu, xīn zhōng jī yā duō nián de chén zhòng gǎn zhōng yú xiāo shì le.
Tā yì shí dào, zhǐ yǒu miàn duì cán quē de xiàn shí, cái néng yíng lái zhēn zhèng de chóng shēng.
Tā jiāng nà xiē chén jiù de hèn yì gē zài xīn dǐ, bù zài ràng tā men zhé mó zì jǐ.
Tā pāo qì le guò qù de yīn yǐng, jué dìng lí kāi zhè zuò sǐ qì chén chén de xiǎo chéng.
Tā kāi chē lí kāi shí, fǎ dòng jī tū rán xī huǒ, tā kǔ xiào le yì shēng, jué dé zhè shì mǒu zhǒng yù zhào.
Tā zhōng yú míng bái, yǒu xiē dōng xī yí dàn huǐ huài, jiù zài yě wú fǎ yuán yàng xiū fù.
Dàn pò miè de huàn xiǎng wǎng wǎng shì qīng xǐng de kāi shǐ.
Tā bù zài shì tú wǎn huí nà xiē shī qù de suì yuè, ér shì kàn xiàng yuǎn fāng.
Tā zhī dào, zhǐ yào yǒng qì bù miè, shēng mìng jiù bù huì zài jué wàng zhōng miè wáng.
Tā bǎ zuì hòu yì zhāng jiù zhào piàn rēng jìn huǒ duī, kàn zhe tā zài huǒ yàn zhōng xiāo shì.
Tā bù zài xū yào rèn hé zhèng míng, yīn wèi zhēn xiàng běn shēn jiù shì zuì qiáng de wǔ qì.
Tā qīng kuài de zǒu xiàng chē zhàn, jiāng suǒ yǒu de chén zhòng dōu liú zài le shēn hòu.
Zhè zuò chéng shì de jiù zhāng bèi fèi chú, yí gè xīn de lí míng zhèng zài dì píng xiàn shàng shēng qǐ.
Lín Yuǎn shēn xī yì kǒu qì, xiàng zhe wèi zhī de wèi lái jiān dìng de zǒu qù.

Yǒu yì tiān, tā zài jiù huò shì chǎng fā xiàn le yì tái bèi zá dé pò suì de jiù dǎ zì jī.
Tā jué dìng yòng zhè tái jī qì jì lù xià dāng nián de zhēn xiàng, shì tú pò chú nà xiē huǎng yán de jiǎ suǒ.

Zhè zhǒng duì shēng mìng de mò shì, zuì zhōng dǎo zhì le zhěng gè shēng chǎn xiàn de miè wáng.
Lín Yuǎn yì shí dào, rú guǒ bù jiāng zhè xiē zuì è sǎo chú, bēi jù jiāng huì zài cì shàng yǎn.

Nà gè zǒng jīng lǐ shì gè jí qí hěn là de rén, xìn fèng zhǎn cǎo chú gēn de zhé xué.

Tā pāo kāi suǒ yǒu de kǒng jù, jiāng nà xiē bèi kè yì shěng lüè de xì jié yì yī huán yuán.

Tā de suǒ yǒu zī liào bèi qiǎng zǒu, tā gǎn jué zì jǐ de shì jiè zài cì pò suì.

Tā bù zài yǔn xǔ duì fāng tōng guò jiǎn dān de bào xiāo fèi yòng lái yǎn gài fēi fǎ jiāo yì.
Tā yào qīng chú diào suǒ yǒu fǔ bài de gēn yuán, ràng nà xiē tān lán zhě chè dǐ miè jué tā men de yě xīn.
Huì yì xiàn chǎng, dāng tā ná chū nà fèn jué mì wén jiàn shí, zǒng jīng lǐ de liǎn sè biàn dé cǎn bái.
Duì fāng shì tú yòng quán lì jiāng qí chè zhí, dàn cǐ shí yú lùn yǐ jīng shī kòng.
Fèn nù de yuán gōng men bù zài dài gōng, ér shì qí shēng yào qǐ gōng zhèng.
Jǐng chá xùn sù jìn rù huì chǎng, jiāng shè shì rén yuán shū sàn, bìng duì zhǔ mó shí shī le zhuā bǔ.
Suī rán fǎ lǜ bù huì qiāng bì tā, dàn tā de zhèng zhì shēng mìng yǐ jīng chè dǐ bèi jiān miè.
Lín Yuǎn kàn zhe duì fāng bèi dài zǒu, xīn zhōng jī yā duō nián de chén zhòng gǎn zhōng yú xiāo shì le.
Tā yì shí dào, zhǐ yǒu miàn duì cán quē de xiàn shí, cái néng yíng lái zhēn zhèng de chóng shēng.
Tā jiāng nà xiē chén jiù de hèn yì gē zài xīn dǐ, bù zài ràng tā men zhé mó zì jǐ.
Tā pāo qì le guò qù de yīn yǐng, jué dìng lí kāi zhè zuò sǐ qì chén chén de xiǎo chéng.
Tā kāi chē lí kāi shí, fǎ dòng jī tū rán xī huǒ, tā kǔ xiào le yì shēng, jué dé zhè shì mǒu zhǒng yù zhào.
Tā zhōng yú míng bái, yǒu xiē dōng xī yí dàn huǐ huài, jiù zài yě wú fǎ yuán yàng xiū fù.
Dàn pò miè de huàn xiǎng wǎng wǎng shì qīng xǐng de kāi shǐ.
Tā bù zài shì tú wǎn huí nà xiē shī qù de suì yuè, ér shì kàn xiàng yuǎn fāng.
Tā zhī dào, zhǐ yào yǒng qì bù miè, shēng mìng jiù bù huì zài jué wàng zhōng miè wáng.
Tā bǎ zuì hòu yì zhāng jiù zhào piàn rēng jìn huǒ duī, kàn zhe tā zài huǒ yàn zhōng xiāo shì.
Tā bù zài xū yào rèn hé zhèng míng, yīn wèi zhēn xiàng běn shēn jiù shì zuì qiáng de wǔ qì.
Tā qīng kuài de zǒu xiàng chē zhàn, jiāng suǒ yǒu de chén zhòng dōu liú zài le shēn hòu.
Zhè zuò chéng shì de jiù zhāng bèi fèi chú, yí gè xīn de lí míng zhèng zài dì píng xiàn shàng shēng qǐ.
Lín Yuǎn shēn xī yì kǒu qì, xiàng zhe wèi zhī de wèi lái jiān dìng de zǒu qù.
stories.story_english:
In this industrial town forgotten by time, the air was always so dry that it made one's throat tighten.
Lin Yuan was once the chief engineer here, until an accident completely scrapped his professional career.
That accident caused the factory's core equipment to go out of control, destroying half the workshop in an instant.
Although the company tried to cover up the truth, they temporarily shelved the investigation due to insufficient evidence.
Lin Yuan remembered that the alarm at the time was deafening, like a violent rock 'n' roll concert.
In the chaos, a young assistant fainted due to inhaling toxic gas and subsequently disappeared.
Lin Yuan tried to save him, but because the safety valve failed, he could only watch the fire spread.
The flames instantly burned down all the archives, turning the hopes of countless people into ashes.
Afterward, to shift the responsibility, the management pushed all the blame onto Lin Yuan.
He was ruthlessly fired, and all his honors were replaced with labels of shame.
He wandered in a sense of loss for three years, and his life fell into a kind of mental collapse.
He began to reject socializing, locking himself in a dark room as if waiting for some kind of destruction.
To survive, he took some odd repair jobs, but the expenses were huge, making it almost impossible to sustain his life.
He had to strictly avoid certain foods in his diet because long-term stress had given him a severe stomach illness.
He looked at himself in the mirror, eyes hollow, as if he had already become blind spiritually.
One day, he found an old typewriter in a second-hand market that had been smashed to pieces.
He decided to use this machine to record the truth of those years, attempting to break the shackles of those lies.
He no longer declined dangerous investigation requests, deciding to expose the inside story of the accident.
He discovered that the company had actually abolished key safety inspection regulations to save costs.
This indifference toward life eventually led to the perish of the entire production line.
Lin Yuan realized that if these evils were not swept away, the tragedy would happen again.
He began collecting evidence, determined to overthrow the general manager who still held power at the top.
That general manager was an extremely ruthless person who believed in the philosophy of eliminating the roots.
He tried to buy Lin Yuan with money, but Lin Yuan cast all these temptations aside.
He threw away all fear and restored the details that had been deliberately left out one by one.
However, the opponent's retaliation arrived quickly, and Lin Yuan's residence was broken into and damaged by mysterious people.
All his materials were stolen, and he felt his world shatter once again.
On the edge of despair, he almost succumbed to the opponent's threats, but he held on at the last moment.
He thought of that missing assistant; if he stopped now, that child would never be found.
He understood that in this dog-eat-dog system, if one does not advance, one will be weeded out.
He decided to take extreme measures and make all evidence public at the shareholders' meeting.
He no longer allowed the opponent to cover up illegal transactions through simple expense reimbursements.
He wanted to clear away all the roots of corruption and completely exterminate the ambitions of those greedy people.
At the meeting, when he produced that top-secret document, the general manager's face turned pale.
The opponent tried to use power to dismiss him, but by then public opinion had gone out of control.
The angry employees stopped slacking off and demanded justice in unison.
Police quickly entered the venue, evacuated the personnel involved, and arrested the mastermind.
Although the law would not execute him by firing squad, his political life had been completely annihilated.
Lin Yuan watched the opponent be taken away, and the heaviness accumulated in his heart for years finally disappeared.
He realized that only by facing a ruined reality could one welcome a true rebirth.
He placed those old hatreds at the bottom of his heart, no longer letting them torture him.
He abandoned the shadows of the past and decided to leave this lifeless small town.
As he drove away, the engine suddenly stalled; he gave a bitter smile, feeling it was some kind of omen.
He finally understood that some things, once devastated, can never be repaired to their original state.
But shattered illusions are often the beginning of awakening.
He no longer tried to reclaim those lost years but looked toward the distance.
He knew that as long as courage did not perish, life would not perish in despair.
He threw the last old photo into the fire, watching it disappear in the flames.
He no longer needed any proof, for the truth itself was the strongest weapon.
He walked lightly toward the station, leaving all the heaviness behind.
The old chapter of this city was abolished, and a new dawn was rising on the horizon.
Lin Yuan took a deep breath and walked firmly toward the unknown future.

sentences.english: Lin Yuan realized that if these evils were not swept away, the tragedy would happen again.

sentences.chinese: 他开始搜集证据，决定打倒那个依然在权力顶端把持的总经理。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāi shǐ sōu jí zhèng jù, jué dìng dǎ dǎo nà gè yí rán zài quán lì dǐng duān bǎ chí de zǒng jīng lǐ.
sentences.english: He began collecting evidence, determined to overthrow the general manager who still held power at the top.

sentences.chinese: 那个总经理是个极其狠辣的人，信奉斩草除根的哲学。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè zǒng jīng lǐ shì gè jí qí hěn là de rén, xìn fèng zhǎn cǎo chú gēn de zhé xué.
sentences.english: That general manager was an extremely ruthless person who believed in the philosophy of eliminating the roots.

sentences.chinese: 他试图用金钱收买林远，但林远将这些诱惑全部撇在脑后。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì tú yòng jīn qián shōu mǎi Lín Yuǎn, dàn Lín Yuǎn jiāng zhè xiē yòu huò quán bù piē zài nǎo hòu.
sentences.english: He tried to buy Lin Yuan with money, but Lin Yuan cast all these temptations aside.

sentences.chinese: 他抛开所有的恐惧，将那些被刻意省略的细节一一还原。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pāo kāi suǒ yǒu de kǒng jù, jiāng nà xiē bèi kè yì shěng lüè de xì jié yì yī huán yuán.
sentences.english: He threw away all fear and restored the details that had been deliberately left out one by one.

sentences.chinese: 然而，对方的报复迅速到来，林远的住所被神秘人潜入并毁坏。
sentences.pinyin: rán ér, duì fāng de bào fù xùn sù dào lái, Lín Yuǎn de zhù sō bèi mì mí rén qián rù bìng huǐ huài.
sentences.english: However, the opponent's retaliation arrived quickly, and Lin Yuan's residence was broken into and damaged by mysterious people.

sentences.chinese: 他的所有资料被抢走，他感觉自己的世界再次破碎。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de suǒ yǒu zī liào bèi qiǎng zǒu, tā gǎn jué zì jǐ de shì jiè zài cì pò suì.
sentences.english: All his materials were stolen, and he felt his world shatter once again.

sentences.chinese: 在绝望的边缘，他差点屈服于对方的威胁，但最后时刻他挺住了。
sentences.pinyin: Zài jué wàng de biān yuán, tā chà diǎn qū fú yú duì fāng de wēi xié, dàn zuì hòu shí kè tā tǐng zhù le.
sentences.english: On the edge of despair, he almost succumbed to the opponent's threats, but he held on at the last moment.

sentences.chinese: 他想起那个失踪的助手，如果现在止步，那孩子就永远无法被找到。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ nà gè shī zōng de zhù shǒu, rú guǒ xiàn zài zhǐ bù, nà hái zi jiù yǒng yuǎn wú fǎ bèi zhǎo dào.
sentences.english: He thought of that missing assistant; if he stopped now, that child would never be found.

sentences.chinese: 他明白，在这个弱肉强食的体系中，不进则会被淘汰。
sentences.pinyin: Tā míng bái, zài zhè gè ruò ròu shí gǔ de tǐ xì zhōng, bù jìn zé huì bèi táo tài.
sentences.english: He understood that in this dog-eat-dog system, if one does not advance, one will be weeded out.

sentences.chinese: 他决定采取极端措施，在股东大会上公开所有证据。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué dìng cǎi qǔ jí duān cuò shī, zài gǔ dōng dà huì shàng gōng kāi suǒ yǒu zhèng jù.
sentences.english: He decided to take extreme measures and make all evidence public at the shareholders' meeting.

sentences.chinese: 他不再允许对方通过简单的报销费用来掩盖非法交易。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zài yǔn xǔ duì fāng tōng guò jiǎn dān de bào xiāo fèi yòng lái yǎn gài fēi fǎ jiāo yì.
sentences.english: He no longer allowed the opponent to cover up illegal transactions through simple expense reimbursements.

sentences.chinese: 他要清除掉所有腐败的根源，让那些贪婪者彻底灭绝他们的野心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yào qīng chú diào suǒ yǒu fǔ bài de gēn yuán, ràng nà xiē tān lán zhě chè dǐ miè jué tā men de yě xīn.
sentences.english: He wanted to clear away all the roots of corruption and completely exterminate the ambitions of those greedy people.

sentences.chinese: 会议现场，当他拿出那份绝密文件时，总经理的脸色变得惨白。
sentences.pinyin: Huì yì xiàn chǎng, dāng tā ná chū nà fèn jué mì wén jiàn shí, zǒng jīng lǐ de liǎn sè biàn dé cǎn bái.
sentences.english: At the meeting, when he produced that top-secret document, the general manager's face turned pale.

sentences.chinese: 对方试图用权力将其撤职，但此时舆论已经失控。
sentences.pinyin: Duì fāng shì tú yòng quán lì jiāng qí chè zhí, dàn cǐ shí yú lùn yǐ jīng shī kòng.
sentences.english: The opponent tried to use power to dismiss him, but by then public opinion had gone out of control.

sentences.chinese: 愤怒的员工们不再怠工，而是齐声要求公正。
sentences.pinyin: Fèn nù de yuán gōng men bù zài dài gōng, ér shì qí shēng yào qǐ gōng zhèng.
sentences.english: The angry employees stopped slacking off and demanded justice in unison.

sentences.chinese: 警察迅速进入会场，将涉事人员疏散，并对主谋实施了抓捕。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐng chá xùn sù jìn rù huì chǎng, jiāng shè shì rén yuán shū sàn, bìng duì zhǔ mó shí shī le zhuā bǔ.
sentences.english: Police quickly entered the venue, evacuated the personnel involved, and arrested the mastermind.

sentences.chinese: 虽然法律不会枪毙他，但他的政治生命已经彻底被歼灭。
sentences.pinyin: Suī rán fǎ lǜ bù huì qiāng bì tā, dàn tā de zhèng zhì shēng mìng yǐ jīng chè dǐ bèi jiān miè.
sentences.english: Although the law would not execute him by firing squad, his political life had been completely annihilated.

sentences.chinese: 林远看着对方被带走，心中积压多年的沉重感终于消失了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuǎn kàn zhe duì fāng bèi dài zǒu, xīn zhōng jī yā duō nián de chén zhòng gǎn zhōng yú xiāo shì le.
sentences.english: Lin Yuan watched the opponent be taken away, and the heaviness accumulated in his heart for years finally disappeared.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，只有面对残缺的现实，才能迎来真正的重生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, zhǐ yǒu miàn duì cán quē de xiàn shí, cái néng yíng lái zhēn zhèng de chóng shēng.
sentences.english: He realized that only by facing a ruined reality could one welcome a true rebirth.

sentences.chinese: 他将那些陈旧的恨意搁在心底，不再让它们折磨自己。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiāng nà xiē chén jiù de hèn yì gē zài xīn dǐ, bù zài ràng tā men zhé mó zì jǐ.
sentences.english: He placed those old hatreds at the bottom of his heart, no longer letting them torture him.

sentences.chinese: 他抛弃了过去的阴影，决定离开这座死气沉沉的小城。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pāo qì le guò qù de yīn yǐng, jué dìng lí kāi zhè zuò sǐ qì chén chén de xiǎo chéng.
sentences.english: He abandoned the shadows of the past and decided to leave this lifeless small town.

sentences.chinese: 他开车离开时，发动机突然熄火，他苦笑了一声，觉得这是某种预兆。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāi chē lí kāi shí, fǎ dòng jī tū rán xī huǒ, tā kǔ xiào le yì shēng, jué dé zhè shì mǒu zhǒng yù zhào.
sentences.english: As he drove away, the engine suddenly stalled; he gave a bitter smile, feeling it was some kind of omen.

sentences.chinese: 他终于明白，有些东西一旦毁坏，就再也无法原样修复。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhōng yú míng bái, yǒu xiē dōng xī yí dàn huǐ huài, jiù zài yě wú fǎ yuán yàng xiū fù.
sentences.english: He finally understood that some things, once devastated, can never be repaired to their original state.

sentences.chinese: 但破灭的幻想往往是清醒的开始。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn pò miè de huàn xiǎng wǎng wǎng shì qīng xǐng de kāi shǐ.
sentences.english: But shattered illusions are often the beginning of awakening.

sentences.chinese: 他不再试图挽回那些失去的岁月，而是看向远方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zài shì tú wǎn huí nà xiē shī qù de suì yuè, ér shì kàn xiàng yuǎn fāng.
sentences.english: He no longer tried to reclaim those lost years but looked toward the distance.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，只要勇气不灭，生命就不会在绝望中灭亡。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhī dào, zhǐ yào yǒng qì bù miè, shēng mìng jiù bù huì zài jué wàng zhōng miè wáng.
sentences.english: He knew that as long as courage did not perish, life would not perish in despair.

sentences.chinese: 他把最后一张旧照片扔进火堆，看着它在火焰中消失。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ zuì hòu yì zhāng jiù zhào piàn rēng jìn huǒ duī, kàn zhe tā zài huǒ yàn zhōng xiāo shì.
sentences.english: He threw the last old photo into the fire, watching it disappear in the flames.

sentences.chinese: 他不再需要任何证明，因为真相本身就是最强的武器。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zài xū yào rèn hé zhèng míng, yīn wèi zhēn xiàng běn shēn jiù shì zuì qiáng de wǔ qì.
sentences.english: He no longer needed any proof, for the truth itself was the strongest weapon.

sentences.chinese: 他轻快地走向车站，将所有的沉重都留在了身后。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qīng kuài de zǒu xiàng chē zhàn, jiāng suǒ yǒu de chén zhòng dōu liú zài le shēn hòu.
sentences.english: He walked lightly toward the station, leaving all the heaviness behind.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市的旧章被废除，一个新的黎明正在地平线上升起。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéng shì de jiù zhāng bèi fèi chú, yí gè xīn de lí míng zhèng zài dì píng xiàn shàng shēng qǐ.
sentences.english: The old chapter of this city was abolished, and a new dawn was rising on the horizon.

sentences.chinese: 林远深吸一口气，向着未知的未来坚定地走去。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuǎn shēn xī yì kǒu qì, xiàng zhe wèi zhī de wèi lái jiān dìng de zǒu qù.
sentences.english: Lin Yuan took a deep breath and walked firmly toward the unknown future.

stories.title_english: The Afterglow of the Old Capital
stories.story_chinese:
林远在这座古城生活了三十年，直到那场风暴摧毁了一切。
他曾是一名受人尊敬的档案管理员，但权力斗争让他被罢免了职务。
在那个阴沉的下午，上司冷漠地通知他被解雇了。
林远没有争辩，他选择直接辞去所有兼职，彻底离职。
他意识到，在这个充满尔虞我诈的环境中，他必须尽快脱身。
曾经的同僚们为了自保，纷纷与他绝缘，仿佛他变成了某种禁忌。
那些曾经的承诺在权力的碾压下被粉碎得体无完肤。
林远在办公室里收拾东西，心中却在思考如何销毁那些可能牵连他人的秘密文件。
他将那些敏感的名单一一销掉，确保没有任何痕迹遗留。
就在他准备离开时，一名年轻的助手突然脱口而出：“林老师，您真的要走吗？”
林远苦笑了一下，他知道在这个节骨眼上，任何犹豫都是危险的。
他不能退让，因为对方绝不会罢休，直到将他彻底驱逐出这个圈子。
他想起了自己的父亲，那位在学术界享有盛名的教授，在多年前突然逝世。
父亲临终前留下的日记中，记录了许多被历史遗忘的真相。
有些真相被刻意隔离在公众视野之外，而有些则被权贵们遗弃在故纸堆里。
林远想起自己年轻时曾因为追求纯粹的真理而选择退学，那时的他以为自由就在前方。
但现实总是让他缩在阴影中，小心翼翼地生存。
他记得当年那个秘密研究小组被强行解散时的绝望。
成员们四散奔逃，有些人像惊恐的鼠类一样窜向远方，试图在异乡生存。
林远在心中默默地将那些痛苦除去，只留下对真理的执着，除外的是那些无谓的愤怒。
他走出大楼，面对着这座城市的黄昏，感觉自己终于得到了解脱。
他不再害怕被辞退或被排挤，因为他已经没有什么可以失去的了。
他决定豁出去，将父亲留下的证据公之于众。
他知道这将是一场诀别，与他过去三十年安稳生活的诀别。
在证据提交给法院的那一刻，他没有退却，而是坚定地走进了光亮中。
尽管他可能会因为这次行动而面临法律的风险，甚至被强制隔离，但他不在乎。
他不再允许自己缺席于正义的审判之中。
他走在回家的路上，看着街道两旁古老的建筑，心中感到前所未有的平静。
那些被掩盖的谎言终将被揭穿，而他将不再是那个被遗弃的灵魂。
他回头看了一眼那座冰冷的办公大楼，轻声说：“再见。”

曾经的同僚们为了自保，纷纷与他绝缘，仿佛他变成了某种禁忌。
那些曾经的承诺在权力的碾压下被粉碎得体无完肤。
林远在办公室里收拾东西，心中却在思考如何销毁那些可能牵连他人的秘密文件。
他将那些敏感的名单一一销掉，确保没有任何痕迹遗留。
就在他准备离开时，一名年轻的助手突然脱口而出：“林老师，您真的要走吗？”
林远苦笑了一下，他知道在这个节骨眼上，任何犹豫都是危险的。
他不能退让，因为对方绝不会罢休，直到将他彻底驱逐出这个圈子。
他想起了自己的父亲，那位在学术界享有盛名的教授，在多年前突然逝世。
父亲临终前留下的日记中，记录了许多被历史遗忘的真相。
有些真相被刻意隔离在公众视野之外，而有些则被权贵们遗弃在故纸堆里。
林远想起自己年轻时曾因为追求纯粹的真理而选择退学，那时的他以为自由就在前方。
但现实总是让他缩在阴影中，小心翼翼地生存。
他记得当年那个秘密研究小组被强行解散时的绝望。
成员们四散奔逃，有些人像惊恐的鼠类一样窜向远方，试图在异乡生存。
林远在心中默默地将那些痛苦除去，只留下对真理的执着，除外的是那些无谓的愤怒。
他走出大楼，面对着这座城市的黄昏，感觉自己终于得到了解脱。
他不再害怕被辞退或被排挤，因为他已经没有什么可以失去的了。
他决定豁出去，将父亲留下的证据公之于众。
他知道这将是一场诀别，与他过去三十年安稳生活的诀别。
在证据提交给法院的那一刻，他没有退却，而是坚定地走进了光亮中。
尽管他可能会因为这次行动而面临法律的风险，甚至被强制隔离，但他不在乎。
他不再允许自己缺席于正义的审判之中。
他走在回家的路上，看着街道两旁古老的建筑，心中感到前所未有的平静。
那些被掩盖的谎言终将被揭穿，而他将不再是那个被遗弃的灵魂。
他回头看了一眼那座冰冷的办公大楼，轻声说：“再见。”
stories.story_pinyin:
Lín Yuǎn zài zhè zuò gǔ chéng shēng huó le sān shí nián, zhí dào nà chǎng fēng bào cuī huǐ le yī qiè.
Tā céng shì yī míng shòu rén zūn jìng de dàng àn guǎn lǐ yuán, dàn quán lì dòu zhēng ràng tā bèi bà miǎn le zhí wù.
Zài nà gè yīn chén de xià wǔ, shàng sī lěng mò de tōng zhī tā bèi jiě gù le.
Lín Yuǎn méi yǒu zhēng biàn, tā xuǎn zé zhí jiē cí qù suǒ yǒu jiān zhí, chè dǐ lí zhí.
Tā yì shí dào, zài zhè gè chōng mǎn ěr yú wǒ zhà de huán jìng zhōng, tā bì xū jǐn kuài tuō shēn.
Céng jīng de tóng liáo men wèi le zì bǎo, fēn fēn yǔ tā jué yuán, fǎng fú tā biàn chéng le mǒu zhǒng jìn jì.
Nà xiē céng jīng de chéng nuò zài quán lì de niǎn yā xià bèi fěn suì de tǐ wú wán fū.
Lín Yuǎn zài bàn gōng shì lǐ shōu shí dōng xī, xīn zhōng què zài sī kǎo rú hé xiāo huǐ nà xiē kě néng qiān lián tā rén de mì mì wén jiàn.
Tā jiāng nà xiē mǐn gǎn de míng dān yī yī xiāo diào, què bǎo méi yǒu rè nà gè hén jì yí liú.
Jiù zài tā zhǔn bèi lí kāi shí, yī míng nián qīng de zhù shǒu tū rán tuō kǒu ér chū: “Lín lǎo shī, nín zhēn de yào zǒu ma?”
Lín Yuǎn kǔ xiào le yī xià, tā zhī dào zài zhè gè jié gǔ niǎo shàng, rè nà gè hóu yù dōu shì wēi xiǎn de.
Tā bù néng tuì ràng, yīn wèi duì fāng jué bù huì bà xiū, zhí dào jiāng tā chè dǐ qū zhú chū zhè gè quān zi.
Tā xiǎng qǐ le zì jǐ de fù qīn, nà wèi zài xué shù jiè xiǎng yǒu shèng míng de jiào shòu, zài duō nián qián tū rán shì shì.
Fù qīn lín zhōng qián liú xià de rì jì zhōng, jì lù le xǔ duō bèi lì shǐ yí wàng de zhēn xiàng.
Yǒu xiē zhēn xiàng bèi kè yì gé lí zài gōng zhòng shì yě zhī wài, ér yǒu xiē zé bèi quán guì men yí qì zài gù zhǐ duī lǐ.
Lín Yuǎn xiǎng qǐ zì jǐ nián qīng shí céng yīn wèi zhuī qiú chún cuì de zhēn lǐ ér xuǎn zé tuì xué, nà shí de tā yǐ wéi zì yóu jiù zài qián fāng.
Dàn xiàn shí zǒng shì ràng tā suō zài yīn yǐng zhōng, xiǎo xīn yì yì de shēng cún.
Tā jì dé dāng nián nà gè mì mì yán jiū xiǎo zǔ bèi qiáng xíng jiě sàn shí de jué wàng.
Chéng yuán men sì sàn bēn táo, yǒu xiē rén xiàng jīng kǒng de shǔ lèi yī yàng cuàn xiàng yuǎn fāng, shì tú zài yì xiāng shēng cún.
Lín Yuǎn zài xīn zhōng mò mò de jiāng nà xiē tòng kǔ chú qù, zhǐ liú xià duì zhēn lǐ de zhí zhuó, chú wài de shì nà xiē wú wèi de fèn nù.
Tā zǒu chū dà lóu, miàn duì zhe zhè zuò chéng shì de huáng hūn, gǎn jué zì jǐ zhōng yú dé dào le jiě tuō.
Tā bù zài hài pà bèi cí tuì huò bèi pái jí, yīn wèi tā yǐ jīng méi yǒu shén me kě yǐ shī qù de le.
Tā jué dìng huō chu qu, jiāng fù qīn liú xià de zhèng jù gōng zhī yú zhòng.
Tā zhī dào zhè jiāng shì yī chǎng jué bié, yǔ tā guò qù sān shí nián ān wěn shēng huó de jué bié.
Zài zhèng jù tí jiāo gěi fǎ yuàn de nà yī kè, tā méi yǒu tuì què, ér shì jiān dìng de zǒu jìn le guāng liàng zhōng.
Jǐn guǎn tā kě néng huì yīn wèi zhè cì xíng dòng ér miàn lín fǎ lǜ de fēng xiǎn, shèn zhì bèi qiáng zhì gé lí, dàn tā bù zài hu.
Tā bù zài yǔn xǔ zì jǐ quē xí yú zhèng yì de shěn pàn zhī zhōng.
Tā zǒu zài huí jiā de lù shàng, kàn zhe jiē dào liǎng páng gǔ lǎo de jiàn zhù, xīn zhōng gǎn dào qián suǒ wèi yǒu de píng jìng.
Nà xiē bèi yǎn gài de huǎng yán zhōng jiāng bèi jiē chuān, ér tā jiāng bù zài shì nà gè bèi yí qì de líng hún.
Tā huí tóu kàn le yī yǎn nà zuò bīng lěng de bàn gōng dà lóu, qīng shēng shuō: “Zài jiàn.”

stories.story_english:
Lin Yuan had lived in this ancient city for thirty years, until that storm destroyed everything.
He was once a respected archivist, but power struggles led to his removal from office.
On that gloomy afternoon, his superior coldly notified him that he was being fired.
Lin Yuan did not argue; he chose to resign from all part-time jobs and leave his position completely.
He realized that in this environment full of intrigue, he had to free himself as quickly as possible.
Former colleagues, in order to protect themselves, cut off all contact with him as if he had become some kind of taboo.
Those former promises were crushed beyond repair under the pressure of power.
Lin Yuan packed his things in the office, while thinking about how to destroy the secret documents that might implicate others.
He cancelled the sensitive lists one by one, ensuring that no traces were left behind.
Just as he was preparing to leave, a young assistant suddenly blurted out: "Teacher Lin, are you really leaving?"
Lin Yuan gave a bitter smile; he knew that at this critical juncture, any hesitation was dangerous.
He could not back down, because the other party would not let it go until he was completely expelled from this circle.
He thought of his father, a professor of great renown in the academic world, who had passed away suddenly years ago.
In the diary his father left before death, many truths forgotten by history were recorded.
Some truths were deliberately isolated from public view, while others were abandoned by the powerful in piles of old papers.
Lin Yuan remembered how he had chosen to quit school in his youth in pursuit of pure truth, believing then that freedom lay ahead.
But reality always made him shrink into the shadows, surviving with extreme caution.
He remembered the despair when that secret research group was forcibly disbanded back then.
Members fled in all directions; some scuttled toward distant lands like terrified rats, attempting to survive in a foreign place.
In his heart, Lin Yuan silently removed those pains, leaving only his persistence for truth, excluding the pointless anger.
Walking out of the building and facing the city's twilight, he felt that he had finally achieved liberation.
He was no longer afraid of being dismissed or marginalized, for he had nothing left to lose.
He decided to throw caution to the wind and make his father's evidence public.
He knew this would be a final farewell, a farewell to the stable life he had known for thirty years.
At the moment the evidence was submitted to the court, he did not retreat but stepped firmly into the light.
Although he might face legal risks or even be forcibly isolated because of this action, he no longer cared.
He would no longer allow himself to be absent from the judgment of justice.
Walking home, looking at the ancient buildings on both sides of the street, he felt an unprecedented peace in his heart.
Those covered-up lies would eventually be exposed, and he would no longer be an abandoned soul.
He looked back at the cold office building and whispered, "Goodbye."

sentences.english: He cancelled the sensitive lists one by one, ensuring that no traces were left behind.

sentences.chinese: 就在他准备离开时，一名年轻的助手突然脱口而出：“林老师，您真的要走吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā zhǔn bèi lí kāi shí, yī míng nián qīng de zhù shǒu tū rán tuō kǒu ér chū: “Lín lǎo shī, nín zhēn de yào zǒu ma?”
sentences.english: Just as he was preparing to leave, a young assistant suddenly blurted out: "Teacher Lin, are you really leaving?"

sentences.chinese: 林远苦笑了一下，他知道在这个节骨眼上，任何犹豫都是危险的。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuǎn kǔ xiào le yī xià, tā zhī dào zài zhè gè jié gǔ niǎo shàng, rè nà gè hóu yù dōu shì wēi xiǎn de.
sentences.english: Lin Yuan gave a bitter smile; he knew that at this critical juncture, any hesitation was dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 他不能退让，因为对方绝不会罢休，直到将他彻底驱逐出这个圈子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù néng tuì ràng, yīn wèi duì fāng jué bù huì bà xiū, zhí dào jiāng tā chè dǐ qū zhú chū zhè gè quān zi.
sentences.english: He could not back down, because the other party would not let it go until he was completely expelled from this circle.

sentences.chinese: 他想起了自己的父亲，那位在学术界享有盛名的教授，在多年前突然逝世。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ le zì jǐ de fù qīn, nà wèi zài xué shù jiè xiǎng yǒu shèng míng de jiào shòu, zài duō nián qián tū rán shì shì.
sentences.english: He thought of his father, a professor of great renown in the academic world, who had passed away suddenly years ago.

sentences.chinese: 父亲临终前留下的日记中，记录了许多被历史遗忘的真相。
sentences.pinyin: Fù qīn lín zhōng qián liú xià de rì jì zhōng, jì lù le xǔ duō bèi lì shǐ yí wàng de zhēn xiàng.
sentences.english: In the diary his father left before death, many truths forgotten by history were recorded.

sentences.chinese: 有些真相被刻意隔离在公众视野之外，而有些则被权贵们遗弃在故纸堆里。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu xiē zhēn xiàng bèi kè yì gé lí zài gōng zhòng shì yě zhī wài, ér yǒu xiē zé bèi quán guì men yí qì zài gù zhǐ duī lǐ.
sentences.english: Some truths were deliberately isolated from public view, while others were abandoned by the powerful in piles of old papers.

sentences.chinese: 林远想起自己年轻时曾因为追求纯粹的真理而选择退学，那时的他以为自由就在前方。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuǎn xiǎng qǐ zì jǐ nián qīng shí céng yīn wèi zhuī qiú chún cuì de zhēn lǐ ér xuǎn zé tuì xué, nà shí de tā yǐ wéi zì yóu jiù zài qián fāng.
sentences.english: Lin Yuan remembered how he had chosen to quit school in his youth in pursuit of pure truth, believing then that freedom lay ahead.

sentences.chinese: 但现实总是让他缩在阴影中，小心翼翼地生存。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàn shí zǒng shì ràng tā suō zài yīn yǐng zhōng, xiǎo xīn yì yì de shēng cún.
sentences.english: But reality always made him shrink into the shadows, surviving with extreme caution.

sentences.chinese: 他记得当年那个秘密研究小组被强行解散时的绝望。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì dé dāng nián nà gè mì mì yán jiū xiǎo zǔ bèi qiáng xíng jiě sàn shí de jué wàng.
sentences.english: He remembered the despair when that secret research group was forcibly disbanded back then.

sentences.chinese: 成员们四散奔逃，有些人像惊恐的鼠类一样窜向远方，试图在异乡生存。
sentences.pinyin: Chéng yuán men sì sàn bēn táo, yǒu xiē rén xiàng jīng kǒng de shǔ lèi yī yàng cuàn xiàng yuǎn fāng, shì tú zài yì xiāng shēng cún.
sentences.english: Members fled in all directions; some scuttled toward distant lands like terrified rats, attempting to survive in a foreign place.

sentences.chinese: 林远在心中默默地将那些痛苦除去，只留下对真理的执着，除外的是那些无谓的愤怒。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuǎn zài xīn zhōng mò mò de jiāng nà xiē tòng kǔ chú qù, zhǐ liú xià duì zhēn lǐ de zhí zhuó, chú wài de shì nà xiē wú wèi de fèn nù.
sentences.english: In his heart, Lin Yuan silently removed those pains, leaving only his persistence for truth, excluding the pointless anger.

sentences.chinese: 他走出大楼，面对着这座城市的黄昏，感觉自己终于得到了解脱。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu chū dà lóu, miàn duì zhe zhè zuò chéng shì de huáng hūn, gǎn jué zì jǐ zhōng yú dé dào le jiě tuō.
sentences.english: Walking out of the building and facing the city's twilight, he felt that he had finally achieved liberation.

sentences.chinese: 他不再害怕被辞退或被排挤，因为他已经没有什么可以失去的了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zài hài pà bèi cí tuì huò bèi pái jí, yīn wèi tā yǐ jīng méi yǒu shén me kě yǐ shī qù de le.
sentences.english: He was no longer afraid of being dismissed or marginalized, for he had nothing left to lose.

sentences.chinese: 他决定豁出去，将父亲留下的证据公之于众。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué dìng huō chu qu, jiāng fù qīn liú xià de zhèng jù gōng zhī yú zhòng.
sentences.english: He decided to throw caution to the wind and make his father's evidence public.

sentences.chinese: 他知道这将是一场诀别，与他过去三十年安稳生活的诀别。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhī dào zhè jiāng shì yī chǎng jué bié, yǔ tā guò qù sān shí nián ān wěn shēng huó de jué bié.
sentences.english: He knew this would be a final farewell, a farewell to the stable life he had known for thirty years.

sentences.chinese: 在证据提交给法院的那一刻，他没有退却，而是坚定地走进了光亮中。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhèng jù tí jiāo gěi fǎ yuàn de nà yī kè, tā méi yǒu tuì què, ér shì jiān dìng de zǒu jìn le guāng liàng zhōng.
sentences.english: At the moment the evidence was submitted to the court, he did not retreat but stepped firmly into the light.

sentences.chinese: 尽管他可能会因为这次行动而面临法律的风险，甚至被强制隔离，但他不在乎。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn tā kě néng huì yīn wèi zhè cì xíng dòng ér miàn lín fǎ lǜ de fēng xiǎn, shèn zhì bèi qiáng zhì gé lí, dàn tā bù zài hu.
sentences.english: Although he might face legal risks or even be forcibly isolated because of this action, he no longer cared.

sentences.chinese: 他不再允许自己缺席于正义的审判之中。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zài yǔn xǔ zì jǐ quē xí yú zhèng yì de shěn pàn zhī zhōng.
sentences.english: He would no longer allow himself to be absent from the judgment of justice.

sentences.chinese: 他走在回家的路上，看着街道两旁古老的建筑，心中感到前所未有的平静。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu zài huí jiā de lù shàng, kàn zhe jiē dào liǎng páng gǔ lǎo de jiàn zhù, xīn zhōng gǎn dào qián suǒ wèi yǒu de píng jìng.
sentences.english: Walking home, looking at the ancient buildings on both sides of the street, he felt an unprecedented peace in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 那些被掩盖的谎言终将被揭穿，而他将不再是那个被遗弃的灵魂。
sentences.pinyin: Nà xiē bèi yǎn gài de huǎng yán zhōng jiāng bèi jiē chuān, ér tā jiāng bù zài shì nà gè bèi yí qì de líng hún.
sentences.english: Those covered-up lies would eventually be exposed, and he would no longer be an abandoned soul.

sentences.chinese: 他回头看了一眼那座冰冷的办公大楼，轻声说：“再见。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā huí tóu kàn le yī yǎn nà zuò bīng lěng de bàn gōng dà lóu, qīng shēng shuō: “Zài jiàn.”
sentences.english: He looked back at the cold office building and whispered, "Goodbye."

stories.story_chinese:
在古镇的深巷里，林奶奶看着那个倔强的丫头，想起了自己的青春。
那是半个世纪前，她被长辈们安排嫁给邻村的富家子。
在那个时代，女人的命运往往与家庭的门第挂钩。
婚礼前夕，她第一次尝试上头，看着镜中端庄的模样，心中却在低泣。
她不愿只做一个在深闺中等待的媳妇，而渴望去外面的世界看看。
最终，她以惊人的勇气逃离了婚礼，远赴上海，在戏剧舞台上正式出道。
如今，她成了名伶，而那个曾经被禁锢的灵魂终于获得了自由。

如今，她成了名伶，而那个曾经被禁锢的灵魂终于获得了自由。
stories.story_pinyin:
Zài gǔzhèn de shēnxiàng lǐ, Lín nǎinai kànzhe nàge juéjiàng de yātou, xiǎngqǐle zìjǐ de qīngchūn.
Nà shì bàn gè shìjì qián, tā bèi zhǎngbèimen ānpái jià gěi líncūn de fùjiā zǐ.
Zài nàge shídài, nǚrén de mìngyùn wǎngwǎng yǔ jiātíng de méndì guàgōu.
Hūnlǐ qiánxī, tā dìyī cì chángshì shàngtóu, kànzhe jìngzhōng duānzhuāng de múyàng, xīnzhōng què zài dīqì.
Tā bù yuàn zhǐ zuò yīgè zài shēnguī zhōng děngdài de xífù, ér kěwàng qù wàimiàn de shìjiè kànkan.
Zuìzhōng, tā yǐ jīngrén de yǒngqì táolíle hūnlǐ, yuǎnfù Shànghǎi, zài xìjù wǔtái shàng zhèngshì chūdào.
Rújīn, tā chéngle mínglíng, ér nàge céngjīng bèi jìngù de línghún zhōngyú huòdéle zìyóu.

stories.story_english:
In the deep alleys of the ancient town, Grandma Lin looked at that stubborn girl and remembered her own youth.
That was half a century ago, when she was arranged by her elders to marry a wealthy son from the neighboring village.
In that era, a woman's fate was often linked to the social status of her family.
On the eve of the wedding, she tried binding her hair into a bun for the first time; looking at her dignified reflection in the mirror, she wept quietly in her heart.
She was unwilling to be just a daughter-in-law waiting in the inner chambers, but longed to see the world outside.
Ultimately, with astonishing courage, she escaped the wedding and traveled far to Shanghai, where she officially made her debut on the theatrical stage.
Now, she has become a famous actress, and the soul that was once imprisoned has finally gained freedom.

stories.story_chinese:
在繁华的艺术之都，林远是一位深居简出的古董鉴定师。
他生活简单，与周围追逐名利的氛围格格不入。
有一天，当地最富有的收藏家赵先生带来了一方古墨。
赵先生声称这方墨是失传已久的皇家秘制，其价值之高，普通人根本买不起。
林远仔细观察后，认为这件作品似是而非，虽然外表考究，但气韵不对。
他直言不讳地指出，这方墨并非真品，不宜作为传世之宝收藏。
赵先生听后不以为然，认为林远在故意刁难他。
两人之间产生了严重的分歧，气氛瞬间变得紧张起来。
赵先生认为林远的判断与他咨询的其他专家有所不同。
他坚称这方墨的艺术价值与现代工艺品相差甚远，绝对是真迹。
林远则指出，真伪之分在细节之中，而赵先生的论据自相矛盾。
面对林远的质疑，赵先生显得很不服气，甚至有些恼羞成怒。
他认为林远是在挑战他的权威，这种针锋相对的局面让旁观者感到不安。
在古董圈，有些所谓的专家为了利益，常有不正之风。
他们往往会对真伪视而不见，只要对方出钱，就不予质疑。
但林远是个原则性极强的人，面对这种压力，他绝不服。
他认为鉴定师的职责是揭露真相，而非迎合权贵。
赵先生试图用金钱诱惑林远，但林远不肯接受。
林远告诉他，艺术的真伪见仁见智，但在学术面前不容欺骗。
赵先生禁不住叹了口气，认为林远太固执。
他提到在某些传统圈子里，质疑长辈的眼光是一种忌讳。
林远反驳道，追求真理不应有这种禁忌。
两人在是非问题上的争论，其激烈程度势不可当。
其实，赵先生与林远的社会地位悬殊，这使得两人的对话充满了反差。
赵先生习惯了被人追捧，而林远则习惯了孤独地坚守。
由于高品质的古墨在市场上供不应求，赵先生急于证明自己的拥有。
他非得让林远在鉴定书上签字不可，否则就威胁要毁掉林远的声誉。
林远冷冷地说，我的专业水准，你即便用钱也比不上。
赵先生突然感到身体不适，额头上渗出了汗珠。
他意识到自己的执念已经让他跟不上理性的步伐。
尽管他心中仍有不平，但面对林远坚定的目光，他最终没有提出异议。
他意识到，在这个充满谎言的世界里，林远这种纯粹的坚持才是最稀缺的。
他默默地收起古墨，虽然不准任何人知道这次失败，但他心中却感到了一丝解脱。

stories.story_pinyin:
Zài fán huá de yì shù zhī dū, Lín Yuǎn shì yī wèi shēn jū jiǎn chū de gǔ dǒng jiàn dìng shī.
Tā shēng huó jiǎn dān, yǔ zhōu wéi zhuī zhú míng lì de fēn wéi gé gé bù rù.
Yǒu yī tiān, dāng dì zuì fù yǒu de shōu cáng jiā Zhào xiān sheng dài lái le yī fāng gǔ mò.
Zhào xiān sheng shēng chūn zhè fāng mò shì shī chuán yǐ jiǔ de huáng jiā mì zhì, qí jià zhí zhī gāo, pǔ tōng rén gēn běn mǎi bu qǐ.
Lín Yuǎn zǐ xì guān chá hòu, rèn wéi zhè jiàn zuò pǐn sì shì ér fēi, suī rán wài biǎo kǎo jiù, dàn qì yùn bù duì.
Tā zhí yán bù huì de zhǐ chū, zhè fāng mò bìng fēi zhēn pǐn, bù yí zuò wéi chuán shì zhī bǎo shōu cáng.
Zhào xiān sheng tīng hòu bù yǐ wéi rán, rèn wéi Lín Yuǎn zài gù yì diāo nán tā.
Liǎng rén zhī jiān chǎn shēng le yán zhòng de fēn qí, qì fēn shùn jiān biàn de jǐn zhāng qǐ lái.
Zhào xiān sheng rèn wéi Lín Yuǎn de pàn duàn yǔ tā zī xún de qí tā zhuān jiā yǒu suǒ bù tóng.
Tā jiān chēng zhè fāng mò de yì shù jià zhí yǔ xiàn dài gōng yì pǐn xiāng chà shèn yuǎn, jué duì shì zhēn jì.
Lín Yuǎn zé zhǐ chū, zhēn wěi zhī fēn zài xì jié zhī zhōng, ér Zhào xiān sheng de lùn jù zì xiāng máo dùn.
Miàn duì Lín Yuǎn de zhì yí, Zhào xiān sheng xiǎn de hěn bù fú qì, shèn zhì yǒu xiē nǎo shù chéng nù.
Tā rèn wéi Lín Yuǎn shì zài tiǎo zhàn tā de quán wēi, zhè zhǒng zhēn fēng xiāng duì de jú miàn ràng páng guān zhě gǎn dào bù ān.
Zài gǔ dǒng quān, yǒu xiē suǒ wèi de zhuān jiā wèi le lì yì, cháng yǒu bù zhèng zhī fēng.
Tā men wǎng wǎng huì duì zhēn wěi shì ér bù jiàn, zhǐ yào duì fāng chū qián, jiù bù yǔ zhì yí.
Dàn Lín Yuǎn shì gè yuán zé xìng jí qiáng de rén, miàn duì zhè zhǒng yā lì, tā jué bù fú.
Tā rèn wéi jiàn dìng shī de zhí zé shì jiē lù zhēn xiàng, ér fēi yíng hé quán guì.
Zhào xiān sheng shì tú yòng jīn qián yòu huò Lín Yuǎn, dàn Lín Yuǎn bù kěn jiē shòu.
Lín Yuǎn gào su tā, yì shù de zhēn wěi jiàn rén jiàn zhì, dàn zài xué shù miàn qián bù róng qī piàn.
Zhào xiān sheng jīn bu zhù tàn le yī kǒu qì, rèn wéi Lín Yuǎn tài gù zhí.
Tā tí dào zài mǒu xiē chuán tǒng quān zi lǐ, zhì yí zhǎng bèi de yǎn guāng shì yī zhǒng jì huì.
Lín Yuǎn fǎn bó dào, zhuī qiú zhēn lǐ bù yīng yǒu zhè zhǒng jìn jì.
Liǎng rén zài shì fēi wèn tí shàng de zhēng lùn, qí jī liè chéng dù shì bù kě dāng.
Qí shí, Zhào xiān sheng yǔ Lín Yuǎn de shè huì dì wèi xuán shū, zhè shǐ de liǎng rén de đối huà chōng mǎn le fǎn chā.
Zhào xiān sheng xí guàn le bèi rén zhuī pǒng, ér Lín Yuǎn zé xí guàn le gū dú de jiān shǒu.
Yóu yú gāo pǐn zhì de gǔ mò zài shì chǎng shàng gōng bù yìng qiú, Zhào xiān sheng jí yú zhèng míng zì jǐ de yōng yǒu.
Tā fēi děi ràng Lín Yuǎn zài jiàn dìng shū shàng qiān zì bù kě, fǒu zé jiù wēi xié yào huǐ diào Lín Yuǎn de shēng yù.
Lín Yuǎn lěng lěng de shuō, wǒ de zhuān yè shuǐ zhǔn, nǐ jí biàn yòng qián yě bǐ bù shàng.
Zhào xiān sheng tū rán gǎn dào shēn tǐ bù shì, é tóu shàng shèn chū le hàn zhū.
Tā yì shí dào zì jǐ de zhí niàn yǐ jīng ràng tā gēn bu shàng lǐ xìng de bù fā.
Jǐn guǎn tā xīn zhōng réng yǒu bù píng, dàn miàn duì Lín Yuǎn jiān dìng de mù guāng, tā zuì zhōng méi yǒu tí chū yì yì.
Tā yì shí dào, zài zhè gè chōng mǎn huǎng yán de shì jiè lǐ, Lín Yuǎn zhè zhǒng chún cuì de jiān chí cái shì zuì xī quē de.
Tā mò mò de shōu qǐ gǔ mò, suī rán bù zhǔn rén hé rén zhī dào zhè cì shī bài, dàn tā xīn zhōng què gǎn dào le yī sī jiě tuō.

stories.story_english:
In the bustling capital of art, Lin Yuan was a reclusive antique appraiser.
He lived a simple life, completely incompatible with the surrounding atmosphere of chasing fame and fortune.
One day, Mr. Zhao, the wealthiest collector in the area, brought an inkstick.
Mr. Zhao claimed that this inkstick was a long-lost royal secret, with a value so high that ordinary people simply could not afford it.
After careful observation, Lin Yuan believed that this piece was specious; although the exterior was exquisite, the spirit was not right.
He pointed out bluntly that this inkstick was not a genuine article and was not suitable for collection as a timeless treasure.
Mr. Zhao did not accept this as correct after hearing it, thinking that Lin Yuan was deliberately making things difficult for him.
A serious disagreement arose between the two, and the atmosphere instantly became tense.
Mr. Zhao believed that Lin Yuan's judgment differed to some extent from the other experts he had consulted.
He insisted that the artistic value of this inkstick differed greatly from modern crafts and was absolutely authentic.
Lin Yuan pointed out that the distinction between genuine and fake lies in the details, while Mr. Zhao's arguments were self-contradictory.
Facing Lin Yuan's questioning, Mr. Zhao seemed very indignant, even becoming somewhat enraged.
He felt that Lin Yuan was challenging his authority, and this tit-for-tat situation made the onlookers feel uneasy.
In the antique circle, some so-called experts often foster unhealthy tendencies for the sake of profit.
They often turn a blind eye to authenticity; as long as the other party pays, they withhold any questioning.
But Lin Yuan was a man of strong principles; facing this kind of pressure, he refused to obey.
He believed that the duty of an appraiser is to reveal the truth, not to cater to the powerful.
Mr. Zhao tried to tempt Lin Yuan with money, but Lin Yuan refused to accept it.
Lin Yuan told him that the authenticity of art is a matter of opinion, but deception is not allowed in the face of scholarship.
Mr. Zhao could not help but sigh, thinking that Lin Yuan was too stubborn.
He mentioned that in some traditional circles, questioning the vision of an elder is a taboo.
Lin Yuan countered that the pursuit of truth should not have such taboos.
Their debate over right and wrong reached an irresistible intensity.
In fact, the disparity in social status between Mr. Zhao and Lin Yuan was huge, which made their conversation full of contrast.
Mr. Zhao was used to being praised, while Lin Yuan was used to holding his ground in solitude.
Because high-quality ancient ink is in short supply in the market, Mr. Zhao was anxious to prove his possession.
He insisted that Lin Yuan must sign the appraisal report, otherwise he threatened to destroy Lin Yuan's reputation.
Lin Yuan said coldly, "My professional level is something you cannot compare to, even with money."
Mr. Zhao suddenly felt unwell, and beads of sweat broke out on his forehead.
He realized that his obsession had already made him unable to keep up with the pace of reason.
Although he still felt a sense of injustice in his heart, facing Lin Yuan's firm gaze, he finally raised no objection.
He realized that in this world full of lies, Lin Yuan's pure persistence was the rarest thing of all.
He silently put away the ancient ink; although he forbade anyone from knowing about this failure, he felt a sense of relief in his heart.
story_english_sentences: In the bustling capital of art, Lin Yuan was a reclusive antique appraiser.
He lived a simple life, completely incompatible with the surrounding atmosphere of chasing fame and fortune.
One day, Mr. Zhao, the wealthiest collector in the area, brought an inkstick.
Mr. Zhao claimed that this inkstick was a long-lost royal secret, with a value so high that ordinary people simply could not afford it.
After careful observation, Lin Yuan believed that this piece was specious; although the exterior was exquisite, the spirit was not right.
He pointed out bluntly that this inkstick was not a genuine article and was not suitable for collection as a timeless treasure.
Mr. Zhao did not accept this as correct after hearing it, thinking that Lin Yuan was deliberately making things difficult for him.
A serious disagreement arose between the two, and the atmosphere instantly became tense.
Mr. Zhao believed that Lin Yuan's judgment differed to some extent from the other experts he had consulted.
He insisted that the artistic value of this inkstick differed greatly from modern crafts and was absolutely authentic.
Lin Yuan pointed out that the distinction between genuine and fake lies in the details, while Mr. Zhao's arguments were self-contradictory.
Facing Lin Yuan's questioning, Mr. Zhao seemed very indignant, even becoming somewhat enraged.
He felt that Lin Yuan was challenging his authority, and this tit-for-tat situation made the onlookers feel uneasy.
In the antique circle, some so-called experts often foster unhealthy tendencies for the sake of profit.
They often turn a blind eye to authenticity; as long as the other party pays, they withhold any questioning.
But Lin Yuan was a man of strong principles; facing this kind of pressure, he refused to obey.
He believed that the duty of an appraiser is to reveal the truth, not to cater to the powerful.
Mr. Zhao tried to tempt Lin Yuan with money, but Lin Yuan refused to accept it.
Lin Yuan told him that the authenticity of art is a matter of opinion, but deception is not allowed in the face of scholarship.
Mr. Zhao could not help but sigh, thinking that Lin Yuan was too stubborn.
He mentioned that in some traditional circles, questioning the vision of an elder is a taboo.
Lin Yuan countered that the pursuit of truth should not have such taboos.
Their debate over right and wrong reached an irresistible intensity.
In fact, the disparity in social status between Mr. Zhao and Lin Yuan was huge, which made their conversation full of contrast.
Mr. Zhao was used to being praised, while Lin Yuan was used to holding his ground in solitude.
Because high-quality ancient ink is in short supply in the market, Mr. Zhao was anxious to prove his possession.
He insisted that Lin Yuan must sign the appraisal report, otherwise he threatened to destroy Lin Yuan's reputation.
Lin Yuan said coldly, "My professional level is something you cannot compare to, even with money."
Mr. Zhao suddenly felt unwell, and beads of sweat broke out on his forehead.
He realized that his obsession had already made him unable to keep up with the pace of reason.
Although he still felt a sense of injustice in his heart, facing Lin Yuan's firm gaze, he finally raised no objection.
He realized that in this world full of lies, Lin Yuan's pure persistence was the rarest thing of all.
He silently put away the ancient ink; although he forbade anyone from knowing about this failure, he felt a sense of relief in his heart.

stories.story_chinese:
林远站在狭窄的办公室里，看着窗外阴沉的天空。
这里的空间极其窄，仿佛在无形中挤压着他的呼吸。
自从公司陷入不景气的状态以来，这里的气氛变得异常沉闷。
作为一名被边缘化的中层管理，他经常感到自己处于职场的低谷。
他的下级们对他不再敬畏，反而用一种微妙的轻蔑来看待他。
林远知道，在这个崇尚权力的环境下，弱势群体永远是牺牲品。
由于一次严重的决策失误，公司遭遇了惨痛的亏损。
这次失败让他成了全公司的笑柄，让他觉得极其丢脸。
在董事会上，他面对那些傲慢的股东，感到一种深深的无力感。
他试图解释，但对方的思维极其狭隘，根本不听他的辩解。
在那次会议上，他出丑的样子被同事们私下议论，令他感到丢人。
他意识到，人们总是容易低估一个沉默者的痛苦，或者简单地小看他的能力。
回到家，林远面对的是一个残缺的生活。
他的妻子在多年前的一场事故中伤残，只能依靠轮椅生活。
看着妻子那单薄的肩膀，林远心中涌起一阵心酸。
在这个充满竞争的城市里，他们这种生活状态显得如此凄凉。
他想起家乡，那里正遭受着严重的干旱。
连年的旱灾让土地龟裂，农民们面对旱情感到无比沮丧。
资源短缺让那个小村庄变得死气沉沉，人们的生活陷入低迷。
林远觉得自己像是一棵在干旱中枯萎的树，生命力微弱得可怜。
他陷入了长期的忧郁之中，每天在烦闷的情绪中挣扎。
这种抑郁像是一层厚厚的灰色阴影，笼罩了他的整个世界。
他开始变得悲观，认为生活永远不会有转机。
他经常在深夜里感到悲哀，为自己无法保护家人的无能而痛心。
这种悲痛在寂静的夜晚被无限放大，让他几乎无法呼吸。
他看着镜子里的自己，眼眶凹陷，面色苍白，显得十分丑陋。
他觉得自己的人生是一场可悲的闹剧，充满了可耻的妥协。
每当想起曾经的雄心壮志，他便感到无比惭愧。
他觉得自己的人生弱点就是过于软弱，缺乏反抗的勇气。
一次偶然的机会，他试图重新创业，但由于资金不足，他处于绝对的劣势。
他购买了一些劣质的原材料，试图降低成本，结果产品质量极差。
这次失败让他再次陷入狼狈的境地，债主们在门前叫嚣。
他垂头丧气地坐在地板上，感觉到一种前所未有的挫败感。
他原本害羞且内敛，如今却在生活的毒打下变得麻木。
当他试图向朋友借钱时，那种尴尬的氛围让空气都凝固了。
朋友的拒绝让他感到气馁，他意识到自己已经失去了所有社交资本。
他心中充满了一种深深的沮丧，觉得自己这辈子注定倒霉。
他向妻子表达了深深的歉意，因为他没能给她一个完整的家。
妻子握住他的手，眼神中虽然带着伤感，但依然有温情。
然而，林远无法摆脱内心的灰心，他觉得自己被生活抛弃了。
他的精神状态在低迷中徘徊，找不到任何出口。
他觉得自己的社会地位低下，就像是社会底层的尘埃。
在这种极度的压抑下，他开始写日记，记录下所有的悲痛。
日记本上的文字凌乱，记录着一个失败者的心路历程。
他写道，最可怕的不是失去金钱，而是失去对未来的希望。
他意识到，人们在面对困境时，往往会陷入一种自我否定的循环。
这种心态让他变得更加脆弱，面对挑战时总是习惯性地退缩。
他想起小时候在乡下奔跑的日子，那时候天空是蓝色的。
而现在，他的世界只剩下这种沉闷的灰色。
他闭上眼睛，听着窗外微弱的风声，心中一片空虚。
他不知道明天是否会好转，但此时此刻，他只想在黑暗中沉没。
这就是林远的生活，一个关于失去与绝望的循环。

stories.story_pinyin:
Lín Yuǎn zhàn zài xiá zhǎi de bàn gōng shì lǐ, kàn zhe chuāng wài yīn chén de tiān kōng.
Zhè lǐ de kōng jiān jí qí zhǎi, fǎng fú zài wú xíng zhōng jǐ yā zhe tā de hū xī.
Zì cóng gōng sī xiàn rù bù jǐng qì de zhuàng tài yǐ lái, zhè lǐ de qì fēn biàn de yì cháng chén mèn.
Zuò wéi yī míng bèi biān yuán huà de zhōng céng guǎn lǐ, tā jīng cháng gǎn dào zì jǐ chǔ yú zhí chǎng de dī gǔ.
Tā de xià jí men duì tā bù zài jìng wèi, fǎn ér yòng yī zhǒng wēi miào de qīng miè lái kàn dài tā.
Lín Yuǎn zhī dào, zài zhè gè chóng shàng quán lì de huán jìng xià, ruò shì qún tǐ yǒng yuǎn shì xī shēng pǐn.
Yóu yú yī cì yán zhòng de jué cè shī wù, gōng sī zāo yù le cǎn tòng de kuī sǔn.
Zhè cì shī bài ràng tā chéng le quán gōng sī de xiào bǐng, ràng tā jué de jí qí diū liǎn.
Zài dǒng shì huì shàng, tā miàn duì nà xiē ào màn de gǔ dōng, gǎn dào yī zhǒng shēn shēn de wú lì gǎn.
Tā shì tú jiě shì, dàn duì fāng de sī wéi jí qí xiá ài, gēn běn bù tīng tā de biàn jiě.
Zài nà cì huì yì shàng, tā chū chǒu de yàng zi bèi tóng shì men sī xià yì lùn, lìng tā gǎn dào diū rén.
Tā yì shí dào, rén men zǒng shì róng yì dī gū yī gè chén mò zhě de tòng kǔ, huò zhě jiǎn dān de xiǎo kàn tā de néng lì.
Huí dào jiā, Lín Yuǎn miàn duì de shì yī gè cán quē de shēng huó.
Tā de qī zi zài duō nián qián de yī chǎng shì gù zhōng shāng cán, zhǐ néng yī kào lún yǐ shēng huó.
Kàn zhe qī zi nà dān bó de jiān bǎng, Lín Yuǎn xīn zhōng yǒng qǐ yī zhèn xīn suān.
Zài zhè gè chōng mǎn jìng zhēng de chéng shì lǐ, tā men zhè zhǒng shēng huó zhuàng tài xiǎn de rú cǐ qī liáng.
Tā xiǎng qǐ jiā xiāng, nà lǐ zhèng zāo shòu zhe yán zhòng de gān hàn.
Lián nián de hàn zāi ràng tǔ dì guī liè, nóng mín men miàn duì hàn qíng gǎn dào wú bǐ jǔ sàng.
Zī yuán duǎn quē ràng nà gè xiǎo cūn zhuāng biàn de sǐ qì chén chén, rén men de shēng huó xiàn rù dī mí.
Lín Yuǎn jué de zì jǐ xiàng shì yī kē zài gān hàn zhōng kū wěi de shù, shēng mìng lì wēi ruò de kě lián.
Tā xiàn rù le cháng qī de yōu yù zhī zhōng, měi tiān zài fán mèn de qíng xù zhōng zhēng zhá.
Zhè zhǒng yì yù xiàng shì yī céng hòu hòu de huī sè yīn yǐng, lóng zhào le tā de zhěng gè shì jiè.
Tā kāi shǐ biàn de bēi guān, rèn wéi shēng huó yǒng yuǎn bù huì yǒu zhuǎn jī.
Tā jīng cháng zài shēn yè lǐ gǎn dào bēi āi, wèi zì jǐ wú néng bǎo hù jiā rén de wú néng ér tòng xīn.
Zhè zhǒng bēi tòng zài jì jìng de yè wǎn bèi wú xiàn fàng dà, ràng tā jǐ hū wú fǎ hū xī.
Tā kàn zhe jìng zi lǐ de zì jǐ, yǎn kuàng āo xiàn, miàn sè cāng bái, xiǎn de shī fēn chǒu lòu.
Tā jué de zì jǐ de rén shēng shì yī chǎng kě bēi de nào jù, chōng mǎn le kě chǐ de tuǒ xié.
Měi dāng xiǎng qǐ céng jīng de xióng xīn zhuàng zhì, tā biàn gǎn dào wú bǐ cán kuì.
Tā jué de zì jǐ de rén shēng ruò diǎn jiù shì guò yú ruǎn ruò, quē fá fǎn kàng de yǒng qì.
Yī cì ǒu rán de jī huì, tā shì tú chóng xīn chuàng yè, dàn yóu yú zī jīn bù zú, tā chǔ yú jué duì de liè shì.
Tā gòu mǎi le yī xiē liè zhì de yuán cái liào, shì tú jiàng dī chéng běn, jié guǒ chǎn pǐn zhì liàng jí chà.
Zhè cì shī bài ràng tā zài cì xiàn rù láng bèi de jìng dì, zhài zhǔ men zài mén qián jiào xiāo.
Tā chuí tóu sàng qì de zuò zài dì bǎn shàng, gǎn jué dào yī zhǒng qián suǒ wèi yǒu de cuò bài gǎn.
Tā yuán běn hài xiū qiě nèi liǎn, rù jīn què zài shēng huó de dú dǎ xià biàn de má mù.
Dāng tā shì tú xiàng péng yǒu jiè qián shí, nà zhǒng gān gà de fēn wéi ràng kōng qì dōu níng gù le.
Péng yǒu de jù jué ràng tā gǎn dào qì něi, tā yì shí dào zì jǐ yǐ jīng shī qù le suǒ yǒu shè jiāo zī běn.
Tā xīn zhōng chōng mǎn le yī zhǒng shēn shēn de jǔ sàng, jué de zì jǐ zhè bèi zi zhù dìng dǎo méi.
Tā xiàng qī zi biǎo dá le shēn shēn de qiàn yì, yīn wèi tā méi néng gěi tā yī gè wán zhěng de jiā.
Qī zi wò zhù tā de shǒu, yǎn shén zhōng suī rán dài zhe shāng gǎn, dàn yī rán yǒu wēn qíng.
 rán ér, Lín Yuǎn wú fǎ bǎi tuō nèi xīn de huī xīn, tā jué de zì jǐ bèi shēng huó pāo qì le.
Tā de jīng shén zhuàng tài zài dī mí zhōng pái huái, zhǎo bù dào rèn hé chū kǒu.
Tā jué de zì jǐ de shè huì dì wèi dī xià, jiù xiàng shì shè huì dǐ céng de chén āi.
Zài zhè zhǒng jí dù de yā yì xià, tā kāi shǐ xiě rì jì, jì lù xià suǒ yǒu de bēi tòng.
Rì jì běn shàng de wén zì líng luàn, jì lù zhe yī gè shī bài zhě de xīn lù lǐ chéng.
Tā xiě dào, zuì kě pà de bù shì shī qù jīn qián, ér shì shī qù duì wèi lái de xī wàng.
Tā yì shí dào, rén men zài miàn duì kùn jìng shí, wǎng wǎng huì xiàn rù yī zhǒng zì wǒ fǒu dìng de xún huán.
Zhè zhǒng xīn tài ràng tā biàn de gèng jiā ruì ruò, miàn duì tiǎo zhàn shí zǒng shì xí guàn xìng de tuì suō.
Tā xiǎng qǐ xiǎo shí hòu zài xiāng xià bēn pǎo de rì zi, nà shí hòu tiān kōng shì lán sè de.
Ér xiàn zài, tā de shì jiè zhǐ shèng xià zhè zhǒng chén mèn de huī sè.
Tā bì shàng yǎn jīng, tīng zhe chuāng wài wēi ruò de fēng shēng, xīn zhōng yī piàn kōng xū.
Tā bù zhī dào míng tiān shì fǒu huì hǎo zhuǎn, dàn cǐ shí cǐ kè, tā zhǐ xiǎng zài hēi àn zhōng chén mò.
Zhè jiù shì Lín Yuǎn de shēng huó, yī gè guān yú shī qù yǔ jué wàng de xún huán.

Yī cì ǒu rán de jī huì, tā shì tú chóng xīn chuàng yè, dàn yóu yú zī jīn bù zú, tā chǔ yú jué duì de liè shì.
Tā gòu mǎi le yī xiē liè zhì de yuán cái liào, shì tú jiàng dī chéng běn, jié guǒ chǎn pǐn zhì liàng jí chà.
Zhè cì shī bài ràng tā zài cì xiàn rù láng bèi de jìng dì, zhài zhǔ men zài mén qián jiào xiāo.
Tā chuí tóu sàng qì de zuò zài dì bǎn shàng, gǎn jué dào yī zhǒng qián suǒ wèi yǒu de cuò bài gǎn.
Tā yuán běn hài xiū qiě nèi liǎn, rù jīn què zài shēng huó de dú dǎ xià biàn de má mù.
Dāng tā shì tú xiàng péng yǒu jiè qián shí, nà zhǒng gān gà de fēn wéi ràng kōng qì dōu níng gù le.
Péng yǒu de jù jué ràng tā gǎn dào qì něi, tā yì shí dào zì jǐ yǐ jīng shī qù le suǒ yǒu shè jiāo zī běn.
Tā xīn zhōng chōng mǎn le yī zhǒng shēn shēn de jǔ sàng, jué de zì jǐ zhè bèi zi zhù dìng dǎo méi.
Tā xiàng qī zi biǎo dá le shēn shēn de qiàn yì, yīn wèi tā méi néng gěi tā yī gè wán zhěng de jiā.
Qī zi wò zhù tā de shǒu, yǎn shén zhōng suī rán dài zhe shāng gǎn, dàn yī rán yǒu wēn qíng.
rán ér, Lín Yuǎn wú fǎ bǎi tuō nèi xīn de huī xīn, tā jué de zì jǐ bèi shēng huó pāo qì le.
Tā de jīng shén zhuàng tài zài dī mí zhōng pái huái, zhǎo bù dào rèn hé chū kǒu.
Tā jué de zì jǐ de shè huì dì wèi dī xià, jiù xiàng shì shè huì dǐ céng de chén āi.
Zài zhè zhǒng jí dù de yā yì xià, tā kāi shǐ xiě rì jì, jì lù xià suǒ yǒu de bēi tòng.
Rì jì běn shàng de wén zì líng luàn, jì lù zhe yī gè shī bài zhě de xīn lù lǐ chéng.
Tā xiě dào, zuì kě pà de bù shì shī qù jīn qián, ér shì shī qù duì wèi lái de xī wàng.
Tā yì shí dào, rén men zài miàn duì kùn jìng shí, wǎng wǎng huì xiàn rù yī zhǒng zì wǒ fǒu dìng de xún huán.
Zhè zhǒng xīn tài ràng tā biàn de gèng jiā ruì ruò, miàn duì tiǎo zhàn shí zǒng shì xí guàn xìng de tuì suō.
Tā xiǎng qǐ xiǎo shí hòu zài xiāng xià bēn pǎo de rì zi, nà shí hòu tiān kōng shì lán sè de.
Ér xiàn zài, tā de shì jiè zhǐ shèng xià zhè zhǒng chén mèn de huī sè.
Tā bì shàng yǎn jīng, tīng zhe chuāng wài wēi ruò de fēng shēng, xīn zhōng yī piàn kōng xū.
Tā bù zhī dào míng tiān shì fǒu huì hǎo zhuǎn, dàn cǐ shí cǐ kè, tā zhǐ xiǎng zài hēi àn zhōng chén mò.
Zhè jiù shì Lín Yuǎn de shēng huó, yī gè guān yú shī qù yǔ jué wàng de xún huán.
stories.story_english:
Lin Yuan stood in the narrow office, looking at the gloomy sky outside the window.
The space here was extremely narrow, as if invisibly squeezing his breath.
Since the company entered a slump, the atmosphere here had become exceptionally oppressive.
As a marginalized middle manager, he often felt himself to be at the low point of his career.
His subordinates no longer respected him, but instead looked at him with a subtle contempt.
Lin Yuan knew that in this environment where power was worshipped, the vulnerable were always the sacrificial lambs.
Due to a serious decision-making error, the company suffered a bitter financial loss.
This failure made him the laughingstock of the entire company, making him feel extremely humiliated.
At the board meeting, facing those arrogant shareholders, he felt a deep sense of powerlessness.
He tried to explain, but the other party's thinking was extremely narrow-minded and they wouldn't listen to his defense.
At that meeting, the way he made a fool of himself was discussed privately by colleagues, making him lose face.
He realized that people often underestimate the pain of a silent person, or simply look down on their abilities.
Returning home, Lin Yuan faced a shattered life.
His wife had been disabled in an accident many years ago and could only live relying on a wheelchair.
Looking at his wife's frail shoulders, a surge of sadness welled up in Lin Yuan's heart.
In this city full of competition, their state of life seemed so miserable.
He thought of his hometown, which was suffering from a severe drought.
Years of drought had cracked the land, and the farmers felt utterly dispirited facing the drought conditions.
A shortage of resources made that small village lifeless, and people's lives fell into a slump.
Lin Yuan felt like a tree withering in the drought, its vitality pitifully weak.
He fell into a long period of melancholy, struggling every day in moody emotions.
This depression was like a thick grey shadow, enveloping his entire world.
He began to become pessimistic, believing that life would never have a turning point.
He often felt sorrow in the dead of night, pained by his inability to protect his family.
This grief was infinitely magnified in the silence of the night, making it almost impossible for him to breathe.
He looked at himself in the mirror; his eyes were sunken, his face pale, and he looked quite ugly.
He felt his life was a lamentable farce, full of shameful compromises.
Whenever he thought of his former ambitions, he felt incredibly ashamed.
He felt the weak point of his life was being too soft and lacking the courage to resist.
By a chance opportunity, he tried to start a business again, but due to insufficient funds, he was at an absolute disadvantage.
He bought some shoddy raw materials to try to reduce costs, but as a result, the product quality was extremely poor.
This failure once again put him in a sorry state, with creditors shouting at his door.
He sat on the floor dejectedly, feeling an unprecedented sense of failure.
He was originally shy and reserved, but now he had become numb under the beatings of life.
When he tried to borrow money from a friend, the awkward atmosphere made the air freeze.
The friend's refusal made him discouraged; he realized he had lost all his social capital.
His heart was filled with a deep dismay, feeling that he was destined to be out of luck in this life.
He expressed deep regret to his wife because he had not been able to give her a complete home.
His wife held his hand, and although there was sadness in her eyes, there was still warmth.
However, Lin Yuan could not escape the loss of heart within, feeling that he had been abandoned by life.
His mental state wandered in a slump, unable to find any exit.
He felt his social status was low, like dust at the bottom of society.
Under this extreme oppression, he began to keep a diary, recording all his grief.
The words in the diary were messy, recording the mental journey of a failure.
He wrote that the most terrifying thing was not losing money, but losing hope for the future.
He realized that when facing hardships, people often fall into a cycle of self-denial.
This mindset made him even more fragile, and he always habitually shrank when facing challenges.
He remembered the days of running in the countryside as a child; the sky was blue then.
But now, his world only had this oppressive grey.
He closed his eyes, listening to the faint sound of the wind outside the window, his heart completely empty.
He didn't know if tomorrow would improve, but at this moment, he just wanted to sink into the darkness.
This was Lin Yuan's life, a cycle of loss and despair.

sentences.english: He bought some shoddy raw materials to try to reduce costs, but as a result, the product quality was extremely poor.

sentences.chinese: 这次失败让他再次陷入狼狈的境地，债主们在门前叫嚣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì shī bài ràng tā zài cì xiàn rù láng bèi de jìng dì, zhài zhǔ men zài mén qián jiào xiāo.
sentences.english: This failure once again put him in a sorry state, with creditors shouting at his door.

sentences.chinese: 他垂头丧气地坐在地板上，感觉到一种前所未有的挫败感。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chuí tóu sàng qì de zuò zài dì bǎn shàng, gǎn jué dào yī zhǒng qián suǒ wèi yǒu de cuò bài gǎn.
sentences.english: He sat on the floor dejectedly, feeling an unprecedented sense of failure.

sentences.chinese: 他原本害羞且内敛，如今却在生活的毒打下变得麻木。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yuán běn hài xiū qiě nèi liǎn, rù jīn què zài shēng huó de dú dǎ xià biàn de má mù.
sentences.english: He was originally shy and reserved, but now he had become numb under the beatings of life.

sentences.chinese: 当他试图向朋友借钱时，那种尴尬的氛围让空气都凝固了。
sentences.pinyin: Dāng tā shì tú xiàng péng yǒu jiè qián shí, nà zhǒng gān gà de fēn wéi ràng kōng qì dōu níng gù le.
sentences.english: When he tried to borrow money from a friend, the awkward atmosphere made the air freeze.

sentences.chinese: 朋友的拒绝让他感到气馁，他意识到自己已经失去了所有社交资本。
sentences.pinyin: Péng yǒu de jù jué ràng tā gǎn dào qì něi, tā yì shí dào zì jǐ yǐ jīng shī qù le suǒ yǒu shè jiāo zī běn.
sentences.english: The friend's refusal made him discouraged; he realized he had lost all his social capital.

sentences.chinese: 他心中充满了一种深深的沮丧，觉得自己这辈子注定倒霉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xīn zhōng chōng mǎn le yī zhǒng shēn shēn de jǔ sàng, jué de zì jǐ zhè bèi zi zhù dìng dǎo méi.
sentences.english: His heart was filled with a deep dismay, feeling that he was destined to be out of luck in this life.

sentences.chinese: 他向妻子表达了深深的歉意，因为他没能给她一个完整的家。

sentences.english: He expressed deep regret to his wife because he had not been able to give her a complete home.

sentences.chinese: 妻子握住他的手，眼神中虽然带着伤感，但依然有温情。

sentences.english: His wife held his hand, and although there was sadness in her eyes, there was still warmth.

sentences.chinese: 他的精神状态在低迷中徘徊，找不到任何出口。

sentences.english: But now, his world only had this oppressive grey.

sentences.chinese: 他不知道明天是否会好转，但此时此刻，他只想在黑暗中沉没。

sentences.english: He didn't know if tomorrow would improve, but at this moment, he just wanted to sink into the darkness.

sentences.chinese: 这就是林远的生活，一个关于失去与绝望的循环。

sentences.english: This was Lin Yuan's life, a cycle of loss and despair.

stories.story_chinese:
在城市最阴暗的巷弄深处，林先生经营着一家快要倒闭的旧书店。
这里不仅书籍紧缺，连基本的生存资源也显得匮乏。
林先生年近古稀，身体日益衰弱，呼吸间带着一种病态的虚弱。
他曾是一个学者，但如今在世人眼中，他只是一个彻头彻尾的输家。
他的生活陷入了长期的贫穷，账本上的赤字像一道道无法愈合的伤口。
他常常陷入苦恼，思考自己一生追求的真理是否仅仅是一场空梦。
有一天，一个年轻的商人走进了店里，眼神中充满了轻蔑。
商人看着那些发黄的纸页，冷冷地评价这里的氛围颓废且毫无价值。
林先生感到一阵难堪，他试图反驳，但声音却显得如此软弱。
面对对方的咄咄逼人，他心中涌起一种深深的胆怯。
他想起年轻时因为一次学术失误而遭受的耻辱，那成了他心中永远的烙印。
那种羞愧感在多年后依然清晰，让他面对他人时总觉得难为情。
商人在谈话中不断强调这个行业的负面影响，认为传统文化已经荒废。
林先生听着这些话，心中泛起一阵辛酸，仿佛在品尝某种苦涩的药剂。
他突然意识到，自己就像一个聋子，在喧嚣的时代里听不到真正的共鸣。
他面对镜子，看到自己脆弱的肩膀，意识到精神的崩塌比身体的衰老更可怕。
商人随口提到一份医疗报告中的阴性结果，以此类比书店毫无生机的情况。
林先生听后只能苦笑，这种无奈在寂静的空气中地久天长。
他意识到自己一直生活在自我否定地阴影之中，拒绝走出阴暗的角落。
然而，就在商人离开后，一个孩子在书架缝隙中发现了一本古籍。
孩子纯真的目光让林先生意识到，即便在最匮乏的土壤中，好奇心依然能生长。
他重新整理了书架，决定不再做一个被恐惧支配的弱者。
虽然生活依旧艰辛，但他终于在绝望中找到了一丝光亮。

stories.story_pinyin:
Zài chéng shì zuì yīn àn de xiàng lòng shēn chù, Lín xiān sheng jīng yíng zhe yī jiā kuài yào dǎo bì de jiù shū diàn.
Zhè lǐ bù jǐn shū jí jǐn quē, lián jī běn de shēng cún zī yuán yě xiǎn de kuì fá.
Lín xiān sheng nián jìn gǔ xī, shēn tǐ rì yì shuāi ruò, hū xī jiān dài zhe yī zhǒng bìng tài de xū ruò.
Tā céng shì yī gè xué zhě, dàn rú jīn zài shì rén yǎn zhōng, tā zhǐ shì yī gè chè tóu chè wěi de shū jiā.
Tā de shēng huó xiàn rù le cháng qī de pín qióng, zhàng běn shàng de chì zì xiàng yī dào dào wú fǎ yù hé de shāng kǒu.
Tā cháng cháng xiàn rù kǔ nǎo, sī kǎo zì jǐ yī shēng zhuī qiú de zhēn lǐ shì fǒu jǐn jǐn shì yī chǎng kōng mèng.
Yǒu yī tiān, yī gè nián qīng de shāng rén zǒu jìn le diàn lǐ, yǎn shén zhōng chōng mǎn le qīng miè.
Shāng rén kàn zhe nà xiē fā huáng de zhǐ yè, lěng lěng de píng jià zhè lǐ de fēn wéi tuí fèi qiě háo wú jià zhí.
Lín xiān sheng gǎn dào yī zhèn nán kān, tā shì tú fǎn bó, dàn shēng yīn què xiǎn de rú cǐ ruǎn ruò.
Miàn duì duì fāng de duō duō bī rén, tā xīn zhōng yǒng qǐ yī zhǒng shēn shēn de dǎn qiè.
Tā xiǎng qǐ nián qīng shí yīn wèi yī cì xué shù shī wù ér zāo shòu de chǐ rǔ, nà chéng le tā xīn zhōng yǒng yuǎn de lào yìn.
Nà zhǒng xiū kuì gǎn zài duō nián hòu yī rán qīng xī, ràng tā miàn duì tā rén shí zǒng jué de nán wéi qíng.
